Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to tell someone angrily that something they have done is wrong

examples.en: He's always bawling people out in meetings.
examples.trans: 他總是在會上訓斥別人。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: be all over bar the shouting
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If an activity is all over bar the shouting, the result of it is known, but it has not been officially finished or announced, so people can still say that a different result is possible.

examples.en: With practically all the results declared, the Nationalist Party has 68 percent of the vote, so it's all over bar the shouting.
examples.trans: 幾乎所有的結果已宣佈，國民黨贏得了68%的選票，看來選舉結果已成定局。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: be a game of two halves
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: UK used, especially in sports reports, to say that in a game of football, one team plays better in each half of the game
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （尤指在體育比賽的兩個半場中）雙方分別在上下半場佔優勢

examples.en: It really was a game of two halves, with Spurs dominating the first, only to be outplayed by Arsenal in the second.
examples.trans: 這確實是一場雙方各佔半場優勢的比賽，熱刺在上半場占主導地位，卻在下半場被兵工廠（阿仙奴）反制。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to not deserve any blame

examples.en: Your behaviour today has been above reproach.
examples.trans: 你今天的行為無可非議。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that you are all in, you mean that you are very tired and unable to do anything more.

examples.en: I'm going home now - I'm all in.
examples.trans: 我已經筋疲力盡了，現在要回家了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to talk a lot about doing something but never do it

examples.en: He says he's going to complain to the manager, but he's all mouth.
examples.trans: 他說他要向經理鳴不平，但我認為他不過是說說而已。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to be something that you do not want to say more about at this particular time

examples.en: When we finally got home, we found that we'd been burgled - but that's another story.
examples.trans: 我們好不容易到了家，卻發現家裡被盜了——這個現在就先甭提了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: be as good as your word
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to do everything that you promise someone you will

examples.en: He said he'd call every day and he was as good as his word.
examples.trans: 他說會每天打電話，結果真的沒有食言。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to be shy and not often express wishes or opinions

examples.en: I'm sure Matt will tell you what he thinks of the idea - he's not usually backward in coming forward.
examples.trans: 我相信馬特會告訴你他對於這個觀點的看法——他一向很直爽。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If something you say or write is close to the bone, it is close to the truth in a way that might offend some people.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （說話或寫文章）尖刻，入木三分

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to do or say something that causes someone pain because you believe that it will help them
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 雖讓人痛苦卻有所助益；忠言逆耳，苦口良藥

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say someone will die or have to stop doing something

examples.en: It'll be curtains for him if he doesn't do what I tell him!
examples.trans: 要是他不按我說的辦，他就完了！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: be damned if you do and damned if you don t
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you cannot escape being criticized, whatever you decide to do
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 左右都不是；兩頭都不討好

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to criticize someone

examples.en: It's not fair of the boss to be so down on a new employee.
examples.trans: 老闆這樣批評一位新員工有些不公平。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: be good and if you can t be good be careful
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone to enjoy themselves at an event or during an activity, but not to take risks
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 可以玩得盡興，但不可任性胡來。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: UK to criticize someone or something in a noisy and eager way

examples.en: The opposition was in full cry over the changes to the education bill.
examples.trans: 反對黨在大吵大嚷地批評對教育法案的修改。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If someone is in your face, they criticize you all the time.

examples.en: One of the managers is always in my face.
examples.trans: 有個經理總是對我諸多挑剔。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone that they should not be worried by a particular situation, because they will get an advantage from it

examples.en: If the loan's approved, you're laughing.
examples.trans: 如果這筆貸款批下來，你就不必發愁了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: be laughing on the other side of your face
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone that, despite being pleased now, they will not be pleased later when things do not happen as expected or planned
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 到時候就笑不出來了，得意變失意

examples.en: She's pleased with her promotion but she'll be laughing on the other side of her face when she sees the extra work.
examples.trans: 她很高興自己能獲得晉升，不過等她明白自己要多做不少工作時恐怕就笑不出來了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: be like a bear with a sore head
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to be in a bad mood that causes you to treat other people badly and complain a lot

examples.en: You're like a bear with a sore head this morning. What's wrong with you?
examples.trans: 你怎麼了？ 今天早上脾氣很暴躁。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to be so shocked, surprised, full of admiration, etc. that you cannot speak
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （因感到震驚、驚訝、震撼等）說不出話來

examples.en: Mary was lost for words when she was awarded the prize.
examples.trans: 瑪麗被授予該獎項的時候激動得說不出話來。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If a joke or remark is lost on someone, they do not understand it.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （笑話或評價）對（某人）沒有産生效果，未被（某人）理解

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say two people are meant for each other, you think they suit each other as romantic partners.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 天造地設，是天生的一對

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say when you give someone permission to do or use something

examples.en: "Can I try out your new bicycle?" "Be my guest."
examples.trans: 「我試騎一下你的新腳踏車可以嗎？」「騎吧。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: be no better than a sth
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that someone is no better than a person who is unpleasant or unkind, you mean that they have behaved in a similar way to this type of person.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 和…幾乎一樣，比…好不到哪裡去

examples.en: People who don't pay for a bus ticket are no better than common criminals.
examples.trans: 乘車逃票的人無異於作奸犯科。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: be no skin off sb s nose
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used when you want to say that it makes no difference to you what someone else does or thinks
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 與（某人）毫不相干；（某人）毫不在乎

examples.en: It's no skin off my nose if you don't take my advice.
examples.trans: 你就算不聽我的建議，我也一點不在乎。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say something is very easy

examples.en: Learning the game is easy - there's nothing to it.
examples.trans: 學會這項運動很容易——沒甚麼難的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: be nothing not much very little in it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when two things that are being compared are the same or very similar
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 毫無差別／相差不多／相差無幾

examples.en: One house has a slightly bigger garden, but there's really not much in it.
examples.trans: 有一間房子花園稍大一點，但其實沒有甚麼差別。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to criticize someone several times in an annoying way
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 多次找（某人）的麻煩；多次批評（某人）

examples.en: She's on my back again about those sales figures - I just haven't had a moment to do them.
examples.trans: 她又跟我嘮叨要那些銷售數據——我只是還抽不出時間整理。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to know someone well enough to talk to them

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: be on the tip of your tongue
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If something that you want to say is on the tip of your tongue, you think you know it and that you will be able to remember it very soon.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （想說的話）就在嘴邊（很快就會記起來）

examples.en: Her name is on the tip of my tongue.
examples.trans: 她的名字就在我的嘴邊，卻一時說不出來。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: You say that it is one thing after another/the other when many things are happening in a short time.

examples.en: I've been so busy today. It's been one thing after another.
examples.trans: 今天我忙得不可開交，事情一件接著一件。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to take the advice of someone
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 聽從（某人）的忠告；採納（某人）的建議

examples.en: If you're wise you'll be ruled by your father.
examples.trans: 你要是明智的話，就該聽從你父親的建議。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to be going further than the truth

examples.en: She's very smart, but it's stretching it to call her a genius.
examples.trans: 她很聰明，但說她是個天才就有點言過其實。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to be so surprised by something that you cannot say anything

examples.en: We were struck dumb when she announced she was pregnant.
examples.trans: 她宣佈懷孕的消息時，我們都驚得目瞪口呆。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that something is now more popular or fashionable than the thing that it replaces

examples.en: This season fashion designers have declared that brown is the new black.
examples.trans: 本季時裝設計師們宣稱棕色比黑色更加流行。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to be something, especially something you say, that other people will remember you for
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （尤指某人說的某些話）會讓人永遠記住（某人 ）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: be your own person woman man
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to be in control of your life and not allow other people to tell you what to do
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 獨立自主；自己做主，自己拿主意

examples.en: Nobody tells me how to live my life - I'm my own man.
examples.trans: 沒人能告訴我該怎樣生活——我自有主張。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to complain to someone again and again about their behaviour or to ask them to do something
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 一再催促（某人）；向（某人）嘮叨

examples.en: My parents are always on at us about having a baby.
examples.trans: 我父母老是催促我們生孩子。

examples.en: She's been on at me to get my hair cut.
examples.trans: 她嘮叨著催促我去理髮。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to support the truth of something

examples.en: His version of events just isn't borne out by the facts.
examples.trans: 他對事件的說法並未得到證實。

examples.en: If you tell them what happened I will bear you out (on it).
examples.trans: 如果你告訴他們所發生的事，我會為你作證的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: beard the lion in his her den
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to visit an important person in order to tell or ask them something unpleasant
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 太歲頭上動土；老虎嘴裡拔牙

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to persuade someone to accept a lower amount of money for something

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to make someone say things they do not want to by hitting them

examples.en: The men claimed that the police had beaten the confession out of them.
examples.trans: 這些人聲稱，他們的供詞是警方刑訊期間逼供出來的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to escape or avoid blame or punishment

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to criticize someone unfairly

examples.en: Kids used to beat up on him after school.
examples.trans: 以前那些孩子放學後常常打他。

examples.en: She didn’t like being beaten up on by the press.
examples.trans: 在媒體上受到不公正的抨擊，她很不高興。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to blame or criticize yourself, usually in a way that is unfair or unnecessary

examples.en: If you fail, don't beat yourself up; just try again.
examples.trans: 如果你失敗了，不要過分怪罪自己，大不了再試試。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: beauty is in the eye of the beholder
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to express the fact that not all people have the same opinions about what is attractive

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to lie down somewhere, usually somewhere different from where you usually sleep, in order to go to sleep

examples.en: I bedded down on the couch for the night.
examples.trans: 我晚上睡在沙發上。

examples.en: It did not take the procedure long to bed down.
examples.trans: 這個程序不久就開始生效了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that someone is wearing beer goggles, you mean that that person has been drinking so much alcohol that they think someone is more sexually attractive than they really are.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 啤酒效應（指因飲酒過度而將某人想像得比真實更加性感）

examples.en: She looked pretty hot to me but maybe I had my beer goggles on.
examples.trans: 她看起來性感迷人，但也有可能只是我的啤酒效應。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: before you can say jack robinson
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that something happens very quickly

examples.en: Before you could say Jack Robinson, she'd jumped into the car and driven away.
examples.trans: 一眨眼的功夫，她已經跳上汽車開走了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to talk about something as if it were true, even though it may not be
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 以假定作為論據來辯論

examples.en: Spending the summer travelling around India is a great idea, but it does beg the question of how we can afford it.
examples.trans: 到印度去旅行過夏天當然是個好主意，但關鍵問題是我們如何能負擔得起。

examples.en: To discuss the company's future begs the question of whether it has a future.
examples.trans: 要討論這間公司的前途問題，不得不問一句：這間公司還有前途嗎？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you recognize that you must accept an offer or a situation because it is the only one available to you
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 要飯的哪能挑肥揀瘦；別無選擇

examples.en: I would have preferred a house of my own rather than sharing, but beggars can't be choosers, I suppose.
examples.trans: 我比較喜歡獨住而不是跟別人住在一起，可是我怎麼可以挑三揀四的，是吧。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: believe sth when you see it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say you will believe something when you see it, you mean you think it will not happen.

examples.en: "Hetty says she'll be here on time." "I'll believe that when I see it."
examples.trans: 「赫蒂說她七點鐘會來這裡。」「除非我親眼見到，否則我是不會相信的。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: very informal used to tell someone to stop talking or making a noise

examples.en: Just belt up, will you! I'm trying to concentrate.
examples.trans: 你閉口！我正在思考。

examples.en: Don't forget, belt up before you drive off.
examples.trans: 別忘了開車前繫好安全帶。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: an exercise in which you lie on a bench and lift a heavy weight with both your arms

examples.en: His exercise routine consisted of bench presses and squats.
examples.trans: 他以仰臥推舉和深蹲作為鍛煉途徑。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you think that it is better for someone or something to be late than never to arrive or to happen
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 晚來總比不來強；遲做總比不做好

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: better the devil you know than the devil you don t
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you think it is wiser to deal with someone or something familiar, although you do not like him, her, or it, than to deal with someone or something you do not know that might be worse
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 寧可跟熟悉的魔鬼打交道；明槍易躲，暗箭難防

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: between you me and the gatepost
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: an expression used to tell someone that what you are about to say should be kept secret
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 「你我私下說說」，「不要告訴別人」（用於表達希望對話內容不要外洩）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: mainly UK If something is beyond a joke, it has stopped being funny and is now a serious matter.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 超出開玩笑的限度；令人極為難堪（或氣憤）

examples.en: I used to think he was funny, but his behaviour has now gone way beyond a joke.
examples.trans: 我曾經以為他滑稽有趣，但他現在所做的已不是開玩笑的問題了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: someone who tries in a forceful or enthusiastic way to persuade other people to believe in the Christian religion and the Bible

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you do not think that what someone has said or done is important or special

examples.en: "I ran five miles this morning." "Big deal! I ran ten."
examples.trans: 「今天早上我跑了五英里。」「沒甚麼了不起！我跑了十英里。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If someone is or has a big mouth, they often say things that are meant to be kept secret.

examples.en: He is/has such a big mouth.
examples.trans: 他太多嘴了。

examples.en: He went and opened his big mouth and told them the whole story.
examples.trans: 他去了，並且多嘴多舌地把整件事告訴了他們。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to talk a lot about how excellent someone or something is, sometimes praising him, her, or it more than is deserved

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to force someone to keep a promise

examples.en: His sister had been bound to secrecy.
examples.trans: 他妹妹被迫承諾保守秘密。

examples.en: We are bound to the original contract.
examples.trans: 我們都要遵守原本的合約。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: birds of a feather flock together
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said about people who have similar characters or interests, especially ones of which you disapprove, and who often spend time with each other

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say to someone that they have made you feel angry or embarrassed

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to speak to someone in a quick, angry way, for no good reason
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 無緣無故地對…發火，莫名其妙地對…發脾氣

examples.en: I only asked if I could help - there's no need to bite my head off!
examples.trans: 我只是問一下我能否幫上忙——沒必要無緣無故地對我發火！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to stop yourself from saying something that you would really like to say

examples.en: I wanted to tell him exactly what I thought of him, but I had to bite my tongue.
examples.trans: 我本想明確告訴他我對他的看法，但是不得不保持沉默。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: bite snap sb s head off
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to speak to someone angrily

examples.en: I asked what was wrong, but he just bit my head off.
examples.trans: 我問他出了甚麽事，可是他卻向我大吼大叫。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said about someone, especially an adult, when you are pretending that you like them
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 談到某人（尤指成人）時的用語（在假裝喜歡該人時使用）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say to a person who has just sneezed
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （在某人打噴嚏時説）大吉大利！

examples.en: "Here, let me help you with your shopping." "Oh, bless you, dear."
examples.trans: 「來，我來幫你拿買的東西吧。」「哦，上帝保佑你，親愛的。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say to tell someone you are grateful to them when they have been kind to you

examples.en: "Here, let me help you with your shopping." "Oh, bless you, dear."
examples.trans: 「來，我來幫你拿買的東西吧。」「哦，上帝保佑你，親愛的。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to express the common belief that men are more attracted to women with blonde hair and give them more attention

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: When an argument blows over, it becomes gradually less important until it ends and is forgotten.

examples.en: I thought that after a few days the argument would blow over.
examples.trans: 我覺得過幾天這場爭論就會逐漸平息。

examples.en: The storm raged all night but by morning it had blown over.
examples.trans: 暴風雨肆虐了一整夜，但到第二天早上就平息了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to make known secret information about who someone is and what they are doing
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 暴露…的身份；揭發…的秘密活動

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to make known a secret

examples.en: He's a good bloke - he wouldn't blow the gaff on us.
examples.trans: 他是個好人——不會洩露我們的秘密。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: blow the whistle on sb sth
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to tell people publicly about something bad that someone is doing
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 叫停，取締（壞事）；（尤指）告發，揭發

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a sudden argument

examples.en: My dad blew up (at me) when he saw the bill.
examples.trans: 我爸爸看到帳單後（對我）大發雷霆。

examples.en: a blow-up mattress/pillow
examples.trans: 充氣床墊/枕頭

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to tell everyone proudly about your achievements

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: blow take the lid off sth
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to cause something bad that was previously kept secret to be known by the public

examples.en: In 1989 they started an investigation that was to blow the lid off corruption in the police force.
examples.trans: 1989年他們開始調查，意圖揭露員警隊伍中的腐敗現象。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone to go away

examples.en: Bog off and leave me alone.
examples.trans: 走開，別管我。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a phrase, originally from French, meaning "good appetite", said to someone who is about to eat, meaning "I hope you enjoy your food"
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 祝你好胃口（餐前祝福語）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a prize given as a joke to the person who finishes last in a competition
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （作為玩笑頒發給比賽最後一名的）末名奬

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a group of people who meet regularly to talk about a book that they have all read
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 參加讀書俱樂部的一群人；書友

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say that you have arrived and sign an official book when you get to a hotel

examples.en: After booking into our hotel, we went straight down to the beach.
examples.trans: 登記入住飯店後，我們就直接去了海灘。

examples.en: As soon as she arrived in Tokyo, she booked in at her hotel.
examples.trans: 她一到東京就登記入住了飯店。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that someone was born and grew up in a particular place, and has the typical character of someone who lives there

examples.en: He's a Parisian born and bred.
examples.trans: 他是土生土長的巴黎人。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: When a person bottles things up, they refuse to talk about things that make them angry or worried.

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: sometimes said by people in a friendly way just before drinking an alcoholic drink together

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you bounce something off someone, you tell someone about an idea or plan in order to find out what they think of it.

examples.en: Can I bounce a couple of ideas off you?
examples.trans: 我可以跟你交流幾個想法嗎？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to stop people fighting

examples.en: Break it up, you two!
examples.trans: 你們倆別打了！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to tell other people about something

examples.en: Don't say a word about the accident to my mother.
examples.trans: 關於這場事故，一點都別告訴我媽媽。

examples.en: If you breathe a word of this to anyone, I'll be really upset.
examples.trans: 如果你把這件事透露任何一點給別人，我都會非常生氣。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to persuade someone to have the same opinion as you have

examples.en: I gave him a sniff of smelling salts to bring him around.
examples.trans: 我給他聞嗅鹽讓他甦醒。

examples.en: At first they refused but I managed to bring them around (to my way of thinking).
examples.trans: 起初他們拒絶了，但我後來還是説服了他們。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: brown green etc is the new black
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that something is the most popular or fashionable colour or thing at the moment
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 棕色（綠色等）是時下的流行色

examples.en: Designers say that brown is the new black.
examples.trans: 設計師說棕色是時下流行的顏色。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to walk quickly past someone, usually because you do not want to speak to them

examples.en: Ignoring their protests, Newman brushed past the waiting reporters.
examples.trans: 紐曼不顧守候記者的抗議，從他們身邊徑直走過。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to refuse to consider something seriously because you feel that it is not important

examples.en: She brushed their objections aside, saying "Leave it to me."
examples.trans: 她對他們的反對置之不理，説道：「交給我吧。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to refuse to listen to what someone says, or to refuse to think about something seriously

examples.en: He just brushed off all their criticisms.
examples.trans: 他對他們的一切批評都置之不理。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to refuse to follow the rules of an organization

examples.en: Alex is always looking for ways to buck the system.
examples.trans: 亞歷克斯總是想方設法抗拒現行制度。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to someone in order to ask them to move so that there is room for you

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to show that you do not think what someone has done or said is very exciting or interesting

examples.en: "He's started ironing his own shirts." "Well, bully for him!"
examples.trans: 「他開始自己熨襯衫了。」「哦，那可真不錯！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a piece of bad advice

examples.en: He gave us a bum steer about that restaurant - it was terrible!
examples.trans: 他替我們出了個餿主意，讓我們去那家餐廳——太難吃了！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to stop an argument and become friends again

examples.en: Can't you two just bury the hatchet?
examples.trans: 你們倆難道就不能言歸於好嗎？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: bury have your head in the sand
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to refuse to think about unpleasant facts, although they will have an influence on your situation
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 逃避現實，不願意面對現實

examples.en: You've got to face facts here - you can't just bury your head in the sand.
examples.trans: 在這裡你必須面對現實——你不能逃避。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to emphasize that you believe work is more important than entertainment and enjoyment
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於強調重要性）事業在先，享樂在後。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a serious argument, especially one that ends a relationship
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （尤指導致關係破裂的）激烈爭吵

examples.en: They busted up last year.
examples.trans: 他們去年鬧翻了。

examples.en: She had a big bust-up with her brother-in-law.
examples.trans: 她與姐夫大吵了一架。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say nothing or stop talking

examples.en: He didn't want to get into a fight, so he decided to button his lip.
examples.trans: 他不願意捲入一場爭執，於是決定保持緘默。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone to go away in a rude way

examples.en: I've got some stuff to do at home, so I'm going to buzz off now.
examples.trans: 我家裡有些事要做，所以我現在得走了。

examples.en: Buzz off, I'm busy!
examples.trans: 滾開，我很忙！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to express surprise

examples.en: By gum, he's a big lad!
examples.trans: 好傢夥，他塊頭真大啊！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: not directly, by hearing what other people say

examples.en: The two men know each other only by reputation.
examples.trans: 這兩個人只是彼此聽說過。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that situations of that type happen in life, and you cannot do anything about them
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 生活就是如此，這就是生活

examples.en: I can't go to the game on Saturday - I've got to work. Oh well, c'est la vie.
examples.trans: 週六我不能去看比賽——我得去上班。哎，這就是生活。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say something in a loud voice

examples.en: He used to call out in his sleep.
examples.trans: 他过去经常在睡梦中大声呼叫。

examples.en: Don't just call the answers out - raise your hand.
examples.trans: 不要大声喊出答案，先举手。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say the truth about something, even if it is not polite or pleasant

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: informal to criticize someone or ask them to explain their actions

examples.en: We had to call out a doctor.
examples.trans: 我们不得不请一位医生来。

examples.en: The government called the army out to deal with violent disorder on the streets.
examples.trans: 政府请来了军队对付街头骚乱。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to make someone prove that what they are saying is true, or to make someone prove that they will really do what they say, because you do not believe them

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say clearly what your intentions are

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a television or radio programme in which members of the public call to express their opinions or ask questions
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （電臺或電視臺的）來電直播節目

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: can take it or leave it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said about something that you like, but that you do not love or need strongly
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 要不要都可以；接不接受都可以

examples.en: My sister's absolutely crazy about chocolate whereas I can take it or leave it.
examples.trans: 我妹妹酷愛巧克力，而我吃不吃都無所謂。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: can t do sth to save your life
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to mean that you are extremely bad at doing something
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 完全做不好；怎麽也做不了

examples.en: I can't draw to save my life.
examples.trans: 我完全不會畫畫。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: can t get your head around sth
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that you can't get your head around something, you mean that you cannot understand it.

examples.en: I just can't get my head around these tax forms.
examples.trans: 我看不懂這些納稅表格。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you do not understand why people think something is good, or that you do not agree
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用來表示不明白為什麼其他人認為…好）我就不覺得

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: recordings of laughter that have been added to a humorous radio or television programme when something funny has been said or done
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （廣播或電視節目的）預錄笑聲；罐頭笑聲

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to take the blame or responsibility for something that is wrong or has not succeeded
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 承受指責，承擔責任，揹黑鍋

examples.en: As usual, I was left to carry the can.
examples.trans: 像往常一樣，就剩下我來承擔責任。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that someone has got a good part in a film or play by using the casting couch, you mean that they had sex with the person who was choosing the actors in order to get the part.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 上床，肉體交易（指演員為獲得某個角色而與有決定權的人發生性關係）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: catch sb with their pants trousers down
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to discover someone doing something that they want to keep secret, usually something sexual
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 撞見…做見不得人的事（通常指苟且之事）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: catch sb with their pants trousers down
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to ask someone unexpectedly to do or say something that they are not prepared for

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a mistake in which something is said or believed to be in one category (= group) when in fact it belongs to another
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 範疇錯誤（認為某一事物屬於某一範疇，實屬另一範疇）

examples.en: To treat atheism as a belief system alongside varieties of religious belief is simply a category mistake.
examples.trans: 把無神論視為一種信仰，等同於各種宗教，是一種範疇錯誤。

examples.en: It is a category mistake to talk about a research programme as being falsified, because only theories can be falsified - research programmes can at most be discredited.
examples.trans: 如果認為研究專題可以被證明是虛假的，這就犯了一種範疇錯誤，因為只有理論可能是虛假的，研究專題只能被推翻其可信度。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a mistake in which something is said to have a particular quality, or be able to do a particular thing, that only members of another category (= group) of things can have or do
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 範疇錯誤（認為某一事物具有某些特質或可做出某些行為，實際上這些特質和行為屬於另一範疇的事物）

examples.en: To treat atheism as a belief system alongside varieties of religious belief is simply a category mistake.
examples.trans: 把無神論視為一種信仰，等同於各種宗教，是一種範疇錯誤。

examples.en: It is a category mistake to talk about a research programme as being falsified, because only theories can be falsified - research programmes can at most be discredited.
examples.trans: 如果認為研究專題可以被證明是虛假的，這就犯了一種範疇錯誤，因為只有理論可能是虛假的，研究專題只能被推翻其可信度。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: chance would be a fine thing
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you would very much like something to happen but there is no possibility that it will
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 可惜沒有機會，要是有機會就好了

examples.en: "You should relax a bit more." "Chance would be a fine thing."
examples.trans: 「你應該再放鬆一點。」「要是能這樣就好了。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a remark that someone makes to another person to make their sexual interest known to that person and start a conversation
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （與對自己有性吸引力的人）調情的話，搭訕的話

examples.en: "Have you been here before?" "That's one of the oldest chat-up lines I've ever heard!"
examples.trans: 「你以前來過這裡嗎？」「這是我所聽過的最老套的搭訕之一。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to tell someone angrily that they have done something wrong

examples.en: The coach chewed his team out for playing so badly.
examples.trans: 教練責備球隊表現太差。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to think about or discuss something carefully for a long time

examples.en: I've been chewing the problem over since last week.
examples.trans: 從上個星期我就一直在仔細考慮這個問題。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to talk with someone in an informal and friendly way

examples.en: We sat in a bar most of the evening just chewing the fat.
examples.trans: 那天晚上大部分時間我們坐在酒吧裡聊天。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: children should be seen and not heard
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to emphasize that you think children should behave well and be quiet

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to interrupt or speak in a conversation, usually to agree with what has been said
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 插話（通常表示贊同），附和

examples.en: "It's very difficult," I said. "Impossible," she chimed in.
examples.trans: 我說：「太難了。」「根本不可能，」她附和道。

examples.en: Andy chimed in with his view of the situation.
examples.trans: 安迪插進話來，談了自己對形勢的看法。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a fault in someone's character or an argument that may cause problems for them
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （某人性格或論點中的）弱點，缺陷，薄弱環節

examples.en: A single chink in our armour at the negotiating table means we could lose out badly.
examples.trans: 在談判桌上的任何一點漏洞都意味著我們可能會慘敗。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a way of paying for goods and services using a credit card and a secret number instead of a signature
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 智慧卡付款系統（指使用信用卡與個人密碼的支付方式）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to interrupt a conversation in order to say something
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 插嘴，插話；打斷別人的話

examples.en: I'll start and you can all chip in with your comments.
examples.trans: 我現在開始，你們隨時都可以插話發表意見。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: informal conversation about matters that are not important

examples.en: "What did you talk about?" "Oh, just chit-chat."
examples.trans: 「你們在談甚麽？」「噢，閒聊而已。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone to hurry

examples.en: Come on, chop-chop, we're late!
examples.trans: 趕快，趕快，我們要遲到了！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: an organization in the UK that gives people free advice about their problems

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: the act by a group of people of refusing to obey laws or pay taxes, as a peaceful way of expressing their disapproval of those laws or taxes and in order to persuade the government to change them
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 非暴力反抗；不合作主義

examples.en: Gandhi and Martin Luther King both led campaigns of civil disobedience to try to persuade the authorities to change their policies.
examples.trans: 甘地和馬丁‧路德‧金都領導過非暴力抵抗運動，試圖說服當局改變政策。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say that you are morally better than someone else
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 自稱道德高尚，自我標榜比別人道德高尚

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to become silent suddenly, usually because you are embarrassed or nervous, or do not want to talk about a particular subject
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （通常指因為尷尬、緊張或不願談論某一話題而突然）沉默不語，閉口不言，拒不開口

examples.en: He just clams up if you ask him about his childhood.
examples.trans: 要是你問起他的童年，他就乾脆不說話了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone to go away in a rude way

examples.en: "Clear off or I'll call the police!"
examples.trans: 「快走開，不然我報警了。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to change your opinion or admit that you were wrong

examples.en: The government has been forced to climb down over the issue of increased taxes.
examples.trans: 政府在加稅問題上被迫讓步。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to refuse to stop believing or hoping for something
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 堅持，保持，死死抱住（信念或希望）

examples.en: She clings to the hope that her husband will come back to her.
examples.trans: 她堅信丈夫一定會回到自己身邊。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that someone almost succeeded, but is not completely successful or correct

examples.en: It was close but no cigar for Johnny as he came second once again.
examples.trans: 強尼又得了第二名，真遺憾，差一點就成功了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to describe someone who has not heard or understood what is being said to them
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 聽覺不靈的，聽不到的；沒聽懂的

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: the person who a married person is said to have committed adultery (= sex outside marriage) with
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （與他人配偶通姦的）共同被告

examples.en: He was cited/named as co-respondent in the divorce.
examples.trans: 他作爲該離婚案的共同被告被傳訊。

examples.en: Compare
examples.trans: respondent

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a special word or name that is used instead of the real name of someone or something to keep the real name secret

examples.en: Her code name is "Running Bear".
examples.trans: 她的代號是「奔跑的熊」。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a word or sign with a special meaning, or a word used to keep something secret

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: an occasion when people meet socially to talk and drink coffee

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a social event where people meet to talk, drink coffee, and eat cakes, often giving money to a charity or other organization
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （常為募捐而舉行的）咖啡早茶會

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to someone with cold hands in order to stop them from being embarrassed
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 手涼心熱；外表冷淡心腸熱

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to fall down heavily and lie on the ground without moving

examples.en: The woman staggered and collapsed in a heap.
examples.trans: 那個女人踉蹌倒地，蜷曲成一團。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to tell the truth about something that you have been keeping secret

examples.en: I thought it was time to come clean (with everybody) about what I'd been doing.
examples.trans: 我認為是時候了，該（向大家）說清楚我一直在做些甚麼。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to punish or criticize a person or activity very strongly

examples.en: They're coming down heavily on people for not paying their licence fees.
examples.trans: 他們對不繳納執照費的人處以重罰。

examples.en: The authorities plan to come down hard on truancy in future.
examples.trans: 當局計劃將來嚴懲翹課者。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that you will do something come hell or high water, you mean that you are determined to do it, despite any difficulties that there might be.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 無論有甚麼困難，不管怎樣

examples.en: I'll get you to the airport by noon, come hell or high water!
examples.trans: 不論有甚麼困難，我都會在中午前把你送到機場！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone that you do not believe what they are saying is true, or that you strongly disagree with them
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 誰信呢！得了吧！別胡說了！別瞎扯了！

examples.en: Ask Simon to cook the meal? Come off it, he can hardly boil an egg!
examples.trans: 叫西蒙去做飯？別瞎扯了，他連煮個雞蛋都不會！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to tell your family, friends, or the public that you are gay, after previously keeping this secret

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you come out of your shell, you become more interested in other people and more willing to talk and take part in social activities, and if someone brings you out of your shell, they cause you to do this.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （使）變得不再自閉，（使）融入外部世界

examples.en: Derek has really come out of his shell since he started working here.
examples.trans: 自從開始在這裡工作以後，德里克真正變得活躍起來。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say something suddenly and unexpectedly

examples.en: He comes out with the strangest things!
examples.trans: 他會突然說些再奇怪不過的話！

examples.en: She comes out with some good ideas though.
examples.trans: 不過，她倒是會出一些好主意。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a remark that someone makes to another person to make their sexual interest known to that person and start a conversation

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a room in a school or college where students or teachers can sit together and talk when they are not working
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （學校或大學師生的）公共休息室

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you will do a particular task immediately

examples.en: "Could you give me a copy of this page, please?" "Consider it done."
examples.trans: 「您能給我一份這一頁的影印件嗎？」「馬上給你。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a belief that an unpleasant event or situation is the result of a secret plan made by powerful people

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a system in which the king or queen's power is severely limited, because they act only on the advice of the politicians who form the government

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a remark that stops the natural flow of the conversation because it is unexpected and in some way causes embarrassment or shock
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （因導致尷尬或驚訝而）打斷談話的言論

examples.en: When she told us her son was in prison, it was a real conversation-stopper.
examples.trans: 當她告訴我們她兒子入獄了之後，大家都停止了談話。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to write something that someone has said or written so that you can remember it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 把…記錄下來；把…抄寫下來

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say you could murder a type of food or drink, it means you would like very much to have it now.

examples.en: I could murder a cup of tea!
examples.trans: 我現在就想喝杯茶！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you would like something

examples.en: I could use some help putting these decorations up if you're not too busy.
examples.trans: 你如果不太忙的話，我想請你幫忙把這些裝飾品掛起來。

examples.en: "Can I get you anything?" "Thanks. I could use a drink."
examples.trans: 「我能給你拿點什麼？」「謝謝，我需要一點飲料。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that something or someone needs something

examples.en: I could use some help putting these decorations up if you're not too busy.
examples.trans: 你如果不太忙的話，我想請你幫忙把這些裝飾品掛起來。

examples.en: "Can I get you anything?" "Thanks. I could use a drink."
examples.trans: 「我能給你拿點什麼？」「謝謝，我需要一點飲料。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say you couldn't agree more/less, you mean you completely agree/disagree.

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that you couldn't agree/disagree more, you mean that you agree/disagree completely.

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: couldn t organize a piss up in a brewery
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said about someone who is completely unable to organize things
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 小事也安排不好，連一點小事也辦不了

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: an argument against another argument, idea, or suggestion

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to do something to protect yourself from blame or criticism in the future
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （做某事以）保護自己的利益，不讓別人抓住痛腳

examples.en: He'd do anything to cover his ass, including lie, cheat, and murder.
examples.trans: 為了保護自己他會不擇手段，包括撒謊、欺騙，乃至殺人。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: UK offensive to talk for a long time in a boring way

examples.en: I had to listen to Mikey crapping on about his music collection.
examples.trans: 我不得不聽米奇沒完沒了地胡扯他的音樂收藏品。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to admit that you were wrong and ask someone to forgive you or ask them for something that you were offered and refused in the past

examples.en: Don't come crawling back to me when she throws you out!
examples.trans: 等她拋棄你時，別跑回來求我原諒！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: crawl go retreat retire into your shell
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to become less interested in other people and less willing to talk and take part in social activities

examples.en: The more they tried to get her to talk about her experiences, the further she retreated back into her shell.
examples.trans: 他們越是想讓她談談自己的經歷，她越是沈默寡言。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: create kick up raise a stink
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to make a strong public complaint
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 公开抗议；製造事端；滋事；起哄

examples.en: She created a stink about the lack of recycling facilities in the town.
examples.trans: 她因城中缺乏廢物回收設施而公开抗议。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say that someone is responsible for something good

examples.en: I had credited them with more integrity than they showed.
examples.trans: 我原以為他們很正直，其實不然。

examples.en: She is credited with making the business a success.
examples.trans: 公司的成功歸功於她。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to emphasize that you believe criminals are always punished for their crimes

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: cross my heart and hope to die
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to show that what you have just said or promised is completely true or sincere
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 我發誓所說屬實（否則不得好死）。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: cross sb s hand palm with silver
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to give someone money so that they will tell you what will happen to you in the future

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to have an argument with someone

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to complain loudly about something that you do not approve of

examples.en: Women's rights groups have cried out against the proposed cut in benefit paid to single mothers.
examples.trans: 婦女權益團體對減少單身母親的救濟金的提議表示強烈反對。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to sit or lie very close to someone and put your arms around them

examples.en: We cuddled up together and tried to get warm.
examples.trans: 我們擠在一起，想借此取暖。

examples.en: She cuddled up to her mother.
examples.trans: 她依偎在母親身旁。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: at the third highest level of the special levels of achievement in a person's studies at a US college or university. The expression comes from Latin, meaning "with praise".
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （拉丁語）以優等成績畢業（美國大學優等學位榮譽中的第三等）

examples.en: Ninety three students graduated cum laude.
examples.trans: 九十三名學生以優等成績畢業。

examples.en: a cum laude qualification
examples.trans: 優等畢業證書

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to warn someone not to ask too many questions about something
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 好奇害死貓，過於好奇會惹禍上身

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to sit or lie in a position with your arms and legs close to your body

examples.en: She curled up on the sofa to watch TV.
examples.trans: 她蜷縮在沙發上看電視。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that something such as a piece of writing is not original, but includes parts of other people's work

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say something cuts both/two ways, you think it has both a good and a bad side.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 是把雙刃劍；有好也有壞，利弊互見

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to stop people from continuing a phone conversation by breaking the phone connection
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 掛斷…的電話；使…電話掉線

examples.en: We got cut off before she could give me directions.
examples.trans: 她還沒給我指示我們的電話就斷掉了。

examples.en: I'm glad the bartender cut Tommy off - he's already had too much to drink.
examples.trans: 我很高興酒保不再賣酒給湯米——他已經喝多了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to talk about or deal with the important parts of a subject and not waste time with things that are not important
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 開門見山；直接切入主題

examples.en: I didn't have long to talk so I cut to the chase and asked whether he was still married.
examples.trans: 我的時間不多，所以就開門見山地問他是否還是已婚。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: cut your coat according to your cloth
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to emphasize that someone should do as well as possible with the limited money they have

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you dam up your feelings, especially anger or sadness, you do not allow yourself to express or show your feelings in a healthy way.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 不健康地壓抑，鬱積（情緒，尤其是憤怒、悲傷等）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to praise someone so slightly that it suggests you do not really admire them
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 有些口是心非地讚許…；對…明褒實眨

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: UK a person who keeps their interests and ideas secret, especially someone who has a surprising ability or skill
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 不愛張揚的人；（尤指）深藏不露的人

examples.en: Anna's such a dark horse - I had no idea she'd published a novel.
examples.trans: 安娜可真是深藏不露——我一點兒都不知道她已經出版了一本小說。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you look at someone or speak to someone de haut en bas, you do it in a way that shows you think you are superior to them. De haut en bas is French for "from high to low".
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （法語）從上到下；態度傲慢地，居高臨下地

examples.en: She looked at me de haut en bas and asked "And where do you come from?"
examples.trans: 她傲慢地看著我，問道：「那麼你是哪裡人？」

examples.en: He had a very de haut en bas approach to teaching.
examples.trans: 他秉持一種居高臨下的教學方式。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that someone is like a modern version of a person from the past. De nos jours is French for "of our days".

examples.en: Justin Bieber - an Elvis Presley de nos jours
examples.trans: 賈斯汀·比伯——當代的艾維斯·普雷斯利

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: People who are dead cannot tell secrets.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 只有死人才會保守秘密

examples.en: I think they killed him because he knew too much. Dead men tell no tales.
examples.trans: 我認為他們把他殺了是因為他知道的太多了。只有死人才不會亂說話。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a person who can neither hear nor speak

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to allow someone or something to make decisions for you or tell you what to do because of your respect for them or because of their higher rank, authority, knowledge, etc.

examples.en: I have to defer to my boss on important decisions.
examples.trans: 在重大決策上，我必須聽從老闆的意見。

examples.en: I defer to (= accept) your judgment.
examples.trans: 我同意你的判斷。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: someone who pretends, in an argument or discussion, to be against an idea or plan that a lot of people support, in order to make people discuss and consider it in more detail
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 假意反對的人，故意唱反調的人

examples.en: I don't really believe all that - I was just playing devil's advocate.
examples.trans: 我並不完全相信那些——我只是故意唱反調而已。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to tell someone what to do

examples.en: Why should anyone dictate to parents on how to raise their children?
examples.trans: 為什麼父母要讓人對他們怎麼養大孩子指手畫腳？

examples.en: I will not be dictated to like that!
examples.trans: 我不願意那樣受人擺布！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to refuse to change your plans or ideas, especially when someone is trying to persuade you to do so
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （尤指不顧他人勸說）堅持己見，一意孤行

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to write or speak about a subject for a long time

examples.en: He likes to dilate upon what he thinks is wrong with the world.
examples.trans: 他喜歡滔滔不絕地談他眼中的世界問題所在。
