Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say something forcefully and repeatedly to someone so that they remember it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 向…反覆強調，對…反覆告誡

examples.en: It was dinned into me that I could never be late.
examples.trans: 我被反覆告誡千萬不要遲到。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said, especially by children, to represent the sound of a bell
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 丁零零（擬鈴鐺聲，尤為兒語）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: When you use direct speech, you repeat what someone has said using exactly the words they used.

examples.en: She said, "If it rains, I won't go out." is an example of the use of direct speech.
examples.trans: 「她說，『如果下雨我就不出去了』」就是使用直接引語的一個例子。

examples.en: Compare
examples.trans: indirect speech

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: discretion is the better part of valour
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you believe it is wise to be careful and avoid unnecessary risks

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to give or say things to people without thinking about them carefully

examples.en: A good doctor listens to the patient rather than just dishing out drugs. He's very keen to dish out criticism.
examples.trans: 他非常熱衷於發表批評意見。

examples.en: He’s mad at me for teasing him – he can dish it out, but he can’t take it!
examples.trans: 他非常生氣我取笑他­——他可以這樣對別人，卻受不了別人這樣對他。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to make it publicly known that you are not in any way connected to, or responsible for someone or something, often to avoid blame or embarrassment

examples.en: Most party members are keen to dissociate themselves from the extremists.
examples.trans: 大多數黨員都急於表明自己與極端分子沒有任何瓜葛。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: do as you would be done by
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to show that you believe in treating others as you would like them to treat you

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say in answer to a stupid and impossible suggestion
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於回答荒謬的建議）得了吧！

examples.en: "Why don't you tell the police what happened?" "Oh, do me a favour!"
examples.trans: 「你為甚麼不告訴員警發生了甚麼事？」「噢，得了吧！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to secretly tell someone in authority that someone else has done something wrong

examples.en: Who was it who dobbed me in (to the teacher)?
examples.trans: 誰（向老師）打我的小報告了？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: does a bear do bears shit in the woods
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that the answer to a question you have just been asked is obviously "yes"

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone that you think something is unlikely to be true or to happen

examples.en: "Do you think they'll give me back the money they owe me?" "I wouldn't bet on it."
examples.trans: 「你認為他們會把欠我的錢還給我嗎？」「我看不見得。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: don t count your chickens before they re hatched
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to emphasize that you cannot depend on something happening before it has happened
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 不要蛋未孵出就數小雞；不要高興得太早；不要過早樂觀

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: don t get mad get even
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say in order to tell someone not to be angry when another person has upset them, but instead to do something that will upset that person very much
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 別激動，報復吧！（告訴別人與其為人困擾，不如以牙還牙）

examples.en: This is my advice to wives whose husbands have left them for a younger woman - don't get mad, get even!
examples.trans: 這是我對丈夫另覓年輕新歡而遭到拋棄的妻子的忠告－－別激動，以其人之道還治其人之身吧！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said in order to tell someone that an event is not likely to happen
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （指不大可能發生）別眼巴巴等著，有你等的

examples.en: She said she might finish by this afternoon but don't hold your breath.
examples.trans: 她説她有可能在今天下午之前完成，不過你可別眼巴巴等著。

examples.en: She said she'd get back to us, but don't hold your breath!
examples.trans: 她說她會給我們回話，但是你不要期待過高！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone not to expect something to happen for a very long time

examples.en: She said she might finish by this afternoon but don't hold your breath.
examples.trans: 她説她有可能在今天下午之前完成，不過你可別眼巴巴等著。

examples.en: She said she'd get back to us, but don't hold your breath!
examples.trans: 她說她會給我們回話，但是你不要期待過高！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to someone to show that you cannot take their suggestion seriously

examples.en: You'll pay? Don't make me laugh!
examples.trans: 你要付錢？別開玩笑了！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to be polite after someone has thanked you

examples.en: "Thanks for your help." "Don't mention it."
examples.trans: 「謝謝你的幫助。」「不用謝。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to tell someone who is in the same room as you not to pay any attention to you, because you do not want to interrupt what they are doing
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 不用管我，當我不在眼前好了

examples.en: Don't mind me - I'm just sorting out some files here.
examples.trans: 不用管我——我只是在這裡整理些文檔。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to warn someone not to be angry with the person who tells them something bad
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 勿斬信使（指不要遷怒於告訴你壞消息的人）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: don t worry your pretty little head
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone not to worry

examples.en: "What about all the work that needs to be done in the kitchen?" "I'll do it - don't worry your pretty little head about it!"
examples.trans: 「廚房裡那些要做的工作怎麼辦？」「別擔心，包在我身上！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: UK informal talk or writing that is nonsense or that you cannot understand

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to promise the same room, seat, ticket, etc. to more than one person or group
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 同一房間（或座位、票等）被預訂給多人，多重預訂

examples.en: The room was double-booked so they had to give us a different one.
examples.trans: 這個房間被重複預訂，他們必須給我們另找一個房間。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: language that has no real meaning or has more than one meaning and is intended to hide the truth
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （爲掩蓋事實而說的）含糊其詞的話

examples.en: He accused the ambassador of diplomatic double-talk.
examples.trans: 他指責大使在玩弄外交辭令。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said before swallowing a drink, especially an alcoholic one

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to refuse to continue working, especially because you are not satisfied with your pay or working conditions
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （尤指因對工資或工作條件不滿而）停工，罷工

examples.en: The printers are threatening to down tools if the pay offer is not increased to eight percent.
examples.trans: 印刷工人威脅說，如果工資不增長8%就停工。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say, write, or shout to show your opposition to someone or something, and to demand that the person is removed from power or the thing is destroyed

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to force someone to say something, especially when they do not want to

examples.en: You never tell me how you feel - I always have to drag it out of you.
examples.trans: 你從來都不告訴我你的感受——總得讓我逼著你說出來。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to force or persuade someone to do something unpleasant

examples.en: [ + -ing verb ] I've been dragooned into giving the after-dinner speech.
examples.trans: 我被迫要在晚餐後發言。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you draw a veil over a particular subject, you do not speak about it because it is unpleasant and you do not want to think about it.

examples.en: Yes, well I think we'll just draw a veil over what went on last night.
examples.trans: 是啊，我想昨晚發生的事情我們就不要提了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to help someone to express their thoughts and feelings more easily by making that person feel less nervous

examples.en: Like all good interviewers he manages to draw people out of themselves.
examples.trans: 像所有優秀的採訪者一樣，他能設法引導人們說出自己的想法。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to talk about something bad or unpleasant that happened in the past
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 翻（舊帳），揭（傷疤），重提（不快往事）

examples.en: The article dredged up details of her unhappy childhood.
examples.trans: 文章翻出了她不幸的童年瑣事。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: drive a coach and horses through sth
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to completely destroy a rule, an argument or a plan
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 駁倒（論據）；徹底挫敗，破壞（規章或計劃）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say something clearly and with a lot of force so that you are certain people understand it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 把…講清楚，使人完全明白

examples.en: She really drove home the message that we need to economize.
examples.trans: 她講得很清楚，我們需要節約。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to talk for a long time in a boring way
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 喋喋不休，無休止地談論

examples.en: He was droning on (and on) about his operation.
examples.trans: 他在喋喋不休地講他的手術。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to do or say something that makes you feel embarrassed

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to describe a place where people can go, usually to get help or advice, at any time without making an appointment (= an agreed date and time)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （諮詢、服務中心等）不用預約的

examples.en: a drop-in centre for the homeless
examples.trans: 為無家可歸人士提供的開放中心

examples.en: a drop-in clinic/shelter
examples.trans: 無須預約診所/開放式庇護所

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to get praise or approval for something you have done

examples.en: I thought I could score some brownie points with my mother-in-law by offering to cook dinner.
examples.trans: 我想如果我主動做晚飯，能得到婆婆的讚許。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that someone's ears are flapping, you mean that they are trying to hear what you are saying, even though they are not part of your conversation.

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when something, especially money, is easily got and then soon spent or lost

examples.en: I lost £500 in a card game last night, but that's life - easy come, easy go.
examples.trans: 昨晚我賭牌輸了500英鎊，但是人生就是這樣子——錢這東西來得容易去得也快。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone to do something slowly and carefully

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to admit that you were wrong

examples.en: After boasting that his company could outperform the industry's best, he's been forced to eat humble pie.
examples.trans: 他吹噓他的公司可以勝過業內最好的企業，但之後，他就不得不承認言過其實了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to criticize someone very angrily

examples.en: If we get our facts wrong we'll be eaten alive by the press.
examples.trans: 如果我們把事實弄錯了，媒體會對我們大肆發難的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say "eat your heart out" followed by the name of a famous person, you are joking that you are even better than that person.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （後接一個名人的名字，開玩笑地說比其還要強）比你強多了，你算老幾

examples.en: I'm singing in the village production of Tosca next month - eat your heart out Pavarotti!
examples.trans: 下個月我們村裡劇團要上演《托斯卡》，我會上臺一展歌喉——帕華洛帝，我比你強多了！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to admit that something you said before was wrong

examples.en: Sam said it would never sell, but when he sees these sales figures he'll have to eat his words.
examples.trans: 山姆曾說這個永遠不會有銷路。可是他要是看到這些銷售數字，就得承認自己錯了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that is said in order to tell someone rudely to go away

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a respected leader, often one who no longer has an active job, who is thought of as having good advice to give
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （常指不再擔任實際工作而起顧問作用的）元老，資深前輩，德高望重的人

examples.en: He is one of the medical profession's elder statesmen.
examples.trans: 他是醫學界的一位元老。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: the act of using a person's feelings of kindness, sympathy, or duty in order to persuade them to do something or feel something

examples.en: This is just emotional blackmail to make mothers feel guilty for going to work.
examples.trans: 讓母親因為出去工作而產生罪惡感實在是情感勒索。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: French for 'in passing': if you say something en passant, you mention it quickly while talking about something else.

examples.en: She mentioned, en passant, that she'd been in L.A. the previous week.
examples.trans: 她順便提到之前一周她在洛杉磯。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say to tell someone that you have made a final decision and you do not want to talk about it any more
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 已成定局；沒有商量的餘地

examples.en: You're not going out tonight - end of!
examples.trans: 你今晚不准出去，這事沒有商量的餘地！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say when you think that the opinion you have just expressed about something is correct and that there is no other way of thinking about it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 情況就是這樣；就這麽辦

examples.en: This woman is innocent - end of story.
examples.trans: 這個女人是無辜的——情況就是如此。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to give more details about something you have said or written

examples.en: Would you care to enlarge on what you've just said?
examples.trans: 您能否再進一步闡述一下您剛才講過的內容？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that something does not enter into something else, it is not an important or necessary part of it.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 對…沒有影響；對…無關緊要；不是…的主要構成部分

examples.en: They refuse to enter into any discussion on this matter.
examples.trans: 他們拒絕就此事進行任何探討。

examples.en: The Council's opinion doesn't enter into it - it's up to us to make the decision.
examples.trans: 政務委員會的意見無關緊要——決定權在我們手裡。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used when telling someone something that is secret and should not be told to anyone else
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 你知我知（地），不可外傳（地）；僅限於我們兩人之間（地）

examples.en: He told me - and this is strictly entre nous - that he's going to ask Ruth to marry him.
examples.trans: 他告訴我——絕對不要跟別人說——他要向露絲求婚。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to emphasize that everyone is successful or happy at some time in their life

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when what has really happened in a situation is clear because of the way that someone or something looks

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: with complete authority, or said by the Pope to be true and so accepted by all members of the Roman Catholic Church
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 權威性的；來自權威方面的；（教皇諭旨）一貫判斷正確的

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to speak with someone

examples.en: We exchanged words after the meeting.
examples.trans: 我們在會後進行了交談。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you are pretending to be sorry for using a word that may be considered offensive

examples.en: Pardon my French, but that's a damned shame!
examples.trans: 不好意思講了粗口——那實在他媽的太遺憾了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: the principle that a president or other important executive official should not have to tell protected information to others
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 行政官員豁免權（指行政官員可拒絕提供受保護資訊）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to give more details about something you have said or written

examples.en: She mentioned a few ideas, but she didn't expand on them.
examples.trans: 她提到了幾個想法，但並沒有進行詳細說明。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to avoid blame for something that has happened by making it seem not important or not your fault
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 為…辯解；對…加以解釋以減輕其嚴重性（或避免被指責等）

examples.en: I don't know how you're going to explain away that dent you made in Dad's car.
examples.trans: 你把爸爸的車撞凹了，我看你怎樣解釋才能過這一關。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: someone or something that people are allowed to criticize

examples.en: Celebrities are fair game for the press.
examples.trans: 社會名流是媒體說三道四的對象。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say when you want someone to act in a reasonable way

examples.en: Fair go mate, let the others have a turn!
examples.trans: 公道一點，老兄，給別人一個機會！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you recognize a trick and refuse to be deceived by it

examples.en: He told me that he owned a mansion in Spain and I fell for it.
examples.trans: 他告訴我他在西班牙有一座莊園，我信以為真。

examples.en: "Lend me a fiver and I'll buy you a drink." "Oh no, I'm not falling for that one."
examples.trans: 「借我五英鎊，我就請你喝一杯。」「噢，我才不會上當。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: When words or sounds fall from your lips, you speak or make sounds.

examples.en: Not a single sound fell from her lips.
examples.trans: 她一個字也沒有說。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If a request or a piece of advice falls on stony ground, it is ignored or unpopular.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （要求或建議）受到忽視，不受歡迎

examples.en: Her speech about the need for a peaceful solution to the crisis fell on stony ground.
examples.trans: 她就和平解決危機的必要性所作的演說如石沉大海，毫無迴響。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: an argument

examples.en: Rachel and Fi had a falling-out and now they're not speaking to each other.
examples.trans: 瑞吉兒和菲吵了一架，現在互不理睬了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that if you know someone very well you stop respecting them because you have seen all of their bad qualities

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when someone makes a statement that is shown very soon, and in an embarrassing way, to be wrong
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 吹牛，說得煞有介事；不見得，那倒不一定

examples.en: I told him categorically that we could never be anything more than friends. Famous last words! Within a few months we were engaged.
examples.trans: 我明確告訴他我們只可能做朋友。說得跟真的似的，可才過了幾個月我們就訂婚了！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you certainly do not think that something is likely to happen

examples.en: "Perhaps they'll invite you." "Fat chance (of that)!"
examples.trans: 「也許他們會邀請你。」「不太可能！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: an older man who you treat like a father, especially by asking for his advice, help, or support

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to tell someone something that is not completely true, often as an excuse
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 以不實之詞欺騙，向…提供虛報情況

examples.en: She fed me a line about not having budgeted for pay increases this year.
examples.trans: 她騙我說今年的預算中沒有漲工資這一項。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to admit that you have done something that someone else will not like

examples.en: Fess up - it was you who ate that last piece of cake, wasn't it?
examples.trans: 坦白吧，是你吃了最後一塊蛋糕，對不對？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to argue about which of a group of people will get something good when there is only one or a few of that thing
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 爭論出結果，打到分出勝負

examples.en: There's only one ticket so you'll have to fight it out between you.
examples.trans: 只有一張票，所以你們兩個商量吧。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to become willing to talk

examples.en: Witnesses often find their voices when they hear a reward has been offered.
examples.trans: 聽到有懸賞時目擊證人往往就願意開口了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said by a child who has found an object to the child who has lost it, to show that they intend to keep it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （兒童用語）東西誰撿到了就是誰的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to tell other people secret and damaging information about someone

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: fire a warning shot across sb s bow
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to do something in order to warn someone that you will take strong action if that person does not change their behaviour

examples.en: Airline employees have fired a warning shot across the company's bows by threatening to strike if higher pay increases are not offered.
examples.trans: 航空公司員工已經向公司發出警告，威脅説如果不大幅度加薪就要進行罷工。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone that more important things should be done before less important things

examples.en: First things first, let's have something to eat.
examples.trans: 要緊的是，我們先吃點東西吧。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone to take action or to stop saying that they will
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 要麼全力以赴，要麼索性放棄；下定決心就別再動搖

examples.en: He's been promising voters that he'll support gun control, now it's time to fish or cut bait.
examples.trans: 他一直向選民承諾他會支持槍械管制，現在是下定決心的時候了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone that praise will not persuade you to do anything you do not want to do
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 奉承是不會有用的（表示不會被說服）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to punish or tell someone off severely

examples.en: I'll be flayed alive when she finds out!
examples.trans: 她要是發現了會活剝了我的皮！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: You say that an object is floating around when you think it is not far away but you cannot see exactly where.

examples.en: I can't find my purse, but it must be floating around here somewhere.
examples.trans: 我找不到我的錢包了，但是它肯定就在這裡什麼地方。

examples.en: rumours floating around
examples.trans: 四處流傳的謠言

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to use, do, or say something so often that it is no longer interesting
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 頻繁使用（或做、說）…而使人失去興趣

examples.en: It's a theme that's been flogged to death.
examples.trans: 這是一個老生常談的主題。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that you would like to be a fly on the wall on an occasion, you mean that you would like to hear what will be said or see what will happen while not being noticed.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 暗中偷聽者；暗中觀察者

examples.en: I'd love to be a fly on the wall when those two get home!
examples.trans: 我想暗中聽聽那兩人回到家說些甚麽！

examples.en: See also
examples.trans: fly-on-the-wall

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to persuade someone to accept something that is of a low quality or different from what they really wanted

examples.en: Well, he wants the report ready by tomorrow but I can always fob him off with some excuse.
examples.trans: 嗯，他想要報告明天就準備好，但是我總可以找個藉口搪塞他。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to persuade someone to accept something that is of a low quality or different from what they really wanted

examples.en: I fobbed the disastrous cupcakes off on my boyfriend to take into work.
examples.trans: 我想辦法讓我男朋友帶著糟糕的紙杯蛋糕上班了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to show that something is not important to someone
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 對…來說無所謂，對…來說不重要

examples.en: You could be the Queen of England, for all I care - you're not coming in here without a ticket.
examples.trans: 你就算是英格蘭女王我也不管——沒有票，你就別想進來。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that you would not do a particular thing for anything (in the world), it means that you certainly would not do it.

examples.en: I wouldn't have missed your party for anything.
examples.trans: 我本來無論如何都不會錯過你的聚會。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you are annoyed, and to emphasize what you are saying
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （表示惱怒和強調）哎呀，天哪，真是豈有此理

examples.en: Oh, for crying out loud, just listen to me!
examples.trans: 噢，真是豈有此理，你們聽我說！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you cannot get something, or if someone will not do something, for love nor money, it is impossible to get it or to persuade them to do it.

examples.en: You can't get hold of those tickets for love nor money these days.
examples.trans: 這些天你根本沒法弄到票。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you think your opinion or action is right, even if others do not
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於表示認為自己的觀點或行為正確，即使別人不這樣認為）對…來說

examples.en: The rest of you may disagree, but I, for one, think we should go ahead with the plan.
examples.trans: 你們其他人可能不同意，可是在我看來，我覺得我們應該繼續執行這項計劃。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that something is the first in a list of things

examples.en: Try this exercise for starters.
examples.trans: 首先，試一下這個練習。

examples.en: "Why did you decide not to go to the concert?" "Well, for starters, the tickets were ridiculously expensive."
examples.trans: 「你為甚麼決定不去聽音樂會了?」「嗯，首先，票貴得太離譜了。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that someone cannot do something for toffee, you mean that they are extremely bad at it.

examples.en: He can't paint for toffee!
examples.trans: 他根本不會畫畫！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you are giving someone a piece of information and you are not certain if that information is useful or important
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 不管有用與否；無論價值如何

examples.en: For what it's worth, I think he may be right.
examples.trans: 不論是否有價值，我認為他可能是正確的。

examples.en: They are, for what it's worth, the single most successful playhouse in the West.
examples.trans: 無論是否重要，他們是西方唯一一個最為成功的劇院。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to mean that if you know about something before it happens, you can be prepared for it

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to tell lies or say one thing and mean something else
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 說謊話；口是心非，言不由衷

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: the fossils in a particular group of rocks that give information about how and when those rocks formed, or the set of all fossils together that can be used to tell the history of the earth

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a country where the government does not control what people say or do for political reasons and where people can express their opinions without punishment
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （公民出於政治原因的言行不受政府控制、可以自由發表言論的）自由國家

examples.en: The transition from a totalitarian state to a free country will be long and slow.
examples.trans: 從獨裁式國家向自由國家的過渡將是漫長而緩慢的。

examples.en: I can say what I like - it's a free country!
examples.trans: 我可以暢所欲言——這是個自由的國度！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If a country has a free press, its newspapers, magazines, and television and radio stations are able to express any opinions they want, even if these criticize the government and other organizations.

examples.en: How can there be democratic elections without a free press?
examples.trans: 沒有新聞自由，怎麼可能有民主選舉呢？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: the freedom to do, say, or feel what you want
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （言行或情感的）自由，自主，無約束

examples.en: The young film-makers were given free rein to experiment with new themes and techniques.
examples.trans: 年輕的電影製片者們對新主題和新技巧可以自由嘗試。

examples.en: He deliberately gave his emotions free rein as he played the sonata.
examples.trans: 演奏這首奏鳴曲時，他刻意使自己的感情盡情奔放。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: the right to express your opinions publicly

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a violent situation or argument that a lot of people join in
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 不受控制的局面，人人均可爲所欲爲的情形，自由放任

examples.en: The fight on the basketball court turned into a free-for-all.
examples.trans: 籃球場上的打鬥很快便失控了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say that seems to show your true thoughts in a way that you do not intend
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 失言，漏嘴（指無意中洩露真實想法）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that someone or something is extremely bad

examples.en: Now Miranda - she was the housemate from hell.
examples.trans: 哎，米蘭達——她是個特別糟的室友。

examples.en: Poor Ann has the mother-in-law from hell.
examples.trans: 可憐的安有個特別討厭的婆婆。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: UK something you say to praise someone for something clever or good that they have said or done

examples.en: Full marks to Jo for spotting the error in time.
examples.trans: 喬應受到表揚，因爲他及時發現了錯誤。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say that means that something produced from materials of low quality will also be of low quality
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 垃圾進，垃圾出（意為用劣質的材料生產出的產品也必然是劣質的）

examples.en: The meals are pretty poor but then they never use fresh ingredients - garbage in, garbage out.
examples.trans: 這飯真難吃，因為他們從來不用新鮮材料——也難怪，垃圾進，垃圾出。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: the idea that gay people should not keep the fact of their sexuality secret and that they should be proud of it instead, or the social and political movement that is based on this idea
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 同性戀者尊嚴，同性戀者尊嚴運動（鼓勵同性戀者公開身份並以之為自豪）

examples.en: a gay pride parade
examples.trans: 同性戀者尊嚴運動的集會

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say to a horse to make it move faster

examples.en: Gee up, Neddy!
examples.trans: 駕，馬兒！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: the standard way in which people from the US speak, that does not sound as though it comes from any particular region

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: the group of army officers who work for and give advice to a commanding officer

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a strike in which most workers in a country refuse to work until they are given higher pay or something else that they want

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say to a boring person when you want them to do more exciting things
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 真沒意思！太無聊了！找點有意思的！

examples.en: Don't tell me you're cleaning the house on a Saturday night? Get a life, Hannah!
examples.trans: 別跟我說你週六晚上在打掃房間，漢娜，找點有意思的事！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone to pay attention to a person or thing that is interesting, surprising, or attractive

examples.en: Get a load of that, guys! Very nice.
examples.trans: 夥計們，快來看看這個！多漂亮啊。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to criticize a person repeatedly
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 一再批評；不斷指責；老是數落（某人）

examples.en: He keeps getting at me and I really don't know what I've done wrong.
examples.trans: 他沒完沒了地指責我，可我真的不知道自己做錯了甚麼。

examples.en: The accused claimed that the witness had been got at.
examples.trans: 被告聲稱證人被收買了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: UK US get a load of him, her, you, etc. said to make the person you are with look at or notice someone, and usually laugh at them
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （通常用於嘲笑某人時）瞧，看看，瞅瞅

examples.en: Get him in his new clothes!
examples.trans: 看看他穿新衣服啦！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say when something good happens to someone
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 真走運（對某人遇到好事時作出的反應）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone forcefully and quite rudely to go away

examples.en: Tell him to get lost!
examples.trans: 叫他滾開！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone to stop criticizing you
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 別再跟我嘮叨！別再數落我了！

examples.en: Why don't you get off my back! I'm doing my best.
examples.trans: 別再跟我嘮叨了！我正盡力而為。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to criticize someone in an annoying way for something they have done

examples.en: I just don't want him getting on my case for being late for work.
examples.trans: 我只是不希望他拿我的遲到來說三道四。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: UK to speak or write to a person or organization because you want him, her, or it to help you in some way
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （為了讓其幫忙而）與…聯繫，寫信給

examples.en: How did we get on to (the subject of) your grandmother's cat?
examples.trans: 我們怎麼說著說著就聊起你祖母的貓（的事兒）來了？

examples.en: Did you remember to get on to the plumber about the shower?
examples.trans: 你記著要聯繫水管工來修淋浴器了嗎？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to express your opinions about a particular subject forcefully

examples.en: She never misses the chance to get on her soapbox about political reform.
examples.trans: 她從不錯過任何可以發表對政治改革看法的機會。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say when something good happens to someone
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 真走運（對某人遇到好事時作出的反應）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to rudely tell someone to stop blocking the way
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於粗魯地告訴別人不要堵住路）讓開！別堵住路！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say to tell someone to stop thinking that they are more important than other people, especially when they are complaining about something
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 得了吧；省省吧（尤用於當某人抱怨的時候，要求其不要自視過高或自以為優於他人）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to persuade someone to allow you something by using your charm
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 哄勸（某人）同意；（用奉承手段）說服（某人）答應

examples.en: [ + to infinitive ] See if you can get round your father to take you to the game.
examples.trans: 看能不能把你父親哄高興了，讓他送你去比賽。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to write something, especially something that someone has said
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 記錄，寫下，記下（尤指口述的內容）

examples.en: I didn't manage to get down the last thing she said, about the meeting.
examples.trans: 她說的話最後有一點兒我沒記下來，是關於會議的事情。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to persuade or force someone to tell or give you something
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 勸（某人）說出（或拿出）；迫使（某人）講出（或交出）

examples.en: He was determined to get the truth out of her.
examples.trans: 他下決心要令她說出真相。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: get sth out of your system
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you get something out of your system, you get rid of a wish or emotion, especially a negative one, by allowing yourself to express it.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 發洩（尤指負面的慾望或情緒）

examples.en: I had a good cry and got it out of my system.
examples.trans: 我大哭一場，痛快地發洩了一下。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: get to the bottom of sth
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to discover the truth about a situation
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 對…尋根究底；找到…的真相

examples.en: I'm not sure what is causing the problem, but I'm determined to get to the bottom of it.
examples.trans: 我現在不能確定導致這個問題的原因是甚麽，不過我一定要弄個明白。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you tell someone to get weaving, you either want them to start something or to do something quickly.

examples.en: We'd better get weaving - we've got a lot to do today.
examples.trans: 我們最好加快速度——今天還有很多事要做呢。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to hear a piece of information that someone else was trying to keep secret
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 聽到…的風聲；得知…秘密消息

examples.en: I don't want my colleagues to get wind of the fact that I'm leaving.
examples.trans: 我不想讓我的同事知道我要離開的消息。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to persuade other people to allow you to do what you want
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （說服別人以便）達到自己的目的，能按自己的主意行事，隨心所欲

examples.en: My little brother always gets his own way.
examples.trans: 我的小弟總是能遂心如願。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a card that you give or send to someone who is ill, to say that you hope they are well again soon
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用來祝願早日康復的）心意卡

examples.en: Everyone at work signed a get-well card for me.
examples.trans: 所有的同事都在祝我早日康復的心意卡上簽了字。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If someone gives you a rocket, they criticize you severely.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 嚴厲斥責（某人），痛駡（某人）

examples.en: She got a rocket for tearing her new dress.
examples.trans: 她把新買的連衣裙弄破了，挨了她媽一頓臭罵。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used when you want to tell someone to hurry up

examples.en: Get your skates on, or we'll be late.
examples.trans: 快點，否則我們會遲到的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you want someone to stop talking about or doing something that is annoying you

examples.en: Oh, give it a rest, can't you?
examples.trans: 得了，別再說了，好不好？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: give me any day every time
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you always like or prefer a particular thing
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 我寧願要…！我更喜歡…！我寧可選擇…！

examples.en: This new stuff is all very well, but give me the old-style weather forecast any day!
examples.trans: 這種新玩意倒也不錯，但是我還是更喜歡以前的天氣預報方式。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say when you want someone to open a hand so you can hit it with your open hand in greeting or celebration
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 我們擊掌吧！（表示問好或慶祝）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say when you find someone else's stupid behaviour or inability to do something annoying
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （表示又可氣又可笑）真受不了！

examples.en: Oh, give me strength! Do you want me to do it for you?
examples.trans: 噢，真受不了！難道你想要我幫你做？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to show that you do not believe what has been said to you
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 算了吧；我才不信呢（表示對某人所說的話不相信）

examples.en: Oh (do) give over (= stop complaining), it's not my fault!
examples.trans: 哎呀，別再抱怨了，又不是我的錯！

examples.en: [ + -ing verb ] It's time you gave over pretending you're still a teenager.
examples.trans: 別再假裝自己還是個十幾歲的孩子。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to tell someone that something is going to happen

examples.en: I just wanted to give you all a heads up that we will be talking about the first two chapters of the book tomorrow.
examples.trans: 我只是想事先提醒你們明天我們將會討論這本書的前兩章。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: give sb a piece of your mind
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to speak angrily to someone about something they have done wrong

examples.en: I'm going to give that mechanic a piece of my mind if the car's not fixed this time.
examples.trans: 如果那輛車這次再修不好的話，我就教訓那個維修技工一頓。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to tell someone

examples.en: Give me a shout when you've finished in the bathroom.
examples.trans: 你洗完澡後告訴我一聲。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to show someone's secret feelings
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 顯露（某人）的感情；暴露（某人）的內心世界

examples.en: She thinks no one knows how much she likes him, but her face when I said he'd be there really gave her away!
examples.trans: 她以為沒有人知道她多麼喜歡他，但當我說他要去那裡時，她的表情把她的內心情感表露無遺！

examples.en: The bride was given away by her father.
examples.trans: 新娘的父親把她交給了新郎。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If someone gives you hell, they criticize you severely.

examples.en: She gave me hell for being 20 minutes late.
examples.trans: 因為我遲到了20分鐘，她狠狠教訓我一頓。

examples.en: These new shoes are giving me hell.
examples.trans: 這雙新鞋把我的腳磨得痛死了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: give sb something to talk about
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to provide someone with an interesting subject to discuss

examples.en: Our new car will give the neighbours something to talk about.
examples.trans: 我們的新車會成為鄰居的話題。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to tell someone to leave their job

examples.en: I heard he'd been given the push.
examples.trans: 我聽說他被解僱了。

examples.en: Oh, give him the push - he's a loser.
examples.trans: 唉，把他甩了吧，他就是個衰鬼。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: give sb the time of day
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If someone will not give you the time of day, they are unfriendly and refuse to speak to you.

examples.en: We had an argument with our neighbours, and now they won't even give us the time of day.
examples.trans: 我們和鄰居吵了一架，到現在他們還不搭理我們。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to allow someone to do what they want to do without trying to help or give them advice

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to speak angrily to someone whose behaviour you strongly disapprove of

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to shout something angry at someone, usually using offensive language
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 生氣地向（某人）叫嚷；咒駡（某人）

examples.en: A taxi driver wound down his window and gave the cyclist a mouthful.
examples.trans: 計程車司機搖下車窗，對騎腳踏車的人破口大駡。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: give someone an inch and they ll take a mile
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said about someone who has been given a small amount of power or freedom to do something, and then has tried to get a lot more

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to spoil a surprise or a joke by telling someone something that should have been kept secret
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 洩露秘密，露餡，露馬腳，穿幫

examples.en: It's a secret, so don't give the game away, will you?
examples.trans: 這是個秘密，別告訴別人，好不好？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to express your thoughts or feelings in words

examples.en: I always had doubts about the project but I never gave voice to them.
examples.trans: 我一直對那個計劃存有疑慮，但我從來沒有說出來。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that you would give your right arm to do or have something, you mean you would like it very much.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 不惜一切代價；（為了…）願捨棄很多

examples.en: I would give my right arm to meet the president.
examples.trans: 只要能見到總統，要甚麼我都給。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: humorous to complain angrily and noisily about something

examples.en: The monster roared and gnashed its teeth.
examples.trans: 那怪獸咆哮，將牙磨得咯咯直響。

examples.en: New Yorkers gnashed their teeth about the governor's decision to raise property taxes.
examples.trans: 紐約人紛紛抱怨政府提高地產稅的決定。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that someone will go a long way, you mean that they will be very successful.

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to do or say the opposite of what most people are doing or saying
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 逆流而動，與主流背道而馳

examples.en: With this new book, she is going against the flow.
examples.trans: 她的這本新書是反社會主流的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: go and take a running jump
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to someone when you want them to go away and stop annoying you

examples.en: He kept following me around, so I just told him to go and take a running jump.
examples.trans: 他老是跟在我屁股後面轉，所以我毫不客氣地讓他一邊歇著去。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to express disapproval of something that is done
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （表示不贊成）居然做了…，竟然做出…

examples.en: He's gone and lost (= he has lost) that wallet I gave him for his birthday.
examples.trans: 他竟然把我送給他作為生日禮物的錢包給遺失了。

examples.en: Mike's really gone and done it now - he'll be in terrible trouble for breaking that window.
examples.trans: 麥克居然把窗戶的玻璃打碎了——他要吃不了兜著走了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone off for not paying attention
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於批評注意力不集中的人）回去睡覺去吧！

examples.en: "Sorry, what did you say?" "Oh, go back to sleep!"
examples.trans: 「對不起，你剛才說甚麽？」 「噢，你回去睡覺算了！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: go down like a lead balloon
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If something that you say or show to people goes down like a lead balloon, they do not like it at all.

examples.en: My joke about the alcoholic went down like a lead balloon.
examples.trans: 大家對我講的有關酒鬼的笑話反應冷淡。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to treat someone in a gentle way and not criticize them or punish them

examples.en: Go easy on/with the cream - I haven't had any yet.
examples.trans: 別吃那麼多鮮奶油——我還一點都沒吃呢 。

examples.en: Go easy on the new students.
examples.trans: 對新生不要那麼嚴。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used when you tell someone a fact and you then want to say that the fact is surprising, strange or stupid

examples.en: It's a terrible movie and it made $200 million. Go figure!
examples.trans: 這是一部很差勁的電影，卻創下了兩億美元的票房。真是怪事！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone who is being annoying to go away

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: You say that someone can go hang (himself or herself) if you do not care what that person says or does about something.

examples.en: If she's expecting the report by tomorrow, she can go hang herself.
examples.trans: 如果她指望明天之前報告能出來的話，那就隨便她去吧。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: go in one ear and out the other
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that something you hear goes in one ear and out the other, you mean you quickly forget it.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 左耳進右耳出；當作耳邊風

examples.en: If I have to listen to something I don't understand, it just goes in one ear and out the other.
examples.trans: 要是非得讓我聽我不懂的事情，那也只是左耳進右耳出。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to express very great enthusiasm and admiration for something

examples.en: She went into rhapsodies over/about the chocolate cake.
examples.trans: 她對那個巧克力蛋糕讚不絕口。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you go on record or if you are on record as saying something, you say it publicly and officially and it is written down.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 公開發表（意見等）；公開表明（觀點）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to speak to or ask permission from someone who has more authority than the person who you would normally go to in that situation
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 不經過（某人）直接越級上報

examples.en: Amanda was refusing to give me the week off so I went over her head and spoke to the boss.
examples.trans: 阿曼達不批准我請一週的假，於是我就跳過他直接跟老闆說。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to make something known that was secret before

examples.en: We will not go public with the results until tomorrow.
examples.trans: 我們要到明天才會公佈結果。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone to go away

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to angrily tell someone to stop talking and go away

examples.en: "Anyway, it's your own fault." "Oh, go to hell!"
examples.trans: 「總之是你自己的錯。」「啊，去你的！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say to someone annoying or bad to tell them to go away for ever

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that an object has gone walkabout you mean that it is missing, often because someone has taken it.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （常因為被別人拿走而）不見了，不知去向

examples.en: My pen was here this morning but it seems to have gone walkabout.
examples.trans: 我的鋼筆上午還在這裡，但現在好像不見了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when saying goodbye to someone, to say that you hope good things will happen to them
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （在向人告別時，祝願對方有好事降臨）上帝保佑你！

examples.en: Good night everyone, and God bless.
examples.trans: 各位晚安，上帝保佑。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when someone sneezes, to say that you hope they have good health
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （當別人打噴嚏時，祝願對方身體健康）上帝保佑。

examples.en: Good night everyone, and God bless.
examples.trans: 各位晚安，上帝保佑。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: informal it is impossible to say

examples.en: God only knows how he managed to find out where I live.
examples.trans: 只有天知道他是怎麼找到我的住處的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say you hope everything happens in the way you want
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （表示希望事情如願以償）如果是天意，如上帝許可，如一切順利

examples.en: We'll be there tomorrow, God willing!
examples.trans: 如果一切順利的話，我們明天就會到那裡！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that someone thinks they are God's gift (to someone or something), you mean that that person believes that they are better than anyone else.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 上帝（對…）的恩寵；上帝恩賜的人（或物）

examples.en: He thinks he's God's gift to women (= he thinks he is extremely attractive to women).
examples.trans: 他認為自己是上天給女人們的恩賜。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to emphasize that something is the complete truth
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於強調某事的真實性）絕對真實

examples.en: I didn't know she would be there - God's honest truth.
examples.trans: 我不知道她會在那裡——真的不知道。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say something is God-given, you mean that it has not been made by people.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 天賦的，天賜的，上帝創造的

examples.en: She has a God-given talent as a painter.
examples.trans: 作為一個畫家，她有著非凡的天賦。

examples.en: She seems to think she has a God-given right to tell us all what to do.
examples.trans: 她好像覺得自己是老天派下來指揮我們大家的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: good things come in small packages
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to emphasize that something does not need to be big in order to be good
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 濃縮的都是精品；好東西不在個頭大

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say to encourage or praise someone

examples.en: "The sales figures are up this week." "Great stuff!"
examples.trans: 本週的銷售數字上升了。 「做得漂亮！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to express great surprise or anger

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say when someone has guessed something correctly

examples.en: "Don't tell me - is Anna pregnant again?" "Got it in one!"
examples.trans: 「你先別說，安娜又懷孕了，對不對？」「猜對了！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to secretly give someone money in order to persuade them to do something for you

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to someone just after you have discovered that they have had the same idea as you

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: the eight countries of Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, Russia, the UK, and the US, whose leaders meet every year to discuss international problems
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 八大工業國組織（包括加拿大、法國、德國、意大利、日本、俄羅斯、英國和美國）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used in writing to represent a shout of laughter, or said by children or by adults behaving like children as a way of making someone look silly
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 哈哈（在寫作中表示笑聲或嘲笑）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: half a loaf is better than none
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said about a situation in which you must accept less than you wanted
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 有一點總比沒有好；聊勝於無

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to reach an agreement or solution after a lot of argument or discussion
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （爭論或討論後）達成（協定或解決辦法）

examples.en: Three years after the accident the lawyers finally managed to hammer out a settlement with the insurance company.
examples.trans: 事故發生三年後，律師們終於與保險公司商定了解決辦法。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said as a way of telling someone to not give up, despite difficulties

examples.en: Work can get tough in the middle of a term but hang in there and it'll be OK.
examples.trans: 到了學期中功課會變得很難，但堅持下去就會順利的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to blame someone for something, especially something they did not do
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 把（尤指某人沒做過的事）怪罪在（某人）頭上

examples.en: I wasn't anywhere near the house when the window was broken, so you can't hang that on me!
examples.trans: 窗戶玻璃被打破的時候我根本就不在房子附近，所以你不能把這個怪到我頭上！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to describe Christians who sing, talk, and shout enthusiastically during their religious ceremonies and who try to persuade other people to join them
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （基督徒）做禮拜時舉止狂熱的

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to express sympathy to someone because something slightly bad has happened

examples.en: "We lost again." "Oh, hard luck!"
examples.trans: 「我們又輸了。」「 噢，真不走運！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say to indicate that you have no sympathy for someone or cannot do anything to help them

examples.en: This is the only food we have left, and if you don't like it, hard cheese.
examples.trans: 這是我們唯一剩下的吃的，你要不喜歡的話，就太抱歉了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to someone who has just accused you of something that you think that person is guilty of himself or herself
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 聽聽（某人）在說甚麽！（表示剛剛指責過你的人本身就有錯）

examples.en: Hark at him calling me lazy when he never walks anywhere if he can drive!
examples.trans: 聽聽他說的，還說我懶，他自己只要是能開車去的地方就絕不會走路去！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If someone harks back to something in the past, they talk about it again and again, often in a way that annoys other people.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （常指令人厭煩地）反覆提起（過去的事），重提（往事）

examples.en: He's always harking back to his childhood and saying how things were better then.
examples.trans: 他老是提起他的童年，說那時一切都比現在好。

examples.en: The director's latest film harks back to the early years of cinema.
examples.trans: 那個導演的新片與早期電影的風格類似。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to talk or complain about something many times

examples.en: He's always harping on about lack of discipline.
examples.trans: 他總是抱怨紀律渙散。

examples.en: I know you want to go to Paris. Don't keep harping on (about it)!
examples.trans: 我知道你想去巴黎。但別一直嘮叨個不停！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: has the cat got your tongue
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say to someone when you are annoyed because they will not speak
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於生氣地質問）舌頭給貓叼走了嗎？為甚麼不說話？

examples.en: What's the matter? Has the cat got your tongue?
examples.trans: 你怎麼了？為甚麼不吭聲？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
