Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to talk about something with someone else in order to reach agreement about it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 和其他人協商共同達成

examples.en: You two hash out the details of the presentation.
examples.trans: 你們倆一起商量一下報告細節。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: informal to criticize someone or say bad things about them, in an unpleasant and public way

examples.en: These kids get hated on for no good reason at all.
examples.trans: 這些孩子無緣由地遭到謾駡。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to praise and thank someone for doing something helpful

examples.en: Hats off to Connie for finding such a splendid venue for a party!
examples.trans: 感謝康妮找到了這個理想的派對場地！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: haul drag sb over the coals
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to speak angrily to someone because they have done something you disapprove of

examples.en: He was hauled over the coals for coming in late for work.
examples.trans: 他因為上班遲到而受到訓斥。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone to be more careful

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that someone has had a good innings, you mean that they have had a long and successful life.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 長壽且一帆風順；壽長福大

examples.en: He was 86 when he died so I suppose he'd had a good innings.
examples.trans: 他去世時86歲，所以我覺得他一生稱得上是多福多壽了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: have a good healthy pair of lungs
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: You say that a baby has a good/healthy pair of lungs when it cries loudly.

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: have a lot to say for yourself
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to talk too much and seem to have a high opinion of yourself

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that someone has a screw loose, you mean that they behave in a strange way and seem slightly mentally ill.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 行爲乖戾；神經有點不正常

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: have a sting in the its tail
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If something, such as a story or joke, has a sting in the/its tail, it has a surprising or unpleasant part that only becomes clear at the end.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （故事、笑話等）結局出人意料，結尾倒人胃口

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: have a word in sb s ear
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: mainly UK to give someone a piece of advice or information secretly

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you tell someone to have faith, you are encouraging them to stay confident.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於鼓勵某人堅持信念或保持自信）別洩氣！

examples.en: Have faith! Everything will work out.
examples.trans: 別氣餒！最後一切都會好起來的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that a person has got something there, you mean they have said or discovered an important or interesting thing.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 說得有道理；發現很重要（或很有意思）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: have it on the highest authority
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to have been told something by someone who knows the truth

examples.en: I have it on the highest authority that they are getting a divorce.
examples.trans: 我聽知情人士說他們正要離婚。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that someone is going to be unpleasantly surprised because something will not be as they want it to be

examples.en: I've got news for him, if he thinks he can keep living here free of charge.
examples.trans: 如果他想繼續賴在這裡白住，我可有好戲讓他看。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to refuse to accept, agree with, or support something

examples.en: She tried to persuade him to retire, but he would have none of it.
examples.trans: 她試圖勸他退休，但他拒絕了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: have nothing to say for yourself
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to not be willing to take part in conversations or express your opinions

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to persuade someone that something is true when it is not, usually as a joke

examples.en: That's your new car? You're having me on!
examples.trans: 那是你的新汽車？你在騙我吧！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: have sb to thank for sth
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you have someone to thank for something, that person is responsible or to blame for it.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 由（某人）對…負責；應責怪（某人）

examples.en: You have John to thank for this problem.
examples.trans: 出現這個問題你該怪約翰。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: have sb s guts for garters
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say you will have someone's guts for garters, you mean that you will punish them severely.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 狠狠懲罰（某人），抽（某人）的筋，扒（某人）的皮

examples.en: If that boy has taken my bike again, I'll have his guts for garters!
examples.trans: 如果那小子又騎走了我的腳踏車，我就扒了他的皮。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to be to blame for something

examples.en: If the police carry on like this they'll have a riot on their hands.
examples.trans: 如果警方繼續這樣下去，那麽他們將要面臨一場暴亂。

examples.en: She has a battle on her hands if she wants the organization to change.
examples.trans: 如果她要讓機構發生改變的話，那麼她會有一場仗要打。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said if you want to go on a journey and use a particular skill
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 有…即可旅行，…助你旅行（意思是如果你想去旅行同時利用自己的技能）

examples.en: The ad in the newspaper read "Have English language skills, will travel".
examples.trans: 報紙上的廣告說「英語技能助你旅行」。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to finally get an advantage from an argument or disagreement, when it seemed that you would not
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 笑到最後，取得最後的勝利

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: have your finger on the trigger
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that someone is ready and prepared to do something, especially something violent
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 準備好做…（尤指使用暴力）

examples.en: They have their finger on the trigger to start a nuclear war.
examples.trans: 他們已經準備好發動一場核戰爭。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: despite what has just been said

examples.en: He forgets most things, but having said that, he always remembers my birthday.
examples.trans: 他很健忘，不過，他一直記得我的生日。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: he who pays the piper calls the tune
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to emphasize that the person who is paying someone to do something can decide how it should be done
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 誰是老闆誰說了算。／財大者氣粗。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: he she deserves whatever everything he she gets
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said if you think someone should have to suffer because of their bad behaviour
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 無論怎樣懲罰他／她都是活該，罪有應得

examples.en: After all the harm she's done, she deserves whatever she gets.
examples.trans: 她做了那麼多壞事，無論受到甚麼懲罰都是罪有應得。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that is said to mean that people will be punished for something bad that has happened

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a short talk or statement about how a situation or plan is developing
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 有關形勢（或計畫）發展狀況的講話（或聲明）

examples.en: This note is just to give you a heads-up that Vicky will be arriving next week.
examples.trans: 這張便條只是向你提醒一下維琪下星期要來。

examples.en: The boss called a meeting to give us a heads-up on the way the project was going.
examples.trans: 老闆召集會議通報計畫進行的情況。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to give someone a lot of praise, criticism, etc.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 對（某人）大加（讚揚、批評等）

examples.en: He deals well with all the criticism heaped on him.
examples.trans: 對於針對他的一大堆批評，他應對得很好。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to listen to someone until said everything they want to say

examples.en: At least hear me out before making up your mind.
examples.trans: 你作決定之前至少先聽我說完。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you hear tell (of) something, someone tells you about it.

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to strongly agree with what someone else has just said

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a serious conversation between two people, usually close friends, in which they talk honestly about their feelings

examples.en: We had a heart-to-heart over a bottle of wine.
examples.trans: 我們就著一瓶葡萄酒促膝談心。

examples.en: a heart-to-heart talk/chat
examples.trans: 敞開心扉的交談／閒聊

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a phrase that you say or shout when you are making a big effort to pull or lift something
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 嗨喲（推舉重物時發出的呼喊聲）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to express surprise or anger

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to express the fact that you cannot change a situation so you must accept it

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to express anger or surprise

examples.en: Hell's bells, can't you do anything right?
examples.trans: 見鬼了，你就不能做對一件事嗎？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to a person that you know but have not seen for a long time
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於稱呼很久沒見的熟人）你好，稀客

examples.en: Hello stranger, I haven't seen you for weeks!
examples.trans: 你好，稀客啊，有幾個星期沒見了！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: her his heart is in the right place
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that someone has good intentions
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 她／他的用意（或心地）是好的

examples.en: He's an odd man but his heart is in the right place.
examples.trans: 他是個脾氣古怪的人，但他的心地還是好的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said just before you do something brave or something that you have never done before
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （表示要開始做需要勇氣或從未嘗試過的事）我要開始了！看我的！

examples.en: Well, I've never ridden a motorbike before, so here goes!
examples.trans: 噢，我以前從來都沒騎過機車，現在就看我的吧！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said about something that lasts only a short time
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 今天來，明天走；曇花一現

examples.en: A lot of new internet companies are here today and gone tomorrow.
examples.trans: 大量新興的網路公司都只是曇花一現。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when something bad starts happening again

examples.en: Oh, here we go again! Claude's just asked to borrow some more money from me.
examples.trans: 唉，又來了！克勞德剛才又向我借錢了。

examples.en: Here we go again - moan, moan, moan!
examples.trans: 又來了——牢騷、牢騷、牢騷！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: here s mud in your eye
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: sometimes said by people in a friendly way just before drinking an alcoholic drink together

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when something appears or happens so quickly or easily that it seems to be magic
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （表示某事物的出現或發生像變魔術一樣迅速或容易）

examples.en: You put your money in the machine and, hey presto, the coffee comes out!
examples.trans: 把錢投到機器裡，嘿，咖啡就出來了！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a secret reason for doing something
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 隱秘的動機，不可告人的理由

examples.en: [ + to infinitive ] The prime minister denied that the new visa requirements were part of a hidden agenda to reduce immigration.
examples.trans: 首相否認實行新簽證規定的背後目的之一是要減少外來移民。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: hide your light under a bushel
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to keep your good qualities and abilities secret from other people
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 不要深藏不露；不要總是隱而不顯

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a children's game in which a group of children hide in secret places and then one child has to go to look for them

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to attack or criticize someone who has attacked or criticized you

examples.en: In tonight's speech, the minister is expected to hit back at critics who have attacked her handling of the crisis.
examples.trans: 一些批評家曾攻擊部長對這危機的處理方式，在今晚的發言中，她預計會對此加以反擊。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to criticize something or someone strongly

examples.en: The Medical Association yesterday hit out at government cuts in healthcare services.
examples.trans: 昨天，醫療協會猛烈抨擊了政府削減醫療保健開支的措施。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to do or say something to someone that will upset them as much as possible
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 刺到（某人）的痛處，碰到（某人）的敏感之處

examples.en: He's always worrying about his weight, so if you want to hit him where it hurts, tell him he's looking a bit fat.
examples.trans: 他一直在擔心自己的體重，如果你想刺中他的痛處，就說他有點胖。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to lie down quickly and suddenly so that you are hidden from view or protected from something dangerous

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: words said by a magician (= a performer who pretends to do magical things) when they are doing a trick
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （魔術師在表演戲法時所說的話）

examples.en: So much of what politicians say is just hocus-pocus.
examples.trans: 政客們說的很多話都是騙人的鬼話。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone to stop what they are doing

examples.en: Hold everything! He's changed his mind again.
examples.trans: 等等！他又改變主意了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to talk about a particular subject for a long time, often in a way that other people find boring
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 滔滔不絕地說，發表長篇大論

examples.en: She held forth all afternoon about/on government incompetence.
examples.trans: 她整個下午都在滔滔不絕地談論政府的無能之處。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: informal to refuse to give help or information to someone
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 拒絕幫助（某人）；向（某人）隱瞞情況

examples.en: Don't hold out on me - I need to know who did it.
examples.trans: 別瞞著我——我需要知道是誰做的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: mainly US informal to refuse to give money to someone

examples.en: Don't hold out on me - I need to know who did it.
examples.trans: 別瞞著我——我需要知道是誰做的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: hold out offer an olive branch
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to do or say something in order to show that you want to end a disagreement with someone
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 伸出橄欖枝；主動表達和解的願望

examples.en: He held out an olive branch to the opposition by releasing 42 political prisoners.
examples.trans: 他釋放了42名政治犯，以此向反對派表達了和解的願望。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone to stop moving

examples.en: Hold still, this won't hurt.
examples.trans: 別動，這不會很痛。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to speak to a group of people, often for a long time, without allowing anyone else to speak

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone to stop and consider carefully their decision or opinion about something

examples.en: Just hold your horses, Bill! Let's think about this for a moment.
examples.trans: 且慢，比爾！我們先考慮一下這件事。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to not speak

examples.en: Hold your tongue, young man!
examples.trans: 年輕人，別說話！

examples.en: I'm going to have to learn to hold my tongue (= to not say things that upset people).
examples.trans: 我以後得學會管好自己的嘴巴。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to admit that something bad is true or that you have made a mistake
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 承認（不愉快的事實或自己的錯誤）

examples.en: I know I'm bossy and I hold my hands up to that.
examples.trans: 我承認我有點專橫。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: someone who speaks to both sides involved in an argument or disagreement and tries to help the two sides to agree

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to advise someone that it is better to tell the truth than to lie

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a system for doing something, such as taking payments, that depends on people who use the system telling the truth
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （依賴參與者誠實，例如主動付款的）無監督系統

examples.en: Previously, we operated an honor system, where employees signed statements of residency but these were not verified.
examples.trans: 過去我們實行一套無監督系統，員工簽署居住聲明，但並無人核實。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone to go away

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you continue to hope that something will happen, although it seems unlikely
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 希望之泉永不枯竭；希望常在

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you are telling someone about a very bad or embarrassing situation

examples.en: Then, horror of horrors, I discovered that my zip had been undone the whole time I was talking to her.
examples.trans: 最糟糕的是，我發現跟她說話的時候我褲子的拉鍊是一直開著的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that it is important to choose suitable people for particular activities because everyone has different skills

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you would not like to have something in your house

examples.en: Most of the furniture is so ugly, you wouldn't give it house-room.
examples.trans: 大多數傢俱都很難看，你是不會要的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: how much do you want to bet
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said in answer to something that someone has said, meaning that you are certain that they are wrong
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （表示確定對方錯了）你敢打賭嗎？你想賭多少？

examples.en: "Surely she won't be late this time." "How much do you want to bet?"
examples.trans: 「她這次肯定不會遲到。」「那你敢跟我賭多少？」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something people say when they see or hear about the lives of people who are richer than them
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 看看人家是怎麼生活的！（評論富人時的調侃話）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that something you did wrong was not your fault because you did not have enough information
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （表示所做的錯事並非自己的過錯）我怎麼會知道?

examples.en: I just wanted to give her a surprise; how was I to know you'd already bought tickets?
examples.trans: 我只想給她個驚喜，我怎麼會知道你已經買了票？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to suggest that someone would not like to be in a situation experienced by someone else

examples.en: I'm not surprised he shouted at you! How would you like to be pushed into a wall?
examples.trans: 他向你嚷我一點都不奇怪！你願意被人推到牆上嗎？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said as an informal greeting

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: A how-to book, video, or other product provides advice on a particular activity.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （書籍、攝影等）入門的，提供指南的

examples.en: How-to books on dieting are often at the top of the bestseller lists.
examples.trans: 減肥類書籍常常位於暢銷書排行榜榜首。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: informal disapproving to complain loudly and express disapproval

examples.en: We were huffing and puffing by the time we'd climbed to the top of the hill.
examples.trans: 我們爬上山頂後直喘大氣。

examples.en: They huffed and puffed about the price but eventually they paid up.
examples.trans: 他們大聲抱怨價格太高，但最後還是付了錢。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: money that is given to someone to make them keep something secret

examples.en: She claimed that the politician had offered her hush money to keep their child a secret.
examples.trans: 她聲稱那名政客給她錢封口，叫她不要把有孩子的事說出去。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: kept secret from people

examples.en: In the end he was forced to resign but it was all very hush-hush.
examples.trans: 最後他被迫辭職，但這些全是秘密發生的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say in order to show your surprise or anger at something someone has done
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 這到底是甚麼回事？（對別人所做的事表示驚訝或憤怒）

examples.en: They stayed for a month and left without even saying thank you! Well, I ask you!
examples.trans: 他們住了一個月，卻連句謝謝都沒說就走了。這到底是甚麼回事？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to show that you understand why someone has a particular opinion or feels a particular way

examples.en: "I'm so annoyed with her." "I'll bet."
examples.trans: 「我實在太煩她了。」「我相信是。」

examples.en: "I was so relieved I didn't have to clean up after the party." "I bet you were."
examples.trans: 「派對結束後，我不必留下來收拾打掃，這讓我大大鬆了口氣。」「我知道你會這樣。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to express surprise

examples.en: Well, I declare!
examples.trans: 嘿，真沒想到！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to express that you do not understand or are angry at something that someone has done
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （表示不理解或惱火）我不明白

examples.en: I don't know, however many notices I put up, people still park in my space.
examples.trans: 我不明白，不管我貼了多少告示，人們還是在我的車位泊車。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: i don t mind if i do
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to politely accept an offer of food or drink
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於禮貌地接受）可以吃點，可以喝些

examples.en: "There's plenty more cake if you'd like another piece." "I don't mind if I do."
examples.trans: 「如果你想再吃一塊，這裡還有很多蛋糕呢。」「那我就不客氣了。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you are not surprised at a situation or someone's behaviour, because you expected it

examples.en: I might have known (that) he'd still be in bed at noon.
examples.trans: 我就知道他到中午了還在睡覺。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you cannot believe something because it is so unlikely
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 我想我一定是聽錯了（表示不相信某事）

examples.en: He's offered to wash the dishes - I must be hearing things.
examples.trans: 他主動提出要洗碗盤——我一定是聽錯了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: I must admit
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 我必須說，我不得不承認

examples.en: I must say, I don't think much of her dress.
examples.trans: 我不得不承認，我認為她的穿著不怎麼樣。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that what you are going to say is obvious

examples.en: I need hardly say what a pleasure it is to introduce our speaker.
examples.trans: 我萬分榮幸介紹我們的演講者。

examples.en: I need hardly remind you of the seriousness of the situation.
examples.trans: 不用我提醒你也該知道局勢嚴峻。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to thank someone for helping you and as a way of saying that you will do something for them in the future
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 我欠你一份情；我會報答你的這份情

examples.en: Thanks for the help, Bill - I owe you one.
examples.trans: 謝謝你的幫助，比爾——我欠你個人情。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when what you want is extremely unlikely to happen
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 我要是那麽走運就好了！

examples.en: "You might win first prize." "I should be so lucky."
examples.trans: 「你也許會中頭獎。」 「我要是那麽走運就好了。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: i should think not so too
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you think what has been suggested is certainly not, or certainly is, the correct and expected thing

examples.en: "I bought her some flowers to say thank you." "I should think so too."
examples.trans: 「我買了些花給她表示感謝。」 「當然應該那樣。」

examples.en: "I don't like to drink more than one bottle of wine in an evening." "I should think not."
examples.trans: 「我不喜歡晚上喝超過一瓶的葡萄酒。」 「當然不能。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you are worried about something unpleasant that might happen or might have happened
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 我一想到…就惴惴不安，我真不敢想

examples.en: I shudder to think what my parents will say when I tell them I've failed my exams.
examples.trans: 我真不敢想如果告訴父母自己沒有通過考試他們會怎麽說。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to admit that something you have said or done was wrong

examples.en: I stand corrected - the date of foundation was 1411, and not 1412 as I had written.
examples.trans: 我弄錯了——創立的年代是1411年，而不是我寫的1412年。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: i take plead the fifth amendment
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say in order to tell someone you are not going to answer a question

examples.en: "So, who do you like best, Jenny or Kim?" "Sorry, I take the Fifth on that."
examples.trans: 「那麼，你最喜歡誰？是珍妮還是金姆？」「對不起，我拒絕回答。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say when you have just said something wrong and want to correct it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於糾正剛剛說過的話）我說錯了

examples.en: Her name is Paula, no, I tell a lie (= I'm wrong) - it's Pauline.
examples.trans: 她的名字叫寶拉，哦，不對——叫保利娜。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you are not surprised by what someone has said or done

examples.en: "I came to ask you a favour." "I thought as much."
examples.trans: 「我來請你幫忙的。」「我早就料到了。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: i would give anything a lot
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you would like to have or to do something very much
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 願意付出一切（以得到某物或做某事）

examples.en: I'd give anything to see the Taj Mahal.
examples.trans: 誰要是能助我去參觀泰姬陵，他要甚麼我都願意給。

examples.en: Janice would give her right arm for a house like that.
examples.trans: 要是能得到那樣一間屋，賈尼絲甚麼都願意做。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you would like something that is offered to you

examples.en: "Would you like another drink?" "I wouldn't say no."
examples.trans: 「再來一杯嗎？」「好吧。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: i wouldn t trust sb as far as i could throw them
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say that means you do not trust someone at all

examples.en: He's very charming but I wouldn't trust him as far as I could throw him.
examples.trans: 他很有魅力，但我一點都不信任他。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to mean that you do not believe someone can do something

examples.en: He said women have an easier life than men, did he? - I'd like to see him bring up children and go to work at the same time.
examples.trans: 「他說女人比男人活得更輕鬆，是不是？－－我倒想看看他怎樣一邊撫養孩子一邊工作。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: i ll be hanged if i know
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you certainly do not know
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 如果我知道，我就不得好死。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to express your determination not to do something or not to allow someone else to do something

examples.en: I'll be hanged if I'm going to clean up after him!
examples.trans: 我才不會跟在他後面整理他弄亂的東西呢！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you are sure something will not happen
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 我敢打賭…絕對不可能發生，要是…發生我把頭給你

examples.en: If she actually marries him I'll eat my hat.
examples.trans: 她要是真的會嫁給他，我就把腦袋給你。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to show that you agree very strongly with what has been said

examples.en: "Does he eat a lot?" "I'll say!"
examples.trans: 「他吃得很多嗎？」「當然！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: i ll wring your his her neck
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say when you are angry with someone
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （表示非常生氣）我會擰斷你／他／她的脖子！

examples.en: I'll wring his neck if he does that again!
examples.trans: 他要是再那樣做，我就擰斷他的脖子！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said after describing or hearing something that is very obviously not true
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於所言所聞明顯不實時）那我就是荷蘭人

examples.en: If that's his real hair, then I'm a Dutchman.
examples.trans: 如果那是他的真頭髮，那我就是荷蘭人。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: informal used to say that you will certainly not do something

examples.en: I'm polite to his ex-wife when I meet her, but I'm damned if I'm going to invite her over for dinner.
examples.trans: 我遇到他前妻時對她很客氣，但絕不會請她來吃晚飯。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you do not mind which choice is made
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （指無論哪種選擇都可以）我隨便；我無所謂

examples.en: "Shall we go to the Indian restaurant, or would you prefer Chinese food?" "I'm easy."
examples.trans: 「你是想吃印度菜呢還是吃中國菜?」「我無所謂。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to a person working in a shop when they offer to help you but you are not ready to buy something and do not want help

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say when you would be satisfied with either choice that is offered you

examples.en: "Red wine or white?" "I'm not fussy."
examples.trans: 「紅葡萄酒還是白葡萄酒?」「隨便，哪個都挺好的。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: i m so hungry i could eat a horse
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you are extremely hungry

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: informal used when you are making a criticism or complaint, to make it less likely to offend someone
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （在批評或抱怨時，用於減弱語氣）我不過說一下

examples.en: I'm just saying I think it could have been done a little more carefully, that's all.
examples.trans: 我不過說一下我覺得這件事可以處理得更謹慎，僅此而已。

examples.en: Isn't it a bit small for you? Just saying.
examples.trans: 對你來說是不是太小了？我只是說一下。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: i you wouldn t wish sth on anyone my your worst enemy
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say in order to emphasize that something is extremely unpleasant
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於強調某事極其令人厭惡）我／你不希望任何人／我的／你的死敵遭那樣的罪

examples.en: The effects of this disease are horrible. You wouldn't wish them on your worst enemy.
examples.trans: 這種病的癥狀極其可怕。你甚至都不希望自己的死敵遭那樣的罪。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: if i were in your shoes
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used when you want to tell someone what you would do in their situation

examples.en: If I were in your shoes, I think I'd write to her rather than try to explain over the phone.
examples.trans: 如果我是你，我想我會給她寫信而不是在電話裡向她解釋。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you see someone look very angrily at someone else
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 要是表情能殺人…；那模樣兇死了

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: if the cap fits wear it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone that they should accept a criticism that another person has made
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 要是批評中肯，就接受吧

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: if you can t beat em join em
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you accept that you cannot be as successful as other people without doing what they do, even though you do not approve of or agree with it

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: if you don t mind me saying asking
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used in order to be more polite when you say something that could slightly upset, annoy, or embarrass someone
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於禮貌地提出批評）如果你不介意我說

examples.en: If you don't mind me saying (so), I think the soup needs a little more salt.
examples.trans: 如果你不介意的話，我認為湯裡需要多加點鹽。

examples.en: Do you have a boyfriend, if you don't mind me asking?
examples.trans: 如果你不介意我問的話，你有男朋友嗎？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you have left out information or your opinion from what you have just said, but that you expect the person listening still to understand it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 如果你明白我的意思（指弦外之音）

examples.en: Let's just say we had "problems", if you take my meaning.
examples.trans: 我們就姑且說我們遇到了「問題」吧，如果你明白我所指的是甚麼的話。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that a particular expression is one way of saying something, especially to suggest that some people may not choose to say it that way
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 如果你願意那樣說的話

examples.en: I did very well in school , with a "genius IQ" if you will.
examples.trans: 我在學校成績很好，有「天才智商」，如果你願意那樣說的話。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: if you ll pardon the expression
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said before or after using language that other people might consider shocking
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 請原諒我用這個詞，請原諒我如此表達

examples.en: The man doesn't know his arse from his elbow, if you'll pardon the expression.
examples.trans: 這個男人是個漿糊腦袋，請原諒我這麼說。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: if you ve seen one you ve seen them all
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that all the things of a particular type are very similar
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用來表示某一類的東西全都差不多）

examples.en: If you've seen one episode of that show, you've seen them all.
examples.trans: 那個節目只要看一集就夠了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to emphasize that sometimes it is better for you if you do not know all the facts about a situation

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say that someone is responsible for something that has happened, or that something is the cause of something else
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 把…歸咎於（某人），把…歸責於（某人）

examples.en: They imputed the error to the lawyer who was handling her case.
examples.trans: 他們把錯誤歸咎於負責處理她案子的那位律師。

examples.en: He arrogantly imputed stupidity to anyone who disagreed with him.
examples.trans: 他傲慢地認為那些與他意見相左的人都是愚蠢的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you are going to give your opinion about something quickly and directly

examples.en: In a word, she's lying.
examples.trans: 一句話，她在說謊。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when expressing your opinion honestly, seriously, or truthfully
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 老實說／嚴肅地說／說真的

examples.en: In all honesty, I do have some criticisms to make.
examples.trans: 老實說，我的確要作些批評。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: in god s heaven s name
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to add force to something that is said. Some people find the use of "God" offensive.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於加強語氣）看在上帝的份上

examples.en: What in God's name caused that outburst?
examples.trans: 老天，究竟是甚麼引發了這次情緒大爆發？

examples.en: Why in the name of God didn't you tell me sooner?
examples.trans: 天啊，你為甚麼不早點告訴我？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say when you do not understand why someone has done something stupid
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 以他／她／他們的智慧（用於表示不明白為甚麼某人要做蠢事）

examples.en: The council, in its wisdom, decided to close the library and now the building stands empty.
examples.trans: 市政會以他們的智慧決定關閉那所圖書館，於是現在那座大樓就空置著。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If a joke or funny story has you in stitches, it makes you laugh a lot.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （笑話或有趣的故事）令人笑岔氣，讓人捧腹

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: in the lap of the gods
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that a situation that cannot be controlled and depends only on good luck
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 全靠運氣，碰運氣，聽天由命

examples.en: The doctors have done everything possible for him, so his recovery now is in the lap of the gods.
examples.trans: 醫生已爲他盡了全力，能否恢復現在就全靠運氣了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say when you are talking about what is most important or true in a situation

examples.en: In the final analysis, the only people who will benefit are property owners.
examples.trans: 歸根究柢，唯一受益的群體將是房產業主。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say two things in the same breath, you say two things that are so different that if one is true, the other must be false.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 同時，緊接著（指同時説出兩件相抵觸的事）

examples.en: You say he treats you badly but in the same breath you tell me how much you love him!
examples.trans: 你一會兒說他對你有多不好，可一會兒又說你有多愛他！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you tell someone something in the strictest confidence, you expect them not to tell it to anyone else.

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say to someone who has just told you about something they are hoping for, in order to show that you do not believe it will happen
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 做白日夢！（當別人說了一些你認為沒可能發生的事情，你給對方的反應）

examples.en: Dave, buy you a car? In your dreams!
examples.trans: 戴夫，給你買輛車？做你的白日夢吧！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say something in your own words, you speak without copying what someone else has said.

examples.en: The court has heard accounts of that night's events from several witnesses - now please tell us in your own words what you saw.
examples.trans: 法庭已經聽取了幾位證人對那天晚上所發生事件的陳述——現在請你用自己的話說說你看到的情況。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a private joke that can only be understood by a limited group of people who have a special knowledge of something that is referred to in the joke
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （只有圈子裡的人才能懂的）內部笑話

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: the act of reporting something that was said, but not using exactly the same words

examples.en: Compare
examples.trans: direct speech

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to use clever, secret, and often unpleasant methods to gradually become part of something

examples.en: Over the years she insinuated herself into the great man's life.
examples.trans: 這些年來她費盡心機一步步地走進了這位偉人的生活。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: Someone might ask if they can interest you in something when that person is trying to persuade you to buy something or is offering you something.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 勸（某人）買；請（某人）吃（或喝）

examples.en: Can I interest you in our new range of kitchen fittings, madam?
examples.trans: 女士，我向您介紹一下我們的新的廚房設備系列好嗎？

examples.en: I don't suppose I can interest you in a quick drink after work, can I?
examples.trans: 可以請你下班後小喝一杯嗎？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to strongly criticize something or someone

examples.en: There were politicians who inveighed against immigrants to get votes.
examples.trans: 有些政客透過猛烈抨擊移民來獲取選票。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that it is reasonable to state or believe something based on facts that are already known

examples.en: You admit you fired the gun and we now know that the shot killed the victim so you are, ipso facto, responsible for his death.
examples.trans: 你承認開過槍，而現在我們知道這一槍殺死了受害人，因此根據事實你應對他的死負責。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that the answer to a question you have just been asked is obviously 'yes'
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於表示答案毫無疑問是肯定的）教皇是天主教徒嗎?這還用問嗎?

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: isn t it aren t they just
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to strongly agree with what someone has said about someone or something

examples.en: "This is very expensive." "Isn't it just?"
examples.trans: 「這太貴了。」「可不是嘛！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you do not understand a situation or someone's behaviour

examples.en: It beats me how she got the job.
examples.trans: 我不明白她是怎樣得到這份工作的。

examples.en: What beats me is why she stays with him.
examples.trans: 我不理解她為甚麼跟他在一起。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that an unpleasant or painful situation, or an unwanted duty cannot be avoided and must be accepted

examples.en: I really didn't want to go away this weekend but, oh well, it can't be helped.
examples.trans: 這週末我真的不想離家外出，可是，唉，不出去又不行。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you are not surprised by something unpleasant that has happened
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 那是意料之中的事，一點都不奇怪

examples.en: "Dad, Sadie spilled her milk all over the floor." "It figures."
examples.trans: 「爸爸，薩迪把她的牛奶全灑在地板上。」「我一點也不意外。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone not to worry about, or place special value on, what you are doing or have done

examples.en: "You seem very upset." "No, no, it's nothing - I'm OK."
examples.trans: 「你看上去很不安。」「不，不，沒甚麼，我很好。」

examples.en: "It was so nice of you to look after the baby all day." "Oh, it was nothing, I enjoyed it."
examples.trans: 「謝謝你一整天照顧孩子。」「哦，沒甚麼，我很樂意效勞。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: it makes me want to puke
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that something makes you very upset or angry

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: it never rains but it pours
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when one bad thing happens, followed by a lot of other bad things that make a bad situation worse
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 不雨則已，一雨傾盆；禍不單行

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: it takes all sorts to make a world
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to emphasize that people have different characters, opinions, and abilities, and that you should accept this
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 世界之大，無奇不有；一樣米養百樣人

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you want to emphasize that both people involved in a difficult situation must accept the blame, or that an activity needs two people who are willing to take part for it to happen
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 兩個人才跳得成探戈；雙方都有責任；一個巴掌拍不響

examples.en: She may want to argue, but it takes two to tango and I won't stoop to her level.
examples.trans: 她可能想要爭吵，可那也得我願意，我可不想跟她一般見識。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: it wouldn t hurt you to do sth
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say when you think someone should do something because they do not often do it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 做…不會有甚麼壞處，不妨做…

examples.en: It wouldn't hurt you to do the ironing for once.
examples.trans: 試熨一次衣服不會對你有甚麼害處。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: it ll all end in tears
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: UK something that you say that means something will end badly and the people involved will be upset
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 悲劇告終，不會有好結局

examples.en: She only met him in May and they were married by July. It'll end in tears, you'll see.
examples.trans: 她五月才認識他，然後他們七月就結婚了。這不會有好結果的，你等著瞧吧。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say when you think a situation is wrong

examples.en: It's a crying shame that she's paid so little for what she does.
examples.trans: 給她那麽點工資真是太不應該了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that a particular time is a good time to meet
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （會面時間）很合適，沒問題，就這樣定了

examples.en: "I can't make it at seven o'clock. How about 9.30?" "Sure, it's a date."
examples.trans: 「我7點鐘不行，9點半怎麼樣？」「當然可以，沒問題。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say when someone has caught you doing something wrong and you agree that you were wrong
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （當場被抓獲時承認錯誤）抓得對，抓得沒錯

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: it s a funny old world
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when someone has told you something that is strange or surprising

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say when someone has asked you about something that has happened and you do not want to explain it to them because it would take too long
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 說來話長（用於別人向你詢問某事時，表示你不想解釋，因為要花很長時間）

examples.en: "So why was Carlo knocking on your door at midnight?" "It's a long story."
examples.trans: 「那為甚麼卡羅在午夜時分去敲你的房門呢？」「那可就說來話長了。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to show your surprise that people or events in different places are connected
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 這世界真小；真有這等巧事；無巧不成書

examples.en: You know my old science teacher! Well, it's a small world, isn't it?
examples.trans: 原來你認識我以前的理科老師！嘿，這真是太巧了，不是嗎？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a phrase used in film making to tell actors and crew that filming of a particular scene, film, etc. has finished
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 完成，停機！（拍攝電影時，告知演員及工作人員某場景拍攝工作完成）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: it s all greek to me
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a way of saying that you do not understand something that is said or written
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 我全然不懂；我一竅不通；對我來說是天書

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: it s an ill wind that blows nobody any good
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to show that even a very bad situation must have some good results

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you think it is too soon to make a judgment about the likely result of something because a lot might still happen or change
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 言之過早；爲時尚早；來日方長

examples.en: Our progress has been fairly slow so far, but it's early days.
examples.trans: 到目前為止我們的進度很緩慢，但來日方長。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: it s every man for himself
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say that means that everyone in a particular situation is trying to do what is best for themselves and no one is trying to help anyone else
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 人不為己，天誅地滅（指在某種特定場合，每個人都會盡力維護自己的利益，而不會幫助他人）

examples.en: It might be a civilized place to shop at other times, but come the January sales, it's every man for himself.
examples.trans: 人們在購物時通常都能保持風度，但一月大減價則除外，這個時候，人不為己，天誅地滅。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: it s just one of those things
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said about an event or situation that you cannot explain, or do not like but cannot change
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （表示無法解釋或不喜歡，但不能改變的事）這是難免的事。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: it s more than my job s worth
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say in order to tell someone that you cannot do what they want you to do because you would lose your job
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 工作不允許；（做了某事）意味著要被解僱

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: it s no use crying over spilled milk
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to emphasize that it is not useful feeling sorry about something that has already happened
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 牛奶潑了，哭也無益；已成定局的事後悔也無用

examples.en: It's no use crying over spilled milk - he's spent all the money, and there's nothing you can do about it.
examples.trans: 事已至此，傷心也沒用——他把錢都花光了，對此你也毫無辦法。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you must do something immediately, especially because you will not get another chance

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: it s raining cats and dogs
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say when it is raining heavily

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone that they are responsible for their own problems
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 是你自己的責任，都怪你自己

examples.en: It's your own lookout if you're not properly insured.
examples.trans: 沒有適當投保是你自己的責任。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: it s that s the story of my life
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when something bad happens to you that has happened to you many times before
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （表示經常遇到類似的倒楣事）我就是這個命

examples.en: Honestly, it's the story of my life - I meet a totally gorgeous bloke and he's leaving for Australia the next day!
examples.trans: 老實說，我就是這個命——我碰上一個非常喜歡的男人，但他第二天就要去澳大利亞！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: jack of all trades master of none
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said about someone who is able to do many things, but is not an expert in any
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 博而不精的人；萬事通；三腳貓

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: secret or dishonest behaviour

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a government office where unemployed people can go for advice and information about jobs that are available

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say when someone has achieved something, especially when it seems easier or quicker than you expected
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 做得好（某人做成某事時所說的話，尤其是比想像的更容易、更快時）

examples.en: I just changed the fuse in the plug and the lamp worked, job done.
examples.trans: 我只是簡單地換了插頭的保險絲，燈就亮了，輕鬆搞定。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to persuade someone to do what you want, often by deceiving them in a clever way

examples.en: [ + -ing verb ] The bosses were eventually jockeyed into signing the union agreement.
examples.trans: 多名老闆最終被哄騙在工會協議上簽字。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said in answer to something that someone has said, meaning that you are in the same bad situation as they are

examples.en: "I've got no money till the end of this week." "Join the club!"
examples.trans: 「一直到週末之前我都身無分文。」「彼此彼此！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you want to start speaking seriously about something after making jokes and laughing about it

examples.en: Joking apart, will you be able to manage on your own?
examples.trans: 言歸正傳，你自己應付得了嗎？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to express approval of something that someone has said or done, or to show that you have heard or understood what someone has said
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （表示贊同、已聽到或明白）很好

examples.en: "I've left all the papers you need on your desk." "Oh, jolly good."
examples.trans: 「我把你需要的文件都放在你桌子上了。」「噢，很好。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to express admiration for what someone has said or done

examples.en: "We won!" "Oh, jolly good show!"
examples.trans: 「我們贏了！」「啊，太棒了！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: US informal to criticize someone suddenly and severely
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 突然而嚴厲地批評（某人）

examples.en: When I showed him my report card, Dad jumped all over me.
examples.trans: 當我給他看我的評語卡時，爸爸突然對我大肆批評。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to criticize someone as soon as they have done something wrong or said something that you disagree with

examples.en: She jumps on her children instantly if they're disobedient.
examples.trans: 孩子一不聽話，她就加以責備。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone to do something quickly

examples.en: I told you to tidy this room - now jump to it!
examples.trans: 我告訴過你要收拾這個房間的——快點做！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: just because i m paranoid doesn t mean they re not out to get me
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you recognize that you generally worry too much about people trying to harm you, but believe that in this particular situation people really are trying to harm you
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 我知道自己多疑，但危險並非不存在（表示你意識到自己通常過度擔心受人傷害，但相信這一次別人真的有加害之心）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: A heterosexual man who is just gay enough has some of the qualities typical of gay men that many women like, such as an interest in clothes or being able to talk about emotions.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 像同性戀的，奶油小生的，脂粉氣的

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say when something bad happens to you

examples.en: They sold the last ticket five minutes before I got there - just my luck!
examples.trans: 就在我到那裡的五分鐘前他們賣掉了最後一張票——真倒楣！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone that what you are about to say should be kept secret
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 作為你我之間的秘密，不要告訴別人

examples.en: Between you and me, I don't think she'll stay in this job very long.
examples.trans: 不要告訴別人，我覺得她做這份工作不會太久。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to mean that there was no way of planning to avoid something
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 命中註定的事；不可避免的事

examples.en: The road was blocked, so we missed the meeting - it was just one of those things.
examples.trans: 道路堵塞，結果我們錯過了會議——這沒辦法。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to not talk to other people very much

examples.en: He's a very private person - he keeps (himself) to himself.
examples.trans: 他是個非常孤僻的人——不太與人交往。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: keep a civil tongue in your head
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone to stop being rude

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to continue to talk in an annoying way about something
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 喋喋不休；嘮叨個沒完沒了

examples.en: Don't keep on, I'll sort it out in a minute.
examples.trans: 別喋喋不休了，我馬上就解決這事。

examples.en: He kept on at me about the money, even though I told him I hadn't got it.
examples.trans: 我告訴他我沒拿到錢，但他還是一直就此和我嘮叨個不停。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to not tell someone what you are going to do next
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 讓（某人）捉摸不定，讓（某人）猜不透

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to act or speak for the country or group that a flag represents
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 代表國家（或組織）行動（或發言）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to tell someone to stop being so angry or upset

examples.en: Keep your hair on! Your car isn't badly damaged!
examples.trans: 別生氣！你的車受損不嚴重！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to not say what your opinions are
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 不透露自己的意見；不發表自己的觀點

examples.en: I'd love to know what Anna thinks, but she always keeps her own counsel.
examples.trans: 我想知道安娜對事情的看法，可她總不發表意見。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to tell someone to stop being so angry or upset

examples.en: Keep your shirt on! Your car isn't even scratched!
examples.trans: 別生氣！你的車連剮蹭的痕跡都沒有！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: keep hold your cards close to your chest
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to keep your intended actions secret
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 對（計劃等）守口如瓶，對（打算）秘而不宣

examples.en: You never quite know what Barry's going to do next - he keeps his cards very close to his chest.
examples.trans: 你永遠不太會知道巴里接下來會有甚麼舉動——他總是守口如瓶。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to refuse to accept something and react strongly against it

examples.en: As a boy he always kicked against his father's authority.
examples.trans: 他小時候總是不服父親的管束。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
