Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you kick ideas around, you talk about them informally in a group.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （在小組中）隨便談一談，非正式討論

examples.en: We need to get everyone together and kick a few ideas around
examples.trans: 我們需要聚集各人，一起討論幾個構思。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: kick hit sb when he she is down
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to criticize or take unfair advantage of someone when they are in a weak position

examples.en: It's typical of the boss to kick someone when they're down.
examples.trans: 趁人之危是這個老闆的典型手法。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone that you will not do what they want you to do
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 不要妄想了！（表示拒絕按別人的意志行事）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone to perform or play as well as possible
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於告訴某人要盡力做好）全力以赴！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone to stop doing something that annoys you

examples.en: Oh, knock it off Alex, I'm really not in the mood for your jokes.
examples.trans: 哎，別說了，亞歷克斯，我真的沒心情聽你說笑話。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: informal to reduce a price, or to persuade someone to reduce the price of something they are selling
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 降價；說服（某人）降價；殺（某人的）價

examples.en: See also
examples.trans: knock-down

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a way of describing the sound made when you hit a door. It is sometimes used as the first line of a joke.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 咚咚的敲門聲；「敲門，敲門」（有時候開玩笑時說的第一句話，然後是玩笑的內容）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: know see where sb is coming from
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say to someone you know or see where they are coming from, you mean you understand why that person has a particular opinion, often although you do not have that opinion.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 明白／知道（某人）為甚麼會那樣想

examples.en: I would've taken the dog to the vet, but I could see where they were coming from.
examples.trans: 是我的話，我會把狗送去看獸醫，但是我也明白他們為什麼會那麼想。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to accept someone's power over you and do what they tell you to do

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to suddenly attack someone or something physically or criticize him, her, or it in an angry way

examples.en: I was only teasing him and suddenly he lashed out (at me) and hit me in the face.
examples.trans: 我只是在和他鬧著玩，他卻突然動起手來，一拳打在我的臉上。

examples.en: Why's Tina in such a bad mood? She really lashed out at me when I was late for work.
examples.trans: 蒂娜爲甚麽情緒這麽糟糕？我上班遲到了她就對我大發雷霆。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: the final remark in an argument or discussion
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （辯論或討論中的）最終的話，最後陳述

examples.en: You're not going, Helena, and that's my last word on the matter.
examples.trans: 你不能去，海倫娜，這事就這麽定了。

examples.en: She always has to have the last word (= win the argument).
examples.trans: 她總是必須得贏。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to mean that trying to be happy is a good way to stop worrying

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to attack someone physically, or to criticize someone in an angry way

examples.en: In the middle of the meeting she suddenly laid into him for no apparent reason.
examples.trans: 在會上，她突然無緣無故地把他訓斥了一頓。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: lay it on a bit thick
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to praise someone too much

examples.en: She went on and on about how she admired his work - laid it on a bit thick, if you ask me.
examples.trans: 她一直不停地在說對他的工作有多麽欽佩——要我說有點過分了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: lay sth at sb s door
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to blame someone for something

examples.en: Blame for the accident has been laid at the government's door.
examples.trans: 人們認為發生此次事故的責任在政府。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to officially establish a rule, or to officially say how something should be done

examples.en: They laid down their weapons and surrendered.
examples.trans: 他們放下武器投降了。

examples.en: Mediators have persuaded both sides to lay down their arms.
examples.trans: 調停者已經說服雙方停止戰鬥。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: mainly US slang to tell someone something they did not know

examples.en: They lay on free entertainment at the club every day.
examples.trans: 他們每天在俱樂部安排免費娛樂活動。

examples.en: They laid on a wonderful buffet after the wedding.
examples.trans: 婚禮後他們安排了一頓豐盛的自助餐。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: informal to say very clearly that something is the case
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 把…說清楚，明白無誤地說出，明確說明

examples.en: I'd be laying my career/life on the line by giving you that information.
examples.trans: 向你透露那個消息會毀了我的前途／要了我的命。

examples.en: You're just going to have to lay it on the line and tell her that her work's not good enough.
examples.trans: 你就要把這件事擺到枱面上，明白無誤地跟她講她的工作沒做好。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to begin to speak, usually as the first person to speak

examples.en: I want to lead off by thanking everyone for coming.
examples.trans: 我想首先發言感謝每一個到來的人。

examples.en: Who swam the lead-off leg of the race?
examples.trans: 誰遊第一棒？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to persuade someone to believe something that is untrue

examples.en: All that time she'd been leading him on (= pretending she liked him), but she was only interested in his money.
examples.trans: 那時她一直都在假裝喜歡他，但她只對他的錢感興趣。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that a bad situation can be quickly forgotten if people stop talking about it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （指對於壞事）議論越少，淡忘越快。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone to stop being annoying

examples.en: Hey, leave off! I hate people touching my hair.
examples.trans: 喂，別煩我了！我討厭別人碰我頭髮。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to not discuss one subject so that you can discuss a different subject
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 將（話題等）擱置，將…放在一邊

examples.en: Leaving aside the question of cost, how many people do we need on the job?
examples.trans: 先不談費用問題，這項工作我們需要多少人？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: unusual and different from what is normally seen, said, or done
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 不同于平時所見（或所說、所作）的

examples.en: The festival will showcase left-field acts that are not often seen in mainstream theatres.
examples.trans: 藝術節將展示平時難以在主流劇院見到的不同尋常的表演。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a remark that seems to say something pleasant about a person but could also be an insult

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to suddenly make a sound or speak in an uncontrolled way

examples.en: The allies let loose an intensive artillery bombardment over the border.
examples.trans: 聯軍對邊境地區進行了一陣猛烈的炮擊。

examples.en: He turned around and let loose a torrent of abuse.
examples.trans: 他轉過身來破口大駡。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to tell other people about something that you know, especially when it is a secret

examples.en: I suspect he knows more than he's letting on.
examples.trans: 除了透露出的那些情況外，我懷疑他對這件事還知道更多。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to tell someone about something that is secret, or to allow someone to become involved in something that only very few people are involved in
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 向（某人）公開；允許（某人）參與（秘密的事情）

examples.en: Debbie agreed to let me in on her plans.
examples.trans: 黛比同意讓我參加她的計劃。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to warn someone that they should not talk about a bad situation that most people have forgotten about
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 過去的事就讓它過去吧；不要再去揭傷疤

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to not correct or argue with something that a person says or does that is wrong

examples.en: I know what he said wasn't strictly accurate but I let it pass anyway.
examples.trans: 我知道他說的並不十分準確，但不管怎樣，我沒有去追究。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to not talk about or mention a particular subject

examples.en: After he had told his friends he was writing a novel, they wouldn't let the subject rest.
examples.trans: 自從他告訴他的朋友們他正在寫一本小說後，他們就沒完沒了地提起這事。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to tell people about something without intending to

examples.en: He let it slip that he hadn't actually read the report.
examples.trans: 他無意中透露出他根本就沒有看過那個報告。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: let the cat out of the bag
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to allow a secret to be known, usually without intending to

examples.en: I was trying to keep the party a secret, but Mel went and let the cat out of the bag.
examples.trans: 我盡力守住要舉辦聚會這個秘密，可是梅爾一去就說漏了嘴。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to tell someone the truth about something
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 告知（某人）真相，對（某人）說真話

examples.en: I'll level with you - the salary's not particularly good, and there's little chance of promotion.
examples.trans: 我實話跟你說——工資並不太高，也沒有多少晉升的機會。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a brand name for a type of plastic or rubber mattress that you fill with air and use to lie on or to float on water

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to tell someone something that you know is completely false

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: someone who you pay to give you advice about how to improve your life
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 人生教練（受僱為某人提供人生建議的人）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: life is just a bowl of cherries
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say that means that life is very pleasant. This phrase is often used humorously to mean the opposite.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （常幽默地用作反語）一切都十全十美；一切都完美無缺

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: someone who you pay to give you advice about how to improve your life
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 生活顧問（受僱為某人提供生活建議的人）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to show that it is unlikely that something bad or unusual will happen to the same person twice
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 閃電不會兩次擊中同一個地方；倒楣事不會總落在同一個人身上；一事不過二

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you tell someone to like it or lump it, you mean that person must accept a situation they do not like, because it cannot be changed.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 必須接受某個現狀，因為情況沒法改變

examples.en: Like it or lump it, romantic fiction is read regularly by thousands.
examples.trans: 還是接受現實吧，數以千計的人都有讀言情小說的習慣。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: liken sb sth to sb sth
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say that someone is similar to or has the same qualities as someone else

examples.en: She's been likened to a young Elizabeth Taylor.
examples.trans: 人們說她很像年輕時的伊麗莎白‧泰勒。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a language used for communication between groups of people who speak different languages
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （母語不同的人交流用的）通用語，混合語

examples.en: The international business community sees English as a lingua franca.
examples.trans: 國際商界將英語視為通用語言。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say that you agree with something but do nothing to support it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 口頭上同意，口頭上支持

examples.en: She claims to be in favour of training, but so far she's only paid lip service to the idea.
examples.trans: 她聲稱對培訓持贊成態度，但到目前為止她的贊成還僅僅停留在口頭上。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to listen to good advice and be influenced by it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 聽從勸告；明白事理；懂道理

examples.en: Friends tried to persuade them to change their minds, but neither man would listen to reason.
examples.trans: 朋友們都力勸他們改變想法，但是這兩個人誰都不聽勸告。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say to make people listen to you

examples.en: Okay everyone - listen up! I have an announcement to make.
examples.trans: 好了，大家注意了！我要說一件事。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to mean that people should accept the way other people live and behave, especially if they do things in a different way
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 自己活也讓別人活；互相寬容

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say when you tell someone about something surprising that happened

examples.en: I was in Vienna sitting quietly in a café when, lo and behold, my cousin walked in.
examples.trans: 我靜靜地坐在維也納一間咖啡館裡喝著咖啡，真沒想到，我的表弟走了進來。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to show support for the person or thing mentioned

examples.en: Long live the president!
examples.trans: 總統萬歲！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone to do something quickly

examples.en: Look lively - we haven't got all day!
examples.trans: 動作快點——我們可沒有一整天的時間！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: look sb in the eye face
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to talk to someone in a direct and confident way that shows you are honest or not ashamed

examples.en: I wanted to look people in the eye and tell them I made a mistake.
examples.trans: 我想坦誠地和人們說，我犯了一個錯誤。

examples.en: I can't believe you can look me in the face and lie to me like that.
examples.trans: 我真想不到你會一臉坦誠地對我說謊。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say when someone criticizes you for something that that person does himself or herself

examples.en: I'm lazy? Look who's talking!
examples.trans: 我懶？虧你有臉說別人！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to make someone speak more freely

examples.en: A couple of glasses of champagne had loosened my tongue and I said things that perhaps I shouldn't have.
examples.trans: 喝了幾杯香檳後我的話就開始多了起來，可能說了一些不該說的話。

examples.en: A few beers should loosen his tongue.
examples.trans: 幾杯啤酒就能打開他的話匣子。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to make someone speak very honestly
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 使（某人）說出，使（某人）講實話

examples.en: A couple of glasses of champagne had loosened my tongue and I said things that perhaps I shouldn't have.
examples.trans: 喝了幾杯香檳後我的話就開始多了起來，可能說了一些不該說的話。

examples.en: A few beers should loosen his tongue.
examples.trans: 幾杯啤酒就能打開他的話匣子。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you do not know

examples.en: Lord knows where we're going to get the money from.
examples.trans: 天知道我們從哪裡才能弄到那筆錢。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to warn someone that if they want to be in a relationship with you, they must be willing to accept everything about you
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 愛屋及烏；愛我就要接受我的一切

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a situation where two or more people praise each other a lot, especially when the praise is more than they deserve

examples.en: The awards ceremony, as usual, was a love-in.
examples.trans: 頒獎儀式一如既往地成為互相吹捧的大會。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a word said by someone performing a trick to help it work successfully

examples.en: I'll just say the magic word and the rabbit will disappear - Abracadabra!
examples.trans: 我唸一下咒語，兔子就會消失——阿布拉卡達布拉！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: at the second highest level of the special levels of achievement in a person's studies at a US college or university. The expression comes from Latin, meaning "with great praise".
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （拉丁語，原意為「以崇高獎勵」，美國大學中對學業的第二高獎勵）以優異成績地

examples.en: In 1977, he graduated magna cum laude from Harvard University with an A.B. in applied mathematics and economics.
examples.trans: 1977年，他在哈佛大學以優異成績畢業，獲得應用數學和經濟學學士學位。

examples.en: The thesis was awarded a magna cum laude qualification.
examples.trans: 這篇論文獲得優異成績。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: make all the right correct etc noises
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say the things you are expected to say, sometimes when you do not mean them

examples.en: He made all the right noises about my audition but I couldn't tell if he was genuinely impressed.
examples.trans: 他不停說我的試唱好，但我判斷不出他是否真的這樣覺得。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to argue that something is the best thing to do, giving your reasons

examples.en: We will only publish a new edition if you can make a convincing case for it.
examples.trans: 你能給出令人信服的理由我們才會出新版。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: make a clean breast of it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to tell the truth about something

examples.en: Julia finally made a clean breast of it and admitted that she had stolen the money.
examples.trans: 朱麗亞最終坦白了，承認是她偷了錢。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to talk about or complain about something a lot
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 對…說個不停；不停地抱怨

examples.en: She's been making a lot of noise about moving to a new house.
examples.trans: 她一直嘮叨要搬新家的事。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say things to someone who you do not know well, in order to be polite

examples.en: I was just trying to make conversation.
examples.trans: 我只是盡力說些應酬話。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to do what you have said you would do

examples.en: My grandfather said he would pay for me to go to college, and he made good on that promise.
examples.trans: 我爺爺說他會付學費送我上大學，他實現了這個承諾。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: UK informal make it snappy used to tell someone to do something quickly or to hurry up

examples.en: Take him to the hospital - and make it quick!
examples.trans: 送他去醫院，動作快點！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone that you want them to do something immediately and to do it quickly

examples.en: Get your shoes on, and make it snappy.
examples.trans: 穿上鞋，快點。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to speak romantically and give attention to someone, especially in order to make them love you
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 向（某人）示愛，對（某人）獻殷勤

examples.en: Mr Jackson, I do believe you are making love to me.
examples.trans: 積遜先生，我敢肯定你在向我示愛。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to intentionally say or do something that causes other people to be upset or annoyed with each other
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 搬弄是非，挑撥離間，製造不和

examples.en: My children often try to make mischief between me and my new husband.
examples.trans: 我的孩子常常試圖在我和我的新丈夫之間製造不和。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to show what you think or feel by what you say, without stating it directly
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （在言語間）透露，暗示；放出風聲

examples.en: He's been making noises about taking us all to Rio, but we haven't heard anything definite.
examples.trans: 他一直暗示要把我們都帶去裡約，但是我們卻沒有聽到任何確切說法。

examples.en: If things start going badly again, our members are sure to make noises.
examples.trans: 如果事態再次惡化，我們的成員肯定會抱怨。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say, usually falsely, that something is true

examples.en: [ + to infinitive ] He made himself out to be a millionaire.
examples.trans: 他謊稱自己是百萬富翁。

examples.en: [ + to be ] The British weather is not always as bad as it is made out to be.
examples.trans: 英國的天氣並非總是像人們所說的那樣糟糕。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: make representations a representation to sb sth
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to complain officially to a person or organization

examples.en: We made representations to the boss about the long working hours.
examples.trans: 我們就工作時間過長一事向老闆提出抗議。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If someone makes your heart flutter, you find that person very physically attractive and you feel excited when you see or talk to them.

examples.en: James has been making hearts flutter ever since he joined the company.
examples.trans: 詹姆斯進入公司以來，已迷得很多人為之心跳。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to show something bad that has been said about someone is true
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 證明（陳述）真實；證明（指控）成立

examples.en: They've arrested him for fraud but they'll never make the charges stick.
examples.trans: 他們以詐騙罪逮捕了他，但將無法證明這些指控成立。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: UK to cause a bad argument

examples.en: He set the fur flying by demanding to see proof.
examples.trans: 他要求看證據，就這樣引起了激烈的爭吵。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to be too friendly to someone or to praise them in order to get advantages for yourself

examples.en: Have you seen the disgusting way she makes up to the boss?
examples.trans: 你見過她巴結老闆的醜態嗎？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to tell someone who you are

examples.en: Just go to the hotel reception and make yourself known (to the receptionist).
examples.trans: 直接去飯店接待處（向接待員）報你的名字。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to talk to a lot of people

examples.en: I've made/done the rounds of all the agents, but nobody has any tickets left.
examples.trans: 我已經問過所有的代理點了，但是都沒有票了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: man cannot live by bread alone
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that people need not just food, but also poetry, art, music, etc. to live happily
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 人活著不只是為了吃飯。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: informal used to tell someone that they should deal with something more bravely
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於鼓勵他人勇敢面對）拿出點男子氣概

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to describe an honest and direct conversation between two men

examples.en: a man-to-man discussion
examples.trans: 開誠布公的討論

examples.en: We talked man-to-man.
examples.trans: 我們坦率地交談。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: someone whose job is to give advice to companies about the best way of managing and improving their businesses
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 管理諮詢師（為企業如何最佳管理和發展業務提出建議的人）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: many a true word is spoken in jest
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said about humorous remarks that contain serious or true statements

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: many happy returns of the day
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to mean "Happy birthday"

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to praise someone in order to make that person think they are better than they are
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 奉承，討好（某人），拍（某人）的馬屁

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to admit that something was your fault
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 我的過失；我應受譴責；我應負責任

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: not brave enough to say what you mean directly and honestly
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 不直爽的，說話拐彎抹角的

examples.en: a mealy-mouthed spokesperson
examples.trans: 說話拐彎抹角的發言人

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said at Christmas to wish people a pleasant Christmas period

examples.en: Hello, Phoebe. Merry Christmas!
examples.trans: 你好，菲比。聖誕快樂！

examples.en: The shop assistant wished me a merry Christmas.
examples.trans: 售貨員祝我聖誕快樂。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to treat someone in a bad, rude, or annoying way, or to start an argument with someone

examples.en: I've warned you already, don't mess with me!
examples.trans: 我已警告過你，別來惹我！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a position between two opposite opinions in an argument, or between two descriptions

examples.en: The UN peace envoy has failed to find any middle ground between the government and the opposition parties.
examples.trans: 聯合國和平特使未能使該政府與反對黨之間達成任何妥協。

examples.en: He can be magical, he can be comical, but only rarely does he occupy the middle ground.
examples.trans: 他可以是神秘迷人的，也可以是滑稽可笑的，但很少介於兩者之間。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: the series of visits made at a particular time of the year by large companies to colleges and universities to discuss giving jobs to students after they have finished their education
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （各大公司進行的）畢業招聘，巡迴招聘，校園招募

examples.en: Dad had a milk round and used to get up really early.
examples.trans: 那時候爸爸有固定的送奶工作，很早就得起床。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a person who performs by using movements of their hands, body, and facial expressions, without speech, to tell a story
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 默劇表演藝術家，默劇演員

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to advise someone that it is best not to have or do too much or too little of anything

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: money doesn t grow on trees
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to warn someone to be careful how much money they spend, because there is only a limited amount
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （提醒別人花錢時要謹慎）錢可不是從樹上長出來的，錢可不是從天上掉下來的

examples.en: "Mum, I'd like a new bike." "I'll have to think about it - money doesn't grow on trees, you know!"
examples.trans: 「媽媽，我想要輛新腳踏車。」「我要好好想一想──你知道，錢可不是從天上掉下來的！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said about people or organizations that are rich, and can therefore get or do what they want
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 財大氣就粗；有錢就有勢

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: more greater bigger etc than the sum of its parts
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that a particular thing, when considered as a whole, is more important, better, etc. than you would expect from looking at the individual parts that make it up
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 整體比局部的總和更好（或更重要）

examples.en: He has built a global operation that is clearly bigger than the sum of its parts.
examples.trans: 他建立了一套全球運作體系，並不是把各地區的活動相加起來那麼簡單。

examples.en: She believes that the Catholic faith is more than the sum of its dogmas.
examples.trans: 她相信天主教信仰並非幾條信條那麼簡單。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a woman who you feel you can ask for help, support, or advice

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to express your opinions too loudly and publicly
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （在公開場合毫無顧忌地）發表意見，談論

examples.en: I had to listen to Michael mouthing off about the government all through lunch.
examples.trans: 吃午餐的整個過程中我不得不聽著麥克對政府大發議論。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to speak in a rude or offensive way to someone

examples.en: She's a typical teenager, coming home late at night and mouthing off to her parents.
examples.trans: 她是個典型的青少年，深夜才回家，又和父母頂嘴。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone to hurry

examples.en: Come on, Phil, move it!
examples.trans: 走吧，菲爾，快點！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to rudely tell someone to hurry up or to get out of your way
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於不禮貌地催促某人）趕快！；（用於粗魯地叫人讓路）滾開！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to mean that people are likely to believe something bad that is said about someone, even if it is not true
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 泥巴黏身不易掉；誹謗總是有人信

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you tell someone, or agree with someone, to keep something a secret
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於告訴或答應某人保守秘密）別張揚出去，一定保密

examples.en: "I'm not telling people generally yet." "OK, mum's the word!"
examples.trans: 「我還沒有公開和大家講。」「好，一定守口如瓶！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say to mean that your life is not bad and that you should not complain about it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 沒有甚麼好抱怨的，日子過得還不錯

examples.en: "How's it going then, Mike?" "Oh, not too bad. Mustn't grumble."
examples.trans: 「那麼，一切還好吧，麥克？」「哦，不錯，沒有甚麼好抱怨的。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you do not believe what someone has just said

examples.en: "She said she had food poisoning." "Food poisoning, my arse! She just drank too much last night."
examples.trans: 「她說她食物中毒了。」「食物中毒？胡說！她昨晚只是喝多了。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you feel great sadness for someone. This phrase is often used humorously to mean the opposite.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 我的心爲（某人）流血，我爲（某人）感到悲傷（幽默的用法，常表示相反的意思）

examples.en: humorous John complains he only has two cars - my heart bleeds for him (= I certainly do not feel sadness about that)!
examples.trans: 約翰抱怨自己只有兩輛汽車——我真爲他感到悲哀！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you are promising to keep a secret

examples.en: "Oh and please don't tell him you saw me here." "Don't worry. My lips are sealed."
examples.trans: 「哦，請別告訴他你在這裡見過我。」「放心吧，我會守口如瓶的。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said in answer to something that someone has just said when you believe it yourself, or when you have said it yourself earlier

examples.en: "So even if we got the funding, we still couldn't get the project started." "My point exactly."
examples.trans: 「那麼即使我們得到了那筆資金，也仍然無法開始專案。」「我就是那意思。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a short journey, especially with a group of other people in a bus, to visit places that are kept secret from you until you get there
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （尤指許多遊客一起乘坐大客車、事先不知道目的地的）神秘旅行

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to rudely tell someone to go away because they are annoying you

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to prove that something really is a lie

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a government that tries to give too much advice or make too many laws about how people should live their lives, especially about eating, smoking, or drinking alcohol
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 保姆式政府（指過分干涉國民生活的政府）

examples.en: The government was accused of trying to create a nanny state when it announced new guidelines on healthy eating.
examples.trans: 政府發布了新的健康飲食指導，卻被指為嘗試建立保姆式政府。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said after a statement when you expect that someone can guess the result of what you have just said

examples.en: Tom was doing the cooking - need I say more?
examples.trans: 湯姆在做飯——還用我多說嗎？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: UK used to say that the person asking you something already knows the answer, because it is expected
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （表示問話者理應知道答案）還用問嗎？

examples.en: "Did he upset a lot of people at the meeting?" "Need you ask!"
examples.trans: 「他在會上觸怒了很多人嗎？」「那還用問！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: never look a gift horse in the mouth
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to advise someone not to refuse something good that is being offered

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: never put off until tomorrow what you can do today
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to emphasize that you should not delay doing something if you can do it immediately

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to encourage people to keep trying

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when two things or people are completely different, unsuitable for each other, or are unable to agree

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say when you have just heard that someone has done something you think is good
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 好樣的！太好了！（用於表示對某人所作所為的讚歎）

examples.en: "Graham's brought some champagne along to mark the occasion." "Oh, nice one, Graham!"
examples.trans: 「格雷厄姆帶了些香檳來慶祝這一時刻。」「太棒了，格雷厄姆！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: nice work if you can get it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say about an easy way of earning money that you would like to do if you could
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 容易賺錢的事人人都願意做，能有這樣的好事就好了。

examples.en: She got one million dollars for appearing on television for five minutes - (that's) nice work if you can get it!
examples.trans: 她在電視上露面5分鐘就拿到了100萬美元——這樣的好事誰不願意做！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that people say when you may not or cannot do something

examples.en: I asked if we could go to the party, but Mom said no dice.
examples.trans: 我問我們可不可以參加派對，媽媽說不行。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: UK If you say there are no flies on someone, you mean that they cannot easily be deceived.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 很精明，不會輕易上當受騙

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say to a child to stop them arguing with you when you want them to do something

examples.en: I want no ifs or buts - just get on and tidy your room now.
examples.trans: 別找藉口——現在就趕快打掃你的房間。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say a person is very good at a certain activity

examples.en: He's no mean cook.
examples.trans: 他是位很好的廚師。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that is said when someone has decided to stop thinking about the wishes and feelings of other people

examples.en: I've had enough of people taking advantage of me. From now on it's no more Mr Nice Guy.
examples.trans: 我真是受夠了老是被人利用。從現在起我不再做好好先生了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to make someone feel less worried when they have not received information about someone or something, because if something bad had happened, they would have been told about it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 沒有消息就是好消息，不聞凶訊便是吉

examples.en: We haven't heard anything from the hospital today, but I suppose no news is good news.
examples.trans: 我們今天沒有得到醫院的任何消息，但我想沒有消息就是好消息。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: mainly UK something you say when it is very easy to guess something

examples.en: No prizes for guessing where Daniel is.
examples.trans: 不用猜都知道丹尼爾在哪裡。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to show that you will or can do what someone has asked you to
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 沒問題（表示答應做某事）

examples.en: I can burn you some copies of the CD, no problemo.
examples.trans: 我可以替你燒錄一些光碟，沒甚麼問題。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say there is no room for a feeling or type of behaviour, you mean it is not acceptable.

examples.en: In a small company like this, there is no room for laziness.
examples.trans: 在這樣的小公司中，懶惰的員工是沒有容身之地的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: an expression of surprise, often used as a joke when someone has told you something that is very obvious
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （表示對剛聽到的話感到驚訝）不會吧

examples.en: "This is hard work!" "No shit!"
examples.trans: 「這事挺費勁的！」「不會吧！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you will do something immediately

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: no not enough room to swing a cat
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said about a place or space that is very small
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 空間很狹小；（地方）連轉個身都困難

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you want to show that someone or something is a surprising or exciting choice or example
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於表示吃驚或興奮）竟然，正是

examples.en: The first speech was given by none other than Clint Eastwood.
examples.trans: 第一個發言的正是克林特．伊斯特伍德。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that an amount is more than the stated amount

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to describe the way someone behaves when they think they are better than other people and do not want to speak to them

examples.en: She walked past me with her nose in the air.
examples.trans: 她旁若無人地從我身邊走過。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when a situation or event is very different from what you expected
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 根本不是那樣（指與預料完全不同）

examples.en: I thought he would be sorry, but not a bit of it.
examples.trans: 我原以為他會感到難過，但他根本沒當一回事。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that something happened when it was almost too late

examples.en: Help arrived - and not a moment too soon.
examples.trans: 援助到達了——差點就遲了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you would never do something

examples.en: I wouldn't invite her again at any price.
examples.trans: 我絕不會再邀請她了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: not be all it s cracked up to be
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to be not as good as people say

examples.en: This new radio station's not all it's cracked up to be.
examples.trans: 這家新電臺並不像吹噓的那樣好。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: not be as black as you are painted
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: old-fashioned offensive not to be as bad as people say you are

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: not be in sb s vocabulary
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: You say that a particular quality is not in your vocabulary if you never show it or experience it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 在（某人的）詞彙裡沒有這個詞

examples.en: Did you say "tact"? The word isn't in his vocabulary!
examples.trans: 你說的是「圓滑」？他的字典中可沒有這個詞！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone to never come back to a place
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 不要再登…的門；別再回到…地方

examples.en: Never darken my door again!
examples.trans: 以後不准再進我的家門！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you do not think or do something at all

examples.en: I don't believe that story for a moment.
examples.trans: 我絕不會相信過那個說法。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that something is unpleasant, and will upset people who are squeamish
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 不適宜神經脆弱的人的；易使人心煩意亂的

examples.en: "The Silence of the Lambs" is an entertaining movie but is not for the squeamish.
examples.trans: 《沈默的羔羊》是部很好看的電影，但非常暴力，不適合神經脆弱的人。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: not get a word in edgeways
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to not be able to say anything because someone else is talking all the time

examples.en: Rosa was talking so much that nobody else could get a word in edgeways!
examples.trans: 羅茲話太多了，別人連一句話也插不進去。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to not start to think about or discuss a subject

examples.en: "Then there's the guilt I feel about leaving her for seven hours every day." "Don't even go there!"
examples.trans: 「還有，每天要有七個小時不跟她在一起，讓我感到十分歉疚。」「你不要再想這件事啦！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used in spoken English to express a positive statement more strongly
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （加強肯定語氣的口語表達）非常，很

examples.en: It wasn't half crowded in the club last night (= it was very crowded).
examples.trans: 俱樂部昨天晚上人滿爲患。

examples.en: She didn't half shout at him (= she shouted a lot at him).
examples.trans: 她衝著他大喊大叫！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: not have a civil word to say about sb
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to not be able to think of anything good to say about someone
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 關於…說不出什麼好話；對…沒有任何好感

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to be completely unwilling or to refuse

examples.en: I asked him to help out, but he wasn't having any of it.
examples.trans: 我請他來幫個忙，但是他不願意。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say you will not hear of something, you mean you will not allow it, usually when you want to do something good for someone.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 拒絕接受，拒不答應（常指有好處的事）

examples.en: I wanted to pay but she wouldn't hear of it.
examples.trans: 我要付帳，但她不同意。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: not in a month of sundays
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that something will not happen in a month of Sundays, you mean that it is very unlikely to happen.

examples.en: He's never going to get that finished in a month of Sundays!
examples.trans: 他才不會把它完成呢！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say you know someone but not in the biblical sense, you mean you have not had sex with them.

examples.en: "Did you know her?" "Yes - not in the biblical sense, of course."
examples.trans: 「你以前認識她嗎？」「認識——不過我們之間沒有曖昧關係。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: not know the meaning of the word
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you are talking about a quality or an activity and you say that someone doesn't know the meaning of the word, you mean they do not have that quality or have no experience of that activity.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （某人對做某事）沒有經驗，一無所知；（某人）完全缺乏某種素質

examples.en: Work? He doesn't know the meaning of the word!
examples.trans: 工作？他根本就不懂甚麼叫做工作。

examples.en: And the irony of Phil talking about ethics. He doesn't know the meaning of the word.
examples.trans: 菲爾談論道德規範簡直是個諷刺。他本身根本就是一個沒有道德的人。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say what you mean clearly and directly, even if you upset people by doing this
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 直截了當地說，直言不諱

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said about someone who never fails to notice and take advantage of a good opportunity

examples.en: Jonathan doesn't miss a trick! If there's a bargain to be had, he'll find it.
examples.trans: 喬納森從不錯失良機！如果市場上有便宜貨，他一定會找到的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when something you failed to see or experience was not important or special
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用以表示所錯過的並不重要）沒錯過什麼，沒什麼大不了的，沒什麼可遺憾的

examples.en: "I didn't manage to see that programme." "Don't worry, you didn't miss much."
examples.trans: 「我錯過了那個節目。」「別擔心，你沒錯過什麼。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said as a way of strongly refusing someone's suggestion or request

examples.en: "So you're going to bring Kev, are you?" "Not on your life!"
examples.trans: 「你會把蓋烏帶來的，是不是？」「休想！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: US informal to say nothing

examples.en: You didn't say boo to me about going to your mother's this weekend.
examples.trans: 你從沒和我提起過這個週末要去看你母親的事情。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: not so much sth as sth
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that something is not so much one thing as something else, you mean it is more the second thing.

examples.en: They're not so much lovers as friends.
examples.trans: 他們與其說是戀人，不如說是朋友。

examples.en: I don't feel angry so much as sad.
examples.trans: 與其說我憤怒，例不如說我悲哀。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to refuse to accept bad or silly behaviour

examples.en: The new teacher won't stand any nonsense.
examples.trans: 新老師不容許任何人搗亂。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to refuse to be treated badly by someone

examples.en: He can't treat you like that! Surely you're not going to take that lying down!
examples.trans: 他不能那樣對待你！你當然不能受這個氣！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say you are not suggesting something

examples.en: She wouldn't tell me how much it cost - not that I was really interested.
examples.trans: 她不願告訴我這花了多少錢——我並不真的想知道。

examples.en: Not that I mind, but why didn't you call yesterday?
examples.trans: 雖然我不介意，但你昨天為甚麼不打電話？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say you do not think something is important
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於表示認為某事不重要）並非

examples.en: She wouldn't tell me how much it cost - not that I was really interested.
examples.trans: 她不願告訴我這花了多少錢——我並不真的想知道。

examples.en: Not that I mind, but why didn't you call yesterday?
examples.trans: 雖然我不介意，但你昨天為甚麼不打電話？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that something, especially an amount of money, is not to be sneezed at, you mean that it is a large enough amount to be worth having.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （尤指某筆錢款）不可輕視，不是個小數目

examples.en: Well, a five percent pay increase means an extra $700 a year, which is not to be sneezed at!
examples.trans: 嗯，加薪5％意味著每年多出700美元的收入，這可不是筆小數目啊！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to show that you are not worried or upset because something has gone wrong or something unexpected has happened

examples.en: Not to worry - maybe you'll be able to come next week instead.
examples.trans: 別著急——或許你可以下星期再來。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If someone does not waste words, they talk only about what is important using as few words as possible.

examples.en: He explained the whole system in about 30 seconds - he doesn't waste words, does he?
examples.trans: 他只用了大約30秒來解釋整個系統——真是惜字如金，對不對？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: nothing could be further from the truth
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that what has been suggested is completely untrue
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （針對剛剛說過的話）完全是錯的

examples.en: People say we're splitting up, but nothing could be further from the truth.
examples.trans: 人們說我們將要分手，可是他們完全錯了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: nothing could have been further from my mind thoughts
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you certainly did not intend something
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 我當然不這樣想；我根本就沒有這樣打算

examples.en: I certainly wasn't trying to get money from him - nothing could have been further from my mind!
examples.trans: 我當然不是要從他身上弄錢——我根本就沒有那樣打算過。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to mean "no", especially when said in answer to a request
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （尤用於對要求作出答覆）不行，辦不到，絕對不

examples.en: We asked if she'd come over and help us, but she said, "Nothing doing".
examples.trans: 我們問她是否願意過來幫忙，但她說「不行」。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to attract attention to what you are going to ask or suggest

examples.en: Now then, what's all this noise about?
examples.trans: 喂，這樣大驚小怪的是為甚麼呢？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when someone makes a suggestion or offer that is better than one that they have already made
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 這下你說對了；這個建議可真是不錯

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you want to make someone feel better or give someone a gentle warning
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於安慰）好了，好了；（用於委婉的警告）行了，行了

examples.en: Now, now, don't cry.
examples.trans: 好了，好了，別哭了。

examples.en: Now, now, children, there's no need to fight!
examples.trans: 行了，孩子們，別打了！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say when you want to suggest that there is a sexual meaning in something that has just been said
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於暗指剛說的話與性有關）注意，注意

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to express the idea that a particular person/thing/place is unlikely or surprising
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （表示認為不可能或驚訝）在所有的人／東西／地方中（偏偏）

examples.en: Donna, of all people, is the last one I'd expect to see at the gym.
examples.trans: 我萬萬沒有想到會在健身房裡見到當娜。

examples.en: And why did you choose Iceland for a holiday, of all places?
examples.trans: 那麼多的地方，你為甚麼偏偏要去冰島度假？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: like or similar to what has been said

examples.en: "You said I was fat." "I didn't say anything of the kind!"
examples.trans: 「你說我胖。」「我沒說過那種話！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you speak off the cuff, you say something without having prepared or thought about your words first.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 未經準備；未加思索；即興地

examples.en: I hadn't prepared a speech so I just said a few words off the cuff.
examples.trans: 我沒準備發言，所以就隨便說了幾句。

examples.en: [ before noun ] an off-the-cuff remark
examples.trans: 即興評論

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that someone is off their rocker, you mean that that person is behaving in a very strange or silly way.

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a subject, idea, or joke that has been discussed or repeated so often that it is not funny any more
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 老掉牙的話題（或想法、笑話）

examples.en: I wondered whether there might, after all, be some truth in the old chestnut that one's school days are the happiest of one's life.
examples.trans: 老話說學生時代是人生中最幸福的時光，我在想這話是否有些道理。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a piece of advice or a theory, often related to matters of health, that was believed in the past but is now known to be wrong
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （常指健康方面）不科學的陳腐說法；無稽之談

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: on a need to know basis
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you tell people something on a need-to-know basis, you only tell them the facts they need to know at the time they need to know them, and nothing more.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 僅限於人們需要知道的東西

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: on one level on another level
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say when you are speaking about two opposite ways of thinking about or reacting to a situation

examples.en: On one level I quite like the attention but on another level, I suppose I find it a little disturbing.
examples.trans: 一方面我很喜歡這種關注，但另一方面我又覺得這種關注對我有些干擾。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If something is said to be on someone's or something's account, it is because of that person or thing.

examples.en: I'm not very hungry, so please don't cook on my account (= don't cook just for me).
examples.trans: 我不是太餓，所以請不要特意為我做飯。

examples.en: They were tired, but not any less enthusiastic on that account.
examples.trans: 他們很累，但是他們的熱情並沒有因此而減退。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If someone is on the inside, they have a job or position in which they have special or secret information.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 在（機構或組織的）內部；參與內部機密

examples.en: Who do we know on the inside who can help us?
examples.trans: 我們認識哪位能幫助我們的內部人士？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say something on the record, you state it publicly.

examples.en: None of the company directors were prepared to comment on the record yesterday.
examples.trans: 昨天，公司董事沒有哪個願意公開發表意見。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you do something on the strength of something such as advice, you do it because you have been influenced by it or believe it.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 受…的影響；基於對…的信任

examples.en: I invested in the company on the strength of my brother's advice.
examples.trans: 在我兄弟的建議下，我投資了這家公司。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If a plan or suggestion has been put/laid on the table, it has been made available for people to hear, read, or discuss.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （計劃、建議等）被提交討論中，正式提交考慮

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: on your own head be it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone that they will have to take full responsibility for what they plan to do

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you are frightened to do something again because you had an unpleasant experience doing it the first time
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 一次被咬，下次膽小；一朝被蛇咬，十年怕草繩

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you do a helpful or kind act for someone who has done something good for you
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 好心應該得到好報；以德報德

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: one man s loss is another man s gain
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when someone gets an advantage from someone else's bad luck
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 一人之失即是他人之得；此消彼長

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: one man s meat is another man s poison
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to emphasize that people like different things

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: one swallow doesn t make a summer
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that because one good thing has happened, it is not therefore certain that a situation is going to improve
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 獨燕不成夏（指一件好事的發生並不意味著整體情況會好轉）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a joke or a clever and funny remark or answer that is usually one sentence long
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （單句的）俏皮話，打趣話；小笑話

examples.en: There are some very witty one-liners in the play.
examples.trans: 這部電影中有些非常詼諧的俏皮話。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: UK also one-to-one If two people discuss something one-on-one, they discuss it directly, without involving anyone else.

examples.en: Each employee has a one-on-one performance review with his or her boss.
examples.trans: 每一個僱員都會與其上司做一對一的業績回顧。

examples.en: It's best to talk with him about the problem one-on-one.
examples.trans: 最好是和他一對一地談一些這些問題。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: only considering one opinion in an argument in a way that is unfair
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 片面的；不公正的；偏向一方的

examples.en: a one-sided contest/game
examples.trans: 實力懸殊的競賽／比賽

examples.en: They blamed their defeat on the media's one-sided reporting of the election.
examples.trans: 他們將失敗歸咎於媒體對競選的片面報道。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: UK US one-on-one If two people discuss something one-to-one, they discuss it directly, without involving anyone else.

examples.en: Is there a one-to-one relationship between pay levels and productivity?
examples.trans: 工資水準和生產效率直接相關嗎？

examples.en: The dollar was linked to the peso at a one-to-one rate.
examples.trans: 比索與美元是一比一掛鉤的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you mean that something you said was not intended to be serious

examples.en: Think I'll leave you with the kids while I go for a beer - only joking!
examples.trans: 想想我去喝啤酒而留下你和孩子在一起——開個玩笑而已！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: UK also (only) time can tell used to say that the truth or a result will only be known in the future after events have happened

examples.en: Only time will tell whether we made the right decision.
examples.trans: 只有時間才能證明我們的決定是否正確。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to express admiration

examples.en: We watched the fireworks, oohing and aahing with everyone else.
examples.trans: 我們觀看著焰火，跟著人們一起發出「噢」「啊」的驚嘆聲。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something said to young children when they fall over
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於小孩摔倒時）起來沒事啦

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a fact that should be a secret when in fact a lot of people know about it

examples.en: It's an open secret around the office that they're having an affair.
examples.trans: 在辦公室，他們的緋聞是公開的秘密。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
