Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to tell someone about your problems and secrets

examples.en: She's very understanding - you feel you can really open your heart to her.
examples.trans: 她十分善解人意——令你覺得確實可以向她敞開心扉。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to speak or start to speak

examples.en: I don't know how she heard about it - I never opened my mouth.
examples.trans: 我不知道她是從哪裡聽說這件事的——我從來沒有開口說起過。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when someone would do anything to achieve what they want to achieve

examples.en: She'll finish the race or die in the attempt.
examples.trans: 她即使累死也要跑完全程。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a system for preserving a group's beliefs, customs, and history, in which parents tell their children about them, and the children tell their children, and so on
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 口述傳統，口頭文化（某一群體對其信仰、習俗、歷史的傳承體系，由父母口頭傳授給孩子，一輩一輩傳授下去）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to tell someone what they should do in an unpleasant or forceful way, especially repeatedly
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （尤指不斷地）支使，差遣，使喚（某人）

examples.en: You can't just come in here and start ordering people around.
examples.trans: 你不能一到這兒就開始把人差來遣去。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to plan what you want to say or do

examples.en: Just give me a moment to order my thoughts, and then I'll explain the system to you.
examples.trans: 請給我一點時間讓我理一理思路，然後我會把這個系統解釋給你聽。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you have to do something because someone in authority has told you to, and usually when you do not really approve of it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （通常指雖然不贊成但）命令就是命令，命令必須執行

examples.en: Nobody wants to do it, but orders are orders, so let's start.
examples.trans: 誰也不想做這事，但命令必須執行，所以我們開始吧。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: In a theatre, if you say that someone is out front, you mean they are one of the people watching the performance.

examples.en: Don't worry about your parents being out front tonight.
examples.trans: 不用為你父母今晚去看演出而擔心。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you refuse something out of hand, you refuse it completely without thinking about or discussing it.

examples.en: Things got a little out of hand at the party and three windows were broken.
examples.trans: 派對的場面有點失控，有三扇窗戶被打破了。

examples.en: He went to see his doctor because he felt his drinking was getting out of hand.
examples.trans: 他去見了醫生，因為覺得自己的酗酒問題有點失控。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: out of sight out of mind
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to emphasize that when something or someone cannot be seen, it is easy to forget it, him, or her

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: out of the mouths of babes and sucklings
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when a child says something that surprises you because it seems very wise
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 出自天真的稚子之口；童言有道

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to someone when you want that person to tell you something that they do not want you to know

examples.en: What did he do then? Come on, out with it!
examples.trans: 那他做什麼了？快點，說吧！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say something will happen over your dead body, you mean that you will do everything you can to prevent it.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 只要我還有一口氣就不能那樣做；除非我死了

examples.en: "Joe says he's going to buy a motorbike." "Over my dead body!"
examples.trans: 「祖說他想買輛機車。 」「只要我還有一口氣就不准他買！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to rudely tell someone to stop doing something that is annoying you
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 結束！停下！（用於粗魯地告訴某人別再做令人討厭的事）

examples.en: This course is really tough - sometimes I feeling like packing it all in.
examples.trans: 這門課程太難了——有時候我都想放棄算了。

examples.en: Pack it in, Julie - I'm trying to read.
examples.trans: 別鬧了，朱莉！我想看書。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to give away something, or persuade someone to accept something, because you do not want it and you know it has no value
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 把（自己不想要或無價值的東西）硬塞給（或賣給）

examples.en: She tried to palm her old car off on me.
examples.trans: 她試圖騙我買下她那輛舊汽車。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you are sorry for doing something wrong or for being rude

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: pardon me for breathing existing living
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone that you think they have just answered or spoken to you in an unreasonably critical or rude way
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 總不能不讓人呼吸了吧！（用於當某人以極其苛刻或粗魯的方式答話或對自己說話時）

examples.en: "If you're going to get in my way, James, could you just leave the kitchen?" "Oh, pardon me for breathing!"
examples.trans: 「詹姆斯，如果你要礙手礙腳的話就離開廚房好嗎？」「哦，真抱歉，我連呼吸都妨礙到你了！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to refuse an opportunity or decide not to take part in something

examples.en: He passed on the chance to be head coach and took a job in Florida.
examples.trans: 他放棄了成為主教練的機會，而是去佛羅里達找了一份工作。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to have a short informal conversation

examples.en: I was just passing the time of day with her.
examples.trans: 我當時只是和她聊了幾句。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to praise someone for doing something good

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: informal to give someone money so that they will not do or say something, or so that they will go away
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 用錢封住（某人）的嘴，收買（某人）

examples.en: There were rumours that key witnesses had been paid off to keep quiet.
examples.trans: 傳言說關鍵證人都被收買了，不肯出面作證。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to visit someone in order to welcome or talk to them

examples.en: We went to pay our respects to our new neighbours.
examples.trans: 我們去拜訪了我們的新鄰居。

examples.en: Friends and relatives came to pay their last respects to Mr Clarke.
examples.trans: 親友們前來向克拉克先生告別。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something said or given by a person to show that they want to be friendly, especially to someone they have argued with

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a sign made with the hand by holding it with the palm forward and the first two fingers in the shape of a V, used to express peace
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （掌心向外、食指和中指形成V字形的）和平手勢

examples.en: See also
examples.trans: V-sign

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you express an amount per capita, you mean that amount for each person.

examples.en: France and Germany invest far more per capita in public transport than Britain.
examples.trans: 法國和德國平均每人在公共交通上的投資遠高於英國。

examples.en: The per capita income in the country is very low.
examples.trans: 該國每人平均收入非常低。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to show that you hope that something that has been suggested will never happen

examples.en: Me, get married? Perish the thought!
examples.trans: 我，結婚？死了這條心吧！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you talk to or meet someone person-to-person, you talk to or meet them directly.

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to find mistakes in something someone has done or said, to show that it is not good or not correct
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 挑…的毛病，找…的漏洞；批評

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to criticize someone about something they have said
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 在…上挑（某人）毛病，指出（某人）在…方面的錯誤

examples.en: "I want to pick you up on the point you made a few minutes ago about personal morality, Archbishop."
examples.trans: 「大主教，我對您剛才有關個人道德的觀點有不同的意見。」

examples.en: His teacher picked him up on his pronunciation.
examples.trans: 他的老師指出了他的發音錯誤。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to start talking again about something that someone said previously
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 重新回到，繼續（某一話題）

examples.en: Can I just pick up on your first point again, please?
examples.trans: 我能繼續探討你的第一個論點嗎？

examples.en: Only one newspaper picked up on the contradictions in the statement.
examples.trans: 只有一家報紙注意到聲明中的矛盾之處。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: pick pull sb sth to pieces
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to criticize someone or something severely
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 嚴厲批評；把…批判得體無完膚

examples.en: The moment she left, the rest of the family started to pull her to pieces.
examples.trans: 她一離開，家裡人就開始七嘴八舌地數落她。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you think that there is no chance at all of something happening
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 根本不可能的事情；無稽之談

examples.en: "I'll have finished it by tomorrow." "And pigs might fly!"
examples.trans: 「明天我就能完成了。」「那才怪呢。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say too much, especially giving too much emphasis
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 過多地談論；（尤指）誇張，言過其實

examples.en: You're really piling it on with the compliments tonight, Gareth, aren't you!
examples.trans: 你今晚的確恭維過頭了，不是嗎，加雷思？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: conversation between sexual partners in bed

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to blame someone for something, especially for something they did not do

examples.en: You can't pin the blame on her - she wasn't even there when the accident happened.
examples.trans: 你不能把責任推到她身上——意外發生時她根本不在現場。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to suddenly start to speak or make a noise
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 突然開始說話（或發出噪音）

examples.en: In the silence that followed, a lone voice piped up from the back of the room.
examples.trans: 隨後一陣沉默，但突然從房間後面傳來一個人的聲音。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: the part of the body in which people say they feel fear or nervousness

examples.en: I got a sick feeling/a knot in the pit of my stomach when the news of the attack was announced.
examples.trans: 當發動攻擊的消息宣佈時，我感到胸口很難受／心揪得緊緊的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to criticize or attack someone or something forcefully

examples.en: He pitched into me as soon as I arrived, asking where the work was.
examples.trans: 我一到他劈頭就對我大罵，問我作品在哪裡。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a US organization that provides sex education and advice on how to avoid becoming pregnant
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 計劃生育（美國的一個組織，提供性教育和如何避免懷孕的建議）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that a football player should continue playing until the referee blows the whistle, rather than stop playing because he or she thinks the referee will award a foul, throw-in, etc.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 繼續比賽知道裁判哨響(足球比賽中，當球員認為裁判應該判罰時，不應停下來等待，而應繼續比賽，直到裁判吹哨暫停比賽）

examples.en: You always have to play to the whistle.
examples.trans: 你必須總是繼續比賽知道裁判哨響。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to express a strong hope
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 但願老天幫忙，上帝保佑

examples.en: It'll be finished by Christmas, please God.
examples.trans: 上帝保佑，這會在耶誕節前完成。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: pluck sth out of the air
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say something quickly, usually because a reply is expected, without having thought about it or made certain it is correct

examples.en: "Where did you get those figures from?" "Oh, I just plucked them out of the air."
examples.trans: 「你是從哪裡獲得這些數字的？」「我只是隨口說出來的。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say you accept what someone has said

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to express an opinion that an idea or suggestion is silly or not worth considering

examples.en: Some seemingly reasonable people go on holiday and pooh-pooh the idea of wearing sunblock.
examples.trans: 一些看來懂道理的人們在度假時卻對塗防曬霜不屑一顧。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: theories and advice about people's behaviour that are easily understood and intended to help people improve their lives

examples.en: Why is it that women buy the majority of pop psychology, self-help manuals?
examples.trans: 為甚麼大多數的大眾心理學的自助手冊都是女性購買的？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: the detailed examination of a person's past, political beliefs, etc. in order to discover if they are suitable for a government job that might involve dealing with secret information
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （對從事政府保密性工作的人進行的）道德審查，正面調查

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to immediately criticize a mistake

examples.en: He knows that his critics are waiting to pounce on any slip that he makes.
examples.trans: 他知道他的批評者們正等著緊咬他的任何差錯。

examples.en: I think if she were given the opportunity to work here, she'd pounce on it.
examples.trans: 我覺得如果給她機會在這裡工作，她會欣然接受的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to do or say something in order to make people stop arguing and become calmer

examples.en: My husband's always arguing with my father, and I'm the one who has to pour oil on troubled waters.
examples.trans: 我丈夫老和我父親爭吵，我不得不做他們的調停人。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to tell someone your secret feelings and things that worry you, usually because you feel a strong need to talk about them
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 傾訴（通常因為感到十分需要向人傾訴，而把心底的感受和憂慮的事情說出來）

examples.en: I poured my heart out to him and then he told all his friends what I'd said.
examples.trans: 我對他毫無保留，推心置腹，但他隨後就把我的話告訴他所有的朋友。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: pour throw cold water on sth
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to criticize someone's opinions or ideas and stop people believing them or being excited about them

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a joke that makes someone seem silly and involves a physical action rather than words

examples.en: She glued her boss's cup and saucer together as a practical joke.
examples.trans: 她玩惡作劇，把老闆的茶杯和托碟黏在一起。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to encourage someone to continue to do something many times, so that they will learn to do it very well

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to do or say something before someone so that you make their words or actions unnecessary or not effective
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 搶在…之前說話（或行動）；預先制止

examples.en: The minister held a press conference in order to pre-empt criticism in the newspapers.
examples.trans: 部長召開了記者招待會，旨在先發制人，預先防備各報紙的指責批評。

examples.en: All the networks pre-empted their regular schedules to broadcast news of the hijacking.
examples.trans: 所有的電視網都取消了安排好的節目，轉而播放劫機的新聞。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to give something to someone and not allow them to refuse to accept it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 迫使（某人）接受，把…硬塞給（某人），把…強加於（某人）

examples.en: All the children had sweets and presents pressed on them by the visitors.
examples.trans: 所有孩子都被來訪者硬塞了一堆糖果和禮物。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to force or strongly persuade someone to do something they do not want to do

examples.en: I've been press-ganged into taking the kids swimming.
examples.trans: 我禁不住勸誘帶了孩子們去游泳。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to persuade someone to do something that they do not want to do

examples.en: He was eventually prevailed upon to accept the appointment.
examples.trans: 他最後被說服，接受了這項任命。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to make someone suddenly understand the unpleasant truth of a situation

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: pride comes goes before a fall
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to emphasize that if you are too confident about your abilities, something bad will happen that shows that you are not as good as you think

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: at first sight (= based on what seems to be the truth when first seen or heard)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 初步認定的；建立在初次印象上的

examples.en: There is prima facie evidence that he was involved in the fraud.
examples.trans: 有初步證據證明他參與了這場騙局。

examples.en: For millions of Americans witnessing the event, it was a prima facie case of police brutality.
examples.trans: 對於目睹了這宗事件的數百萬美國人來說，乍看這是一宗員警施暴案件。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say that you will do much greater things than you will ever be able to achieve
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 向（某人）作無法兌現的承諾

examples.en: Like most governments in their first term of office, they promised the earth.
examples.trans: 像大多數處於第一個任期內的政府一樣，他們也作了無法兌現的承諾。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say when someone says they will do something and you do not believe it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 保證，又是保證！（用於表達不相信對方的承諾）

examples.en: "When I've got some time I'll show you everything." "Promises, promises!"
examples.trans: 「有時間的話我保證把全部都拿給你看。」「保證，又是保證！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to express an opinion or fact so strongly or so often that people start to doubt that you are telling the truth

examples.en: She keeps trying to impress on me how she doesn't like him but does she protest too much?
examples.trans: 她不停地試圖讓我覺得她不喜歡他，但她是不是做得太過火了呢？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to tell someone that they have done something wrong

examples.en: She's always pulling me up for/on/over my bad spelling.
examples.trans: 她總是批評我的拼寫很糟糕。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to try to persuade someone to believe something that is not true, as a joke

examples.en: Is it really your car or are you pulling my leg?
examples.trans: 這真是你的汽車，還是你在騙我？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say that something, usually a piece of work, is very bad

examples.en: The last essay I gave him he completely pulled apart.
examples.trans: 上次我給他的文章被批得體無完膚。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: pull the other leg one it s got bells on
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used when you do not believe what someone has just said

examples.en: Helen, mountain climbing? Pull the other one - she can't even climb a ladder without feeling sick!
examples.trans: 海倫去爬山？別逗了，她爬梯子不暈就不錯了！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: mainly UK slang used to rudely tell someone to go away

examples.en: He told me to push off.
examples.trans: 他叫我滾開。

examples.en: He pushed off from the side of the pool and swam slowly to the other side.
examples.trans: 他從游泳池的一邊出發，慢慢遊到了對面。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to tell someone what to do in a rude or threatening way
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 對（某人）粗暴地發號施令，擺布（某人）

examples.en: If you think you can push me around like that, you're mistaken.
examples.trans: 如果你認為你能那樣對我發號施令，那麼你錯了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say exactly how much something is or costs
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 說出確切的金額（或具體費用）

examples.en: I'm sure we'll make a good profit, but I couldn't put a figure on it.
examples.trans: 我肯定我們能賺一大筆錢，但是我說不出確切的數字。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone to be quiet or stop making so much noise

examples.en: Hey, put a sock in it, will you? I'm trying to work here.
examples.trans: 嘿，別出聲，好嗎？我正在這裡工作呢。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: put flesh on the bones of sth
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: UK to add more details to a plan, idea, argument, etc. to make it better or more complete

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: put in a good word for sb
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say positive things about someone
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 為（某人）美言，說（某人）的好話

examples.en: I really need a job and I was hoping you might put in a good word for me with your boss.
examples.trans: 我真的需要一份工作，所以希望你能在你老闆面前為我美言幾句。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say when you want someone to shake your hand to show that you have just made an agreement
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （達成協議或取得一致意見時的用語）握個手吧！

examples.en: "So, do we have a deal?" "Sure, put it there."
examples.trans: 「那麼，我們達成協議了？」「當然，我們握手慶祝一下吧。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to behave or speak in a false or artificial way
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 裝模作樣；裝腔作勢；做戲

examples.en: He's just putting on an act for the boss's benefit.
examples.trans: 他做戲只是為了給老闆看。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to try to persuade someone that something is true when it is not, usually as a joke

examples.en: She said she was planning to give her house to a charity for the homeless but I thought she was putting me on.
examples.trans: 她說她打算把房子捐給為無家可歸者服務的慈善機構，不過我覺得她是在騙我。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to annoy or upset someone, often by what you do or say to them
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 使（某人）憤怒（或心煩意亂）

examples.en: Would it put you out if we came tomorrow instead of today?
examples.trans: 如果我們今天不來明天來，會給你添麻煩嗎？

examples.en: She was very put out when they turned up two hours late for dinner.
examples.trans: 他們吃飯遲到了兩個小時，這讓她非常惱火。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to tell a lot of people something that is not true

examples.en: [ + that ] I'd like to know who put the rumour around that I'm pregnant.
examples.trans: 我想知道誰在到處造謠說我懷孕了。

examples.en: Someone's been putting it about that Dan is leaving.
examples.trans: 有人在四處造謠說丹要走了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to express your ideas and opinions clearly so that people understand them easily
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 表達（或解釋）清楚（自己的想法或觀點）

examples.en: It's an interesting idea and I thought he put it across well.
examples.trans: 這個想法很有趣，我認為他表達得很清楚。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to formally tell or explain facts or ideas to a group of people in authority
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 向（權威人士）正式陳述（或解釋）

examples.en: I'd never put my work before my family.
examples.trans: 我絕不會把工作看得比家庭重要。

examples.en: We have to put our proposal before the committee.
examples.trans: 我們必須向委員會解釋我們的提議。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to express an idea clearly so that people understand it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 把（觀點）表達清楚；使被理解

examples.en: Did you feel that you managed to put over your point of view?
examples.trans: 你認為你把自己的觀點表達清楚了嗎？

examples.en: She's not very good at putting across her ideas.
examples.trans: 她不太善於表達自己的觀點。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to suggest an idea or plan to someone so that they can consider it or discuss it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 向（某人）提出（想法或計劃）供考慮（或討論）

examples.en: "Shall we all go out for a pizza tonight?" "I don't know. I'll put it to Jim and see what he says."
examples.trans: 「今晚我們都出去吃批薩好嗎？」「不知道，我問問吉姆，看他怎麼說。」

examples.en: [ + that ] formal I put it to you (= I believe it to be true), Ms Dawson, that you were in the building at the time of the murder.
examples.trans: 道森女士，我相信發生謀殺時你在那棟樓裡。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say when you are pleased and surprised that something has happened
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 懸旗致敬！（表示對發生的事感到驚訝和高興）

examples.en: Josh has cleaned the bathroom - put the flags out!
examples.trans: 喬希清理了浴室——向他懸旗致敬！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: UK also put the word around/round/about to tell people a new piece of news

examples.en: So, the new manager has been appointed - should we put the word out?
examples.trans: 那麼，已經任命了新的經理——我們應不應該公佈這消息？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: put two and two together and make five
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to understand a particular situation wrongly, often in a way that is more shocking or exciting than the truth

examples.en: "Why in the world did she think you were pregnant?" "I was sick a couple of times, and I guess she just put two and two together and made five."
examples.trans: 「她究竟為甚麼會認為你懷孕？」「我曾嘔吐過一兩次，我猜她就這樣想了。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to guess the truth about a situation from what you have seen or heard
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 根據現有情況推論；綜合判斷

examples.en: "How did you know they were having an affair?" "I'd seen them out together a couple of times, so I just put two and two together."
examples.trans: 「你怎麼知道他們有婚外情?」「我好幾次見到他們一起外出，所以就這麼推斷。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say someone should put up or shut up, you mean that they should either take action in order to do what they have been talking about, or stop talking about it.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 採取行動（如果你說某人應「採取行動」或「閉嘴」，你的意思是說，他們要麼採取行動來實踐他們所說的事情，要麼停止談論這些事情）

examples.en: You keep saying you're going to ask her out. Well, put up or shut up.
examples.trans: 你老是說要約她出來。那就去呀！否則就閉嘴。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to show or express a particular type of opposition to something

examples.en: The villagers were unable to put up any resistance to the invading troops.
examples.trans: 村民沒有能力對侵略軍進行任何抵抗。

examples.en: We're not going to let them build a road here without putting up a fight.
examples.trans: 他們要在這裡修築公路，我們不會輕易讓他們得逞。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: UK US put your foot in your mouth to say something by accident that embarrasses or upsets someone
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 無意中說出讓人尷尬（或生氣）的話

examples.en: I really put my foot in my mouth – I asked her if Jane was her mother, but she said Jane is her sister.
examples.trans: 我真的讓自己無地自容：我問她簡是不是她母親，但是她說簡是她姐姐。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to stop someone believing something that is not true, or to correct someone by telling them the truth
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 糾正（某人）的錯誤想法；使（某人）明白正確的道理

examples.en: She thought she wouldn't have to work hard, but we soon put her right on that.
examples.trans: 她認為不需要努力工作，但是我們很快就糾正了她這種錯誤的想法。

examples.en: A good night's sleep will soon put you right.
examples.trans: 你好好睡一宿，很快就會恢復的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: put stick that in your pipe and smoke it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a rude way of telling someone that they must accept what you have just said, even if they do not like it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 不管你喜歡與否都要接受！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say or do something that annoys other people because they have not asked you to join their conversation or activity

examples.en: No one asked him to help - he's always sticking his oar in.
examples.trans: 沒人請他幫忙——他總愛多管閒事。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: the symbols “ ” or ‘ ’ that are put around a word or phrase to show that someone else has written or said it

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to show that you are repeating someone else's words, especially if you do not agree
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （尤指在不贊同某人時表示引用其話語）引文起…引文止

examples.en: She says they're quote "just good friends" unquote.
examples.trans: 她說她們，開引號，「只是好朋友而已」，關引號。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to make a forceful complaint

examples.en: You should raise a rumpus about the lack of safety routines here.
examples.trans: 這裡連常規的安全措施都沒有，你應該對此提出抗議。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to talk again about a past event or experience that should be forgotten, because it upsets or annoys someone else
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 提及（令別人煩惱的往事）；揭（瘡疤）；翻（舊帳）

examples.en: She's always raking up the past/that old quarrel.
examples.trans: 她老翻舊帳，提以前／多少年前的那次爭吵。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to speak officially to someone in a severe or angry way because you disapprove of their actions
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 嚴厲批評，厲聲指責，憤怒譴責（某人）

examples.en: He was rapped over the knuckles by the management.
examples.trans: 他受到了管理層的嚴厲批評。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to not be loyal to someone, especially by giving away secret information about them, or to fail to do something that you said you would do
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 背叛；（尤指）告密出賣，對…背信棄義

examples.en: He ratted on us.
examples.trans: 他出賣了我們。

examples.en: They ratted on the deal.
examples.trans: 他們不守信用，談好的交易出爾反爾。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said by someone who does not want to do the thing that someone else is doing
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （表示不想做別人正在做的事）換了我才不會去呢

examples.en: "I'm having two teeth out next week." "Rather you than me."
examples.trans: 「下週我要去拔兩顆牙。」「換了我才不會去呢。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to talk for a long time, especially about things that are not important
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 喋喋不休地說，沒完沒了地嘮叨（尤指雞毛蒜皮的事）

examples.en: She was on the phone for hours last night, just rattling on to her friends.
examples.trans: 昨晚她打電話沒完沒了，跟她那些朋友們嘮叨了好幾個小時。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say or read aloud very quickly a list of names or things, or something you have learned
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 快速大聲說（或讀）出；不假思索地說出；快速背出

examples.en: She rattled off the names of the people who were coming to the party.
examples.trans: 她一口氣說出了要來參加派對者的名字。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to do or say something very quickly
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 迅速完成；匆匆做完（或講完）

examples.en: I'm going to rattle through my work today so that I can go home early.
examples.trans: 我今天要儘快做完我的工作好早點回家。

examples.en: He rattled through the list of countries he had visited.
examples.trans: 他一口氣說出了他去過的那些國家的名稱。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to speak angrily to someone about something they have done and warn that person that they will be punished if it happens again
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 嚴厲警告（某人）不得再犯

examples.en: He'd put up with a lot of bad behaviour from his son and thought it was time to read him the riot act.
examples.trans: 對於兒子的很多不良行為他一直持容忍態度，但他覺得是該嚴厲警告他收斂一些的時候了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to follow the movements of someone's lips in order to understand what is being said, especially if you are unable to hear them speak
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （尤指在無法聽見別人說話時）從口型判斷某人說的話，唇讀，觀唇辨意

examples.en: She read his lips across the busy conference hall - "Time to go."
examples.trans: 她在熱鬧的會議廳的另一端從他說話的口型判斷他在說「該走了」。

examples.en: See also
examples.trans: lip-read

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: the ability to read a language, but not to speak it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （對一種語言可以讀而不會說的）書面語言能力，閱讀能力

examples.en: I've got a good reading knowledge of Spanish.
examples.trans: 我西班牙語的閱讀能力不錯。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said at the start of a race, especially one for children
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 各就各位，預備，跑！（尤指用於小孩子們賽跑時）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to tell someone off severely because you strongly disapprove of their behaviour
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 責罵，嚴厲批評，臭罵（某人）

examples.en: The boss reamed them out for sleeping on the job.
examples.trans: 他們上班睡覺，讓老闆給狠狠罵了一頓。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: informal to say a long list of things quickly and without stopping
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 一口氣說出；滔滔不絕地講

examples.en: The old man reeled off the names of his 22 grandchildren.
examples.trans: 老人一口氣說出了他22個孫子孫女的名字。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to ask someone to say hello to another person for you

examples.en: Please remember me to your parents.
examples.trans: 請代我向你的父母問好。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone not to worry and that you are in control of the situation
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於安慰某人）請放心，別擔心

examples.en: "Rest assured, Mrs Cooper," said the police officer. "We will find your son for you."
examples.trans: 「您放寬心，庫珀太太，」員警說：「我們會為您找到您兒子的。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to express the hope that someone's spirit has found peace after death

examples.en: She was a decent and compassionate woman: may she rest in peace.
examples.trans: 她生前為人正直、富有同情心：願她安息。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you feel satisfaction from harming someone who has harmed you

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: A rib-tickling story or joke is very funny.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （故事或笑話）非常好笑的，令人大笑不止的

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to show that you understand and agree

examples.en: "Give me a shout when you're ready." "Right you are."
examples.trans: 「你要是準備好了就叫我一聲。」「好的。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to end a phone conversation intentionally

examples.en: She said "No, thank you" and rang off hurriedly.
examples.trans: 她說了一句「不了，多謝」就匆匆掛了電話。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to attack or criticize someone or something with great force

examples.en: She ripped into her opponent's proposals, calling them "completely unworkable".
examples.trans: 她猛烈批評對手的提議，稱其「完全無法實行」。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to tell someone to wake up and get out of bed

examples.en: Wakey wakey, rise and shine!
examples.trans: 醒醒，醒醒，快起床！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to express an emotion, such as laughter or anger, noisily
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 因…大叫；放聲（大笑）；高聲（怒吼）

examples.en: She roared with laughter when she saw what he was wearing.
examples.trans: 看到他的一身穿戴，她哈哈大笑起來。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: roll on the weekend five o clock etc
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you want time to go quickly because you are looking forward to something
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 但願週末／五點鐘（等）快點到！

examples.en: I can't wait to be finished with this project - roll on October!
examples.trans: 我真想這個專案計劃馬上結束——恨不得十月份快點到！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said, especially in the past, by someone who wanted people to come and pay to look at something unusual or interesting
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （尤在舊時用於呼喚人們觀看稀罕或有趣的事物）快來看哪！快來看哪！

examples.en: "Roll up! Roll up! Come and see the amazing bearded lady!" shouted the circus man.
examples.trans: 「快來看哪！快來看哪！過來看長鬍子的怪女人！」那個馬戲團的人喊道。

examples.en: They rolled up at the party two hours late and rather drunk.
examples.trans: 派對開始兩小時後他們才醉醺醺地趕到。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to move your eyes upwards as a way of showing that you are annoyed or bored after someone has done or said something

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to persuade someone to do something for you
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 勸說（某人）幫忙；說服（某人）加入

examples.en: At the last minute, we roped in a couple of spectators to complete the team.
examples.trans: 在最後關頭，我們說服幾位觀眾加入，湊足了比賽人數。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to criticize someone who has criticized you

examples.en: The fox rounded on its pursuers.
examples.trans: 那隻狐狸突然轉身向追獵牠的人撲來。

examples.en: The mayor rounded on his critics with a very forceful speech.
examples.trans: 市長突然發表了措詞強硬的講話，回擊批評他的人。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: A round-table discussion/meeting is one where people meet and talk in conditions of equality.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （討論或會議）圓桌的；（參與者）以平等方式的

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: rub sb s nose in it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say or do things that make someone remember that they failed or got something wrong
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 揭（某人）的瘡疤；不斷提起（某人）以前的過失

examples.en: Sue failed her exam, so just to rub her nose in it, I put my certificate up on the wall.
examples.trans: 蘇考試沒有及格，所以我把自己的證書貼在牆上，就是為了讓她難堪。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: rules are made to be broken
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that it is good and acceptable to not obey a rule
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於表示違反一項規則合情合理）制定規則是為了被打破的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: one of a set of raised strips on a road that makes a low sound when vehicles drive over it to warn drivers to slow down or change direction because they are getting close to something
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 齒紋標誌帶，隆起標誌帶，減速振動帶（路面上狹長的隆起帶，汽車駛過時發出隆隆聲，提醒司機減速或不要太靠近某物）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to children to tell them to go away

examples.en: Run along now, children!
examples.trans: 快走開，孩子們！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to tell someone about something so that that person can give their opinion about it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 對（某人）說…（以聽取對方意見）；向（某人）徵求對…的看法；就…請教（某人）

examples.en: Would you run your idea by me one more time?
examples.trans: 你能不能再跟我說一遍你的想法？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: an argument that lasts over several different occasions

examples.en: I've had a running battle with the neighbours over whose responsibility that fence is.
examples.trans: 關於誰該負責那個圍欄，我和鄰居們爭執不下。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to forcefully persuade someone to do something without giving them time to decide if they really wantto do it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 使（某人）倉促做…；使（某人）草率做…

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a belief, custom, etc. that people support and do not question or criticize
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 不容質疑的信仰；神聖不可侵犯的習俗

examples.en: They did not dare to challenge the sacred cow of parliamentary democracy.
examples.trans: 他們不敢反對不容質疑的議會民主。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a talk or a way of talking that is intended to persuade you to buy something

examples.en: I didn't want to listen to his sales pitch.
examples.trans: 我不想聽他的推銷宣傳。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a way of talking that is intended to persuade you to buy something

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you want another drink of the same type as you have just had

examples.en: "What are you having, David?" "Same again, please."
examples.trans: 「你喝甚麽，大衛？」「和剛才的一樣。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you agree that what you said was not exactly correct, but you think the difference is not important

examples.en: "He was driving a red car." "Actually, it was maroon." "Same difference."
examples.trans: 「他開一輛紅色的車。」「實際上是褐紅色的。」「差不多吧。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you agree with what has been said or you have experienced the same thing as they have

examples.en: "I thought that film was awful!" "Same here!"
examples.trans: 「我覺得那部電影糟透了！」「我也有同感！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that a situation or someone's behaviour remains the same, especially when it is boring or annoying

examples.en: Most people just keep on doing the same old same old every day.
examples.trans: 許多人每天都重複做著同樣的事情。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: sarcasm is the lowest form of wit
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to mean that sarcasm is unkind and not very funny
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 挖苦是最低級的幽默；挖苦乃刻薄之舉

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that it is not worth talking to someone because they will not listen to you
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 不值得浪費唇舌；不必對牛彈琴

examples.en: I don't know why I even try to talk to him - I might as well save my breath.
examples.trans: 我不知道爲甚麽要浪費唇舌和他說話——最好還是不要對牛彈琴。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: the ability to do and say the right thing in any social situation
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 隨機應變的能力；應付自如的社交能力

examples.en: She possesses great savoir-faire.
examples.trans: 她的社交能力極強。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that someone who is taking a photograph of you tells you to say so that your mouth makes the shape of a smile
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 說「茄子」（要求照相的人說 cheese 使口形呈微笑狀）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to show that you understand exactly what the other person is suggesting

examples.en: "I saw him coming out of her flat." "Say no more!"
examples.trans: 「我看見他從她的公寓裡出來。」「明白了，不要再說了！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone that you will do what they want at the time they ask you
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 吩咐一下，說一聲，表示一下

examples.en: You only have to/Just say the word, and I'll come and help.
examples.trans: 你只要說一聲，我就會來幫忙。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: say this that much for sb sth
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say something good about someone or something considered to be bad

examples.en: I'll say this much for Kay, she always agrees to help whenever we ask her.
examples.trans: 我要幫凱說幾句好話，只要我們提出來，她總是願意伸出援手。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you are pouring a drink for someone and you want them to tell you when to stop pouring
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （為人倒酒時跟對方說的話）斟夠了請說一聲

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say what you are obviously wanting to say

examples.en: Just say your piece and then go.
examples.trans: 只管說你想說的話，說完就離開。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: informal used when you are arguing with someone, to show that you do not accept or agree with what they say
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （在爭執時表示不同意或不接受對方的說法）誰說的？

examples.en: You're the best? Says who?
examples.trans: 「你最好？誰說的？」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that someone has been killed

examples.en: "Marvin's bought it!" screamed the sergeant.
examples.trans: 「馬文被殺了！」中士大叫道。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you think that someone's actions are extremely unreasonable
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （某人）真該殺（用以表示其行爲太過分）

examples.en: They should be shot for selling drinks at that price!
examples.trans: 他們的飲料賣得那麽貴，真是天殺的！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: sb s eyes are bigger than their belly stomach
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say when someone has taken more food than they can eat

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that someone does not need to be frightened of a particular person or thing

examples.en: Just go and ask her - she won't bite.
examples.trans: 你去問問她——別怕，她不會咬你的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to persuade someone to do something by frightening them

examples.en: The two boys scared the old man into handing over his wallet.
examples.trans: 這兩個男孩恐嚇老人，逼他交出錢包。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say things that make someone else seem silly or wrong

examples.en: He's always trying to score points off people and it's really irritating.
examples.trans: 他老是想駁倒別人，太令人討厭了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you are trying to make someone believe that you are telling the truth
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 保證；童子軍誓言（希望別人相信自己所說的話是事實）

examples.en: I didn't break it. Scout's honour!
examples.trans: 我敢發誓，不是我打破的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say when you do not know the answer to a question

examples.en: "Where's Jack?" "Search me!"
examples.trans: 「傑克在哪裡？」「我怎麽知道！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: US to criticize someone's actions or an event after it has happened

examples.en: She's always trying to second-guess the boss.
examples.trans: 她老是試圖揣測老闆的意圖。

examples.en: Of course it's easy to second-guess the management of the election campaign, but I do think serious mistakes were made.
examples.trans: 當然事後批評競選活動的組織管理很容易，不過我確實認爲他們犯了大錯。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a person who likes another person but does not say so

examples.en: Who sent you those flowers - do you have a secret admirer?
examples.trans: 那些花是誰送的——有人在暗戀你吧？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a government employee whose job involves getting secret information about the governments of unfriendly foreign countries

examples.en: Synonym
examples.trans: spy

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a government organization that is responsible for things such as the safety of important politicians and for preventing secret information being discovered by possible enemy countries
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （政府的）特務情報機關，特務部門

examples.en: The press reported that he was paid more than $700,000 by the British Secret Service for sharing classified information.
examples.trans: 報刊報導說英國情報機構付給他70萬美元作為洩露機密文件的回報。

examples.en: The Secret Service has a responsibility to protect the President from harm.
examples.trans: 特勤局有保護總統不受傷害的責任。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: see a man about a dog
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: You might say you have to see a man about a dog when you do not want to say what you are really doing, especially when going to the toilet.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 出去一下（尤指上廁所的隱諱說法）

examples.en: I've just got to see a man about a dog. I'll be back in a minute.
examples.trans: 我出去一下，一會兒就回來。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to mean that if you see something yourself, you will believe it to exist or be true, despite the fact that it is extremely unusual or unexpected
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 眼見爲憑；百聞不如一見

examples.en: I never thought Mark would get out of bed before lunchtime on a Saturday, but seeing is believing!
examples.trans: 我從沒想過馬克星期六會在午餐前起床，真是眼見為實！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: control of what you say or do in order to avoid annoying or offending others, but without being told officially that such control is necessary

examples.en: These writers knew that unless they practised a form of self-censorship, the authorities would persecute them.
examples.trans: 這些作家知道，除非他們採取某種自我約束，否則當局會迫害他們。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: expressing one thing that is the opposite of another thing that was already said; saying two things that cannot both be correct

examples.en: He is described as a Texas oil millionaire and environmentalist, which might appear to be self-contradictory.
examples.trans: 他被描述爲德州的石油大亨和環境保護者，這看來可能有些自相矛盾。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: the act of hiding the truth from yourself

examples.en: His claim to be an important and unjustly neglected painter is sheer self-deception - he's no good at all.
examples.trans: 他自稱是位被無端埋沒的偉大畫家，這純粹是自欺欺人——他根本就一無是處。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: behaviour based on the characteristics or feelings that warn people or animals to protect themselves from difficulties or dangers

examples.en: It was his instinct for self-preservation that led him to abandon his former friends and transfer his allegiance to the new rulers.
examples.trans: 正是他自保的本能驅使他拋棄了以前的朋友，轉而效忠於新的統治者。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said or announced about yourself

examples.en: He's a self-proclaimed expert on national defence.
examples.trans: 他自稱是位精通國防的專家。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said, announced, or admitted about yourself

examples.en: a self-professed gambler
examples.trans: 承認自己是賭徒的人

examples.en: She's a self-professed supporter of prison reform.
examples.trans: 她自稱是監獄改革的支持者。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: determined to base your actions on your own decisions without listening to advice from other people

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a characteristic of a product that will persuade people to buy it

examples.en: Its best selling point is the price - it's the cheapest on the market.
examples.trans: 其最大賣點在於價格——這是市場上最便宜的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: send a signal to sb that
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to show or warn that something is true

examples.en: The change should send a signal to financial institutions that we are serious about tackling fraud.
examples.trans: 這種改變應該能向金融機構發出信號：我們將嚴肅打擊詐騙行為。

examples.en: This pay deal sends a clear signal that we value our employees.
examples.trans: 這項工資協定傳達了一個明確的資訊：我們重視僱員的價值。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: send sb away with a flea in their ear
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to angrily tell someone to go away

examples.en: A young kid came asking for money but I sent him away with a flea in his ear.
examples.trans: 一個小孩來要錢，但是我氣衝衝地把他轟走了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If a group of people send someone to Coventry, they refuse to speak to that person, usually as a punishment for having done something to upset the group.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （通常作爲懲罰）不理睬（某人），不搭理（某人）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: an occasion at which people can express good wishes and say goodbye to someone who is leaving a place

examples.en: We'll have to give her a good send-off when she leaves the office.
examples.trans: 她離職的時候，我們得為她舉辦一個像樣的道別會。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that something bad serves someone right, you mean that that person deserves it.

examples.en: "He hit me!" "It serves you right. You shouldn't have been so mean to him."
examples.trans: 「他打了我！」「活該。你不該對他那麽不好。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to decide what subjects other people should discuss and deal with

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say that you are a particular type of person

examples.en: He sets himself up as an expert on vegetable growing, but he doesn't seem to me to know much about it.
examples.trans: 他以蔬菜種植專家自居，但在我看來他對此懂得並不多。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: advice and/or training given by an expert to help people who have sexual problems

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: unwanted or offensive sexual attention, suggestions, or talk, especially from an employer or other person in a position of power

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a long joke that has an intentionally silly or meaningless ending

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone to hurry or act more quickly

examples.en: Come on, Nick, shake a leg or we'll never be ready in time.
examples.trans: 快，尼克，把握時間，否則我們就不能按時準備好。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to tell someone that they must improve their performance or behaviour or they will have to leave

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: shoot sth sb down in flames
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to refuse to accept someone's suggestion or idea and not consider it at all
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 斷然拒絕，否定（某人的建議或想法）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to talk too much in a loud and uncontrolled way

examples.en: It's just like Richard to go shooting his mouth off about other people's business.
examples.trans: 理查就是這種人，愛對別人的事情信口開河。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: shout proclaim sth from the rooftops
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say something publicly

examples.en: I'm so in love I want to shout your name from the rooftops.
examples.trans: 我太愛你了，真想對整個世界大喊你的名字。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: an argument that involves people shouting at each other because they have very strong opinions

examples.en: The meeting soon degenerated into a shouting match.
examples.trans: 會議很快淪爲一場爭吵。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone angrily to go away

examples.en: Just shove off, will you?
examples.trans: 走開，好嗎？

examples.en: She jumped into the dinghy and shoved off.
examples.trans: 她跳進小艇，離岸而去。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: informal to tell someone what to do, in a rude or threatening way

examples.en: The older boys at school are always shoving him around.
examples.trans: 學校裡年齡大一點的男孩總是對他推推撞撞的。

examples.en: Don't let them shove you around. You've got to stand up for your rights.
examples.trans: 別任由他們擺布，你應該振作維護自己的權利。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: shove stick sth up your ass
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone angrily that you do not want or need something that they are offering you or telling you to do
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 不稀罕你的！收起你那一套！關你屁事！

examples.en: If she asks me to work over the weekend, I'll tell her to shove it up her ass!
examples.trans: 她要是讓我週末工作，我就會讓她滾到一邊去！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to allow people to know about intentions that you had previously kept secret

examples.en: Keep the names of the team secret - don't show your hand until the day of the game.
examples.trans: 球隊的名稱要保密——比賽那天再宣佈。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to support one person or group in an argument
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （在爭論中）支持（某人或某方），站在（某人）一邊

examples.en: If ever there was any sort of argument, she'd always side with my father against me.
examples.trans: 只要有爭論，她就總是站在我父親一邊反對我。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: also sign [ U ] a system of hand and body movements representing words, used by and to people who cannot hear or talk

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: the movements that people sometimes make when talking to someone whose language they do not speak
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （語言不通時進行交流採用的）手勢，比劃

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to mean it is often better to say nothing

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: sing the praises of sb sth
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to praise someone or something

examples.en: The newspapers have been singing the praises of Italy's new star player.
examples.trans: 報紙一直在誇讚這位義大利的體育新星。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to choose one person or thing from a group for special attention, especially criticism or praise
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （爲給予批評、表揚等）單獨挑出

examples.en: It's not fair the way my sister is always singled out for special treatment.
examples.trans: 我妹妹總是受到特殊待遇，這不公平。

examples.en: Jamie was thrilled when the teacher singled out his poem and asked him to read it aloud.
examples.trans: 老師選出傑米的詩並讓他自己朗讀時，傑米非常激動。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: A sit-down strike or protest is one in which people refuse to leave a place until their demands are listened to.

examples.en: I sat down on the sofa next to Barbara.
examples.trans: 我緊靠著芭芭拉在沙發上坐了下來。

examples.en: We're having a sit-down meal at our wedding, rather than a buffet.
examples.trans: 我們結婚時會擺正式桌宴而不是自助餐。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: US an occasion when you sit down and talk seriously with someone

examples.en: I sat down on the sofa next to Barbara.
examples.trans: 我緊靠著芭芭拉在沙發上坐了下來。

examples.en: We're having a sit-down meal at our wedding, rather than a buffet.
examples.trans: 我們結婚時會擺正式桌宴而不是自助餐。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: mainly UK to refuse to change your mind
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 固執己見，堅持自己的主張

examples.en: You'd better sit tight and I'll call the doctor.
examples.trans: 你最好待著別動，我去叫醫生。

examples.en: My parents tried to persuade me not to go alone, but I sat tight.
examples.trans: 我的父母試圖說服我不要單獨前往，但我執意如此。
