Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: six of one and half a dozen of the other
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you think that neither of two choices is better than the other

examples.en: "Shall we give her chocolates or flowers?" "I don't know, it's six of one and half a dozen of the other."
examples.trans: 「我們應該送她巧克力還是花？」 「不知道，都差不多。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: an embarrassing secret

examples.en: Most families have one or two skeletons in the closet.
examples.trans: 大多數家庭都有一兩件家醜。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to punish or tell someone off severely
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 活剝（某人）的皮，狠狠責罰（某人）

examples.en: My mother will skin me alive for being so late home.
examples.trans: 這麽晚回家，我媽媽會活活剝了我的皮。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to criticize someone

examples.en: I hate the way Dan is always slagging people off behind their backs.
examples.trans: 我不喜歡丹總是那樣在背後詆毀別人。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: an argument in which both people use angry uncontrolled language and insult each other

examples.en: The politicians started a slanging match in the middle of the debate.
examples.trans: 辯論中，政客們開始互相謾罵起來。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to criticize someone or something severely, usually in public
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （通常指在公共場合）批評（某人／某事）

examples.en: This claim was slapped down by the chairman.
examples.trans: 這一說法遭到了主席的公開批評。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say by accident when you intended to say something else

examples.en: I called her new boyfriend by her previous boyfriend's name - it was just a slip of the tongue.
examples.trans: 我叫她的新男友時喊成了她前任男友的名字——那只是一個口誤。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to close and open your mouth loudly to express a strong wish to eat something you like a lot

examples.en: "I love chocolate cake," said Susannah, smacking her lips.
examples.trans: 「我喜歡巧克力蛋糕，」蘇珊娜邊咂著嘴脣邊說道。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: conversation about things that are not important, often between people who do not know each other well

examples.en: I don't enjoy parties where I have to make small talk with complete strangers.
examples.trans: 我不喜歡那種不得不和陌生人寒暄的派對。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If someone has or is a smart mouth, they speak to other people in a way that shows little respect.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 愛貧嘴的人，愛耍嘴皮子的人

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a place where powerful people, such as politicians, meet to have discussions and make agreements in secret
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （政治人物進行密談決策的）密談室

examples.en: The whole business stinks of political corruption and decisions made in smoke-filled rooms.
examples.trans: 整個事件充滿了政治腐敗和密室決策的味道。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone to do something more quickly

examples.en: We're leaving in five minutes so you'd better snap to it and finish your breakfast.
examples.trans: 我們五分鐘以後就走，所以你最好快點吃完早飯。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that it is necessary to accept the situation as it exists
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於表示有必要接受目前的處境）就接受吧

examples.en: If she wants to spend all her money on clothes, so be it!
examples.trans: 如果她想把錢都花在衣服，就由她去吧。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to make a promise in a very formal and serious way

examples.en: Everything I have said is true, so help me God.
examples.trans: 上帝作證，我說的一切都是真的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that a particular action or situation would be even more successful

examples.en: If you can go there this afternoon, so much the better.
examples.trans: 如果你今天下午去那裡會更好。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: someone who you can easily persuade to do what you want
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 耳根軟的人，易被說服的人

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that someone claims to be a particular thing, especially when you do not accept that person's claim. Soi-disant comes from French.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （來自法語，用來表示不相信所聲稱的）所謂

examples.en: a soi-disant literary critic
examples.trans: 一個所謂的文學評論家

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: an outside entertainment that uses sounds, lights, and often a spoken story to tell the history of a place
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 聲光表演（一種室外娛樂活動，運用聲光效果、常配以故事來講述某地的歷史）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: (said) in a quiet voice so that only people near can hear

examples.en: The remark was uttered sotto voce.
examples.trans: 說這話時聲音很小。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to express your opinions forcefully, especially without being asked for them
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （尤指未經邀請）大發議論，言辭激烈地發表意見

examples.en: He's always sounding off about how he thinks the country should be run.
examples.trans: 他總是大發議論，表明自己對治理國家的看法。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: spare the rod and spoil the child
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to mean that if you do not punish a child when they do something wrong, they will not learn what is right
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 孩子不打不成器；愛之深，責之切

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If sparks fly between two or more people, they argue angrily.

examples.en: When they get together in a meeting the sparks really fly.
examples.trans: 他們只要在開會時碰頭，就會激烈爭論。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say to someone to say that the opinion that they have just expressed is not the same as your opinion
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於表示不同意某人的觀點）那是你自己的看法，我不是那樣想的

examples.en: "We had a really boring trip." "Speak for yourself! I had a wonderful time!"
examples.trans: 「我們的旅行可真無趣。」「我可不這麽想！我玩得很開心！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: mainly US to talk about something

examples.en: He could not speak to the details of the new plan.
examples.trans: 他不能談論計畫的細節。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say something that is quickly shown not to be true

examples.en: He won't be home for hours yet ... Oh, I spoke too soon - here he is now!
examples.trans: 他暫時還不會到家……哦，我這話說得太早了——他回來了！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: speak when you re spoken to
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to a child to tell the child not to speak if no one speaks to them first
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 有問才答；要你說你才說

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say when the person you were talking about appears unexpectedly

examples.en: Did you hear what happened to Anna yesterday - oh, speak of the devil, here she is.
examples.trans: 你聽說安娜昨天出的那件事了嗎——噢，說曹操，曹操就到了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say something that you should not have said

examples.en: I'm sorry if I spoke out of turn, but I thought you already knew.
examples.trans: 如果我說了不該說的話，我很抱歉，我還以為你已經知道了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a place in Hyde Park, in London, where people speak publicly about moral and political matters
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 演說廣場（倫敦海德公園中人們就道德和政治問題公開發表個人見解的地方）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: an occasion when you have been asked to give a formal talk about something
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （獲邀就某事正式演說的）受邀演講

examples.en: He knows a lot about the history of this area, so he has many speaking engagements with local community groups.
examples.trans: 他非常瞭解這個地區的歷史，因此常常受邀在當地社區作報告。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: in the theatre, someone who has a small part, usually without any words to say
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （戲劇中）飾演小角色的人，跑龍套者

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to talk about or express an emotion freely

examples.en: All his resentment spilled out.
examples.trans: 他的怨恨一股腦全都發洩了出來。

examples.en: I listened quietly as she spilled out all her anger and despair.
examples.trans: 我靜靜地聽她傾訴她的憤怒和絕望。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to tell people secret information

examples.en: So who spilled the beans about her affair with David?
examples.trans: 那到底是誰把她和戴維的私情抖露出來的？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to tell someone all about yourself, especially your problems

examples.en: Why do people take part in these shows and spill their guts on camera in front of a studio audience?
examples.trans: 為什麼人們參加這樣的節目，並當著演播室觀眾的面，對著攝像機傾訴衷腸？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone to start speaking or to speak more quickly, when they are unwilling to speak or are speaking slowly
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 有甚麽儘管說出來！爽快點吧！

examples.en: Come on, spit it out, who told you about this?
examples.trans: 說吧，爽快點，是誰告訴你這事的？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say something quickly and angrily

examples.en: He spat out an insult and marched out of the room.
examples.trans: 他一邊大步走出房間，一邊罵了句髒話。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to argue about small details of something
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 糾纏於末枝細節；在雞毛蒜皮的事上爭論不休

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to suddenly tell or ask someone something when they do not expect it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 突然告訴（某人）；冷不防地問（某人）

examples.en: I hope he's not going to spring any nasty surprises on us at the meeting this morning.
examples.trans: 我希望今天上午的會議他不會冷不防對我們說出一些讓人討厭的話來。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say someone is or will go square-eyed, you mean they are watching too much television.

examples.en: You'll go square-eyed if you sit in front of that TV any more!
examples.trans: 如果你還是老坐在電視機前，你會看上癮的！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to persuade or force someone to give you money or information
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 勒索，敲詐（某人）；逼迫（某人）吐露（資訊）

examples.en: During the negotiations, the union managed to squeeze several concessions from the management.
examples.trans: 談判期間，工會設法迫使管理階層作出了幾項讓步。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If an actor says something in a stage whisper, it is intended to be heard by the people watching the play, and the other actors on the stage pretend not to hear it.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （演員有意讓觀眾聽見的）舞臺旁白

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say something in a stage whisper, you intend it to be heard by people other than the ones you are talking to.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 故意讓旁人聽到的低語

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you stake a claim to something, you say or show that you have a right to it and that it should belong to you.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 宣佈所有權，提出擁有權

examples.en: He marked the spot on his map where he had seen the gold and returned later that month to stake his claim.
examples.trans: 他在地圖上標出了見到金子的地方，然後在當月稍晚的時候回來宣佈自己對此地擁有所有權。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said in the past by highwaymen when they stopped a carriage (= a vehicle pulled by horses) on a road to demand objects of value from the travellers
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （舊時攔路強盜用語）站住，留下買路財！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to continue doing what you said you would when you made a decision, agreement, or promise
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 繼續遵守，信守（決定、協定或承諾）

examples.en: Despite its financial problems, the company is standing by the no-redundancy agreement.
examples.trans: 公司儘管遇到了財務問題，但仍然信守不裁員的協定。

examples.en: I stand by the statement I made earlier - there is no reason for the minister to resign.
examples.trans: 我堅持早些時候的表態——部長沒有理由必須辭職。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to continue to believe that something you have said before is still true
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 仍然堅信，堅持（先前的說法）

examples.en: Despite its financial problems, the company is standing by the no-redundancy agreement.
examples.trans: 公司儘管遇到了財務問題，但仍然信守不裁員的協定。

examples.en: I stand by the statement I made earlier - there is no reason for the minister to resign.
examples.trans: 我堅持早些時候的表態——部長沒有理由必須辭職。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to make someone start to laugh, cry, or talk about something that they talk about often
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 使（某人）開始（笑、哭或談起常談之事）

examples.en: I'll start her off on some fairly basic stuff and see how she gets on.
examples.trans: 我會先讓她做些相當基礎的事情，看看她做得如何。

examples.en: I could see Emma trying not to laugh and of course that started me off.
examples.trans: 我注意到艾瑪想忍住不笑，當然，那卻惹得我笑了出來。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone that what they are saying is too extreme
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 別那麼極端！說話留點餘地！

examples.en: Steady on, Chris - she's nice but she's not that nice!
examples.trans: 別這麼絕對，克裡斯——她很好，但還沒你說的那麼好！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone to drive faster or to hurry

examples.en: Could you step on it? I'm late.
examples.trans: 你能開快點嗎？我要遲到了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: step tread on sb s toes
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you step/tread on someone's toes, you say or do something that upsets or annoys that person, especially by involving yourself in matters that are not your responsibility.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （尤指干預他人負責之事而）惹惱，得罪（某人）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to be unable to say the words you want to say, usually because of a strong emotion
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （通用因為情緒激動）無法說出想說的話

examples.en: She looked at him, but her voice stuck in her throat.
examples.trans: 她看著他，卻說不出她想說的話來。

examples.en: It really sticks in my throat that I did all the work, and she's getting all the credit.
examples.trans: 所有工作都是我做的，但功勞全都歸她，這令我很惱火。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to point up above the surface of something and not lie flat

examples.en: When I get up in the morning, my hair is always sticking up.
examples.trans: 我早上起床的時候，頭髮總是翹著。

examples.en: There were some large rocks sticking up out of the water.
examples.trans: 有一些大石頭突出水面。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: sticks and stones may break my bones but words can never hurt me
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said in order to show that people cannot be hurt by unpleasant things that are said to them
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 棍棒和石頭可能會打斷我的骨頭（但言語傷害不了我）。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said about a person who says little, but who might in fact know a lot
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 靜水流深；沉默寡言者可能胸藏丘壑

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to show that you are telling the truth

examples.en: You're a really attractive woman, straight up!
examples.trans: 你是個非常有魅力的女人，真的！

examples.en: "She's 16! Straight up?" (= Are you telling the truth?)
examples.trans: 「她16歲？真的嗎？」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that although a suggested event or idea seems very strange or surprising, it is possible
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 還有更離奇的事（用於說明雖然所說的事件或想法聽起來非常奇怪或令人吃驚，但也是有可能會發生的）

examples.en: "You don't think Katie and Darryl are falling in love, do you?" "Well, stranger things have happened."
examples.trans: 「你不是認為凱蒂和達瑞爾墜入愛河了吧？是吧？」「噢！更離奇的事也會有。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to lie with your legs and arms spread out in a relaxed way

examples.en: I just want to get home and stretch out on the sofa.
examples.trans: 我只想回家攤開四肢舒舒服服地躺在沙發上。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say something that is not completely honest in order to make someone or something seem better than it really is

examples.en: He was accused of stretching the truth about how much he had helped in the project.
examples.trans: 他被指責誇大了自己在整個專案計劃中的貢獻。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to express and communicate a particular opinion or feeling about something

examples.en: I find it really difficult to strike the right note when I'm writing job applications.
examples.trans: 我發現寫求職信時很難說到重點上。

examples.en: At the end of her speech, she struck a note of warning about the risks involved in the project.
examples.trans: 演講的最後，她就這個專案計劃所潛藏的風險發出警告。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to criticize someone or something in a public way

examples.en: He turned around and struck out at the man behind him.
examples.trans: 他轉過來打他身後的那個男人。

examples.en: She struck out at her husband's family in her famous TV interview.
examples.trans: 在那個著名的電視採訪中，她抨擊了她丈夫的家庭。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to start a relationship or conversation with someone

examples.en: When the applause had died down, a band struck up the national anthem.
examples.trans: 掌聲漸漸平息之後，軍樂隊奏響了國歌。

examples.en: He gets really jealous if his girlfriend strikes up a friendship with another man.
examples.trans: 如果他的女友和其他男性建立起友誼的話，他會很嫉妒。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you string words or sentences together, you manage to say something that other people can understand.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 組織（語言 ）；把…連成句子；把…說清楚

examples.en: People tend to be very impressed if you can string together a couple of sentences in Japanese.
examples.trans: 如果你能說上幾句日語，人們往往就會覺得你很了不起。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to show anger or disapproval about a situation or person, or that you refuse to obey someone
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於表示生氣、不贊成或不服從）去它的／去他們的／去你的（等等）

examples.en: He's expecting us to work late. Well, stuff that/him!
examples.trans: 「他希望我們加班。」「不可能！」

examples.en: "Should we clean up now?" "No, stuff it! Let someone else do it!"
examples.trans: 「我們現在要收拾嗎?」「不用，管它呢！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to refer to something that you do not want to name or say exactly
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於不想明確說出的事物）某，某個

examples.en: If they tell you to arrive at such and such a time, just get there a couple of minutes early.
examples.trans: 如果他們告訴你要在某個時間到，就早到幾分鐘。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to persuade someone to do something by deceiving them

examples.en: [ + -ing verb ] We were suckered into doing the job for free.
examples.trans: 我們受騙白白做了那工作。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: it is enough to say
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 無需多說，只需說…就夠了

examples.en: Suffice (it) to say, Mike won't be going to Tina's birthday party after what he said about her to her boss.
examples.trans: 不用多說，麥克對蒂娜的老闆那樣說她之後，他是不會去參加她的生日聚會的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: disapproving An announcement or promise that is sugar-coated is intended to seem positive or pleasant, although in fact it will result in something unpleasant or unacceptable.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （公告或承諾）外裹糖衣的，將不好的一面隱藏住的，巧加粉飾的

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: at the highest level of the special levels of achievement in a person's studies at a US college or university. The expression comes from Latin, meaning "with the highest praise"
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （源自拉丁語，美國大學的）最優等的

examples.en: Danielle graduated summa cum laude.
examples.trans: 丹妮耶拉以最優等的成績畢業。

examples.en: a summa cum laude graduate
examples.trans: 一名獲得最優等的畢業生。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when someone has done something or when something has happened in a way that you expected and that you do not approve of
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （表示不贊同的事情在預料之中發生）真是意外啊

examples.en: "I've forgotten my keys again." "Surprise, surprise!"
examples.trans: 「我又忘記帶鎖匙了。」「真是意外啊！」

examples.en: I asked him if he wanted to come to dinner, and surprise, surprise, he said yes!
examples.trans: 我問他想不想來吃晚飯，太讓人驚喜了，他竟然答應了！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you are telling someone about a situation in which something unexpected and pleasant has happened
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （表示發生了讓人感到驚喜的事情）太讓人意外了

examples.en: "I've forgotten my keys again." "Surprise, surprise!"
examples.trans: 「我又忘記帶鎖匙了。」「真是意外啊！」

examples.en: I asked him if he wanted to come to dinner, and surprise, surprise, he said yes!
examples.trans: 我問他想不想來吃晚飯，太讓人驚喜了，他竟然答應了！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to be forced to admit that something you have said has been shown to be wrong
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 被迫承認自己說的話不對

examples.en: I had to swallow my words when the project turned out to be a great success.
examples.trans: 結果這個計劃非常成功，我不得不承認我之前說的話是錯的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to refuse to consider something or to treat it as important
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 對…置之不理，無視，對…不予考慮

examples.en: They swept his doubts and objections aside.
examples.trans: 他們對他的疑慮和反對置之不理。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: romantic and loving talk

examples.en: They're the couple in the corner, whispering/murmuring sweet nothings to each other.
examples.trans: 他們就是躲在角落裡，低聲說著情話的那一對情侶。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a way of talking to someone in a pleasing or funny way in order to persuade them to do or believe something
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 用甜言蜜語勸說，用花言巧語勸說

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to add something to what you have said or written at a later time

examples.en: Tag on a couple of paragraphs about recent events.
examples.trans: 添加幾段最近發生的事。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: take a rain check on sth
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone that you cannot accept an invitation now, but would like to do so at a later time
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於婉拒邀請）下次吧，以後再說，以後再叨擾

examples.en: Mind if I take a rain check on that drink? I have to work late tonight.
examples.trans: 這杯酒你改天再請我喝好不好？今晚我要加班工作。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: take a the fall for sb
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to accept the blame for something another person did

examples.en: I wasn't going to take the fall for him.
examples.trans: 我不打算替他揹黑鍋。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: take sb s name in vain
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to criticize someone or talk about someone without respect, especially when they are not there
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （尤指在背後）肆意批評（某人），說（某人）的閒話

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said as someone hits someone else, especially in humorous films or cartoons
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （尤指喜劇電影或卡通片中打人時的用語）看招！吃我一拳！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: take the piss out of sb or sth
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to make a joke about someone or make someone look silly

examples.en: They're always taking the piss out of him because he's a Barry Manilow fan.
examples.trans: 他們總是取笑他，因為他是巴瑞‧曼尼洛的狂熱崇拜者。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: take the words out of sb s mouth
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say something that another person was just about to say or was thinking
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 說出（某人）要說（或正在思考）的話

examples.en: "What a rude and obnoxious man!" "You took the words right out of my mouth!"
examples.trans: 「那個男人真是又粗魯又討厭！」「那正是我想說的！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: take up the cudgels for against sb sth
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to argue strongly in support of, or against, someone or something

examples.en: Relatives have taken up the cudgels for two British women accused of murder.
examples.trans: 親屬們極力爲兩名被控謀殺的英國女子辯護。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: take your hat off to sb
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that you take your hat off to someone, you mean that you admire them for an achievement.

examples.en: So Emma actually manages to juggle two small children and a full-time job, does she? Well, I take my hat off to her.
examples.trans: 這麽說艾瑪在照顧好兩個小孩子的同時還做著一份全職工作，是嗎？我可真佩服她。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: take lead sb on to one side
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to have a private talk with someone

examples.en: Bill's father took him to one side and told him to stop misbehaving.
examples.trans: 比爾的父親把他拉到一邊，讓他別再那麽無禮了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to make a formal promise to stop drinking alcohol

examples.en: What's this then, you're only drinking orange juice - have you signed the pledge or something?
examples.trans: 這是怎麼回事？你只喝柳橙汁——你是發過誓不再喝酒了，還是其他甚麼原因？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to talk quickly and without stopping

examples.en: He talked a blue streak all through breakfast.
examples.trans: 他吃早餐時一直滔滔不絕地說話。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: UK also talk round to avoid speaking directly about something

examples.en: He just kept talking around the subject and didn't tackle the main issues.
examples.trans: 我覺得他只是不著邊際地說了一通，沒有涉及主要問題。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to speak to someone without listening to that person or allowing them to speak
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （不顧對方如何反應）而大發議論，滔滔不絕地（對某人）說

examples.en: What discussion? You weren't talking to me, you were talking at me!
examples.trans: 那是甚麼討論？你不是在跟我交談，一直都是你在說，根本不容我說！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to talk to someone as if they are less intelligent than you or not important
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 以居高臨下的語氣對（某人）說話

examples.en: I wish politicians wouldn't talk down to us as if we were idiots.
examples.trans: 我希望政客們不要以那種居高臨下的語氣跟我們講話，好像我們都是白癡似的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say things that are not reasonable or have no meaning

examples.en: Is it just me or was she talking nonsense in the meeting?
examples.trans: 只有我這麼覺得，還是她確實在會上胡說八道？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a type of radio programme on which events and people in the news are discussed and listeners call to talk

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: UK to speak loudly or without stopping to prevent someone else from speaking
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 以高聲（或連續）講話制止（某人）說話

examples.en: I tried to explain, but he just talked me down.
examples.trans: 我想解釋一下，但他根本不讓我插話。

examples.en: Just as soon as the President voiced his dissent, his advisors talked him down.
examples.trans: 總統剛出聲表示異議，他的顧問就立刻說服他打消這個念頭。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: mainly US to persuade someone that he or she is wrong or should not act
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 說服（某人）承認錯誤；說服（某人）放棄做（某事）

examples.en: I tried to explain, but he just talked me down.
examples.trans: 我想解釋一下，但他根本不讓我插話。

examples.en: Just as soon as the President voiced his dissent, his advisors talked him down.
examples.trans: 總統剛出聲表示異議，他的顧問就立刻說服他打消這個念頭。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to persuade someone who is threatening to kill himself or herself not to jump from a high place
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 勸（企圖自殺者）從高處下來

examples.en: I tried to explain, but he just talked me down.
examples.trans: 我想解釋一下，但他根本不讓我插話。

examples.en: Just as soon as the President voiced his dissent, his advisors talked him down.
examples.trans: 總統剛出聲表示異議，他的顧問就立刻說服他打消這個念頭。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to persuade someone to agree with you or to do what you want them to do

examples.en: She's not keen on the idea but we think we can talk her round.
examples.trans: 她對這個想法不怎麼感興趣，不過我們認為能說服她。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to talk to someone too much

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to talk to someone for a long time, usually loudly

examples.en: She talked my head off.
examples.trans: 她對我喋喋不休地說了半天。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to speak in a reasonable way

examples.en: It's good to hear someone finally talking sense on this issue.
examples.trans: 真不錯，關於這個問題，終於有人說點有道理的話了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to talk about your job with those you work with when not at work
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （與同事在工作時間外）談論自己的工作

examples.en: Even at a party they have to talk shop!
examples.trans: 就是在派對上，他們還是三句不離本行！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to talk about something in a way that makes it seem less important or less serious than it really is

examples.en: He began his lecture by talking down the initiatives of a rival company.
examples.trans: 他在講座一開始就貶低競爭對手的計劃。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to speak with enthusiasm about something

examples.en: If we talk up the event, people will come.
examples.trans: 如果我們把這事好好宣傳一下，人們一定會來的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: talk the hind leg s off a donkey
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to talk without stopping for a long time

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: talk the talk walk the walk
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that someone talks the talk but does not walk the walk, you mean that they do not act in a way that agrees with the things they say.

examples.en: When it comes to recycling he talks the talk but he doesn't walk the walk.
examples.trans: 在廢物回收利用這個問題上，他是說一套做一套。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to talk or act in a confident way so that you seem to be very good at what you do
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 流利（或令人信服）地談論某事

examples.en: She's only been a lawyer for three years, but she sure can talk the talk.
examples.trans: 她成為律師才三年，但是在談吐上顯得很有一套的樣子。

examples.en: Compare
examples.trans: walk the walk

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to talk about something without understanding what you are talking about

examples.en: Nothing of what he said made sense - he was talking through his hat.
examples.trans: 他說的話沒一點道理——他只是隨口亂說。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to speak in a way that makes other people fear you

examples.en: He likes to talk tough, but he's really a sweetheart inside.
examples.trans: 他嘴上強硬，但其實內心很柔軟。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: informal to say things that do not have a lot of meaning

examples.en: There are too many radio shows featuring idiots who call in and talk trash all day.
examples.trans: 在很多廣播節目裡，總有一些白癡整天打進電話說些廢話。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: US informal to criticize other people, especially unfairly or cruelly
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （尤指不公或殘忍地）批評，指責

examples.en: There are too many radio shows featuring idiots who call in and talk trash all day.
examples.trans: 在很多廣播節目裡，總有一些白癡整天打進電話說些廢話。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to discuss something honestly and directly

examples.en: OK, let's talk turkey - you're broke and you don't have work. What are you going to do?
examples.trans: 好，我們就別繞彎子了——你沒錢了，又沒有工作。你怎麼辦呢？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: talk your way into out of sth
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to persuade people that you should do something/not do something by the reasons you give

examples.en: He talked his way into the job.
examples.trans: 他靠三寸不爛之舌得到了那份工作。

examples.en: You might be able to talk your way out of most things but you still have to wash the dishes!
examples.trans: 也許你靠耍嘴皮子能夠推脫大部分的事情，但無論如何還是得洗碗。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say things in a confusing way
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 說話令人莫名其妙，說話像打啞謎

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a severe talk with someone who has done something wrong

examples.en: I gave her a good talking-to about doing her homework on time.
examples.trans: 我狠狠訓了她一頓，讓她按時做功課。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: UK the fact that people do not like and often criticize other people who are successful
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 槍打出頭鳥綜合症（指人們不喜歡並經常批評成功人士的現象）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: tall great oaks from little acorns grow
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said about organizations or plans that start off very small or simple and become extremely large or successful
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 參天巨樹萌生於幼籽；合抱之木生於毫末

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a shout made by someone hunting who sees a fox
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 呔呵！（獵人發現狐狸時的吆喝聲）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: teach your grandmother to suck eggs
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to give advice to someone about a subject that they already know more about than you

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to criticize someone in a forceful way

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to criticize someone or something very strongly

examples.en: Unfortunately, if he doesn't agree with you, he tends to tear into you.
examples.trans: 遺憾的是，如果他不同意你的意見，往往就會狠狠地批評你。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: tear rip sb sth to shreds
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to strongly criticize a person or something they do, think, or say
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 猛烈抨擊，將…批得體無完膚

examples.en: The critics tore his performance to shreds.
examples.trans: 評論家把他的表演批得一無是處。

examples.en: My trousers were torn to shreds when I fell off my bike.
examples.trans: 我從腳踏車上摔了下來，褲子破了好幾個洞。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you feel the same way or have had the same experience
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用來表示有相同的感受，有同樣的體驗）可不是嘛，的確這樣

examples.en: "He's driving me crazy with his stupid jokes." "Tell me about it!"
examples.trans: 「他愚蠢的笑話都快把我逼瘋了。」「可不是嘛！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you do not believe what someone has told you

examples.en: "I worked all day yesterday." "Oh yeah, tell me another one!"
examples.trans: 「我昨天工作了一整天。」「是嗎，鬼才信你！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: informal to give information about someone, usually something bad that they have said or done, especially to a person in authority

examples.en: A succession of late nights had begun to tell on him and his work was suffering.
examples.trans: 連續的熬夜開始令他的身體吃不消，他的工作也受到了影響。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: tell that it to the marines
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you do not believe something

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that tempers are getting frayed, you mean that people are getting angry with each other.

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say ten to one something will or will not happen, you mean it is very likely that it will or will not happen.

examples.en: Ten to one he won't be there tonight.
examples.trans: 他今晚十之八九不會去那裡。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to mean that a message has been received
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （民用頻帶電臺使用者用語）電信收到；是，好

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: an informal private conversation between two people, especially friends
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 兩人密談；（尤指朋友間的）促膝談心

examples.en: We must have a tête-à-tête sometime.
examples.trans: 我們哪天得坐下來好好聊聊。

examples.en: We dined tête-à-tête.
examples.trans: 我們兩人單獨一起用餐。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you thank someone for something, you mean that they are responsible or to blame for it.

examples.en: You can thank John for the mess we're in.
examples.trans: 我們現在陷入這般境地，都怪約翰。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: You say that something or someone (really) takes the biscuit when it or they have done something that you find extremely annoying or surprising.

examples.en: And you say she's opening your letters now? Oh, that really takes the biscuit!
examples.trans: 你說她在拆你的信？啊，這可真令人難以置信！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to express great surprise
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （表示非常驚訝）真是從未發生過的怪事

examples.en: You mean she just left her job without telling anyone she was going? Well, that beats everything!
examples.trans: 你是說她剛剛離職，卻沒有告訴任何人她要走了？哦，這可真是一件怪事！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when someone or something goes further than the limit of what is acceptable

examples.en: That does it! I will not tolerate that kind of behaviour in this class.
examples.trans: 太不像話了！我不能容忍班裡出現這樣的行爲。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say to tell someone that you are in the same unpleasant situation, or have the same negative feelings as them
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 我們兩人的情況一樣；我跟你有同感

examples.en: "I have no idea what's going on." "That makes two of us!"
examples.trans: 「我不知道怎麼回事。」「我也一樣。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: that was a game meal walk etc and a half
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say about something that was very surprising, very good, or took a lot of time
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 那是一場精彩的比賽／一頓佳餚／一段很長的路！（等等）（表示很令人吃驚、非常出色、花了很長時間等）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to mean that you do not want any more of something

examples.en: "Do you need more potatoes peeled?" "No, that'll do, thanks."
examples.trans: 「還要多削一些馬鈴薯嗎？」「不，夠了，謝謝。」

examples.en: That will do, Charles. I don't want to see any more of that kind of behaviour.
examples.trans: 查理斯，夠了，我不想再看到你那樣的舉動。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that a situation is wrong and unacceptable

examples.en: "The dinner was excellent except that they served red wine with the chicken." "Dear me! That will never do!"
examples.trans: 「晚餐很棒，只是不該用紅酒配雞肉。」「天啊！那怎麽行啊！」

examples.en: "He promised to pay me back last week, but he didn't." "Dear me, that will never do!"
examples.trans: 「他本來答應上週還錢給我，可他沒還。」「天啊！那怎麼行！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you think that something is unacceptable

examples.en: "The dinner was excellent except that they served red wine with the chicken." "Dear me! That will never do!"
examples.trans: 「晚餐很棒，只是不該用紅酒配雞肉。」「天啊！那怎麽行啊！」

examples.en: "He promised to pay me back last week, but he didn't." "Dear me, that will never do!"
examples.trans: 「他本來答應上週還錢給我，可他沒還。」「天啊！那怎麼行！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said of an action that you intend as a punishment for someone who has done something wrong

examples.en: The next time she's late home, I'll throw her dinner away. That'll show her!
examples.trans: 下一次她再晚回家的話，我會把她的晚餐扔掉。她就等著瞧吧！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say in order to show you think that something is unlikely to happen
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （表示不太相信）胡說，哪有這樣的事

examples.en: "Mike says he's going to give up smoking." "That'll be the day!"
examples.trans: 「麥克說他要戒煙了。」「別聽他的！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: mainly UK used to say that something is satisfactory
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 那樣很好，那很令人滿意

examples.en: That'll do nicely, thank you.
examples.trans: 那樣挺好，謝謝你。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone to stop behaving badly

examples.en: That'll do, Timothy! Please just sit down and keep quiet.
examples.trans: 夠了，蒂莫西！請坐下別說話。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: that ll put hairs on your chest
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that is said to someone who is going to drink something that contains strong alcohol or eat something satisfying that will make their stomach feel full
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 那會使你像個男子漢！（當某人要喝烈酒或飽餐一頓時別人說的玩笑話）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that a person should avoid doing something bad in the future thanks to the experience of the effects of their actions
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 這下（某人）該知道（做某事的）後果了，這下（某人）該知道（不應做某事了）

examples.en: So Roger spent the night in a freezing garage, did he? That'll teach him to (= show him that he should not) go out without his house keys!
examples.trans: 這麼說羅傑在冷冰冰的車庫裡過了一夜是嗎？這下他該知道出去不帶房門鎖匙的後果了吧！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: that s a matter of opinion
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to show that you do not agree with something that has just been said
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於表示不同意他人觀點）個人看法會有所不同

examples.en: "Anyway, she's a wonderful mother." "That's a matter of opinion."
examples.trans: 「不管怎麼說，她都是個很棒的母親。」「那是你個人的看法。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: that s a new one on me
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when someone has just told you a surprising fact that you did not know before

examples.en: "Sian and Richard are getting married." "Really! That's a new one on me!"
examples.trans: 「沙恩和李察要結婚了。」「真的嗎？我沒聽說過呢！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: that s about the size of it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to show your agreement with someone who has said something correct

examples.en: "So you mean you won't come to the party with me?" "Yes, that's about the size of it."
examples.trans: 「那麽你的意思是你不和我一起參加派對了?」「對，就是這樣。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said after something bad or unlucky has happened, to express your feeling that such events will sometimes happen and have to be accepted
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 這就是生活，生活就是這樣

examples.en: No, I didn't get the job but that's life, isn't it?
examples.trans: 不，我沒得到那份工作，不過生活就是這樣，對吧？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when something bad has happened that you cannot change
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 人生就是這樣。（表示無奈）

examples.en: No, I didn't get the job but that's life, isn't it?
examples.trans: 不，我沒得到那份工作，不過生活就是這樣，對吧？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to show that you do not think what someone has said is special
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 沒甚麽特別的；沒甚麽不同尋常的

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: that s the way the cookie crumbles
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when something slightly unlucky has happened that could not have been prevented and so must be accepted
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 生米已成熟飯；事已定局，無可變更

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you do not believe something
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 聽起來像真的一樣！真會編故事！

examples.en: "He said he bought them all very cheaply from some guy he knows." "That's a likely story!"
examples.trans: 「他說那些都是他從一個熟人那裡低價買來的。」「說得像真的似的！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said if you think that it is someone's own fault that something bad has happened to them

examples.en: Well, if you missed the presentation because you couldn't be bothered to turn up on time, that's your hard luck!
examples.trans: 嗯，如果你是因爲不屑於勞神費力準時到場而誤了發言，那是你活該倒楣！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: that s it s your funeral
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say that means that if someone suffers bad results from their actions, it will be that person's fault, not yours
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 那活該你倒楣！你自作自受！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you think something is a typical example of something bad

examples.en: You spend two hours cooking a meal and they say "it's disgusting" - that's children for you!
examples.trans: 你花兩個小時做了頓飯，他們卻說「難吃死了」——孩子就是這樣！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: prayers said in the morning, in the middle of the day and in the evening in the Roman Catholic Church
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （羅馬天主教堂在早、午、晚做的）三鐘經

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when the person you are looking for has gone away or escaped

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to describe a situation where a person who knows nothing is getting advice and help from another person who knows almost nothing
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 盲人教瞎子；外行指導外行

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to refuse to talk or be pleasant to someone
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 對…充耳不聞，對…不加理睬

examples.en: So she gave you the brush-off, did she?
examples.trans: 這麽説，她沒有理睬你，對吧？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said by someone who is responsible for making decisions and who will be blamed if things go wrong
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 責任到此，不能再推卸；我負責

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: well-educated middle-class people who enjoy discussing political, cultural, and social matters and who express opinions on a lot of subjects
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 閒聊階層（指喜愛談論政治、文化、社會問題，對各種問題發表意見的受過良好教育的中產階級）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that there is no food in a house or that there is no money, etc. available
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 櫥櫃空空；家裡一點吃的都沒有了；沒錢（做某事）

examples.en: I'd like to help you out, Paul, but I'm afraid the cupboard is bare.
examples.trans: 保羅，我倒是想幫助你，不過恐怕我也是兩手空空。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to mean that it is too late to improve a bad situation

examples.en: I didn't even know I'd offended her until Colin told me and then it was too late - the damage was done.
examples.trans: 經科林提醒，我才發覺自己冒犯了她，可是為時已晚。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: the darkest hour is just before the dawn
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to emphasize that things often seem at their worst just before they get better
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 黑暗即將過去，黎明就在眼前

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when a situation is certain to develop in a particular way because decisions have been taken that cannot be changed

examples.en: From the moment the negotiations failed, the die was cast and war was inevitable.
examples.trans: 談判失敗之時就大局已定，戰爭已經不可避免了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If the dust settles after an argument or big change, the situation becomes calmer.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 塵埃落定，有了眉目，形勢明朗

examples.en: We thought we'd let the dust settle before discussing the other matter.
examples.trans: 我們認爲應該在形勢明朗之後再討論另一個問題。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: the early bird catches the worm
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to advise someone that they will have an advantage if they do something immediately or before anyone else does it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 捷足先登；早起的鳥兒有蟲吃

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: You say that you wish the earth/floor/ground would open (up) if you are so embarrassed that you want suddenly to disappear.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （指尷尬得希望）地面裂開（使自己消失）

examples.en: At that moment the boss walked in, and I just wanted the ground to open up and swallow me.
examples.trans: 正在那時老闆走了進來，我只希望地上裂條縫讓我鑽進去。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said about a situation in which the final aim is so important that any way of achieving it is acceptable

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: the exception that proves the rule
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that emphasizes the general truth of a statement by disagreeing with it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 反證規律的例外；足以證明普遍性的例外

examples.en: Most company directors are middle-aged men, but this 28-year-old woman is an exception that proves the rule.
examples.trans: 大多數公司的董事長都是中年男性，但這位28歲的女董事卻是普遍中的例外。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a way of referring to newspapers, television programmes, etc. that discuss and criticize the clothes that famous people wear; a way of referring to people in general who criticize the clothes that people wear
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 時尚警察（指報刊或電視上有關名人著裝的評論，或泛指人們對他人著裝的評論）

examples.en: Don't wear socks with sandals if you don't want to get arrested by the fashion police.
examples.trans: 穿涼鞋的時候不要穿襪子，不然時尚警察們一定不會放過你。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: UK If the fur flies, people have a bad argument.

examples.en: The fur was really flying during that meeting.
examples.trans: 那次會議上吵得很厲害。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone that you know what their secret activities or plans are and that these cannot continue

examples.en: Okay, you two, the game's up! Give me the cigarettes - this time I'm telling your parents.
examples.trans: 好了，你倆，狐狸尾巴露出來了！把煙給我——這回我可要告訴你們的父母了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: the ability to speak easily and confidently in a way that makes people want to listen to you and believe you

examples.en: She's got the gift of the gab - she should work in sales and marketing.
examples.trans: 她能言善道——她應該去做銷售和市場行銷的工作。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: evangelical Christians whose members are generally thought to be too forceful in trying to persuade other people to believe as they do
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 上帝使團（指屬於基督教福音派的成員，常常力勸別人皈依他們的信仰）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: the grass is always greener on the other side
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say that means that other people always seem to be in a better situation than you, although they may not be
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （總是覺得別人的處境好）鄰家的草分外青；這山望著那山高

examples.en: I sometimes think I'd be happier teaching in Spain. Oh well, the grass is always greener on the other side!
examples.trans: 我有時會覺得在西班牙教書會更開心。嗨，真是的，這山望著那山高啊。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: the hand that rocks the cradle rules the world
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to emphasize that women have a strong influence on events through their children
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 搖搖籃的手統治著世界（強調母親對孩子的深遠影響）。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: the hell sb is does etc
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone that you do not believe what they have said or that you will not allow them to do what they want
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 你省省吧（強調不相信所聽到的話或不允許某人做某事）

examples.en: "I don't need your advice, Gene, I know what's good for me." "The hell you do!"
examples.trans: 「我不需要你的建議，吉恩，我知道甚麼對我有利。」「你省省吧！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a promise made by people when they become doctors to do everything possible to help their patients and to have high moral standards in their work
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 醫科學生誓約（新醫生執業前保證遵守醫德守則的誓言）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: the ink is not dry still wet
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: You say that the ink is not dry/still wet on a document if it has just been written or produced.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （文件）剛寫成的，剛製作完成的

examples.en: The ink was barely dry on the peace agreement when fighting broke out again.
examples.trans: 和平協議才剛簽好，戰鬥又再爆發了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: the leaders of the US armed forces, who give military advice to the president

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that the joke is on a particular person, you mean that that person has tried to make someone else look silly but has made himself or herself look silly instead.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 開玩笑反而開到（某人）自己頭上

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a secret US organization of white Protestant Americans, especially in the south of the country, who oppose people of other races or religions
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 三K黨（主要活動於美國南部的秘密組織，成員為新教白人，反對其他種族和宗教）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: the long and the short of it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you want to explain the general situation without giving details
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 總之，總的來講，總而言之

examples.en: The long and the short of it is that they are willing to start the work in January.
examples.trans: 總之，他們願意在一月份開工。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used humorously to talk about a wet sponge, used during a football game to treat an injured player, that seems to have magical qualities because the player is quickly able to move and play normally again
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 魔術海綿（戲謔的說法，指足球比賽期間用來治療受傷球員的濕海綿，因為接受治療的球員似乎都很快就恢復正常了）

examples.en: He was rolling around in agony, then the physio rubs him with the magic sponge and he's fine!
examples.trans: 他在地上痛苦地滾來滾去，隊醫給他擦了擦魔術海綿，於是他就一點沒事了！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say an occasion will be more enjoyable if a lot of people are there

examples.en: "Do you mind if I bring a couple of friends to your party?" "Not at all - the more the merrier!"
examples.trans: 「你介意我帶幾個朋友來參加你的聚會嗎？」「當然不會，人越多越有意思！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: the bar at a golf course where people go to have drinks and talk after they have finished playing
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 第十九洞（指高爾夫球賽後球員們去的設在球場上的酒吧）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: the joke about

examples.en: Have you heard the one about the Italian, the American and the Australian?
examples.trans: 你聽過那個關於義大利人、美國人和澳大利亞人的笑話嗎？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: the most important word in a phrase, which explains the truth of a situation

examples.en: He was a painter - "was" being the operative word, since he died last week.
examples.trans: 他曾經是位畫家——「曾經」是關鍵詞，因為他上周去世了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: the patter ing of tiny feet
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say that means that someone is going to have a baby
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 小寶寶的腳步聲（指即將有孩子）

examples.en: Are you telling me we're going to be hearing the patter of tiny feet?
examples.trans: 你是說我們就要有小寶寶了嗎？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: the pen is mightier than the sword
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to emphasize that thinking and writing have more influence on people and events than the use of force or violence

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a promise to be loyal to the US that is said especially by American children at school at the start of each day
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （尤指在美國學校裡，孩子們在每天一早要做的活動）宣誓效忠美國

examples.en: The teacher asked the children to stand and recite the Pledge of Allegiance.
examples.trans: 教師要孩子們站起來並宣誓效忠美國。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when a situation suddenly becomes more complicated or mysterious

examples.en: "Now there are two men calling her up all the time." "The plot thickens!"
examples.trans: 「現在有兩個男人一直打電話給她。」「情況越來越複雜了！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: the pot calling the kettle black
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say that means people should not criticize someone else for a fault that they have themselves
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 五十步笑百步；鍋嫌壺黑

examples.en: Elliott accused me of being selfish. Talk about the pot calling the kettle black!
examples.trans: 艾麗特竟然責備我自私，真是「五十步笑百步」。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: someone or something that is very good and has all the qualities that people say they have
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 真正的能手／好事（非常好的某人或某物，具有人們所說其應有的所有素質）

examples.en: His performance proved he's the real deal.
examples.trans: 他的演出證明他確實很棒。

examples.en: The booklet gives you the real deal on smoking.
examples.trans: 這本小冊子給你講述關於吸煙的事實真相。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: the road to hell is paved with good intentions
