Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to emphasize that you must not simply intend to behave well but you must act according to your intentions, because you will have problems or be punished if you do not
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 黃泉路上徒有好意多（指空有好的意圖卻不付諸行動，則不僅無用，還會給自己帶來很多問題或懲罰）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: the same that goes for sb sth
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: what I have said about one person or thing is also true for or relates to another person or thing
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 同樣適用於…；和…也有關；對…來說也是如此

examples.en: You really need to take more care with your appearance, Chris - and the same goes for the rest of you.
examples.trans: 克裡斯，你真的需要打扮得整潔些——你們也一樣。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: the sands of time are running out
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that there is not much time left to do something
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 時間不多，期限將到（沙漏裡的沙要跑完了，比喻做某事剩下的時間不太多了）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: abbreviation for the Special Air Service: a part of the British Army that has been specially trained for secret or very dangerous military activities
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （英國特種部隊）特別空勤旅（Special Air Service的縮寫）

examples.en: Compare
examples.trans: the SBS

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: the scales fall from sb s eyes
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If the scales fall from your eyes, you suddenly know and understand the truth.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （某人）恍然大悟，頓時看清真相

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: all the bad and good experiences that you have and that you learn from; used especially to talk about someone who is wise but not highly educated

examples.en: I learned my skills at the university of life.
examples.trans: 我在生活中學會了這些技能。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to encourage someone to continue with what they are doing, even if they are experiencing difficulties
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 戲還得照演；事情還得繼續做下去

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: the squeaky wheel gets the grease
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to emphasize that attention is paid to those problems that are made most noticeable
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 嘎吱響的輪子先上油；最明顯的問題先得到關注

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: the streets are paved with gold
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said about a place where it is easy to get rich, or where people imagine that it is

examples.en: Immigrant families soon discovered that the streets of New York were not paved with gold.
examples.trans: 移民家庭很快就發現紐約並非遍地黃金。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that the time is ripe, you mean that it is a suitable point for a particular activity.

examples.en: I'm waiting till the time is ripe before I tell my parents that I failed my two exams.
examples.trans: 我要等到時機成熟後再告訴父母兩門考試不及格的事。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a piece of news is known, especially if it was secret or if it will cause changes

examples.en: The word is out that superstar Candice is to marry towards the end of this year.
examples.trans: 有消息說超級明星坎迪斯將於今年年底結婚。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: there but for the grace of god go i
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when something bad that has happened to someone else could have happened to you
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （表示沒有遭到別人的厄運而慶幸）要不是上帝的恩典（我也遭殃）；多虧上帝開恩（我才逃過一劫）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said in a bad situation when something good happens unexpectedly
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於在不好的形勢下出現轉機時）天助我也！老天有眼！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: there ll be hell to pay
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say that means someone will be very angry if something happens

examples.en: There'll be hell to pay if she doesn't get the money in time.
examples.trans: 如果她沒有及時拿到錢，那可就有大麻煩了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: there s a lot of it about
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to mean that the stated thing is very common
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 這東西沒甚麽稀奇的，這東西多了去了

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: there s a time and a place for everything
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when someone is behaving in a way that you do not think is suitable for the situation they are in

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: there s little to be said for sth
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to mean that something has disadvantages

examples.en: Personally, I think there's little to be said for such a policy.
examples.trans: 我個人認爲這樣的政策沒有甚麽好處。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: there s many a slip twixt cup and lip
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to emphasize that many bad things might happen before something is finished
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 杯到嘴邊還會失手；世事往往功虧一簣

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: there s no danger of that
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to mean that something certainly will not happen
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （表示某事肯定不會發生）不會的！沒事的！

examples.en: "Bye - don't work too hard!" "There's no danger of that!"
examples.trans: 「再見——別太累了！」「不會的！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say there's no knowing, you mean it is impossible to be certain about something.

examples.en: There's no knowing what she'll do if she finds out about this.
examples.trans: 無從知曉她查出這事後會做些甚麼。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: there s no rest for the wicked
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you must continue with your work or other activity although you are very tired
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （形容自己太忙）惡人永無寧日。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: there s no smoke without fire
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If unpleasant things are said about someone or something, there is probably a good reason for it.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 無火不生煙；無風不起浪

examples.en: She says the accusations are not true, but there's no smoke without fire.
examples.trans: 她說那些指控純屬子虛烏有，但無風不起浪。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: there s no such thing as a free lunch
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to emphasize that you cannot get something for nothing

examples.en: "I get to travel with my job but the downside is I have to give talks." "Well, there's no such thing as a free lunch."
examples.trans: 「我這份工作可以經常去四處走走，不過壞處是我要經常作報告。」「哎呀，天下沒有免費的午餐嘛。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: there s no time like the present
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to encourage someone to take action immediately instead of waiting

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: there s none so deaf as those who will not hear
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said about someone who chooses to ignore advice or will not believe what they are told

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: there s nowt so queer as folk
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to emphasize that people sometimes behave in a very strange way
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 人世間千奇百怪；人間有百態

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to emphasize that being part of a group makes you less likely to be harmed
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 人多比較保險；人多勢眾

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to admit that there is some value or truth in what someone does or says, although you do not completely approve of it

examples.en: I don't go along with all his theories but there's probably something in it.
examples.trans: 我不同意他所有的理論，但其中也許還是有點道理的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: there s something to be said for
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to mean that something has advantages

examples.en: There's a lot to be said for living alone.
examples.trans: 自己住有很多好處。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: there s no two ways about it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say in order to emphasize that something is true

examples.en: Without that drug I'd have died - there's no two ways about it.
examples.trans: 如果沒有那藥我就死了——事實就是這樣。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say to comfort someone, especially a child

examples.en: There, there, don't cry.
examples.trans: 好啦，好啦，不哭。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to someone when what they have asked about involves a long explanation
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 說來話長，其中大有文章

examples.en: "Why are you limping?" "Ah, thereby hangs a tale."
examples.trans: 「你為甚麼一瘸一拐的？」「唉！說來話長。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said about or to someone who clearly has no need to worry
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 沒甚麼好擔心的，沒有必要擔心

examples.en: She should worry! She hasn't a problem in the world.
examples.trans: 她擔心甚麼？她根本就沒有問題。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to mean that you are very much enjoying the situation you are in

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: those whom the gods love die young
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: sometimes said when someone has died young

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: throw sth back in sb s face
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to say unkind things about someone's behaviour in the past during an argument

examples.en: She threw all his failures back in his face.
examples.trans: 她當著他的面把他過去的那些失敗經歷都抖摟出來。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: UK informal to speak severely to and criticize someone who has done something wrong

examples.en: I had to tick him off for being late again.
examples.trans: 他又遲到了，我得說說他。

examples.en: It really ticks me off when she doesn't keep her promises.
examples.trans: 她不守信，令我特別生氣。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: Someone who is tight-lipped is pressing their lips together to avoid showing anger, or is refusing to speak about something.

examples.en: He's been very tight-lipped about what happened at the meeting.
examples.trans: 他對會上發生的事情一直守口如瓶。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when minutes, hours, weeks, etc. seem to go past very slowly

examples.en: Time hangs heavy in prison.
examples.trans: 監獄裡真是度日如年。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to encourage someone to hurry
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （催促某人時用）時間是關鍵，時間很寶貴

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: time is on sb s side
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that time is on your side, or that you have time on your side, you mean that you do not have to do quickly whatever it is that you want or have to do.

examples.en: We don't have to make a final decision till next week, so time is on our side.
examples.trans: 下星期之前我們不必作出最後決定，因此我們有充裕時間。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said, especially by children, to represent the sound of a bell
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 丁零零（擬鈴鐺聲，尤為兒語）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to give someone a piece of secret or private information that might bring an advantage to them
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 向…洩露秘密（或內幕消息）

examples.en: Thanks for tipping me the wink about those cheap tickets, Bill.
examples.trans: 比爾，謝謝你向我透露這些廉價票的消息。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you tip your hand, you say what you are going to do or what you believe when you have been keeping it secret.

examples.en: Despite weeks of media speculation, the president refused to tip his hand about his plans for re-election.
examples.trans: 儘管數週來媒體都在猜測，但總統拒絕透露爭取連任的計劃。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a secret warning or piece of secret information

examples.en: Acting on a tip-off, the police arrested the drug dealers.
examples.trans: 警方根據密報採取行動，逮捕了毒品販子。

examples.en: Following a tip-off from a friend, we sold all our shares in the company.
examples.trans: 根據一位元朋友透露的消息，我們出售了手中該公司的所有股份。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: talk about other people's lives that is usually unkind, disapproving, or not true

examples.en: Synonym
examples.trans: gossip

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say before using an expression that has been very popular or used too much
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 套用一句流行的話；常言道；俗話說

examples.en: I was, to coin a phrase, gobsmacked!
examples.trans: 套用一句老話，我簡直目瞪口呆！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that something is the worst thing to happen in a series of unpleasant events

examples.en: I had lost my ticket, was soaked to the skin, and, to crown it all, discovered that my purse had been stolen.
examples.trans: 我把票弄丟了，又被淋得渾身濕透，最糟糕的是，我發現我的錢包被偷了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: to err is human to forgive divine
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say that means that it is natural for people to make mistakes and it is important to forgive people when they do
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 人皆犯錯（寬恕是德）；凡人多舛誤（唯神能見宥）； 人非聖賢，孰能無過

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: to give credit where credit s due
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: an expression that means that you should praise someone who deserves it, although you might dislike some things about them

examples.en: I don't especially like the woman but, credit where credit's due, she's very efficient.
examples.trans: 我不是特別喜歡那個女人，不過，該說好的就說好，她辦事效率很高。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: mainly US informal also US the hell with sb/sth used to say that you do not care about someone or something
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 讓…見鬼去吧（表示不在意某人或某事）

examples.en: I was ready to say the hell with it and leave.
examples.trans: 我那時候已經想好要走了，讓它見鬼去吧。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to make clearer or more particular something that you have already said

examples.en: She's starting to see the effects of the disease, to wit: her memory is less reliable and she can't always find her way home after going somewhere.
examples.trans: 她開始意識到這種疾病對她的影響，就是她的記憶變得不可靠，而且有時候出門之後找不到回家的路。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: to give the devil his due
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you admit that someone you do not like or admire does have some good qualities

examples.en: I don't like the man but - give the devil his due - he works incredibly hard.
examples.trans: 我不喜歡那個人，可是平心而論，他工作起來真是特別賣力。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say something tongue in cheek, you intend it to be understood as a joke, although you might appear to be serious.

examples.en: He said that he was a huge fan of the president, although I suspect it was tongue in cheek.
examples.trans: 他說自己對總統極為仰慕，而我認為他是在開玩笑。

examples.en: Her latest play is a firmly tongue-in-cheek look at the world of advertising.
examples.trans: 她最新的劇本對廣告界大開玩笑。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: meant to be understood as a joke, although it might appear to be serious

examples.en: He said that he was a huge fan of the president, although I suspect it was tongue in cheek.
examples.trans: 他說自己對總統極為仰慕，而我認為他是在開玩笑。

examples.en: Her latest play is a firmly tongue-in-cheek look at the world of advertising.
examples.trans: 她最新的劇本對廣告界大開玩笑。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you give someone a tongue-lashing, you speak angrily to that person about something that they have done wrong.

examples.en: He got a real tongue lashing after the game.
examples.trans: 賽後他受到了嚴厲的指責。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that something is too good to miss, you mean that it is a very good opportunity and that people should see it, do it, etc.

examples.en: Henri's latest show is too good to miss.
examples.trans: 亨利最近的表演太好了，不容錯過。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: too many cooks spoil the broth
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when there are too many people involved in trying to do the same thing, so that the final result will not be good
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 廚師太多燒壞湯；人多反倒誤事

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used when you want to tell someone that what they have said should be kept private or is embarrassing

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you agree completely
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 一點不錯，太對了；太有道理了

examples.en: "You can't do anything in this town if you don't have any money." "Too right."
examples.trans: 「在這個城市裡你要是沒有錢，甚麼也做不成。」「一點都不錯。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: (of information) extremely secret and not to be told to anyone outside a particular group of people

examples.en: These papers are top secret.
examples.trans: 這些文件是絕密的。

examples.en: [ before noun ] a top-secret military research project
examples.trans: 絕密的軍事研究專案計劃

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you toss ideas, suggestions, or phrases around, you mention them and discuss them with other people.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 拋出，提出（想法、建議或說法）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to talk to someone for a short time to find out how they are or what they think about something
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 與（某人）取得聯繫；聊聊，談談

examples.en: I just wanted to quickly touch base with you: did you get an email from my secretary about the meeting?
examples.trans: 我只想快快地問一下：你收到我的秘書給你的關於這個會議的郵件嗎？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to show that you have no sympathy for someone's problems or difficulties

examples.en: "They lost a lot of money on their investment." "Tough luck - they should have been more careful."
examples.trans: 「他們的投資損失慘重。」「活該——誰叫他們不小心呢。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to speak or behave carefully to avoid upsetting or causing offence to anyone

examples.en: The government knows it has to tread carefully on this issue.
examples.trans: 政府知道這件事必須謹慎處理。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that you tremble to think about a possible future event, you are worried or frightened about it

examples.en: I tremble to think what will happen when he finds out.
examples.trans: 我真擔心他發現後會怎麼樣。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: Something that trips off the tongue is easy to say or pronounce

examples.en: The new company will need to have a name that trips off the tongue and is easy to remember.
examples.trans: 這家新公司需要取一個順口易記的名字。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that it is typical of someone to do something stupid

examples.en: Trust Chris to leave the tickets at home!
examples.trans: 克裡斯肯定會把票忘在家裡！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you want to emphasize that real events or things are sometimes stranger than imaginary ones

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to show that you believe the truth will always be discovered

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to ignore someone when they complain or ask for something
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 不理睬，充耳不聞，置若罔聞

examples.en: In the past they've tended to turn a deaf ear to such requests.
examples.trans: 過去，他們往往對這類要求置若罔聞。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that a dead person would turn in their grave, you mean that they would be very angry or upset about something.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 在九泉之下也不得安寧；氣得（或由於不安）在墳墓中輾轉反側；將死人氣活

examples.en: She'd turn in her grave if she knew what he was spending his inheritance on.
examples.trans: 如果得知他是如何揮霍她留下的遺產的，她在九泉之下也不得安寧。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: the ability to express yourself well

examples.en: "Significant other" meaning "partner" - now that's an interesting turn of phrase.
examples.trans: 「重要的另一半」的意思是「伴侶」——現在成了一個很有意思的說法。

examples.en: She has a nice turn of phrase, which should serve her well in journalism.
examples.trans: 她的口才很好，對她從事新聞業大有裨益。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to attack or criticize someone suddenly and unexpectedly
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 突然襲擊（某人）；突然批評（某人）

examples.en: Suddenly she just turned on me and accused me of undermining her.
examples.trans: 她突然開始攻擊我，指責我背後說她壞話。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that someone could turn their hand to an activity or skill, you mean they could do it well, despite having no experience of it.

examples.en: Stella's very talented - she could turn her hand to anything.
examples.trans: 斯特拉很有才華——她甚麼事都能做好。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: the day on which a person reaches the age of 21 and is traditionally said, in Western societies, to become an adult

examples.en: the twenty-first century
examples.trans: 二十一世紀

examples.en: It's Jamie's twenty-first next Friday.
examples.trans: 下週五是傑米的21歲生日。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: twist sb around your little finger
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to be able to persuade someone to do anything you want, usually because they like you so much
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 任意擺布，任意左右（通常指十分喜歡自己的人）

examples.en: He'd do anything for you. You've got him twisted around your little finger.
examples.trans: 他會為你做一切。你已經完全可以左右他。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to persuade someone to do something they do not want to do
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 強迫（某人），向（某人）施加壓力

examples.en: I didn't want to go but Linda twisted my arm.
examples.trans: 我並不想去，可琳達非要我去不可。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: two can play at that game
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say when you intend to harm someone in the same way as they harmed you
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （表示要進行報復）你這一套我也會

examples.en: When I found out that my husband had been having an affair, I thought "two can play at that game!"
examples.trans: 當我發現丈夫一直在外面有女人時，我就想「你這一套我也會」。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: two wrongs don t make a right
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to emphasize that it is not acceptable to do something bad to someone just because they did something bad to you first

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to deceive someone you are having a relationship with by having a secret sexual relationship with someone else at the same time

examples.en: I ended the relationship when I found out he was two-timing me.
examples.trans: 當我發現他腳踏兩船時，就與分手了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used in writing to represent the sound that people sometimes make in order to agree with or show understanding of something that has just been said
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 呃呵，嗯，喔，哦（表示肯定、贊成或理解的象聲詞）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If a criticism, insult, remark, or action is uncalled-for, it is unfair, rude, or unkind and therefore considered to be unnecessary.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （批評、侮辱、言論或行動）不公允的，不恰當的，不必要的

examples.en: an uncalled-for remark
examples.trans: 一句不必要的話

examples.en: There's no reason to make personal comments - that was completely uncalled-for.
examples.trans: 沒有必要進行人身攻擊——那樣做很不合適。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If something is done under the table, it is a secret, hidden action.

examples.en: They offered him money under the table to change his mind.
examples.trans: 他們私下賄賂他，令他改變主意。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: secret

examples.en: They tried to keep the report under wraps.
examples.trans: 他們試圖將該報告保密。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: until you are blue in the face
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say or shout something until you are blue in the face, you are wasting your efforts because you will get no results.

examples.en: You can tell her to clean her room until you are blue in the face, but she won't do it.
examples.trans: 任憑你磨破嘴皮叫她打掃自己的房間，她也不會去做的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: unto thine own self be true
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you should only do what you think is right.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 只做自己認爲對的事情。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to show that you very much dislike someone or the things that someone has just said or done

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to express surprise
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 喲，嗨，哎呀（表示驚訝或生氣）

examples.en: My word! Is that Jenkins on the roof?
examples.trans: 哎呀！屋頂上不是詹金斯嗎？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone in a slightly angry way to think more carefully about what they are doing
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （略有些生氣地告訴某人）動動腦子

examples.en: Why didn't you use your head and cover the furniture before you started painting?
examples.trans: 你爲甚麽不動腦筋想想，在油漆前把傢俱罩上？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone in a slightly angry way to think more carefully about what they are doing
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於表示對某人思考問題欠認真而稍為惱火時）多動動腦子，好好想想

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: variety is the spice of life
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to emphasize that doing many different things, or often changing what you do, makes life interesting
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 豐富多彩的經歷會令生活充滿樂趣。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to talk continuously or too much

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a system that allows two or more people who are in different parts of the world to talk to each other and see each other on television screens

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a book sometimes found in a hotel or a place of interest, in which people who are visiting are asked to write their name, address, and anything they would like to say about their visit
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 來賓登記簿；來客留言簿

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: Voice-activated machines, systems, etc. work when you speak instructions to them.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （機器或者系統等）聲控的；可以用語音發出指令的

examples.en: The phone has voice-activated dialling.
examples.trans: 這部電話有聲控撥號功能。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to start to do or say something in a forceful way, often without thinking about it carefully

examples.en: Even when she knows nothing about it, she wades in with her opinion.
examples.trans: 即使對事情一無所知，她也要插嘴說說自己的意見。

examples.en: When the crowd started throwing bottles, the police waded in with tear gas.
examples.trans: 當人群開始投擲石塊的時候，警方用催淚彈進行了干預。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: wake up and smell the coffee
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone that they are wrong about a particular situation and must realize what is really happening
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於告訴某人）認清形勢，正視目前的情況

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say to tell someone to listen or to become involved when they have not been listening or paying attention

examples.en: Wake up, Daniel! It's your turn.
examples.trans: 注意點，丹尼爾！輪到你了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to someone in order to wake them up from sleep

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: When people talk about walk(s) of life, they are referring to different types of jobs and different levels of society.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 各行各業；各個社會階層

examples.en: Members of the gym include lawyers, teachers, plumbers, and hairdressers - people from all (different) walks of life.
examples.trans: 我們這個俱樂部裡有律師，有教師，有水管工人，有理髮師——各行各業的人都有。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say to warn someone that it is not safe to speak at that particular time because other people might be listening

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that war clouds are gathering over a particular country, you mean that a war seems increasingly likely there.

examples.en: It was the 1930s and war clouds were gathering on the horizon in Europe.
examples.trans: 時值20世紀30年代，戰爭的陰雲籠罩在歐洲的地平線上。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to use an idea that has been used before or to discuss a subject that has already been discussed before
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 再次使用（已用過的辦法）；對…老調重彈

examples.en: Voters are bored with politicians warming over old policies.
examples.trans: 選民們已經厭倦了政客們對老的政策舊調重彈。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If an excuse or argument won't wash with someone, they are unlikely to believe or accept it.

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: wash your dirty linen in public
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: People who wash their dirty linen in public discuss, or allow to be discussed in public, matters that should be kept private.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 在公開場合談論私密之事；家醜外揚

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to advise someone not to waste anything, because they might need it in the future

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone to be careful

examples.en: Watch it - you nearly knocked my head off with that plank!
examples.trans: 小心點，你差點用那塊厚木板把我的腦袋砸掉了！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that there will very soon be an exciting change in the situation.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 注意看著（精彩的情形即將發生）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to wave to someone as they leave a place in order to say goodbye

examples.en: We went outside to wave her off.
examples.trans: 我們走到外面與她道別。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to refuse to consider what someone says

examples.en: She waved aside all my objections.
examples.trans: 她完全不理會我各種的反對意見。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: informal used to tell someone they have done well, or used humorously when someone has done something stupid
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用以表示贊同、興奮等或揶揄他人時）很好，真棒

examples.en: I heard you girls won the contest. Way to go!
examples.trans: 我聽說你們這些姑娘們贏了比賽。真棒！

examples.en: Way to go, John - you broke the chair!
examples.trans: 好樣的，約翰——你把椅子弄破了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: informal to become involved in an argument or discussion in a forceful way

examples.en: Tyson weighed in at 245 lb for the fight.
examples.trans: 泰森打這場比賽時體重為245磅。

examples.en: Several leading architects weighed in with criticisms regarding the design of the new museum.
examples.trans: 幾位著名的建築師加入討論，對新博物館的設計方案提出了批評意見。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to carefully think about everything you are going to say before you say it

examples.en: He gave evidence to the court, weighing each word as he spoke.
examples.trans: 他字斟句酌地向法庭提供了證詞。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: A well-kept secret has not been told or shown to anyone.

examples.en: [ before noun ] He was astonished to find nice streets and well-kept houses.
examples.trans: 他看到漂亮的街道和整潔的房屋後感到很驚訝。

examples.en: The details of the new car were a well-kept secret.
examples.trans: 新車的詳細情況仍然是嚴守的秘密。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said or done in order to be helpful, but not always achieving this

examples.en: [ before noun ] a well-meant suggestion
examples.trans: 出於好心的建議

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say when you are surprised by a piece of information. This phrase is often used humorously to mean the opposite
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （表驚訝時用，常借此幽默地表達相反的意義）真想不到！你說怪不怪！

examples.en: So they're getting married, are they? Well, what do you know!
examples.trans: 這麼說他們要結婚了，是嗎？真想不到！

examples.en: Well, what do you know! The Raiders lost again!
examples.trans: 唉，你說怪不怪！突襲者隊又輸了！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you are very surprised at something

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something you say to show that you think a suggestion is stupid

examples.en: I can't turn up at a funeral in a pink jacket. What an idea!
examples.trans: 我不能穿粉紅色的夾克去參加葬禮。多可笑的建議！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to a friend who has thanked you for doing something special for them

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: what are you going to do
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that there is nothing you can do to make a situation better
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於無計可施時）你又能有甚麼辦法？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used when someone has said or done something silly
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於表示某人的言行很愚蠢）…怎麽這個樣子？

examples.en: "Of course Emma's only worry was whether her lipstick had smudged." "Emma! What is she like?"
examples.trans: 「當然了，愛瑪關心的只是她的口紅是否弄花了。」「愛瑪，她怎麽這個樣子？」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that it is very likely that something is true or will happen

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: what i wouldn t give for sth
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you want something very much

examples.en: What I wouldn't give for a cold drink!
examples.trans: 我多想來杯冷飲啊！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: what is he are they etc like
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to ask someone to describe someone or something to you
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 他／她／它／他們（等等）是甚麼樣的?

examples.en: What was her boyfriend like?
examples.trans: 她男朋友長甚麼樣？

examples.en: "What was the weather like?" "It rained all week."
examples.trans: 「天氣怎麼樣？」「整整一週都在下雨。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: what more do you want jam on it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that someone should be grateful for what they have or have been offered, and not demand something better
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 知足常樂（用來表示某人應對其所擁有的或別人所提供的表示感激，而不應當得寸進尺）

examples.en: They've given him a holiday in Italy. What more does he want - jam on it?
examples.trans: 他們已經讓他到義大利度假。他還想要甚麼呢？不要得寸進尺！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to rudely say that you do not think something is important
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 那又怎麼樣呢？那又有甚麼關係？

examples.en: "That's the third time you've done that!" "Yeah, what of it?"
examples.trans: 「你那樣做已經是第三次了！」「是啊，那又怎麼樣呢？」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to mean that you must do whatever a particular person says
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （某人）怎麽說就得怎麽做；服從（某人的）命令

examples.en: Around here, kid, what I say, goes!
examples.trans: 老兄，在這裡，我怎麽說就怎麽做！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you will do something although you know you should not do it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 管它的（表示要做明知不應該做的事）

examples.en: The doctor said I shouldn't drink, but what the heck.
examples.trans: 醫生說我不能喝酒，管他的。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you suddenly realize that your plan is not important to you and that you will do something else

examples.en: I was supposed to be working this evening but what the hell - I'll see you at the bar in half an hour.
examples.trans: 今晚我本來應該工作的，但這也沒關係——我們半小時後酒吧見。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: what with one thing and another
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: You say what with one thing and another when you want to explain that the reason you have failed to do something is because you have been very busy.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 因為事情一件接著一件，因為忙得不可開交

examples.en: What with one thing and another, I forgot to call you yesterday.
examples.trans: 由於昨天事情一件接著一件，我忘了給你打電話。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: what you lose on the swings you gain on the roundabouts
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to mean that the positive and negative results of a situation or action balance each other
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 有得也有失；有利也有弊；失之東隅，收之桑榆

examples.en: "The route through town would be shorter, but there'll be more traffic." "Well, it's just swings and roundabouts."
examples.trans: 「穿過市鎮的這條路更近一些，但是車也更多。」「哦！就是有利也有弊。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: what you see is what you get
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to show that there is nothing hidden

examples.en: See also
examples.trans: WYSIWYG

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you cannot change something that has already happened

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: what s it worth to you
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you want to know what someone will give you if you give them the piece of information they have asked for

examples.en: "Do you know where Dave's living now?" "What's it worth?"
examples.trans: 「你知不知道戴夫現在住在哪裡？」「告訴你對我有甚麼好處？」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you think something is very good, and that nobody could disagree with your opinion
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （表示認為非常好）有什麼不好的呢？

examples.en: It's a big house with a swimming pool. What's not to like?
examples.trans: 一座帶著游泳池的大屋，還能有什麼不好的呢？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: what s sauce for the goose is sauce for the gander
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to emphasize that if one person is allowed to do something or to behave in a particular way, then another person must be allowed to do that thing or behave in that way, too
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 適用於此者也應適用於彼；應該一視同仁

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: what s sth in aid of
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you want to know the reason for something

examples.en: What's all this shouting in aid of?
examples.trans: 這大喊大叫的到底怎麼回事？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that it is very likely that something is true or will happen
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 很可能（是真的或會發生）

examples.en: What's the betting Dan forgets to bring the tickets?
examples.trans: 丹十之八九會忘了帶票，你敢打賭嗎？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to a child who has not said "please" when asking for something
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 該怎麼說呢？（讓孩子要東西時說「請」字的用語）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone to stop worrying because worrying will not help
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於勸告某人不要爲某事擔心）…有甚麽用?

examples.en: Try not to get depressed - after all, what's the use of worrying?
examples.trans: 不要沮喪——話說回來，擔心又有甚麽用呢？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: when all is said and done
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you are about to tell someone the most important fact they should remember in a situation

examples.en: When all is said and done, you can only do your best.
examples.trans: 終究你只能盡力而爲。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that something will happen when hell freezes over, you mean that it will never happen.

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a lie that is told in order to be polite or to stop someone from being upset by the truth
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 善意的謊話；無傷大雅的謊言

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you do not think what someone has said or done is important or special
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 哈哈（對某人說的話或做的事表示輕蔑）

examples.en: Well, whoop-de-doo, they're offering us a 0.5 percent pay raise!
examples.trans: 噢，哈哈，他們給我們漲了0.5%的工資！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: why keep a dog and bark yourself
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you want to know why someone would do something himself or herself when that person already pays someone else to do it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 既然花錢找人代勞了，為何還親自動手？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: wild horses wouldn t drag me
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say wild horses would not drag you somewhere, you mean that nothing could persuade you to go there.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 任何事情也不能勸說我做…；八匹馬也拉不了我回頭

examples.en: Wild horses wouldn't drag me to a party tonight.
examples.trans: 今晚我堅決不去參加派對。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: will never hear the end of it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say you will never hear the end of it, you mean that someone is repeatedly going to speak proudly, disapprovingly, etc. about something.

examples.en: If Linda gets that promotion, we'll never hear the end of it.
examples.trans: 如果琳達獲得擢升，她會說個沒完沒了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: will not take no for an answer
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to not allow someone to refuse what you have offered
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 不容拒絕，不接受別人說「不」

examples.en: I told Steve I'm not interested, but he keeps asking me out - he won't take no for an answer.
examples.trans: 我已經告訴史蒂夫我沒興趣，可他還是不斷請我出去——他就是不接受別人說「不」。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to persuade people to support your ideas or opinions

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to tell someone something that is not true in order to make a joke

examples.en: It really winds me up when he goes on about teachers having an easy life.
examples.trans: 他不停地說教師的日子過得很輕鬆，真是把我氣壞了。

examples.en: She just knows how to wind me up.
examples.trans: 她就知道如何惹惱我。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that is not true that you tell someone in order to make a joke

examples.en: If he keeps doing stuff like that he's going to wind up in prison!
examples.trans: 如果他這麼做下去，最終會進監獄的！

examples.en: You don't want to wind up homeless, do you?
examples.trans: 你不想最後落得無家可歸，對不對？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: disapproving things that are of no real importance and are said or done in order to make an attractive effect

examples.en: How many of the candidate's policies are real intentions, and how many are just window dressing?
examples.trans: 這些候選人的政策中，有多少是真實的意圖，有多少不過是裝點門面的東西？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to express polite disagreement in a formal situation
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於正式場合禮貌地表示異議）恕我直言

examples.en: With all due respect, Sir, I cannot agree with your last statement.
examples.trans: 恕我直言，先生，我不能同意您最後的那部分闡述。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: with a capital a b etc
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said after the name of a particular quality to say that it is very strong, using its first letter
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於表示性質的詞後，表示強調）非常，特別

examples.en: He's trouble with a capital T!
examples.trans: 他這個人特別煩人！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: with a small c d etc
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say something is more general or less extreme than the usual meaning
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用來形容更普遍的或不那麼極端的情況）

examples.en: She is deeply conservative with a small "c" (= has traditional values, rather than being a member or supporter of the Conservative Party).
examples.trans: 儘管不是保守黨的成員，她卻是一個非常保守的人。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: with friends like you who needs enemies
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to or about someone who says he or she is your friend but who is treating you very badly
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 像你這樣的朋友和敵人有甚麽區別？

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If a group of people express an opinion or decide something with one voice, they all agree.

examples.en: The committee decided with one voice to accept the proposal.
examples.trans: 委員會一致同意接受該提議。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: with your own fair hand s
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you have made something yourself

examples.en: "Where did you get this cake?" "I made it with my own fair hands."
examples.trans: 「你從哪裡弄的蛋糕？」「我一雙巧手做出來的。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: without even a small complaint
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 一聲不吭地，毫無抱怨地

examples.en: For once the children went to bed without a murmur.
examples.trans: 孩子頭一次一聲不吭就上床睡覺了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to express how unhappy you are

examples.en: I'm cold and wet and I don't have enough money for the bus home. Oh woe is me!
examples.trans: 我又冷又濕，連買張回家的公車票的錢也不夠。真是慘啊！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to describe an honest and direct conversation between two women
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 女性間坦率的（地），女性間開誠布公的（地）

examples.en: a woman-to-woman discussion
examples.trans: 女性間開誠布公的討論

examples.en: We talked woman-to-woman.
examples.trans: 作為兩名女性，我們坦率地進行了交談。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: won t hear a word said against sb sth
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you won't hear a word said against someone or something, you refuse to believe anything bad about him, her, or it.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 聽不進一句（針對…的）壞話

examples.en: He's completely infatuated with the woman and won't hear a word said against her.
examples.trans: 他被這個女人迷得神魂顛倒，聽不進一句她的壞話。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a method sometimes used in psychoanalysis in which the person being treated says the first word they think of when a particular word is said, which may help to discover how parts of the mind work

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to emphasize your surprise or shock, especially at something you have just seen or been told
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （尤指因剛見到或剛被告知的事）驚得說不出話來，不知說甚麼好

examples.en: "So what did you think of Olive's pink outfit?" "Words fail me. I've never seen anything quite like it!"
examples.trans: 「那麼你覺得奧利芙的那套粉色衣服怎麼樣？」「我都不知道說甚麼好，我從沒見過那樣的東西！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said at the end of a statement to show unhappiness or anger about what has been stated
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用在陳述的末尾）真倒楣，真不幸

examples.en: I have to work on Saturday, worse luck.
examples.trans: 我星期六還要上班，真倒楣。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: would not do sth for all the tea in china
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that nothing could persuade you to do something
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 絕對不做，無論如何都不做

examples.en: I wouldn't take that job for all the tea in China.
examples.trans: 我決不會去做那個工作。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: wouldn t have it any other way
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you would not want a situation to be different, even though it has problems connected with it

examples.en: It's never going to be easy having kids but I wouldn't have it any other way.
examples.trans: 養孩子不容易，但我毫無怨言。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If you say that someone wouldn't hurt a fly, you mean they are gentle and would not do anything to injure or offend anyone.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 連一隻蒼蠅都不肯傷害，心地善良

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: wouldn t know sth if you fell over one it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that someone would not recognize something even if it was obvious
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 即使很明顯也識別不出

examples.en: She wouldn't know a bargain if she fell over one!
examples.trans: 眼前擺著好交易，她也看不出來！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: wrap sb around your little finger
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: UK also wrap sb round your little finger to persuade someone easily to do what you want them to do

examples.en: She could wrap her father around her little finger.
examples.trans: 她能輕鬆說服她父親。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: If something such as plan is wrapped (up) in secrecy, the details about it are kept secret.

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: wring sth from out of sb
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: to force or persuade someone to give you something
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 強迫（某人）交出；說服（某人）給予

examples.en: They managed to wring a few concessions from the bosses.
examples.trans: 他們設法迫使這些大老闆作出了一些讓步。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used when you do not believe what someone has said

examples.en: "I always miss you when I go away ." "Yeah, right!"
examples.trans: 「我旅行時一直很想念你。」「哦，當真？」

examples.en: "Anyway, we're just good friends." "Yeah, yeah!"
examples.trans: 「無論如何，我們只是好朋友。」「哦，真的？」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: a Jewish holy day in September or October when nothing is eaten all day and people say prayers in the synagogue asking God to forgive them for things they have done wrong
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 贖罪日（猶太教節日，在每年的九月或十月，人們於此日禁食並懺悔祈禱）

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you are completely certain that something is true or will happen

examples.en: You can bet your bottom dollar that she'll be the next president.
examples.trans: 她肯定會當選下一任總統。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to show that you completely agree with what someone has said
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 你說得很對！一點也沒錯！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: you can t judge a book by its cover
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to show that you cannot know what something or someone is like by looking only at that person or thing's appearance
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 勿只憑外表判斷；不能以貌取人

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: you can t make bricks without straw
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you cannot make something without the necessary materials

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: you can t say fairer than that
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you think an offer or arrangement is good
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 價格再公道不過了；協定的條件已很優厚了

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: you could have heard a pin drop
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: something that you say in order to describe a situation where there was complete silence, especially because people were very interested or very surprised by what was happening

examples.en: Margaret's ex-husband turned up at the wedding. Honestly, you could have heard a pin drop.
examples.trans: 瑪格麗特的前夫出現在婚禮現場。老實說，當時全場真是鴉雀無聲。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: you could have knocked me down over with a feather
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you are extremely surprised
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用來表示自己極度吃驚）你嚇死我了！

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used either to express surprise or lack of surprise in a humorous and slightly unkind way
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （表示驚訝）不會這樣吧！不至於吧！（幽默且不太客氣地表示並不驚訝）我就知道！

examples.en: "He's lost his job." "You don't say!"
examples.trans: 「他丟掉了工作。」「不會吧！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you will quickly do what someone has asked you to do
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於表示很快就完成對方要求你做的事情）

examples.en: "Would you get me a coffee?" "Sure, you got it!"
examples.trans: 「你能幫我拿杯咖啡麼？」「沒問題，馬上就來。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: you have got to be kidding
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: informal also you must be kidding used to show that you are very surprised by what someone has said and do not accept it
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （表示對某人的話非常驚訝而且不相信是真的）別開玩笑了

examples.en: You want me to drive into the city? You’ve got to be kidding.
examples.trans: 你想讓我開車去城裡？別開玩笑了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said for emphasis when you are describing how good or bad an experience is
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （表示強調）你不知道，你難以想像

examples.en: Flying a plane is wonderful, you have no idea.
examples.trans: 你不知道駕駛飛機有多棒。

examples.en: You have no idea how embarrassed I was.
examples.trans: 你不知道我當時有多尷尬。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said before giving an opinion or a piece of information
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於告知意見或資訊之前）要我告訴你嗎？你聽說了嗎？

examples.en: You know something? I don't think I like that man.
examples.trans: 聽我說，我想我不喜歡那個人。

examples.en: You know what? I think it's time to go home.
examples.trans: 要我告訴你嗎？我想該回家了。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when you hear or discover something that is surprising
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （表示對得知的東西感到驚訝）真想不到

examples.en: I had no idea they were related. Oh well, you live and learn.
examples.trans: 我一點都沒想到他們之間還有聯繫。唉，真是想不到啊。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: you might as well be hung for a sheep as for a lamb
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to mean that because the punishment for a bad action and an even worse one will be the same, you have no reason not to do the worse one
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 既然懲罰都一樣，我還不如索性做得更差些。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: you pays your money and you takes your choice chance
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said to someone who must decide between different things and accept the results of their decision

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: you pays your money and you takes your choice chance
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: You are responsible for your decisions and cannot blame anyone else when what you have chosen is not successful.
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 自己選擇自己承擔後果。

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that you agree with what has just been said
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 你說對了！正是如此！沒錯！

examples.en: "How stupid of me to lend him that money!" "You said it!"
examples.trans: 「我借錢給他，真傻。」「沒錯！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.word: you scratch my back and i ll scratch yours
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone that if they help you, you will help them
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 你幫我，我也幫你；我們互謀其利

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to say that someone is very unlikely to get what they want
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: （用於告訴某人其幾乎不可能如願）但願你走運！

examples.en: "She's going to ask for a salary increase." "She should be so lucky!"
examples.trans: 「她打算要求加薪。」「但願她走運吧！」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: used to tell someone that they are spending too much time doing things that are boring or not important
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.translation: 你應該做點更有意義的事；別老憋在家裡做些雞毛蒜皮的事

examples.en: "I arranged all my CDs in alphabetical order." "Mmm, I think you should get out more, Mike."
examples.trans: 「我把所有的光碟都按字母順序排好了。」「哦，我覺得你倒不如出去做些更有意思的事，麥克。」

Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communicati.definition_en: said when thanking someone who has given you a present, to mean that you did not expect it
