examples.trans: 別等我吃飯了——我會很晚才回家。

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: to wait until something unpleasant has ended
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.translation: 等到（令人不快之事）結束

examples.en: I'd rather wait out the storm than drive home immediately.
examples.trans: 我想等到風暴過去，而不是馬上開車回家。

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: to not go to bed at night because you are expecting someone to arrive

examples.en: I'll be home after midnight, so don't wait up for me.
examples.trans: 我會在半夜以後才回家，所以你先睡吧，不用等我。

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: to wait until it is really your turn to do or get something

examples.en: If people were more polite, they would wait their turn.
examples.trans: 假如人們是更講禮貌的話，他們就會按順序等候。

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: a situation in which you delay taking any action, so that you can watch how a situation develops and see what it is best for you to do

examples.en: In a contest like this, the stronger team can afford to play a waiting game.
examples.trans: 在這種比賽中，實力較強的一方才可以採取伺機而動的策略。

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: If something that happens is a wake-up call, it should make you realize that you need to take action to change a situation.

examples.en: For the insurance industry, these floods were a wake-up call.
examples.trans: 對保險業來說，這些洪水敲響了警鐘。

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: a phone call that you arrange to be made, for example in a hotel, to wake you up at a certain time

examples.en: For the insurance industry, these floods were a wake-up call.
examples.trans: 對保險業來說，這些洪水敲響了警鐘。

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: to stop working or leave your job because of a disagreement with your employer

examples.en: All the parents walked out (of the meeting) in protest.
examples.trans: 所有的父母都退（出會）場以示抗議。

examples.en: He walked out on his wife and two kids.
examples.trans: 他突然拋下他的妻子和兩個孩子出走了。

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: A walk-on part in a play is a very small part in which the actor is on the stage for a short time and speaks very few or no words.
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.translation: （戲劇裡的）跑龍套角色，小角色

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: US also warm up to sb to start to like someone

examples.en: I wasn't sure about Sarah at first, but I warmed to her after we'd been out together a few times.
examples.trans: 一開始我不太確定是不是喜歡莎拉，可後來我跟她一起外出約會了幾次後就對她有了好感。

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: US also warm up to sth If you warm to an idea, you start to become interested in or enthusiastic about it.
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.translation: 對…變得感興趣；對…變得熱衷

examples.en: Unfortunately, I had to leave just as the speaker was warming to his theme.
examples.trans: 不巧的是，正當發言者就他的主題越講越起勁時，我不得不離開了。

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: If an event or sports competition is washed out, it is prevented from happening or stopped early because of heavy rain.

examples.en: Do you think these stains will wash out?
examples.trans: 你說這些汙跡洗得掉嗎？

examples.en: The men's tennis semifinals were washed out this morning.
examples.trans: 今天上午的男子網球準決賽因雨被迫取消。

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: If you wash your hands of something that you were previously responsible for, you intentionally stop being involved in it or connected with it in any way.

examples.en: She couldn't wait to wash her hands of the whole project.
examples.trans: 她迫不及待地想與整個專案計劃脫離關係。

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: If you are washed up, you are no longer successful and you have no chance of success in the future.
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.translation: （工作）不會再有成功的希望的，沒有前途的

examples.en: [ before noun ] a bunch of washed-up celebrities
examples.trans: 一群光環不再的明星

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: to start doing something immediately

examples.en: Caroline wasted no time in tackling her new responsibilities.
examples.trans: 卡洛琳立刻開始承擔起新的職責。

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: to often notice the time and wish that it was later, especially when you are doing work that you do not like
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.translation: （尤指在做自己不喜歡的工作時）不停地看表（希望時間過得快一點）

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: the level below the surface of the ground at which you start to find water

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: problems that someone has had in the past that they do not worry about because they happened a long time ago and cannot now be changed
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.translation: 已成往事，不可改變的既成事實

examples.en: Yes, we did have our disagreements but that's water under the bridge now.
examples.trans: 是的，我們確實曾經不和，但那已是陳年往事了。

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: to make a driver stop their vehicle by waving your arms up and down

examples.en: If a car comes along, wave it down.
examples.trans: 如果有汽車來，就攔住它。

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: to make someone gradually stop using something that is bad for them
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.translation: 使（某人）逐漸戒掉；使（某人）脫離

examples.en: It's difficult to wean addicts off cocaine once they're hooked.
examples.trans: 一旦對古柯鹼上了癮，就很難戒掉。

examples.en: The whole scheme is intended to wean people off welfare dependency.
examples.trans: 整個計劃旨在使人們擺脫對福利的依賴。

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: the damage that happens to an object in ordinary use during a period

examples.en: Seat covers on buses take a lot of wear and tear.
examples.trans: 火車上的座套磨損比較嚴重。

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: If a period of time wears on, it seems to pass very slowly.

examples.en: She felt less confident about finishing the work as the week wore on.
examples.trans: 隨著這一週的時間慢慢過去，她更加覺得沒有信心完成這項工作。

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: someone who scientifically studies weather conditions and says what the weather is likely to be in the future
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.translation: 天氣預報員；氣象研究員

examples.en: weathergirl
examples.trans: 天氣預報播音員（或主持人）

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: the early hours of the morning, between twelve o'clock at night and the time when the sun rises

examples.en: He was up until the wee hours trying to finish his work.
examples.trans: 為了完成工作，他一直熬夜到淩晨。

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: the early hours of the morning, between twelve o'clock at night and the time when the sun rises

examples.en: There's nothing worse than being wide awake in the wee small hours.
examples.trans: 淩晨了還醒著睡不著，沒有什麼比這更糟糕。

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: happening or caused to happen at a suitable or effective time
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.translation: 及時的；適時的；不早不晚的

examples.en: [ before noun ] A well-timed joke stopped the disagreement developing into something more serious.
examples.trans: 一個及時的笑話使這場爭論沒有變得更加劍拔弩張。

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: If an object or method went out with the ark, it has not been used for a long time.

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: a question in English that is a request for information. Wh- questions usually start with a word beginning with wh-, but "how" is also included. The wh- words are: what, when, where, who, whom, which, whose, why, and how.

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: to turn round quickly

examples.en: She wheeled round to face him and saw him take out a gun.
examples.trans: 她快速轉身面對他，看到他掏出了手槍。

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.word: when sb was a mere twinkle in their father s eye
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: at a time before someone was born
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.translation: 在（某人）還未出世的時候

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: to spend time in a relaxed way because you have nothing to do or you are waiting for something else to happen

examples.en: We whiled away the afternoon playing cards in front of the fire.
examples.trans: 我們下午坐在爐火邊打牌來消磨時間。

examples.en: That's the spot where Sara and I used to while away the hours between lectures.
examples.trans: 我和莎拉課間就在那個地方消磨時間。

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: while an opportunity lasts
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.translation: 趁還有機會時；趁情況還有利時；趁形勢還未發生變化時

examples.en: Many people fear that the newly elected government will be ousted in a military coup and are leaving their country while the going is good.
examples.trans: 很多人擔心新當選的政府會被軍事政變推翻，所以趁形勢尚穩定紛紛離開自己的國家。

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: in various countries, a government report on a particular subject giving information and details of future planned laws
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.translation: 白皮書（某些國家的政府說明某方面未來立法的資訊和細節的正式報告）

examples.en: a White Paper on employment
examples.trans: 就業白皮書

examples.en: Compare
examples.trans: Green Paper

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: a musical note with a time value equal to two minims or four crotchets

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: informal the freedom or opportunity to do something, or to change your mind and do something differently if that is what is needed

examples.en: We need to leave ourselves some wiggle room when we're negotiating the deal.
examples.trans: 我們談判業務的時候需要給自己留一些迴旋餘地。

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: a sudden strike (= act of refusing to work as a protest) without any warning by the workers and often without the official support of the unions
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.translation: （事先沒有警告的且沒有工會支持的）「野貓」式罷工，閃電式罷工

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: A wind-up toy, watch, etc. has a key or part that you turn in order to make it operate.

examples.en: If he keeps doing stuff like that he's going to wind up in prison!
examples.trans: 如果他這麼做下去，最終會進監獄的！

examples.en: You don't want to wind up homeless, do you?
examples.trans: 你不想最後落得無家可歸，對不對？

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: the activity of spending time looking at the goods on sale in shop windows without intending to buy any of them
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.translation: 瀏覽商店櫥窗（無意購買）

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: to start a new and better way of behaving, forgetting about any bad experiences in the past
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.translation: 重新開始，將以前的糟糕經歷一筆勾銷

examples.en: A new relationship presents you with the opportunity to wipe the slate clean.
examples.trans: 一段新的感情使你有機會忘掉以前的不愉快，開始新生活。

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: the imagining or discussion of a very unlikely future event or situation as if it were possible and might one day happen

examples.en: "Do you think you might be in line for promotion?" "No, it's just wishful thinking."
examples.trans: 「你是否認為自己會獲得晉升？」「不，那只不過是想入非非而已。」

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: with your past mistakes or crimes forgotten
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.translation: （過去的錯誤或罪行）一筆勾銷

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: at a time that you are able to remember

examples.en: Women gained the vote within my grandmother's memory.
examples.trans: 從我祖母記事時起，女性就已獲得了投票權。

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: a period of time in which a student temporarily works for an employer to get experience

examples.en: Please list your educational qualifications and work experience.
examples.trans: 請列出你接受教育的情況及工作經驗。

examples.en: Many firms understand that giving work experience to students from colleges and schools will benefit everyone in the long term.
examples.trans: 很多公司都明白，為大學生和中學生提供實習機會從長遠來看會使大家都受益。

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: to develop an emotional or physical state that you feel strongly, after a period of effort or time

examples.en: We worked up a real appetite climbing in the mountains.
examples.trans: 我們突然很想爬山。

examples.en: It's strange, but I can't work up any enthusiasm for going on this trip.
examples.trans: 很奇怪，這次旅行激不起我任何熱情。

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: the amount of time a person spends doing their job on a day when they work

examples.en: An eight-hour working day is still typical for many people.
examples.trans: 很多人依然通常每天工作八小時。

examples.en: On a working day I tend to get up around seven o'clock.
examples.trans: 在工作日，我通常七時左右起床。

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: a meal in the middle of the day, or at the beginning of the day, during which work is discussed

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: If you believe that something is written in the stars, you believe that it will be made to happen by a force that controls the future.

examples.en: It was written in the stars that they would meet and fall in love.
examples.trans: 上蒼註定讓他們相遇、相愛。

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: If you think your hour has come, you think you are going to die.

examples.en: I thought my hour had come when he pointed his gun at me.
examples.trans: 當他用槍指著我時，我想我的死期到了。

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: an agreement under which an employer can change the number of hours worked by an employee, and does not have to offer any hours
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.translation: 零工時合同（雇主可自由改變雇員工作時間甚至無須保證有任何工作時間的合同）

examples.en: Thousands of workers in the UK are on zero-hours contracts.
examples.trans: 在英國，成千上萬的工人簽的是零工時合同。

Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Oppo.definition_en: to stop paying attention and not hear or see what is around you for a short period of time

examples.en: When the men start talking about football, I just zone out.
examples.trans: 男人們一開始談論足球，我就走神了。

Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success,.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success,.definition_en: an unpleasant or painful situation or person that you have to accept and deal with, although you find it very difficult
Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success,.translation: 沉重的十字架；煩惱；心理負擔

Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success,.word: a bad workman blames his tools
Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success,.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success,.definition_en: said when someone has blamed a mistake or failure on the things that they use to work

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （離婚後付給前配偶的）子女撫育費

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: a small present, especially of money, given at Christmas
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （給郵差、送奶人等的）聖誕小禮物（尤指金錢）

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: a school in the UK that is not controlled by the local authority and receives its money directly from the central government
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （英國不受當地政府管理，直接從中央政府獲得資金的）城市學校

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: an official document that you use to request an amount of money from an organization, when you think you are owed it

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: a small advertisement that you put in a newspaper or a magazine, usually because you want to sell or buy something or to find or offer a job

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: If the government, for example, claws back money, it takes money back in one way that it has already given in another way.

examples.en: The airline is beginning to claw back some of the business it lost after the bomb explosion.
examples.trans: 航空公司開始著手奪回在炸彈爆炸事件後損失的一些業務。

examples.en: We got a government grant for setting up our business, but they clawed it all back again in taxes.
examples.trans: 我們得到了一項政府撥款開辦了公司，可是他們以稅收的形式把錢全收回去了。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to use or steal all of someone's money or goods

examples.en: Buying our new house has completely cleaned us out.
examples.trans: 買新房子把我們完全掏空了。

examples.en: Richard came home for the weekend and completely cleaned us out of food.
examples.trans: 理查回家過週末，把我們的食物一掃而光。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: a central office used by banks to collect and send out money and cheques
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （銀行）票據交換所，結算所，清算中心

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: a large, expensive book with a lot of pictures, intended to be looked at rather than read

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to be sold at an auction (= public sale where objects are bought by the people who offer the most money)

examples.en: A private collection of her early paintings is expected to go under the hammer next year.
examples.trans: 一批由私人收藏的她的早期畫作預計將於明年拍賣。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: a value that contains both a real number and an imaginary number

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: a demand made by a public authority to buy land or property from a private owner in order to use the land for public purposes
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 強制徵收，強制性購買令（政府當局以公共用途為名從私人業主手中收購土地或財產的命令）

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: an amount of money that you have to pay each day to drive into a city centre, charged in order to reduce traffic
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 擁堵費（開車進入市中心需要支付的費用，徵收該項費用的目的是減少車流量。）

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: the situation in which people spend a lot of money intentionally so that other people notice and admire them for their wealth

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: a measurement of the changes in the cost of basic goods and services

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: a society in which people often buy new goods, especially goods that they do not need, and in which a high value is placed on owning many things

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: food that is almost ready to eat when it is bought and can be prepared quickly and easily

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: cooked beef that has been preserved in salty water and spices, often sold in tins (= metal containers)

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.word: cost an arm and a leg a small fortune
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to be extremely expensive

examples.en: I'd love to buy a Porsche, but they cost an arm and a leg.
examples.trans: 我倒是想買輛保時捷，可實在太貴了。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to be very expensive

examples.en: That coat must have cost you a pretty penny!
examples.trans: 那件外套一定花了你很多錢！

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: UK to cause someone to spend a lot of money or lose money
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 讓…花很多錢；使…損失一大筆錢

examples.en: Buying that second-hand car without having it checked by a mechanic first cost us dear.
examples.trans: 沒先請機修工檢查就買了那輛二手汽車，這讓我們虧了許多錢。

examples.en: Later that year he attacked a photographer, an incident that cost him dear.
examples.trans: 那年底他攻擊了一位攝影師，這件事讓他付出了巨大代價。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to cost, charge, etc. a lot of money
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 花費/收取（等等）一大筆錢

examples.en: They charge the earth just for a cup of coffee.
examples.trans: 一杯咖啡他們就能要個天價。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: If an activity is cost-effective, it is good value for the amount of money paid.
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 有成本效益的；物有所值的；合算的，划算的

examples.en: It wouldn't be cost-effective to buy an expensive new computer when all you want to do is store your photos.
examples.trans: 只為保存照片而買一台昂貴的新電腦並不划算。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: an amount of money that an employee gets in addition to his or her normal pay, because the cost of living in a particular area is high

examples.en: Nurses working in the capital receive an additional 7.5 percent cost-of-living allowance.
examples.trans: 在首都工作的護士額外獲得7.5%的生活費用津貼。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: cheap jewellery made to look as if it is expensive

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: a large soft ball of white or pink sugar in the form of thin threads, usually sold on a stick and eaten at fairs and amusement parks

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to produce money or information unwillingly

examples.en: Doctors were worried when she started to cough up blood.
examples.trans: 她開始咳血，醫生擔心了。

examples.en: I've just had to cough up £40 for a parking fine.
examples.trans: 我只得掏出40英鎊交停車罰款。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: a charge that is sometimes added to the amount that a customer pays for food, drinks, and service in a restaurant, or that is added in a nightclub to pay for entertainment

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: ways of explaining how money has been spent, that hide what has really happened to it

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: a piece of paper given by a shop when you return something you do not want, that allows you to buy other goods of the same value
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 換貨憑單，信用票據（退貨時商店給的票據，可用於換取等值的其他商品）

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: a calculation of someone's ability to pay back money that they have borrowed

examples.en: See also
examples.trans: rating agency

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: an organization that lends money to its members at low rates of interest
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 信用合作社，儲蓄互助社

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: If the value or amount of something creeps up, it slowly increases.
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （價值或數量）慢慢增加，逐漸上升

examples.en: Over the last year, the rate of inflation has crept up to almost seven percent.
examples.trans: 過去一年裡，通貨膨脹率逐漸上升，幾乎達到了7%。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to avoid losing any more money than you have already lost
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 及時放棄無利可圖之事；知難而退，及早撒手

examples.en: Let's cut our losses and sell the business before prices drop even further.
examples.trans: 我們趁早收手，在價格繼續下跌之前把店賣掉吧。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: Cut-price products cost less than the usual price.

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: A cut-price shop sells things at lower prices than other shops.

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: the money you need to pay for necessary things, such as food

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: extra money that is paid to someone because their job is dangerous
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （從事危險工作的）安全津貼，高危工作津貼

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: a job that you do to earn money so that you can do something else that you prefer but that does not pay you much money
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 正職（收入的主要來源，以便維持個人的其他愛好）

examples.en: Many actors have day jobs too.
examples.trans: 許多演員都有演藝工作之外的日常工作。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: a situation in which you have to pay far too much money for something
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 漫天要價，光天化日之下搶錢

examples.en: £6 for an orange juice? That's just daylight robbery!
examples.trans: 柳橙汁六英鎊一杯？簡直就是搶錢！

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: an amount of money that is added to a person's basic pay or pension because of rising prices and other costs

examples.en: Giving relief to its employees and pensioners from inflation, the central government announced a seven percentage point increase in dearness allowance.
examples.trans: 為了減輕通貨膨脹對僱員和退休人員的影響，中央政府宣佈把物價津貼提高7個百分點。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: a money system in which a smaller unit can be multiplied by ten or a 100 to make up a bigger unit

examples.en: The UK and the US both have decimal currencies.
examples.trans: 英國和美國都採用十進幣制。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: a container for drinks for which a small amount of money is given back to you if you return the container to a store when it is empty
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 帶押金的瓶子（若將此等空飲料瓶退還商店，即可返還少量現金）

examples.en: If you bring the deposit bottles back, you'll have enough money for gum.
examples.trans: 只要你把帶押金的瓶子還回來，你便有足夠的錢買口香糖了。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.word: dig deep into your pocket s resources savings
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to give away money

examples.en: Richer countries must dig deeper into their pockets if global problems, such as pollution, are to be solved.
examples.trans: 在應對諸如污染這樣的全球問題時，富國必須掏更多的錢。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: the activity in which companies or organizations write to people to try to persuade them to buy their product or give money, etc.

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: very cheap

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: very poor

examples.en: In the tiny town where I grew up, my family and most of our neighbors were dirt poor.
examples.trans: 在我長大的小鎮上，我家和大多數鄰居當時都處於赤貧狀態。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to leave secretly, especially to avoid paying money that you owe
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （尤指為躲債而）潛逃，偷偷逃掉

examples.en: When he discovered the police were after him, he did a moonlight flit.
examples.trans: 當他發現警方在追蹤他時，就偷偷逃掉了。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to sell a lot of goods very quickly

examples.en: It was a hot sunny day and the ice cream sellers were doing a roaring trade.
examples.trans: 天又熱，日頭又毒，那些賣霜淇淋的生意好極了。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.word: dot the i s and cross the t s
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to pay a great deal of attention to the details of something, especially when you are trying to complete a task
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （尤指在完成某項工作時）一絲不苟，注重細節

examples.en: The negotiations are nearly finished, but we still have to dot the i's and cross the t's.
examples.trans: 談判即將結束，但是我們還是要做到一絲不苟。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: an amount of money that you pay at the time that you buy something but is only a part of the total cost of that thing. You usually pay the rest of the cost over a period of time

examples.en: I made/put a down payment on a new smart TV.

examples.trans: 他們學會了靠土地吃飯。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 以自己的方式生活；自由自在地生活

examples.en: Now that the children have left home, I can live my own life again.

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.word: look feel like a million dollars
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to look or feel extremely good, often because you are wearing something that costs a lot of money
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （通常指享受奢侈品時）看起來／感覺非常好

examples.trans: 20世紀90年代，低成本航空公司大量增加。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 一次性支付的金額，一整筆款項

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （罐頭）午餐肉（不需加熱即可切片食用的熟肉）

examples.trans: 當要找些零食時，他徑直到冰箱裡找午餐肉片。

examples.en: See also

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: expensive things, such as jewellery and make-up, that are pleasant to have but are not necessary

examples.en: The government will pay for the new schools by increasing the tax on luxury goods.
examples.trans: 政府將透過提高奢侈品的稅率來支付新學校的費用。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to earn a lot of money

examples.en: They made a bundle selling their business.
examples.trans: 他們賣掉公司，大賺了一筆。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to use something, especially a bad situation, to your advantage
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 將（尤指壞事）變好事；對…因勢利導

examples.en: I had a couple of months to spare between jobs so I thought I'd make a virtue of necessity by acquiring a few new skills.
examples.trans: 我換工作期間有幾個月空閒時間，因此不如趁此機會學一些新技能。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to use a situation to get an advantage for yourself
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 從…中獲益（或贏得好處）；利用

examples.en: The Opposition is making a lot of political capital out of the government's failure to invest in education.
examples.trans: 反對黨正利用政府未能做好教育投資而大撈政治資本。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: When someone makes good something, they either pay for it, or make it happen.

examples.en: a working-class boy made good
examples.trans: 獲得成功的工人階級家庭的孩子

examples.en: My uncle owed thousands, but eventually he made good on all of his debts.
examples.trans: 我叔叔欠了幾千的債，可是最後都還清了。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to give a particular level of value or importance to something
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 給予…（一定程度的）的重視

examples.en: You should make more of your computer skills on the application form.
examples.trans: 你填申請表時應該更加突出你的 IT 技能。

examples.en: I think we make too much of the benefits of Western society.
examples.trans: 我認為我們過分強調了西方社會的好處。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to give something, such as money or land, to someone so that they legally own it
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 將…移交給（某人）；（以法律形式）把…轉讓給（某人）

examples.en: Just before her death, she had made over $100,000 to her new husband.
examples.trans: 就在臨死之前，她將10萬美元轉給了新任丈夫。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.word: make sth it worth your while
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to pay someone money to do something

examples.en: If you can get me the list of names I want, I'll make it worth your while.
examples.trans: 如果你能弄到我要的名單，我會給你報酬。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.word: make put a dent in sth

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to reduce an amount of money

examples.trans: 度假花去了我們很大一部分的存款。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to reduce the price of something, usually in order to encourage people to buy it

examples.trans: 低迷的消費需求迫使我們降低了許多商品的價格，有時降幅高達30%。

examples.en: Shares in the electricity companies were marked down following the announcement of the new energy tax.
examples.trans: 新的能源稅頒布後，電力公司的股價隨即紛紛下跌。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to increase the price of something

examples.en: They buy paintings at auctions, mark them up, and then resell them at a vast profit to collectors.
examples.trans: 他們在拍賣會上購買畫作，再加價轉手賣給收藏家，賺取高額利潤。

examples.en: In the days of hyperinflation, we would rush to the market as soon as we were paid and buy our weekly groceries before they were marked up.
examples.trans: 在惡性通貨膨脹時期，一發工資我們就衝到市場，趕在漲價之前買回一周所需的食品雜貨。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: a shop where you can buy medicines; a

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: the part of American society that is neither rich nor poor and has traditional political and religious opinions

examples.trans: 中等偏上收入階層的人往往會在商界發展，或成為專業人士，如律師、醫生或會計師。

examples.trans: lower class

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: all the money that is in use in a country

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: used to describe something that is not important, usually because it does not involve much money
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （通常指由於涉及金額不多而）微不足道的

examples.en: a nickel-and-dime dispute

examples.en: The banks nickle and dime you to death with all the little fees they charge you.
examples.trans: 銀行用一筆又一筆的小費用積少成多地把人壓垮。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （透過金錢上的逐漸索取或對細節的過分關注而）一點一滴地耗損

examples.trans: 我討厭那些利用人們的恐懼和偏見的行銷策略。

examples.en: Management policy seemed to be to play one department off against another.
examples.trans: 管理階層的政策似乎在有意激起各部門之間的競爭。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to emphasize a particular quality or part of something, or make it seem more important than it really is, usually for your own advantage
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （通常指為個人利益而）強調；提升…的重要性；大肆宣傳

examples.en: The official report plays up the likely benefits of the plan, but glosses over the costs.
examples.trans: 這份官方報告過分強調這項計劃可能帶來的好處，卻掩蓋了所要付出的代價。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to try to gain an advantage by drawing attention to someone's race or to issues of race
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 打種族牌（指在競選中力求獲勝而發表帶有種族偏見的言論）

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.word: point sb towards in the direction of sth

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to suggest that someone should do or buy a particular thing
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 提議某人做某事（或購買某物）

examples.en: The salesman was trying to point us in the direction of the most expensive furniture in the showroom.
examples.trans: 那個銷售員設法誘勸我們購買展覽室中最貴的傢俱。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: an organization that gives money and support to politicians in order to influence them
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （資助政客已求得影響力的）政治行動委員會

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （清除公共場所狗糞用的）長柄撿糞鏟

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: poor, having little money and/or few possessions

examples.en: The country was so poorly off it had to close many of its embassies abroad.
examples.trans: 這個國家很窮，不得不關閉許多駐外大使館。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: the act of giving advantage to those groups in society that are often treated unfairly because of their race, sex, etc.
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （對因種族、性別等原因遭受歧視的群體予以照顧的）積極區別待遇政策；正面差別待遇

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: used when something is sent by post without any money having to be paid
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 郵資免付的；郵資已付的

examples.en: Send for an educational DVD post-free.
examples.trans: 請來函索取教學DVD，郵資免付。

examples.en: The guidebook costs £10.95 post-free.
examples.trans: 旅行指南定價10.95英鎊，郵資免付。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: a charge for the cost of having something wrapped and then sent to you

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: an official piece of paper with an amount of money written on it that you can send or give to someone who can then exchange it for the same amount of money at a post office

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: the official name of the pound used as money in the UK

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: the official level of income that is needed to achieve a basic living standard with enough money for things such as food, clothing, and a place to live

examples.en: In 1991 almost 36 million Americans were living below the poverty line.
examples.trans: 在1991年大約有3600萬美國人生活在貧窮線以下。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: in the UK, a private school (= a school paid for by parents not the government) for children, especially boys, between the ages of seven and 13, who will then usually go to public school and in the US, a private school for children over the age of eleven that prepares them to go to college
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 預備學校（在英國通常指為進入公學作準備的私立學校，所收學生為7至13歲的兒童，尤指男孩；在美國指為11歲以上的孩子上大學作準備的私立中學）

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: a piece of paper with a price that is attached to a product, or the amount that something costs
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （掛在商品上的）價格標籤；價格

examples.en: How much is it? I can't find the price tag.
examples.trans: 這多少錢？——我找不到價格標籤。

examples.en: These suits have designer names and a price ticket to match.
examples.trans: 這些西服牌子響噹噹，價格也不菲。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: knowing how much things cost and avoiding buying expensive things
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 對價格敏感的，注重價格的

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: A price-sensitive product is one whose sales are influenced by price rather than quality.
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （商品銷售）對價格敏感的，易受價格變化影響的

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to value a skill or good quality that you have

examples.en: He prides himself on his loyalty to his friends.
examples.trans: 他以自己對朋友的忠誠而自豪。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: a list of things that have been ordered, sent with their prices to a customer so that the things can be paid for before they are delivered
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （發貨前通知顧客付款的）形式發票，估價單

examples.en: a pro forma declaration of loyalty
examples.trans: 形式上的效忠表白

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to earn money from something

examples.en: Many companies will profit from the fall in interest rates.
examples.trans: 利率降低，許多公司將從中獲利。

examples.en: I profited enormously from working with her.
examples.trans: 和她一起工作，我獲益匪淺。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to achieve an advantage from something

examples.en: Many companies will profit from the fall in interest rates.
examples.trans: 利率降低，許多公司將從中獲利。

examples.en: I profited enormously from working with her.
examples.trans: 和她一起工作，我獲益匪淺。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: the difference between the total cost of making and selling something and the price it is sold for

examples.en: Many small companies operate on very narrow profit margins.
examples.trans: 許多小公司靠非常微薄的利潤維持經營。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: a document that contains a promise to pay a stated amount of money to a stated person either on a fixed date or when the money is demanded

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to give someone the things they need, such as money, food, or clothes

examples.en: He has a wife and two young children to provide for.
examples.trans: 他要養活妻子和兩個小孩。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: in England, an expensive type of private school (= a school paid for by parents and not by the government)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （英格蘭的）公學（一種昂貴的私立學校）

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: a date printed on a product such as food after which it should not be sold

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to earn a stated amount of money

examples.en: Between them they must be pulling down over $100,000 a year.
examples.trans: 他們兩個人加起來每年肯定能賺十萬美元以上。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to do something that prevents an activity from continuing, especially by no longer giving money to support it
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 制止，阻止（某事繼續）；釜底抽薪（尤指停止資助）

examples.en: If the viewing figures drop much more, the TV network will probably pull the plug on the whole series.
examples.trans: 如果收視率繼續下滑，該電視製作公司可能會停止整個系列節目的製作。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to spend a lot of money trying to make something operate successfully

examples.en: They had been pumping money into the business for some years without seeing any results.
examples.trans: 幾年來他們一直在為這個企業投入大量資金，可是還沒有看到任何成果。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: the value of money considered as the amount of goods it will buy

examples.en: The purchasing power of people living on investment income has fallen as interest rates have gone down.
examples.trans: 隨著利率的下降，靠投資收入為生的人們的購買力也下降了。

examples.en: The purchasing power of the average hourly wage has risen in the last five years.
examples.trans: 在過去五年內，每小時的平均工資的購買力上升了。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to cause the amount, number, or value of something to increase or be reduced

examples.en: Rising demand tends to push prices up, and falling demand pushes them down.
examples.trans: 需求增加往往促使價格上漲，而需求減少促使價格下跌。

examples.en: The rise in interest rates has pushed up the value of my investments.
examples.trans: 利率上漲使我的投資升值。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to spend a lot of money on celebrating something
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （為慶祝某事而）花費一大筆錢

examples.en: They really pushed the boat out for Annie's wedding.
examples.trans: 他們為了安妮的婚禮確實花了一大筆錢。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to emphasize the good parts of something that has been done, especially those that are to your advantage, and to avoid the bad parts
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （尤指出於私心而）突出…的好處，誇飾…好的一面，粉飾

examples.en: Politics is all about putting a good gloss on unpleasant or difficult situations.
examples.trans: 政治無非就是用粉飾太平的手段來掩飾令人不快或困難的局面。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to make a record that someone has promised to pay a particular amount of money as part of a collection to help people in need
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 記下（某人）（答應捐款的數額）

examples.en: Put me down for a £10 donation.
examples.trans: 請你記下我捐十英鎊。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to pay for someone to study at school, college, or university

examples.en: I'm sorry to put you through this ordeal.
examples.trans: 讓你受這種煎熬，我很抱歉。

examples.en: It's costing them a lot of money to put their children through school.
examples.trans: 供孩子們上學花了他們很多錢。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to guess or roughly calculate that something will cost a particular amount, or that something is a particular size, number, or amount
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 推測，估計（某物的價格、大小、數量等）

examples.en: The value of the painting has been put at £1 million.
examples.trans: 這幅畫估價為100萬英鎊。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to save an amount of money to use later

examples.en: I try to put by a few pounds every week.
examples.trans: 我設法每週存幾英鎊。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to use an amount of money to pay part of the cost of something
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 拿出（一定量的錢）貼補著買…

examples.en: My grandma gave me some money to put towards a new coat.
examples.trans: 我祖母貼補了我一些錢來買件新大衣。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to ask someone to give you money

examples.en: She put the squeeze on her mother for a hundred bucks.
examples.trans: 她向她媽媽要了100美元。

examples.en: The insurance company put the bite on me for a huge increase in my premium after I crashed the car.
examples.trans: 我把車撞壞以後，保險公司對我收取的保險費提高了很多。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.word: put your hand in your pocket
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to give money to someone or to charity (= organizations that collect money to give to poor people, ill people, etc.)

examples.en: People are more inclined to put their hands in their pockets to help children.
examples.trans: 人們更傾向於捐款幫助兒童。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: an equation that includes an unknown value that is multiplied by itself only once, and does not include an unknown value multiplied by itself more than once

examples.en: In the quadratic equation, 2y2+3y=14, y=2 or y=-3½.
examples.trans: 在二次方程式2y2+3y=14中，y=2或y=-3½

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: time that you spend with someone, giving them your full attention because you value the relationship
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （用於全心照顧某人的）寶貴時光，優質時間

examples.en: He spends quality time with his children every day.
examples.trans: 他確保自己每天都能好好地陪伴孩子們。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to increase something such as a rent or price, especially by an amount that is considered to be too much
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （尤指過分地）增加，提高（房租、價格等）

examples.en: He has racked up 450 points in three months.
examples.trans: 三個月內，他已經累積了450分。

examples.en: Astronomical profits/losses were racked up by airlines last year.
examples.trans: 去年各航空公司累計盈利／虧損達到了天文數字。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: used to describe what happens to a person who was poor but becomes rich

examples.en: a rags-to-riches story
examples.trans: 白手起家的故事

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: a piece of paper that you are given by a shop when something that is advertised for sale at a certain price is not available. This piece of paper allows you to buy the product at the advertised price when it becomes available.
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （商店因促銷商品無庫存而發給顧客、允許日後以相同優惠價購買的）購物優惠券

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to earn or get a large amount of money

examples.en: He rakes in over $200,000 a year.
examples.trans: 他一年能賺20多萬美元。

examples.en: She's really raking it in (= making a lot of money).
examples.trans: 她真賺大錢了。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: a meal cooked and bought at a shop but taken somewhere else, often home, to be heated and eaten
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 外賣，即食餐（店中出售的已做好的餐食，購買後帶走加熱後食用）

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: money that is available to be spent immediately

examples.en: See also
examples.trans: the readies

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: bought or found in a finished form and available to use immediately
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 現成的；預先造好的；成品的

examples.en: a ready-made frozen meal
examples.trans: 預製冷凍膳食

examples.en: figurative When she married Giles, she acquired a ready-made family - two teenage sons and a daughter.
examples.trans: 她嫁給了賈爾斯，也就接過來一個現成的家庭——兩個十幾歲的兒子和一個女兒。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: a shop that sells damaged or not perfect products that cannot be sold at the full price
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 次品商店；殘次品專賣店

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: the situation when the kidneys cannot remove waste products of the body through the urine leading to electrolyte imbalances

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: a young male prostitute (= someone who has sex for money) used by other men

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: A reply-paid envelope has had the cost of posting it already paid for, usually by the person it is sent to.
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （通常由收信人先付郵資的）郵資已付的

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: a measurement of the changes in the cost of basic goods and services

examples.en: Compare
examples.trans: consumer price index

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: a room in a bus station or railway station where a passenger can pay to stay for a few days
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 公共汽車站（或火車站）裡旅客可以付錢住幾天的房間

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: the act of giving advantage to those groups in society that are often treated unfairly, usually because of their race, sex, or sexuality
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （指對通常遭受種族或性別歧視的人給予優待的）逆向歧視

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to record the money that has been paid by a customer by pressing buttons on a cash register
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 把（收到的款額）輸入收銀機

examples.en: I'm sorry, I rang up the wrong amount.
examples.trans: 對不起，我輸錯錢數了。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: having little importance or influence, or old-fashioned or of poor quality
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 無足輕重的；無價值的；過時的；劣質的

examples.en: Their family business is a rinky-dink operation.
examples.trans: 他們的家族企業是小本經營。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: something that is not worth what you pay for it

examples.en: $300 for that shirt? - That's a complete rip-off.
examples.trans: 那件襯衫300美元？——純粹是敲竹槓。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to borrow money from one person to pay back money you borrowed from someone else
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 拆東牆補西牆；借新債還舊債

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to reduce the cost or price of something

examples.en: The furniture dealer is rolling back the prices on all beds for this week only.
examples.trans: 傢俱商對所有的床降價銷售，優惠時間僅本週一週。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: jewellery made of cheap metal covered with a thin layer of gold

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: a brand name for a large and very expensive type of car made in the UK
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （英國生産的大型昂貴豪華車）勞斯萊斯

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: male prostitutes who have sex with other men and who give the appearance of being from a poor social class
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （看起來像是來自社會底層的）男妓，搞同性關係的粗漢

examples.en: He went to the docks to pick up a bit of rough trade.
examples.trans: 他到碼頭上去找搞同性關係的粗漢廝混。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to go out to buy or do something

examples.en: After school he runs errands for his father.
examples.trans: 放學後他替父親跑跑腿辦些事情。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to reach a particular cost or amount, as a total
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 共計，合計為；總共達到…之多

examples.en: We ran into bad weather/debt/trouble.
examples.trans: 我們遇到了壞天氣／背上了債務／遇到了麻煩。

examples.en: The repairs will probably run into thousands of dollars.
examples.trans: 維修費可能會達數千美元之多。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to have enough money to buy something or (of an income, etc.) to be enough to buy something
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 有錢做…，買得起；（收入）足夠供…之用

examples.en: The new encyclopedia runs to several thousand pages.
examples.trans: 這部新的百科全書厚達幾千頁。

examples.en: I can lend you €1,000, but I can't run to more than that.
examples.trans: 我可以借給你1000歐元，但是再多我就拿不出來了。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: the money you need to spend regularly to keep a system or organization working

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: the money you need to spend in order to keep and use a vehicle

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to very quickly produce something and make it available to sell

examples.en: When the war started, several publishers rushed out books on the conflict.
examples.trans: 戰爭一爆發，幾家出版社就迅速出版了一批有關這場衝突的書。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: the activity of gradually reducing something, usually in order to save money, by removing one small amount of it after the other, in a way that is damaging
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （通常為了省錢）逐量減少（而造成有害的結果）

examples.en: He argues that cuts should be achieved by fundamentally re-thinking the role of the state rather than by salami slicing.
examples.trans: 他提出削減開支應該通過從根本上重新思考政府的角色來實現，而不是靠會造成損害的逐量減少。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: a bar in a pub or hotel that is more comfortable than the other bars, and in which you sometimes pay a little more money for your drink

examples.en: Compare
examples.trans: public bar

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to save something, often money, secretly

examples.en: He salted away a fortune over the years and no one ever knew!
examples.trans: 這幾年他偷偷地存了一大筆錢卻沒人知道！

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: any small gun that is cheap, often bought illegally and used by criminals
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （常指罪犯非法購得的廉價）小口徑手槍

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to avoid using something so that you do not have to pay for it

examples.en: It was a warm winter, so we saved on electricity.
examples.trans: 那是一個暖冬，因此我們省了不少電。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to believe that someone you are competing against is having difficulties and to use this to get an advantage for yourself
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 嗅到血腥味（意識到競爭對手有麻煩，並加以利用）

examples.en: The manager has already made some serious errors of judgment and it is clear that other employees scent blood.
examples.trans: 經理已經犯了一些嚴重的判斷錯誤，顯然其他員工都想利用經理的過失，為自己謀求利益。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: in the US, a scholarship (= money to pay for studies) that allows a student to attend a private school rather than a state school
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （美國）學券，教育券，教育代金券（一種獎學金，資助學生上私立學校而不是公立學校）

examples.en: Opponents of school vouchers gathered outside the meeting room to protest.
examples.trans: 反對教育券的人士聚集在會議室外面抗議。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: a brand name for a long, thin strip of sticky and usually transparent material that is sold in a roll and is used for joining together things such as paper or cardboard

examples.en: a roll of Scotch tape
examples.trans: 一捲透明膠帶

examples.en: I stuck the note to the door with Scotch tape.
examples.trans: 我用透明膠帶把便條貼在門上。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to only just earn enough money to provide yourself with food, clothing, and a place to live

examples.en: He settled in Paris, where he scraped a living writing short stories and magazine articles.
examples.trans: 他定居巴黎，以寫短篇小說和雜誌文章勉強度日。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to manage to live when you do not have enough money and other necessary things

examples.en: He lost his job, so the family had to scrape by on one small salary.
examples.trans: 他丟了工作，所以一家人只好靠一份微薄的薪水勉強過活。

examples.en: I only studied Spanish for a year but I can scrape by in most situations.
examples.trans: 我只學了一年的西班牙語，但在大多數情況下我都能夠勉強應付。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: UK Second-class post is less expensive and sent less quickly than first-class.

examples.en: Women are still treated as second class citizens.
examples.trans: 女性仍然被當作二等公民對待。

examples.en: a second-class seat/ticket

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: the part of central London where there are many theatres and many large, expensive shops and hotels

examples.trans: 倫敦西區的一家劇院

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: the money necessary for a particular purpose

examples.trans: 我想買一所大一點的房子，可是沒那麼多錢。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （人）筋疲力盡的；（物品）破損不堪的，破舊的

examples.en: After a month of journeying over rough roads, the drivers and their trucks were looking the worse for wear.
examples.trans: 在崎嶇不平的路面上行駛一個月之後，司機和他們的貨車看上去情況都很糟。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.word: the wrong other side of the tracks
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: a part of a town that is considered poor and dangerous
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 貧民區（城鎮中被視爲貧困和危險的區域）

examples.en: Her boyfriend came from the wrong side of the tracks.
examples.trans: 她的男朋友來自貧民區。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.word: there s one law for the rich and another for the poor
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: said when a rich person has not been punished for something that a poor person would be punished for

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: insurance that will pay money to a person or group damaged in some way by the person or group who has this insurance

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: a shop that sells used things such as clothes, books, and furniture, typically in order to raise money for a charity
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （出售二手衣物、圖書、傢俱等，通常用來為慈善機構籌款的）節儉商店

examples.en: Compare

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to spend money, especially in an obvious and careless way, on things that are not necessary

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to waste money by spending more money on something you have already spent money on that is no good
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: 把錢投入無底洞，花冤枉錢

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: to cause something, often money or possessions, not to be available for use

examples.en: All my money is tied up in property.
examples.trans: 我所有的資金都投在房地產上，無法動用。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: unwilling to spend money

examples.trans: 別幻想吉莉恩會給你買飲料——她這人太小氣。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: said to emphasize that you should not waste time, because you could be using it to earn money

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: UK having lost or spent a particular amount of money as a result of something

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: If you have nothing or very little to your name, you own very little or have no money.

examples.trans: 他到美國的時候身無分文。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: a bridge that you pay to use

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （兒童們相信的能取走他們脫落的乳牙並留下錢的）牙仙子

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （主要供卡車司機進餐的）路邊小餐館

examples.en: a treasure trove of information
examples.trans: 豐富的資訊

examples.en: Though small, this museum is a veritable treasure trove of history.
examples.trans: 儘管這家博物館很小，卻也是大量史實資料的寶庫。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: number plates on a vehicle that have particular numbers or letters on them that the vehicle's owner has specially chosen and paid to have

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: the money that you earn, especially when it is given to you in notes and coins in an envelope

examples.en: cash a monthly/weekly wage packet
examples.trans: 發月／週薪

examples.en: She got £25 in cash in her first wage packet.
examples.trans: 她的第一份工資拿到了25英鎊。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: the price you pay for something such as a ticket if you buy it just before using it, rather than buying it some time earlier

examples.en: Tickets booked online for the same day will be charged at the full walk-up price.
examples.trans: 當天網上訂購的票價為全價，跟臨時購買的價格一樣。

Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.definition_en: money that has been collected or saved to pay for something, especially a long fight to achieve something
Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost.translation: （為需要經過漫長鬥爭而取得成功而籌集的）資金，款項

examples.en: The candidates are gathering money for their election war chests.
examples.trans: 候選人為競選籌集資金。
