examples.en: He was having it off with his friend's wife.
examples.trans: 他與朋友的妻子發生了性關係。

all_entries.meaning_vi: giao hợp tình dục

all_entries.word: have it on the highest authority
all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: to have been told something by someone who knows the truth

examples.en: I have it on the highest authority that they are getting a divorce.
examples.trans: 我聽知情人士說他們正要離婚。

all_entries.meaning_vi: người biết chuyện / người trong cuộc / nguồn tin thông thạo

all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: to talk to someone about something they have done that makes you angry, in order to try to solve the problem

examples.en: She'd been late for work every morning and I thought I'd better have it out with her.
examples.trans: 那一周她每天上班都遲到，我想還是把這個問題明白給她指出來比較好。

all_entries.meaning_vi: sự việc; vấn đề; điều; công việc

all_entries.topic: Cảm xúc, Thái độ & Tâm lý (Emotions, Attitudes & Psychology)
all_entries.definition_en: to be very worried, upset, or angry about something
all_entries.meaning_vi: bối rối / hốt hoảng / lúng túng

all_entries.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
all_entries.definition_en: If a story in the news has legs, it will continue for a long time.
all_entries.translation: 未完待續；對某事的後續報道還將持續很長時間

examples.en: This latest scandal has legs - you'll probably still be reading about it in a year's time.
examples.trans: 最近的醜聞還有下文。也許近一年內，你還會讀到其後續報道。

examples.en: The business has legs.
examples.trans: 這家企業有很強的生命力。

all_entries.meaning_vi: đưa tin (tin tức) / bản tin
all_entries.translation_zh: 未完待續；對某事的後續報道還將持續很長時間

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: If something has legs, it can continue to exist and be successful.
all_entries.translation: 經久不衰的；持續時間久且成功的

examples.en: This latest scandal has legs - you'll probably still be reading about it in a year's time.
examples.trans: 最近的醜聞還有下文。也許近一年內，你還會讀到其後續報道。

examples.en: The business has legs.
examples.trans: 這家企業有很強的生命力。

all_entries.meaning_vi: thời gian kéo dài
all_entries.translation_zh: 經久不衰的；持續時間久且成功的

all_entries.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
all_entries.definition_en: to be rich

examples.en: I believe her family has money.
examples.trans: 我想她家很有錢。

all_entries.meaning_vi: giàu có; phú quý; sung túc / phong phú về; dồi dào với

all_entries.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
all_entries.definition_en: to spend a lot of money on things that are not necessary

examples.en: I don't know what her job is but she certainly seems to have money to burn.
examples.trans: 我不知道她做甚麼工作，不過看來她的錢多得花不完。

all_entries.meaning_vi: phung phí tiền / xa hoa / phóng túng / tự do tự tại / nhanh nhẹn

all_entries.topic: Cảm xúc, Thái độ & Tâm lý (Emotions, Attitudes & Psychology)
all_entries.definition_en: to be very brave

examples.en: You need to have nerves of steel to be a fighter pilot.
examples.trans: 當戰鬥機飛行員需要有過人的膽量。

all_entries.meaning_vi: dũng cảm

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: used to say that someone is going to be unpleasantly surprised because something will not be as they want it to be

examples.en: I've got news for him, if he thinks he can keep living here free of charge.
examples.trans: 如果他想繼續賴在這裡白住，我可有好戲讓他看。

all_entries.meaning_vi: một người nào đó / một người nhất định / một số người / tôi (xưng hô sau họ của một người)

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to have no right to do something

examples.en: You had no business reading my private letters.
examples.trans: 你無權看我的私人信件。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không có quyền / không có thẩm quyền

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: to refuse to accept, agree with, or support something

examples.en: She tried to persuade him to retire, but he would have none of it.
examples.trans: 她試圖勸他退休，但他拒絕了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: khác / riêng biệt / không giống

all_entries.word: have nothing on sb or sth
all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to not be as good as someone or something

examples.en: He's a good player, but he's got nothing on his brother.
examples.trans: 他是個不錯的運動員，但是沒有他弟弟優秀。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không bằng; không tốt bằng; kém hơn / sẽ tốt hơn nếu

all_entries.word: have nothing to say for yourself
all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: to not be willing to take part in conversations or express your opinions
all_entries.meaning_vi: không sẵn lòng

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to need to do something

examples.en: Of course, as a teacher I had authority, but rarely did I have occasion to use it.
examples.trans: 當然，作為老師我有權威，可是我很少用到它。

all_entries.meaning_vi: cần thiết / thiết yếu / không thể thiếu / bắt buộc

all_entries.word: have one foot in the grave
all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to be very old and near death
all_entries.translation: 一隻腳已踏進墳墓，行將就木
all_entries.meaning_vi: gần đất xa trời; một chân bước vào mộ
all_entries.translation_zh: 一隻腳已踏進墳墓，行將就木

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to have someone in a situation where you have complete power over them
all_entries.meaning_vi: hoàn chỉnh; toàn bộ / hoàn toàn; toàn diện

all_entries.word: have sb eating out of your hand
all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to easily make someone do or think what you want
all_entries.translation: 牽著…的鼻子走；使…百依百順；將…治得服服貼貼

examples.en: Within two minutes of walking into the classroom, she had the kids eating out of her hand.
examples.trans: 她走進教室不到兩分鐘，就把這群孩子治得服服貼貼的。

all_entries.meaning_vi: ngoan ngoãn và vâng lời / rất mực vâng lời
all_entries.translation_zh: 牽著…的鼻子走；使…百依百順；將…治得服服貼貼

all_entries.word: have sb in the palm of your hand
all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to have complete control over someone and to be able to make them do anything you want
all_entries.translation: 把（某人）抓在手心裡，完全控制（某人）

examples.en: He had the audience in the palm of his hand.
examples.trans: 他牢牢地抓住了觀眾的心。

all_entries.meaning_vi: hoàn chỉnh; toàn bộ / hoàn toàn; toàn diện
all_entries.translation_zh: 把（某人）抓在手心裡，完全控制（某人）

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: to persuade someone that something is true when it is not, usually as a joke

examples.en: That's your new car? You're having me on!
examples.trans: 那是你的新汽車？你在騙我吧！

all_entries.meaning_vi: lừa dối / lừa gạt

all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: to put someone in a very difficult situation in which the person has no choice about what they do
all_entries.translation: 使（某人）別無選擇，使（某人）聽從擺布

examples.en: She knows I need the work so she's got me over a barrel in terms of what she pays me.
examples.trans: 她知道我需要這份工作，所以就在薪水上為難我。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không có lựa chọn nào khác
all_entries.translation_zh: 使（某人）別無選擇，使（某人）聽從擺布

all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: to know about and be able to deal with a person or situation
all_entries.meaning_vi: thông tin nội bộ / tường tận của sự việc / tình hình ra sao / chuyện gì đang xảy ra

all_entries.word: have sb to thank for sth
all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: If you have someone to thank for something, that person is responsible or to blame for it.
all_entries.translation: 由（某人）對…負責；應責怪（某人）

examples.en: You have John to thank for this problem.
examples.trans: 出現這個問題你該怪約翰。

all_entries.meaning_vi: một người nào đó / một người nhất định / một số người / tôi (xưng hô sau họ của một người)
all_entries.translation_zh: 由（某人）對…負責；應責怪（某人）

all_entries.word: have sb s guts for garters
all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: If you say you will have someone's guts for garters, you mean that you will punish them severely.
all_entries.translation: 狠狠懲罰（某人），抽（某人）的筋，扒（某人）的皮

examples.en: If that boy has taken my bike again, I'll have his guts for garters!
examples.trans: 如果那小子又騎走了我的腳踏車，我就扒了他的皮。

all_entries.meaning_vi: hình phạt / sự trừng phạt / trừng phạt
all_entries.translation_zh: 狠狠懲罰（某人），抽（某人）的筋，扒（某人）的皮

all_entries.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
all_entries.definition_en: to know a lot about someone and so have an advantage over them
all_entries.translation: 對（某人）心中有數；摸透（某人）的底

examples.en: Don't worry, I've got his number, he doesn't fool me.
examples.trans: 別擔心，我對他的底細一清二楚，他騙不了我的。

all_entries.meaning_vi: biết rõ tình hình
all_entries.translation_zh: 對（某人）心中有數；摸透（某人）的底

all_entries.word: have sb sth hanging round your neck
all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to be limited in what you can do by someone or something

examples.en: The last thing I want is a couple of kids hanging round my neck!
examples.trans: 我最不希望的就是有幾個孩子拖累著我！

all_entries.meaning_vi: làm liên lụy / là gánh nặng / chịu ảnh hưởng

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to be old and in bad condition

examples.en: That jacket has seen better days. Why don't you get a new one?
examples.trans: 那件夾克很舊了，爲甚麽不買件新的？

all_entries.meaning_vi: không còn; không nữa

all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: to be extremely stupid

examples.en: Don't ask Jack to do anything - he's got shit for brains.
examples.trans: 任何事情也不要找傑克做－－他腦子裡有水。

all_entries.meaning_vi: mất trí / điên / rối trí

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to have already achieved all that you have the power, ability, or strength to do and to be unable to do more

examples.en: He started off the game well but seemed to have shot his bolt by half-time.
examples.trans: 比賽開始時他表現不錯，但半場時似乎已經筋疲力盡了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không tiếc công sức (thành ngữ); làm hết sức mình

all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: If you have something going with someone, you are involved in a sexual relationship with them.
all_entries.translation: 和（某人）有性關係，和（某人）有染

examples.en: Didn't he have something going with one of his students?
examples.trans: 他不是和一個學生關係很曖昧嗎？

all_entries.meaning_vi: quan hệ tình dục / tiếp xúc tình dục / giao hợp
all_entries.translation_zh: 和（某人）有性關係，和（某人）有染

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to have a plan or intention

examples.en: Did you have anything in mind for Helen's present?
examples.trans: 你想好為海倫準備甚麼禮物了嗎？

all_entries.meaning_vi: suy nghĩ kỹ / cân nhắc / sự cân nhắc

all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: to be able to believe a piece of information because you trust the person who told you it

examples.en: I have it on good authority that she's getting married.
examples.trans: 根據可靠的資訊，她就要結婚了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: đáng tin cậy

all_entries.word: have something nothing to show for sth
all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: If you have something/nothing to show for your work or effort, you have/have not won any advantage from it.

examples.en: I worked for two weeks, and $50 was all I had to show for it.
examples.trans: 我工作了兩星期，所得到的酬勞只有50美元。

examples.en: I've been trying to write this essay all day and I have nothing to show for it.
examples.trans: 我一整天都在努力寫這篇文章，可是沒甚麽進展。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không thu được gì / kết thúc tay trắng

all_entries.word: have sth coming out of your ears
all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to have more of something than you want or need
all_entries.translation: 擁有的比想要（或需要）的多

examples.en: He's going to have money coming out of his ears if this deal comes off.
examples.trans: 如果這筆交易能做成，他就要發大財了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: muốn / cảm thấy thích / thích / quan tâm đến ai đó / mong muốn
all_entries.translation_zh: 擁有的比想要（或需要）的多

all_entries.word: have sth down to a fine art
all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to be able to do something very well or quickly, often because you have done it so many times
all_entries.translation: 把…學到家；做…的技能達到爐火純青的地步
all_entries.meaning_vi: nghĩa đen: lửa lò đã chuyển sang màu xanh sáng (điển tích luyện đan Đạo giáo) (thành ngữ) / nghĩa bóng: (một nghệ thuật, kỹ thuật, v.v.) đã đạt đến mức độ hoàn hảo
all_entries.translation_zh: 把…學到家；做…的技能達到爐火純青的地步

all_entries.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
all_entries.definition_en: If you have something going for you, or if something has something going for it, there are certain advantages that will make the end result successful.

examples.en: They've got a happy marriage, great careers, wonderful kids - in fact they've got everything going for them.
examples.trans: 他們婚姻美滿、事業有成、兒女聰慧——實際上他們的一切都完美無缺。

all_entries.meaning_vi: có lợi; thuận lợi

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to have something well organized or under control
all_entries.translation: 把…組織得很好；把…置於控制之下

examples.en: The police have the situation in hand.
examples.trans: 警方已經控制了局面。

examples.en: I had enough money in hand to buy a new car.
examples.trans: 我手頭有足夠的錢買一輛新汽車。

all_entries.meaning_vi: dưới / ở dưới / ít hơn
all_entries.translation_zh: 把…組織得很好；把…置於控制之下

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: mainly UK If you have something in hand, you have not yet used it and it is still available.

examples.en: The police have the situation in hand.
examples.trans: 警方已經控制了局面。

examples.en: I had enough money in hand to buy a new car.
examples.trans: 我手頭有足夠的錢買一輛新汽車。

all_entries.meaning_vi: nắm bắt (thường là nghĩa bóng) / kiểm soát / nắm giữ (sáng kiến, cơ hội, số phận) / thành thạo / biết rõ / hiểu rõ và biết cách sử dụng / trôi chảy

all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: to be certain to win or succeed at something

examples.en: Last year's winners again have the championship firmly in their pocket.
examples.trans: 去年的冠軍得主今年仍舊穩操勝券。

all_entries.meaning_vi: nắm chắc và chiến thắng được đảm bảo / thành công trong tầm tay (thành ngữ)

all_entries.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
all_entries.definition_en: to not be able to stop thinking or talking about one particular thing
all_entries.translation: 念念不忘；總是想到（或提到）

examples.en: You've got cars on the brain. Can't we talk about something else for a change?
examples.trans: 你説話老是離不開汽車。我們能不能換個話題？

all_entries.meaning_vi: luôn ghi nhớ trong lòng (thành ngữ)
all_entries.translation_zh: 念念不忘；總是想到（或提到）

all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: If you have a difficult situation on your hands, you have to deal with it.

examples.en: If the police carry on like this they'll have a riot on their hands.
examples.trans: 如果警方繼續這樣下去，那麽他們將要面臨一場暴亂。

examples.en: She has a battle on her hands if she wants the organization to change.
examples.trans: 如果她要讓機構發生改變的話，那麼她會有一場仗要打。

all_entries.meaning_vi: trong tay / có sẵn / tình hình tài chính

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: to be to blame for something

examples.en: If the police carry on like this they'll have a riot on their hands.
examples.trans: 如果警方繼續這樣下去，那麽他們將要面臨一場暴亂。

examples.en: She has a battle on her hands if she wants the organization to change.
examples.trans: 如果她要讓機構發生改變的話，那麼她會有一場仗要打。

all_entries.meaning_vi: chỉ trích / tìm lỗi / lên án

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to have something, usually a large amount of important work, to deal with

examples.en: She's got a lot on her plate - especially with two new projects starting this week.
examples.trans: 她有很多工作要做——特別是這個星期她又開始了兩個新專案計劃。

examples.en: The aid agencies have (more than) enough on their plate without having unnecessary visitors to take care of.
examples.trans: 即使不需接待不速之客，救援機構也已經忙得不可開交。

all_entries.meaning_vi: ghép kênh / nhiều / phức hợp-

all_entries.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
all_entries.definition_en: If you have something on your side, it gives you an advantage when you are trying to achieve something.

examples.en: I thought I would get the job, but the other person who was being considered for it had experience on his side.
examples.trans: 我覺得我能得到那份工作，但另外那個人有經驗方面的優勢。

all_entries.meaning_vi: sự vượt trội / sự thống trị / lợi thế

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)

examples.en: You'll have to have that tooth out.

examples.en: I don't believe that story for a moment.
examples.trans: 我絕不會相信過那個說法。

all_entries.meaning_vi: chưa từng có; chưa bao giờ có / (trước động từ) chưa từng

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: certainly not

examples.en: I'm not suggesting for one minute that she meant to cause any trouble.
examples.trans: 我絕非在暗示她是有意找麻煩。

all_entries.meaning_vi: một chút / một ít / một chấm / một điểm

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: used to say that something is unpleasant, and will upset people who are squeamish
all_entries.translation: 不適宜神經脆弱的人的；易使人心煩意亂的

examples.en: "The Silence of the Lambs" is an entertaining movie but is not for the squeamish.
examples.trans: 《沈默的羔羊》是部很好看的電影，但非常暴力，不適合神經脆弱的人。

all_entries.meaning_vi: nghĩa đen: tim rối loạn, ý nghĩ hỗn loạn (thành ngữ); lo lắng bối rối
all_entries.translation_zh: 不適宜神經脆弱的人的；易使人心煩意亂的

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: UK also not for all the world never; not in any situation
all_entries.translation: 不管怎樣都不，無論如何都不

examples.en: If I took that job I'd have to leave the kids and I wouldn't do that for the world.
examples.trans: 如果我接受那份工作，就要必須離開孩子們，而我無論如何都不會那樣做。

all_entries.meaning_vi: dù sao đi nữa; bất kể chuyện gì xảy ra
all_entries.translation_zh: 不管怎樣都不，無論如何都不

all_entries.word: not get a word in edgeways
all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: to not be able to say anything because someone else is talking all the time

examples.en: Rosa was talking so much that nobody else could get a word in edgeways!
examples.trans: 羅茲話太多了，別人連一句話也插不進去。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không, cảm ơn (dùng để từ chối lịch sự nhưng không trang trọng)

all_entries.topic: Cảm xúc, Thái độ & Tâm lý (Emotions, Attitudes & Psychology)
all_entries.definition_en: If you don't/couldn't give a monkey's about something, you are not at all worried by it.
all_entries.translation: 一點都不在乎，完全無所謂

examples.en: "Chrissie won't like it." "I don't give a monkey's."
examples.trans: 「克麗茜不會喜歡它的。」「我才不在乎呢。」

all_entries.meaning_vi: không quan tâm
all_entries.translation_zh: 一點都不在乎，完全無所謂

all_entries.topic: Cảm xúc, Thái độ & Tâm lý (Emotions, Attitudes & Psychology)
all_entries.definition_en: to not be interested in or worried about something or someone
all_entries.translation: （對…）絲毫不感興趣；（對…）毫不在意

examples.en: I don't give a shit what he thinks.
examples.trans: 我他媽才不管奈傑爾怎麽想。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không chú ý / không bận tâm
all_entries.translation_zh: （對…）絲毫不感興趣；（對…）毫不在意

all_entries.word: not give a tinker s cuss
all_entries.topic: Cảm xúc, Thái độ & Tâm lý (Emotions, Attitudes & Psychology)
all_entries.definition_en: to not be interested in or worried about something or someone

examples.en: I couldn't give a tinker's cuss about what they think.
examples.trans: 我根本不在乎他們怎麼想。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không quan tâm

all_entries.word: not give much for sb s chances
all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: to not believe someone will succeed

examples.en: I wouldn't give much for his chances in the next race.
examples.trans: 我不大相信他在下一場比賽中會贏。

all_entries.meaning_vi: Trấn Thành Công hoặc trấn Chengkung ở huyện Đài Đông 臺東縣|台东县[Tai2 dong1 Xian4], đông nam Đài Loan

all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: to think that something will not succeed

examples.en: I wouldn't give tuppence for their chances of winning the match.
examples.trans: 我認為他們贏得這場比賽的機會很少。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không có khả năng / không có khả năng xảy ra / sẽ không (hành động, xảy ra v.v.) / không thể / không biết làm việc gì đó / (khẩu ngữ) (Đài Loan) đừng nhắc đến / không có chi

all_entries.word: not give budge move an inch
all_entries.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
all_entries.definition_en: to not change your opinion

examples.en: She's definite that she wants to do it, and she'll not give an inch, however hard you try to persuade her.
examples.trans: 她決意要做那件事，你無論怎樣勸她都不會改變心意。

all_entries.meaning_vi: (thành ngữ) không nhượng bộ dù chỉ một inch

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: informal used as a way of saying you do not care about something, especially the annoying things that someone else is doing or saying

examples.en: I don't give a damn what he thinks of me!
examples.trans: 他對我愛怎麼想就怎麼想——我才不在乎呢！

all_entries.meaning_vi: không quan tâm

all_entries.topic: Cảm xúc, Thái độ & Tâm lý (Emotions, Attitudes & Psychology)
all_entries.definition_en: to not be worried at all by something
all_entries.translation: 毫不介意；一點也不擔心

examples.en: I don't give a toss what he thinks.
examples.trans: 我根本不在乎他的想法。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không bận tâm (chút nào) / không quan tâm chút nào
all_entries.translation_zh: 毫不介意；一點也不擔心

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to dislike something

examples.en: I don't go much on white wine.
examples.trans: 我不愛喝白葡萄酒。

all_entries.meaning_vi: thích; ưa thích

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: to not start to think about or discuss a subject

examples.en: "Then there's the guilt I feel about leaving her for seven hours every day." "Don't even go there!"
examples.trans: 「還有，每天要有七個小時不跟她在一起，讓我感到十分歉疚。」「你不要再想這件事啦！」

all_entries.meaning_vi: không đếm xỉa tới (thành ngữ) / phớt lờ / bỏ qua một bên

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: used in spoken English to express a positive statement more strongly
all_entries.translation: （加強肯定語氣的口語表達）非常，很

examples.en: It wasn't half crowded in the club last night (= it was very crowded).
examples.trans: 俱樂部昨天晚上人滿爲患。

examples.en: She didn't half shout at him (= she shouted a lot at him).
examples.trans: 她衝著他大喊大叫！

all_entries.meaning_vi: củng cố; tăng cường; nâng cao
all_entries.translation_zh: （加強肯定語氣的口語表達）非常，很

all_entries.definition_en: to be completely unable to achieve something
all_entries.translation: 毫無機會，根本不可能做到

examples.en: They haven't a cat in hell's chance of getting over the mountain in weather like this.
examples.trans: 天氣如此，他們根本不可能翻越這座山。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không thể / không thể nào / không có khả năng
all_entries.translation_zh: 毫無機會，根本不可能做到

all_entries.meaning_vi: không thể nói
all_entries.translation_zh: 關於…說不出什麼好話；對…沒有任何好感

all_entries.word: not have a hope in hell
all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to have no possibility of doing or achieving something

examples.en: We were so outclassed - we didn't have a hope in hell of winning.
examples.trans: 我們差得太多了——根本就沒希望獲勝。

all_entries.meaning_vi: hy vọng / một hy vọng; một điều ước (LT:個|个[ge4])

all_entries.definition_en: to be in a situation in which you cannot prove something

examples.en: If you have no witnesses, you don't have a leg to stand on.
examples.trans: 如果沒有證人，你就無法證明。

all_entries.meaning_vi: dựa vào / cơ sở / nền tảng

all_entries.word: not have a pot to piss in
all_entries.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
all_entries.definition_en: to be very poor

examples.en: Any help we can offer them will be appreciated. They don't have a pot to piss in.
examples.trans: 他們會非常感謝我們提供的任何幫助，他們實在是窮得叮噹響。

all_entries.meaning_vi: cùng cực / nghèo khổ

all_entries.meaning_vi: Trấn Thành Công hoặc trấn Chengkung ở huyện Đài Đông 臺東縣|台东县[Tai2 dong1 Xian4], đông nam Đài Loan

all_entries.word: not have a snowball s chance in hell

all_entries.definition_en: to have no chance of succeeding

examples.en: If he can't afford a good lawyer, he doesn't have a snowball's chance in hell of winning the case.
examples.trans: 如果請不起好律師，他就不可能打贏這場官司。

all_entries.meaning_vi: có thể (xảy ra) / có khả năng / có xác suất / khả năng / xác suất / có lẽ / có thể

all_entries.word: not have a the ghost of a chance

all_entries.definition_en: to have no chance at all

examples.en: They don't have a ghost of a chance of winning.
examples.trans: 他們毫無勝算。

all_entries.meaning_vi: cơ hội / thời cơ / dịp

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: to be completely unwilling or to refuse

examples.en: I asked him to help out, but he wasn't having any of it.
examples.trans: 我請他來幫個忙，但是他不願意。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không sẵn lòng

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to not know or understand something at all
all_entries.translation: 完全不明白；一無所知；茫無頭緒

examples.en: I didn't have the foggiest idea what he was talking about.
examples.trans: 我完全不明白他在講甚麼。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không biết gì cả (thành ngữ); hoàn toàn ngu dốt / không một chút manh mối nào
all_entries.translation_zh: 完全不明白；一無所知；茫無頭緒

all_entries.word: not have the heart to do sth
all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to feel unable to do something because you feel it would be unkind

examples.en: She asked me to go with her and I didn't have the heart to refuse.
examples.trans: 她要我和她一起去，我不忍心拒絕她。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không thể chịu được

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to not know at all

examples.en: "Who's that?" "I haven't the remotest idea."
examples.trans: 「那人是誰？」「我壓根不認識他。」

all_entries.meaning_vi: không biết gì cả (thành ngữ); hoàn toàn ngu dốt / không một chút manh mối nào

all_entries.word: not have the stomach for sth

all_entries.definition_en: to not feel brave or determined enough to do something unpleasant
all_entries.translation: 沒有做…的勇氣；缺乏做…的決心

examples.en: I didn't have the stomach for another fight.
examples.trans: 我沒有勇氣再打一架。

all_entries.meaning_vi: can đảm / dũng khí
all_entries.translation_zh: 沒有做…的勇氣；缺乏做…的決心

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: If you say you will not hear of something, you mean you will not allow it, usually when you want to do something good for someone.
all_entries.translation: 拒絕接受，拒不答應（常指有好處的事）

examples.en: I wanted to pay but she wouldn't hear of it.
examples.trans: 我要付帳，但她不同意。

all_entries.meaning_vi: dễ hòa hợp
all_entries.translation_zh: 拒絕接受，拒不答應（常指有好處的事）

all_entries.word: not hear the end last of sth
all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to be told repeatedly about something

examples.en: We'll never hear the last of it if they win that competition.
examples.trans: 如果他們贏了那場比賽，我們的耳根就不得清靜了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không có kết thúc / không ngớt / tiếp diễn mãi

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to not approve of an idea or activity
all_entries.meaning_vi: không tán thành / phản đối

all_entries.word: not in a month of sundays
all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: If you say that something will not happen in a month of Sundays, you mean that it is very unlikely to happen.

examples.en: He's never going to get that finished in a month of Sundays!
examples.trans: 他才不會把它完成呢！

all_entries.meaning_vi: hầu như không / có vẻ không

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: If you say you know someone but not in the biblical sense, you mean you have not had sex with them.

examples.en: "Did you know her?" "Yes - not in the biblical sense, of course."
examples.trans: 「你以前認識她嗎？」「認識——不過我們之間沒有曖昧關係。」

all_entries.meaning_vi: quan hệ tình dục / tiếp xúc tình dục / giao hợp

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: not nearly as good as something or someone else

examples.en: She's a brilliant golfer - I'm not in the same league.
examples.trans: 她高爾夫球打得非常好——我比不上她。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không thể so sánh với

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to have never met someone and not know anything about them
all_entries.translation: 根本不知道（某人），與（某人）素不相識

examples.en: Why should she lend me money? She doesn't know me from Adam.
examples.trans: 她怎麼會借錢給我？她根本不認識我。

all_entries.meaning_vi: hoàn toàn xa lạ (thành ngữ)
all_entries.translation_zh: 根本不知道（某人），與（某人）素不相識

all_entries.word: not know the first thing about sth
all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to know nothing about a subject

examples.en: I'm afraid I don't know the first thing about car engines.
examples.trans: 恐怕我對汽車引擎一無所知。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không biết gì cả (thành ngữ); hoàn toàn ngu dốt / không một chút manh mối nào

all_entries.word: not know the half of it
all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: If someone does not know the half of it, they know that a situation is bad but do not know how serious it is.

examples.en: "I hear things aren't going too well at work." "You don't know the half of it!"
examples.trans: 「我聽說工作進展得不太順利。」「更糟的事你還不知道呢！」

all_entries.meaning_vi: không biết / không hay / vô tình / không thừa nhận (thất bại, khó khăn, mệt mỏi, v.v.)

all_entries.word: not know the meaning of the word
all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: If you are talking about a quality or an activity and you say that someone doesn't know the meaning of the word, you mean they do not have that quality or have no experience of that activity.
all_entries.translation: （某人對做某事）沒有經驗，一無所知；（某人）完全缺乏某種素質

examples.en: Work? He doesn't know the meaning of the word!
examples.trans: 工作？他根本就不懂甚麼叫做工作。

examples.en: And the irony of Phil talking about ethics. He doesn't know the meaning of the word.
examples.trans: 菲爾談論道德規範簡直是個諷刺。他本身根本就是一個沒有道德的人。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không biết gì cả (thành ngữ); hoàn toàn ngu dốt / không một chút manh mối nào
all_entries.translation_zh: （某人對做某事）沒有經驗，一無所知；（某人）完全缺乏某種素質

all_entries.word: not know what has hit you
all_entries.topic: Cảm xúc, Thái độ & Tâm lý (Emotions, Attitudes & Psychology)
all_entries.definition_en: to be shocked and surprised because something unpleasant suddenly and unexpectedly happens to you

examples.en: You wait till he starts working for Michael - he won't know what's hit him!
examples.trans: 你等到他開始為邁克爾工作時——他就會不知所措了！

all_entries.meaning_vi: bối rối / luống cuống / mất bình tĩnh

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to feel shocked or confused because something bad has happened to you suddenly when you were not expecting it
all_entries.translation: 過度驚嚇而無法反應，嚇呆了
all_entries.meaning_vi: phản ứng / đáp lại / phản hồi / trả lời / phản ứng hóa học
all_entries.translation_zh: 過度驚嚇而無法反應，嚇呆了

all_entries.word: not know what sb sees in sb sth
all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: to not understand why someone likes a particular person or thing
all_entries.translation: 不明白（某人）喜歡…的哪一點

examples.en: He's so boring - I don't know what she sees in him.
examples.trans: 他這個人非常乏味－－我不明白她看上他哪一點。

all_entries.meaning_vi: một chút / một ít / một chấm / một điểm
all_entries.translation_zh: 不明白（某人）喜歡…的哪一點

all_entries.word: not know where to put yourself
all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to feel very embarrassed

examples.en: And then he started to sing. Well, I didn't know where to put myself.
examples.trans: 接著他開始唱歌。唉，我簡直尷尬極了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không yên / bất ổn / bất an / rối bời / bồn chồn / lo lắng

all_entries.word: not know where which way to turn
all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to not know what to do or who to ask for help
all_entries.translation: 不知所措；不知該求助何人

examples.en: When both her parents died, she didn't know which way to turn.
examples.trans: 她父母雙雙去世，她不知道該如何是好。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không biết phải làm sao (thành ngữ); hết cách / bối rối và hoàn toàn lúng túng
all_entries.translation_zh: 不知所措；不知該求助何人

all_entries.word: not know whether to laugh or cry
all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to not know how to react in a particular situation
all_entries.translation: 哭笑不得；不知如何是好

examples.en: When she told me they were getting married I didn't know whether to laugh or cry.
examples.trans: 當她告訴我他們要結婚時，我簡直不知該如何是好。

all_entries.meaning_vi: nghĩa đen: không biết nên khóc hay cười (thành ngữ) / vừa buồn cười vừa cực kỳ xấu hổ / giữa tiếng cười và nước mắt
all_entries.translation_zh: 哭笑不得；不知如何是好

all_entries.word: not know whether you are coming or going
all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to be in a very confused state
all_entries.translation: 無所適從，不知該怎麼辦

examples.en: I'm so busy, I don't know whether I'm coming or going.
examples.trans: 我很忙，不知道該怎麼辦。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không biết theo hướng nào (thành ngữ); bối rối không biết làm gì
all_entries.translation_zh: 無所適從，不知該怎麼辦

all_entries.word: not know your arse from your elbow
all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: to be stupid and unable to understand very simple things
all_entries.meaning_vi: ngớ ngẩn / ngu ngốc

all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: to fail or be unsuccessful very soon

examples.en: You won't last long in your job if you carry on being so rude to the customers.
examples.trans: 如果你繼續這樣粗暴地對待顧客，那麽你這份工作就做不了多久了。

examples.en: He wouldn't last five minutes in the police force - it's far too tough for him.
examples.trans: 他在警察隊伍裡留不了多久——他受不了那份苦。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không, cảm ơn (dùng để từ chối lịch sự nhưng không trang trọng)

all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: to not make any effort to help
all_entries.translation: 不（肯）幫一點忙，不（願）盡舉手之勞

examples.en: He never lifts a finger to help with the housework.
examples.trans: 他從不幫忙做家務。

all_entries.meaning_vi: nghĩa đen: dùng sức nhấc tay (thành ngữ) / nghĩa bóng: nỗ lực rất nhỏ
all_entries.translation_zh: 不（肯）幫一點忙，不（願）盡舉手之勞

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: If someone is not long for this world, they will die soon.
all_entries.translation: 行將就木的，將不久於人世的
all_entries.meaning_vi: gần đất xa trời; một chân bước vào mộ
all_entries.translation_zh: 行將就木的，將不久於人世的

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to not be important

examples.en: It doesn't matter tuppence what you think.
examples.trans: 你的看法一點也不重要。

all_entries.meaning_vi: quan trọng; đáng kể; chính yếu

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: to say what you mean clearly and directly, even if you upset people by doing this
all_entries.translation: 直截了當地說，直言不諱
all_entries.meaning_vi: trực tiếp và thẳng thắn (thành ngữ); bộc trực / thẳng thắn
all_entries.translation_zh: 直截了當地說，直言不諱

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to not pause or show any uncertainty, usually when this is surprising
all_entries.translation: （尤指令人驚訝地）沒有稍作停頓；一點沒有遲疑

examples.en: The player hasn't missed a beat this year, scoring three touchdowns in his first three games.
examples.trans: 這名隊員今年沒有一點錯失，在頭三場比賽中就已三次觸地得分。

all_entries.meaning_vi: một chút / một ít / một chấm / một điểm
all_entries.translation_zh: （尤指令人驚訝地）沒有稍作停頓；一點沒有遲疑

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: mainly US to do something without any mistakes or failures

examples.en: The player hasn't missed a beat this year, scoring three touchdowns in his first three games.
examples.trans: 這名隊員今年沒有一點錯失，在頭三場比賽中就已三次觸地得分。

all_entries.meaning_vi: một chút; có phần

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: said about someone who never fails to notice and take advantage of a good opportunity

examples.en: Jonathan doesn't miss a trick! If there's a bargain to be had, he'll find it.
examples.trans: 喬納森從不錯失良機！如果市場上有便宜貨，他一定會找到的。

all_entries.meaning_vi: giỏi về; thành thạo

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: said when something you failed to see or experience was not important or special
all_entries.translation: （用以表示所錯過的並不重要）沒錯過什麼，沒什麼大不了的，沒什麼可遺憾的

examples.en: "I didn't manage to see that programme." "Don't worry, you didn't miss much."
examples.trans: 「我錯過了那個節目。」「別擔心，你沒錯過什麼。」

all_entries.meaning_vi: tệ nhất thì; nếu tệ nhất xảy ra / (thường dùng ở phủ định) nghiêm trọng; đáng lo ngại
all_entries.translation_zh: （用以表示所錯過的並不重要）沒錯過什麼，沒什麼大不了的，沒什麼可遺憾的

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to stay completely still

examples.en: She sat without moving a muscle as the nurse put the needle in.
examples.trans: 當護士將針頭紮入時，她坐著一動也沒動。

all_entries.meaning_vi: bất động

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: said as a way of strongly refusing someone's suggestion or request

examples.en: "So you're going to bring Kev, are you?" "Not on your life!"
examples.trans: 「你會把蓋烏帶來的，是不是？」「休想！」

all_entries.meaning_vi: không được / không thể chấp nhận / không tốt / không hiệu quả / không có khả năng

all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: to speak in an honest way without trying to be kind

examples.en: Her image is that of an investigative reporter who doesn't pull any punches.
examples.trans: 她是位專寫調查報道的記者，給人的印象是說話從來都直言不諱。

all_entries.meaning_vi: nói thẳng thắn (thành ngữ) / không quanh co

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to not make any mistakes
all_entries.meaning_vi: bất kỳ; bất cứ; nào cũng được

all_entries.word: not put it past sb to do sth
all_entries.topic: Cảm xúc, Thái độ & Tâm lý (Emotions, Attitudes & Psychology)
all_entries.definition_en: to not be surprised if someone does something bad, because it is a typical thing for that person to do

examples.en: Perhaps Helena told him - I wouldn't put it past her.
examples.trans: 可能是海倫娜告訴他的——我相信她做得出來。

all_entries.meaning_vi: điều xấu; việc xấu / phá hỏng việc

all_entries.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
all_entries.definition_en: If you cannot put a book down, you are unable to stop reading it until you reach the end.
all_entries.translation: 捨不得放下（書），對（書）愛不釋手

examples.en: It was so exciting from the first page I couldn't put it down.
examples.trans: 這本書從一開始就引人入勝，我簡直愛不釋手。

all_entries.meaning_vi: (thành ngữ) thích đến mức không muốn đặt xuống; thấy cái gì đó hoàn toàn không thể cưỡng lại
all_entries.translation_zh: 捨不得放下（書），對（書）愛不釋手

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: US informal to say nothing

examples.en: You didn't say boo to me about going to your mother's this weekend.
examples.trans: 你從沒和我提起過這個週末要去看你母親的事情。

all_entries.meaning_vi: một câu / ngắn gọn

all_entries.topic: Cảm xúc, Thái độ & Tâm lý (Emotions, Attitudes & Psychology)
all_entries.definition_en: US also be afraid to say boo, UK not say boo to a goose informal to be very nervous and easily frightened

examples.en: You didn't say boo to me about going to your mother's this weekend.
examples.trans: 你從沒和我提起過這個週末要去看你母親的事情。

all_entries.meaning_vi: nhát gan / nhút nhát

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to have all your attention on something and therefore be unable to consider other things

examples.en: The government cannot see beyond next year's election.
examples.trans: 政府只關心明年的大選。

all_entries.meaning_vi: quan tâm đến; chăm sóc

all_entries.definition_en: to not see someone at all over a period of time
all_entries.translation: 根本沒見過（某人）的影子

examples.en: I haven't seen hide nor hair of her since last Friday.
examples.trans: 自上週五開始我就根本沒有見過她。

all_entries.meaning_vi: bóng / phản chiếu / (nghĩa bóng) gợi ý / dấu hiệu / ảnh hưởng
all_entries.translation_zh: 根本沒見過（某人）的影子

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: used to describe someone leaving quickly in order to avoid something
all_entries.translation: （某人）逃之夭夭；（某人）躲得不見人影

examples.en: If you let him know that Margaret's coming, you won't see him for dust.
examples.trans: 要是你讓他知道瑪格麗特會來，他一定會溜之大吉。

all_entries.meaning_vi: trốn thoát không dấu vết (thành ngữ); tẩu thoát khỏi hiện trường (tội ác) / chạy trốn nhanh chóng
all_entries.translation_zh: （某人）逃之夭夭；（某人）躲得不見人影

examples.en: In financial planning you need to look beyond the end of your nose.
examples.trans: 做財務規劃時，你不能只顧眼前。

examples.en: I don't think his vision for the company goes beyond the end of his nose.
examples.trans: 我覺得他對公司的願景缺乏深謀遠慮。

all_entries.meaning_vi: thiển cận

all_entries.word: not set the world on fire

examples.en: He has a nice enough voice but he's not going to set the world on fire.
examples.trans: 他的聲音夠好聽，但還不能一鳴驚人。

all_entries.meaning_vi: kinh ngạc thế giới với một kỳ tích xuất sắc (thành ngữ); nổi tiếng sau một đêm

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: If you say that something is not so much one thing as something else, you mean it is more the second thing.

examples.en: They're not so much lovers as friends.
examples.trans: 他們與其說是戀人，不如說是朋友。

examples.en: I don't feel angry so much as sad.
examples.trans: 與其說我憤怒，例不如說我悲哀。

all_entries.meaning_vi: thà rằng ... / chi bằng ...

all_entries.word: not so shabby not too shabby

all_entries.definition_en: used for saying that something is good

examples.en: It was a not so shabby week for the team, who had three wins.
examples.trans: 這個隊本週還不錯，已經贏了三場。

all_entries.meaning_vi: (khẩu ngữ) không tệ / tốt / ổn

all_entries.definition_en: to not become involved in something unpleasant or bad
all_entries.translation: 不沾染汙點，不參與不好的事情

examples.en: These were top lawyers, the kind who wouldn't normally soil their hands with police work or criminal law.
examples.trans: 這些是頂級律師，他們一般不會插手警務和觸犯刑法。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không tốt
all_entries.translation_zh: 不沾染汙點，不參與不好的事情

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: to refuse to accept bad or silly behaviour

examples.en: The new teacher won't stand any nonsense.
examples.trans: 新老師不容許任何人搗亂。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không được / không thể / không cho phép / không thể dung thứ

all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)

all_entries.translation: 不願遷就笨人，不能容忍愚蠢者
all_entries.meaning_vi: không thể / không được / không nên
all_entries.translation_zh: 不願遷就笨人，不能容忍愚蠢者

all_entries.word: not take a blind bit of notice
all_entries.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
all_entries.definition_en: to pay no attention to something

examples.en: He didn't take a blind bit of notice of what I said.
examples.trans: 他對我説的話毫不在意。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không chú ý / không để ý

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: to refuse to be treated badly by someone

examples.en: He can't treat you like that! Surely you're not going to take that lying down!
examples.trans: 他不能那樣對待你！你當然不能受這個氣！

all_entries.meaning_vi: cam chịu nghịch cảnh (thành ngữ); cười mà chịu đựng / ngậm đắng nuốt cay trước sự lăng mạ, ngược đãi, sỉ nhục, v.v.

all_entries.word: not take your eyes off sb sth
all_entries.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
all_entries.definition_en: to not stop looking at someone or something
all_entries.translation: 無法將目光從…移開；盯著…看

examples.en: He was so handsome - I couldn't take my eyes off him.
examples.trans: 他太英俊了——我無法將目光從他身上移開。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không thể; không có khả năng
all_entries.translation_zh: 無法將目光從…移開；盯著…看

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: used when answering a question to mean that, judging from the information you have, the answer is no
all_entries.translation: 據我所知並非如此，據我所知沒有

examples.en: "Is she especially unhappy at school?" "Not that I know of."
examples.trans: 「她在學校特別不高興嗎？」「據我所知沒有。」

all_entries.meaning_vi: theo như tôi biết / theo như tôi được biết
all_entries.translation_zh: 據我所知並非如此，據我所知沒有

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: used to say you are not suggesting something

examples.en: She wouldn't tell me how much it cost - not that I was really interested.
examples.trans: 她不願告訴我這花了多少錢——我並不真的想知道。

examples.en: Not that I mind, but why didn't you call yesterday?
examples.trans: 雖然我不介意，但你昨天為甚麼不打電話？

all_entries.meaning_vi: không phải / không phải là

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: used to say you do not think something is important
all_entries.translation: （用於表示認為某事不重要）並非

examples.en: She wouldn't tell me how much it cost - not that I was really interested.
examples.trans: 她不願告訴我這花了多少錢——我並不真的想知道。

examples.en: Not that I mind, but why didn't you call yesterday?
examples.trans: 雖然我不介意，但你昨天為甚麼不打電話？

all_entries.meaning_vi: thật sự không phải
all_entries.translation_zh: （用於表示認為某事不重要）並非

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: not socially acceptable

examples.en: Smoking during a meal is not the done thing.
examples.trans: 吃飯時吸煙是不禮貌的。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không phù hợp với / không thích hợp với / không khớp với / không nên / không đáng

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: used for emphasis with nouns
all_entries.translation: （與名詞連用，表示強調）一點也不

examples.en: I haven't the least idea (= I do not know) who he was.
examples.trans: 他是誰我一點都不知道。

examples.en: She hasn't the least interest (= she has no interest) in the project.
examples.trans: 她對該專案一點興趣都沒有。

all_entries.meaning_vi: một chút / một ít / một chấm / một điểm
all_entries.translation_zh: （與名詞連用，表示強調）一點也不

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: not as good
all_entries.translation: 不那麽令人愉快的，不那麽合人意的

examples.en: You can make shortbread with margarine instead of butter, but it isn't the same.
examples.trans: 你可以用人造牛油代替牛油製作甜酥餅，不過口味會差一點。

all_entries.meaning_vi: kỳ vọng của mọi người
all_entries.translation_zh: 不那麽令人愉快的，不那麽合人意的

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: not wanting someone else to do something better than you
all_entries.translation: 不甘落後，不服輸，不甘示弱

examples.en: Pat was wearing an outrageous purple dress, so, not to be outdone, I put on my new gold suit.
examples.trans: 派特穿了件前衛惹火的紫色連衣裙，我不甘示弱，穿上了那套新買的金色套裝。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không chịu thua kém
all_entries.translation_zh: 不甘落後，不服輸，不甘示弱

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: If you say that something, especially an amount of money, is not to be sneezed at, you mean that it is a large enough amount to be worth having.

examples.trans: 該設計從理論上看起來的確很不錯。

all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: to try to persuade or force someone to do something
all_entries.translation: 勸說（某人）；給（某人）施加壓力
all_entries.meaning_vi: gây áp lực / tăng áp lực
all_entries.translation_zh: 勸說（某人）；給（某人）施加壓力

all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: If something that happens puts the lid on a plan, it causes the plan to fail.

examples.en: Well, James' resignation just about puts the lid on it/the project.
examples.trans: 詹姆斯的辭職幾乎使它／該專案流産。

all_entries.meaning_vi: bị đánh bại / thua / thất bại (ví dụ: thí nghiệm) / sự thất bại / sự thua cuộc

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to throw a heavy metal ball as far as possible in a sports competition

examples.en: He won the gold medal for putting the shot.
examples.trans: 他獲得了鉛球項目的金牌。

all_entries.meaning_vi: môn đẩy tạ (điền kinh)

all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: to cause something such as a plan to fail

examples.en: Local residents have put the skids under plans to build a new shopping centre.
examples.trans: 當地居民的反對使得建造新購物中心的計劃泡了湯。

all_entries.meaning_vi: bị đánh bại / thua / thất bại (ví dụ: thí nghiệm) / sự thất bại / sự thua cuộc

all_entries.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
all_entries.definition_en: to ask someone to give you money

examples.en: She put the squeeze on her mother for a hundred bucks.
examples.trans: 她向她媽媽要了100美元。

examples.en: The insurance company put the bite on me for a huge increase in my premium after I crashed the car.
examples.trans: 我把車撞壞以後，保險公司對我收取的保險費提高了很多。

all_entries.meaning_vi: một người nào đó / một người nhất định / một số người / tôi (xưng hô sau họ của một người)

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: UK also put the word around/round/about to tell people a new piece of news

examples.en: So, the new manager has been appointed - should we put the word out?
examples.trans: 那麼，已經任命了新的經理——我們應不應該公佈這消息？

all_entries.meaning_vi: truyền ra ngoài / phát tán / dẫn ly (dây thần kinh)

all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: If two or more people put their heads together, they plan something together.
all_entries.translation: 共同出謀劃策，集思廣益

examples.en: If we put our heads together, we can think of a solution.
examples.trans: 如果我們一起動腦筋，會想出解決辦法的。

all_entries.meaning_vi: đưa ra kế hoạch và ý tưởng (cũng mang nghĩa chê bai) / đưa ra lời khuyên (thành ngữ)
all_entries.translation_zh: 共同出謀劃策，集思廣益

all_entries.word: put two and two together and make five
all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: to understand a particular situation wrongly, often in a way that is more shocking or exciting than the truth

examples.en: "Why in the world did she think you were pregnant?" "I was sick a couple of times, and I guess she just put two and two together and made five."
examples.trans: 「她究竟為甚麼會認為你懷孕？」「我曾嘔吐過一兩次，我猜她就這樣想了。」

all_entries.meaning_vi: nghĩa đen: tin có mưa khi nghe gió (thành ngữ) / tin đồn / dễ tin

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: to guess the truth about a situation from what you have seen or heard
all_entries.translation: 根據現有情況推論；綜合判斷

examples.en: "How did you know they were having an affair?" "I'd seen them out together a couple of times, so I just put two and two together."
examples.trans: 「你怎麼知道他們有婚外情?」「我好幾次見到他們一起外出，所以就這麼推斷。」

all_entries.meaning_vi: phán đoán / xác định / phán xét
all_entries.translation_zh: 根據現有情況推論；綜合判斷

all_entries.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
all_entries.definition_en: to stay somewhere for the night

examples.en: We put up at a small hotel for the night.
examples.trans: 我們在一家小旅館裡過夜。

all_entries.meaning_vi: qua đêm / trọn đêm

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: If you say someone should put up or shut up, you mean that they should either take action in order to do what they have been talking about, or stop talking about it.
all_entries.translation: 採取行動（如果你說某人應「採取行動」或「閉嘴」，你的意思是說，他們要麼採取行動來實踐他們所說的事情，要麼停止談論這些事情）

examples.en: You keep saying you're going to ask her out. Well, put up or shut up.
examples.trans: 你老是說要約她出來。那就去呀！否則就閉嘴。

all_entries.meaning_vi: thực hiện hành động / áp dụng chính sách / tiến hành giải quyết vấn đề
all_entries.translation_zh: 採取行動（如果你說某人應「採取行動」或「閉嘴」，你的意思是說，他們要麼採取行動來實踐他們所說的事情，要麼停止談論這些事情）

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: to show or express a particular type of opposition to something

examples.en: The villagers were unable to put up any resistance to the invading troops.
examples.trans: 村民沒有能力對侵略軍進行任何抵抗。

examples.en: We're not going to let them build a road here without putting up a fight.
examples.trans: 他們要在這裡修築公路，我們不會輕易讓他們得逞。

all_entries.meaning_vi: phản đối; chống lại

all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: having to do more than is fair in order to allow other people to get what they want in a situation

examples.en: I don't mind helping them, but I can't help feeling a little put upon.
examples.trans: 我不介意幫他們，但難免感到有點被利用了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: ra lệnh cho ai một cách tùy tiện / (khẩu ngữ) điều khiển (động vật kéo, công cụ, máy móc, v.v.) / cách phát âm ở Đài Loan: [shi3 huan4]

all_entries.word: put words in into sb s mouth
all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to suggest that someone meant one thing when really they meant another
all_entries.translation: 曲解（某人）的話，故意歪曲（某人）的話

examples.en: Stop putting words in my mouth - I didn't say you looked fat in the red dress - I merely said you looked very slim in the black!
examples.trans: 別曲解我的話——我並不是說你穿紅色顯胖——我只是說你穿黑色顯得非常苗條！

all_entries.meaning_vi: cố ý; có chủ đích
all_entries.translation_zh: 曲解（某人）的話，故意歪曲（某人）的話

all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: If something puts years on a person, it makes them appear much older.

examples.en: Being tired and unhappy puts years on you.
examples.trans: 疲勞和憂鬱會使你顯得蒼老。

all_entries.meaning_vi: một người nào đó / một người nhất định / một số người / tôi (xưng hô sau họ của một người)

all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: to use a lot of physical effort to try to do something

examples.en: You could dig this plot in an afternoon if you really put your back into it.
examples.trans: 如果你賣力做的話，一下午就能挖完這塊地。

all_entries.meaning_vi: nói chung; hơn kém; về đại thể; cơ bản; nhìn chung / tình hình tổng thể; bức tranh toàn cảnh / tử thi để giải phẫu trong đào tạo sinh viên y khoa

all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: to try as hard as you can
all_entries.meaning_vi: làm bằng mọi giá / nỗ lực hết mình

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to relax, especially by sitting with your feet supported above the ground

examples.en: You go home and put your feet up.
examples.trans: 親愛的，你回家後好好休息。

all_entries.meaning_vi: nghỉ / nghỉ ngơi

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: UK US put your foot in your mouth to say something by accident that embarrasses or upsets someone
all_entries.translation: 無意中說出讓人尷尬（或生氣）的話

examples.en: I really put my foot in my mouth – I asked her if Jane was her mother, but she said Jane is her sister.
examples.trans: 我真的讓自己無地自容：我問她簡是不是她母親，但是她說簡是她姐姐。

all_entries.meaning_vi: một cách tình cờ / không cố ý / không ngờ tới
all_entries.translation_zh: 無意中說出讓人尷尬（或生氣）的話

all_entries.word: put your hand in your pocket
all_entries.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
all_entries.definition_en: to give money to someone or to charity (= organizations that collect money to give to poor people, ill people, etc.)

examples.en: People are more inclined to put their hands in their pockets to help children.
examples.trans: 人們更傾向於捐款幫助兒童。

all_entries.meaning_vi: tổ chức từ thiện

all_entries.word: put your head over above the parapet
all_entries.topic: Cảm xúc, Thái độ & Tâm lý (Emotions, Attitudes & Psychology)
all_entries.definition_en: to be brave enough to state an opinion that might upset someone
all_entries.meaning_vi: liều lĩnh / táo bạo / quá đáng / can đảm / dũng cảm / không sợ hãi

all_entries.word: put your heart and soul into sth
all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: to make a lot of effort to do something

examples.en: She puts her heart and soul into her work.
examples.trans: 她是那種全心投入工作中的人。

all_entries.meaning_vi: hết lòng hết dạ / toàn tâm toàn ý

all_entries.word: put your money where your mouth is
all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to show by your actions and not just your words that you support or believe in something
all_entries.translation: 以實際行動支持；以行動證明自己的話
all_entries.meaning_vi: thực tế / thực hành / thực tiễn / thực / sự thật
all_entries.translation_zh: 以實際行動支持；以行動證明自己的話

all_entries.word: put your neck on the line
all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: to do something that you know might fail and spoil other people's opinion of you or cause you to lose money
all_entries.translation: 冒（失敗、名譽受損或金錢損失）的風險

examples.en: There's a lot of money at stake here and none of the partners wants to put his neck on the line.
examples.trans: 這牽涉到一大筆錢，沒有任何一位合夥人願意承擔這個風險。

examples.en: No one wants to put their neck on the line and predict an outcome.
examples.trans: 沒人願意冒險預測結果。

all_entries.meaning_vi: bị tổn hại
all_entries.translation_zh: 冒（失敗、名譽受損或金錢損失）的風險

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to feel very certain that something will happen

examples.en: I'd put my shirt on the president being re-elected.
examples.trans: 我肯定總統會再次當選。

all_entries.meaning_vi: xảy ra; xảy đến; diễn ra; bùng phát

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to think seriously about something

examples.en: I need some interesting suggestions so if you can put your thinking cap on I'd be grateful.
examples.trans: 我需要一些有意思的建議，如果你能幫我好好想想，我會很感激。

all_entries.meaning_vi: suy nghĩ kỹ / cân nhắc / sự cân nhắc

all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: to express your ideas and opinions clearly so that people understand them and realize what you are like as a person
all_entries.translation: 清楚表達自己的想法（或觀點）

examples.en: I don't think I managed to put myself across very well in my interview.
examples.trans: 我覺得面試時我沒有把自己的意思表達清楚。

all_entries.meaning_vi: cách nghĩ; ý kiến; quan niệm / nghĩ cách (làm gì đó)
all_entries.translation_zh: 清楚表達自己的想法（或觀點）

all_entries.word: put yourself in sb s place position shoes
all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: to imagine how someone else feels in a difficult situation

examples.en: Put yourself in my place - what else could I have done?
examples.trans: 你站在我的角度想想，我還能做甚麼呢？

all_entries.meaning_vi: một người nào đó / một người nhất định / một số người / tôi (xưng hô sau họ của một người)

all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: to make an effort to do something to help someone, even if it is not convenient

examples.en: Ethan is always willing to put himself out for other people.
examples.trans: 伊森總是願意盡力幫助別人。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không tiếc công sức (thành ngữ); làm hết sức mình

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: an unkind remark that makes someone seem silly

examples.en: One of the big put-downs of the presidential election campaign was the comment that he was "no Jack Kennedy".
examples.trans: 美國總統競選活動中最厲害的奚落語之一就是他「絕不是傑克•甘迺迪」。

all_entries.meaning_vi: chế nhạo / chế giễu / chọc ghẹo / đối xử lạnh nhạt / bỏ rơi

all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: an attempt to deceive someone into believing something that is not true

examples.en: She's not really angry - it's just a put-on.
examples.trans: 她沒有真的生氣，這只不過是裝出來的。

all_entries.meaning_vi: giả vờ / giả đò

all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: an attempt to trick or deceive someone

examples.en: The hotel looked like a good investment, but it turned out that the whole thing was a put-up job.
examples.trans: 這個旅馆看上去像是個不錯的投資，但後來發現整件事只是一場騙局。

all_entries.meaning_vi: kế hoạch xấu / xảo kế

all_entries.word: put get sb s back up
all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to annoy someone

examples.en: Just ignore him - he's only trying to put your back up.
examples.trans: 別理他——他只是在成心惹你生氣。

all_entries.meaning_vi: một người nào đó / một người nhất định / một số người / tôi (xưng hô sau họ của một người)

all_entries.word: put get the wind up sb
all_entries.topic: Cảm xúc, Thái độ & Tâm lý (Emotions, Attitudes & Psychology)
all_entries.definition_en: to make someone feel worried about their situation
all_entries.translation: 使（某人）變得緊張（或害怕）

examples.en: Tell them your father's a policeman - that'll put the wind up them!
examples.trans: 告訴他們你爸爸是員警——那會令他們害怕！

all_entries.meaning_vi: sợ hãi; lo sợ
all_entries.translation_zh: 使（某人）變得緊張（或害怕）

all_entries.word: put lay sth on the line
all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: to risk something

examples.en: Firefighters put their lives on the line every working day.
examples.trans: 消防隊員每天上班都要冒著生命危險。

all_entries.meaning_vi: mạo hiểm

all_entries.word: put lay your cards on the table
all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: to be honest about your feelings and intentions
all_entries.translation: 攤牌，（把想法和意圖）和盤托出

examples.en: I thought it was time I laid my cards on the table, so I told him that I had no intention of marrying him.
examples.trans: 我覺得到攤牌的時候了，於是就告訴了他我並不打算嫁給他。

all_entries.meaning_vi: nghĩa đen: bày ra mọi thứ kể cả mâm / tiết lộ mọi thứ / thú nhận tất cả
all_entries.translation_zh: 攤牌，（把想法和意圖）和盤托出

all_entries.word: put leave sb in the shade
all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: to be so good that another person or thing does not seem important or worth very much
all_entries.translation: 使黯然失色，使相形見絀

examples.en: Although I thought I'd done well, my sister's exam results put mine in the shade.
examples.trans: 儘管我認爲自己考得不錯，但我妹妹的考試成績讓我相形見絀。

all_entries.meaning_vi: bị lu mờ khi so sánh (thành ngữ)
all_entries.translation_zh: 使黯然失色，使相形見絀

all_entries.word: put leave sth on to one side
all_entries.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
all_entries.definition_en: to stop talking about a particular subject

examples.en: Can we leave the issue of pay on one side for the moment?
examples.trans: 我們能不能暫時不談工資的事情？

all_entries.meaning_vi: một bên / mỗi bên / một mặt / mặt khác / vừa làm vừa

all_entries.word: put place your faith in sth sb
all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: to make a decision to trust something or someone

examples.en: Some people put their faith in strong leaders rather than sound policies.
examples.trans: 一些人相信強而有力的領導者，而不相信健全的政策。

all_entries.meaning_vi: tin tưởng / có niềm tin vào

all_entries.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
all_entries.definition_en: to start to write

examples.en: It's time you put pen to paper and replied to that letter from your mother.
examples.trans: 該動筆給你媽媽回信了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: bắt đầu / khởi đầu / ban đầu / lúc đầu

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to write

examples.en: Everyone should put pencil to paper and complain about the proposal.
examples.trans: 每個人都應該把對這項建議的不滿寫出來。

all_entries.meaning_vi: viết

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: to stop someone believing something that is not true, or to correct someone by telling them the truth
all_entries.translation: 糾正（某人）的錯誤想法；使（某人）明白正確的道理

examples.en: She thought she wouldn't have to work hard, but we soon put her right on that.
examples.trans: 她認為不需要努力工作，但是我們很快就糾正了她這種錯誤的想法。

examples.en: A good night's sleep will soon put you right.
examples.trans: 你好好睡一宿，很快就會恢復的。

all_entries.meaning_vi: cách nghĩ; ý kiến; quan niệm / nghĩ cách (làm gì đó)
all_entries.translation_zh: 糾正（某人）的錯誤想法；使（某人）明白正確的道理

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: If liquid runs over, it flows over the edges of something, because there is too much of it.

examples.en: The water/The bath is running over - quick, turn the taps off.
examples.trans: 水／洗澡水溢出來了——快，關掉水龍頭。

all_entries.meaning_vi: tràn ra, trào ra (chậu nước...); chạy đè lên; chẹt phải (ai...) (ôtô); lướt (ngón tay trên phím đàn...)

all_entries.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
all_entries.definition_en: to continue after the expected finishing time

examples.en: We're starting to run over time, so could you keep your speeches short, please.
examples.trans: 恐怕我們要超時了，你可否將發言縮短？

all_entries.meaning_vi: vượt qua / vượt quá / vượt trội

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: If someone runs rings round you, they are very much better, faster, or more successful at something than you are.
all_entries.translation: 遙遙領先（某人）；比（某人）出色得多

examples.en: Our girls' hockey team have run rings round all their opponents this year.
examples.trans: 我們的女子曲棍球隊今年的表現遠遠超過任何對手。

all_entries.meaning_vi: dẫn trước một khoảng cách lớn; dẫn đầu với cách biệt lớn

all_entries.definition_en: to be very active but with few results
all_entries.translation: 做無用功，徒勞無功；在原地兜圈子

examples.en: We've been running round in circles trying to get the information we need, but no-one will tell us anything.
examples.trans: 我們徒勞地試圖找到需要的資訊，但是沒有任何人願意告訴我們。

all_entries.meaning_vi: làm việc không có kết quả (thành ngữ)

all_entries.meaning_vi: vận động viên đánh bóng (bóng chày, cricket, v.v.)

all_entries.word: run sb out of town on a rail

all_entries.definition_en: to force someone to leave a town

examples.en: The sheriff and his men ran the horse thieves out of town.
examples.trans: 治安官和他的手下把那些偷馬賊趕出鎮去。

all_entries.meaning_vi: thị trấn nhỏ

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: If you run someone ragged, you make them very tired, usually by giving them too much work or work that is too demanding.
all_entries.translation: （通常透過給某人沈重或艱巨的工作）使（某人）筋疲力盡，壓得（某人）透不過氣來

examples.en: The kids have run me ragged this week - I'm glad they're going back to school tomorrow.
examples.trans: 這一星期孩子們可把我累壞了——他們明天就要回學校上學了，我真開心。

all_entries.meaning_vi: cơ thể mệt mỏi, kiệt sức (thành ngữ); cực kỳ mệt mỏi / kiệt quệ

all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: to push a sword or similar pointed weapon right into a person or animal

examples.en: He drew his sword and ran the villain through.
examples.trans: 他拔出劍來，一下子刺進了那個惡棍的胸膛。

all_entries.meaning_vi: xuyên qua / đâm xuyên / xuyên thủng

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to find someone or something after a lot of searching and problems
all_entries.translation: 經過艱難調查而發現；經過艱苦努力而搜尋到

examples.en: Detectives finally ran the terrorists to ground in an apartment building in Chicago.
examples.trans: 偵探們曆盡艱辛終於在芝加哥的一座公寓樓內挖出了恐怖分子。

all_entries.meaning_vi: nỗ lực; cố gắng; phấn đấu / chăm chỉ; tận tụy
all_entries.translation_zh: 經過艱難調查而發現；經過艱苦努力而搜尋到

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: to tell someone about something so that that person can give their opinion about it
all_entries.translation: 對（某人）說…（以聽取對方意見）；向（某人）徵求對…的看法；就…請教（某人）

examples.en: Would you run your idea by me one more time?
examples.trans: 你能不能再跟我說一遍你的想法？

all_entries.meaning_vi: người kia; bên kia; phía bên kia
all_entries.translation_zh: 對（某人）說…（以聽取對方意見）；向（某人）徵求對…的看法；就…請教（某人）

examples.en: [ + two objects ] Could you run me off five copies of this, please?
examples.trans: 替我把這個複印五份好嗎？

examples.en: Kate can run off a sonnet in half an hour on any subject you like.
examples.trans: 只要你定好一個題材，凱特都能在半小時內信筆寫成一首十四行詩。

all_entries.meaning_vi: sao chép / tạo bản sao tài liệu

all_entries.translation: 下筆如神（快速地、容易地寫出某些內容，這些內容通常寫起來較慢且難，如詩或音樂）

examples.en: [ + two objects ] Could you run me off five copies of this, please?
examples.trans: 替我把這個複印五份好嗎？

examples.en: Kate can run off a sonnet in half an hour on any subject you like.
examples.trans: 只要你定好一個題材，凱特都能在半小時內信筆寫成一首十四行詩。

all_entries.meaning_vi: bắt đầu viết
all_entries.translation_zh: 下筆如神（快速地、容易地寫出某些內容，這些內容通常寫起來較慢且難，如詩或音樂）

all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: to have to deal with a lot of people who are criticizing or attacking you
all_entries.translation: 受到眾人的批評（或攻撃）；受到夾道攻撃

examples.en: Every day they had to run the gauntlet of hostile journalists on their way to school.
examples.trans: 每天去學校的路上他們都要受到一群不友好的記者的圍追堵截。

all_entries.meaning_vi: nhận được (lời khen ngợi, sự giáo dục, hình phạt, v.v.) / bị (khen ngợi, giáo dục, trừng phạt, v.v.)
all_entries.translation_zh: 受到眾人的批評（或攻撃）；受到夾道攻撃

all_entries.word: run the risk of doing sth
all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to do something although something bad might happen because of it

examples.en: If you tell him the truth, you run the risk of hurting his feelings.
examples.trans: 你要是告訴他真相就太冒險了，可能會傷害他的感情。

all_entries.meaning_vi: mạo hiểm / liều lĩnh / cuộc thám hiểm / cuộc phiêu lưu

all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: to be the leader, who is in control of a group of people doing something

all_entries.translation_zh: （想法、曲調等）縈繞於腦際，在腦海中盤旋不去

examples.trans: 一個想法突然閃進我的腦中：我被查理騙了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: nghĩ đến / gợi nhớ / dự đoán

all_entries.meaning_vi: (về cạnh tranh hoặc chiến đấu) mãnh liệt / dữ dội / (về cơn đau) dữ dội / (về biểu hiện ý kiến) sôi nổi / mãnh liệt / (về hành động) quyết liệt / cực đoan

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)

all_entries.meaning_vi: bình thường và tầm thường (thành ngữ); không có gì nổi bật

all_entries.meaning_vi: tập dượt (một buổi biểu diễn)

all_entries.definition_en: In some sports, a run-up is a period or distance of running that you do in order to be going fast enough to perform a particular action

examples.en: The longer and faster your run-up is, the higher you can jump.
examples.trans: 你助跑的距離越長、速度越快，跳得就越高。

examples.trans: 他出於自衛使用了槍。

examples.en: In self-defence, I have to say that I only did what you asked me to do.
examples.trans: 爲了自我辯護，我不得不說我只是做了你要我做的事。

examples.trans: 他出於自衛使用了槍。

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: trying to make yourself, your abilities, or your achievements seem less important

examples.en: a self-deprecating manner/remark

all_entries.meaning_vi: tự- / cái tôi (tâm lý học)

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)

all_entries.translation: （尤指國家治理方式的）自決，自主
all_entries.meaning_vi: quốc gia; dân tộc; nhà nước
all_entries.translation_zh: （尤指國家治理方式的）自決，自主

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: the process of learning about yourself and your beliefs

examples.en: Her own journey/voyage of self-discovery started as she was recovering from a severe illness.
examples.trans: 在重病康復的過程中，她開始了自我發現的歷程。

all_entries.meaning_vi: để ý; nhận ra / phát hiện; tìm thấy; phát giác / một khám phá

all_entries.topic: Cảm xúc, Thái độ & Tâm lý (Emotions, Attitudes & Psychology)
all_entries.definition_en: a feeling of having no confidence in your abilities and decisions
all_entries.meaning_vi: nghi ngờ (điều gì); hoài nghi / có nghi ngại; ấp ủ sự nghi ngờ; nghi rằng

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
