examples.trans: 供自駕者租用的汽車

all_entries.meaning_vi: bản thân / tự mình

all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: not making yourself noticeable, or not trying to get the attention of other people

examples.en: The captain was typically self-effacing when questioned about the team's successes, giving credit to the other players.
examples.trans: 當問到該隊的勝績時，隊長經常很謙虛，把功勞都歸於其他隊友。

all_entries.meaning_vi: phô trương bản thân / tìm kiếm danh tiếng / nổi bật / giống như 出鋒頭|出锋头[chu1 feng1 tou5]

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: clear or obvious without needing any proof or explanation
all_entries.translation: 不證自明的；不言而喻的；顯然的

examples.en: Solutions which seem self-evident to humans are often beyond the grasp of computers.
examples.trans: 對人類來說一些顯而易見的解決辦法常常是電腦所不能做到的。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không cần nói cũng hiểu; điều đó tự nhiên
all_entries.translation_zh: 不證自明的；不言而喻的；顯然的

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: easily understood from the information already given and not needing further explanation
all_entries.translation: 無需解釋的；不證自明的

examples.en: a self-explanatory list of instructions
examples.trans: 一目了然的說明書

all_entries.meaning_vi: không cần thiết
all_entries.translation_zh: 無需解釋的；不證自明的

all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: expression of your personality, emotions, or ideas, especially through art, music, or acting
all_entries.translation: （尤指透過藝術、音樂或表演的）自我表現，自我表達

examples.en: He regarded poetry as sentimental self-expression.
examples.trans: 他把詩歌看成是一種感情的自我表現。

all_entries.meaning_vi: đặc biệt / đặc biệt là
all_entries.translation_zh: （尤指透過藝術、音樂或表演的）自我表現，自我表達

all_entries.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
all_entries.definition_en: paid for only by the money that an activity itself produces

examples.en: Fees would have to triple to make the courses self-financing.
examples.trans: 收費必須增加到原來的三倍，這些課程才能做到資金自給。

all_entries.meaning_vi: huy động nguồn lực

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: happening because it is expected to happen
all_entries.translation: 自我實現的；自然會實現的

examples.en: Pessimism is self-fulfilling - expect the worst and it happens.
examples.trans: 悲觀自然會成爲現實——預計有最壞的事，最壞的事便會發生。

all_entries.meaning_vi: tự hiện thực hóa (tâm lý học) / tự thực hiện
all_entries.translation_zh: 自我實現的；自然會實現的

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: something that you cause to happen by saying and expecting that it will happen
all_entries.meaning_vi: thành sự thật / xảy ra như đã dự đoán / được ứng nghiệm

all_entries.topic: Cảm xúc, Thái độ & Tâm lý (Emotions, Attitudes & Psychology)
all_entries.definition_en: a feeling of satisfaction that you have achieved what you wanted

examples.en: When the options are unemployment or a boring job, having babies can seem like the only means of self-fulfilment.
examples.trans: 如果只能在失業或枯燥的工作中進行選擇，那麽生孩子似乎是達到自我滿足的唯一途徑。

all_entries.meaning_vi: tự hiện thực hóa (tâm lý học) / tự thực hiện

all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: the control of a country or an area by the people living there, or the control of an organization by a group of people independent of central or local government

examples.en: The poll showed that 80 percent of the population of the region supported self-government.
examples.trans: 投票顯示80%的人口支持區域自治。

all_entries.meaning_vi: độc lập và tự chủ (thành ngữ); tự quyết / hoạt động một cách độc lập / duy trì quyền kiểm soát công việc của mình

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to deliberately hurt yourself, for example by cutting yourself, because you have emotional problems or are mentally ill

all_entries.meaning_vi: rối loạn tâm thần / loạn thần
all_entries.translation_zh: 自殘（由於有情緒問題或精神病而故意傷害自己，如割傷自己）

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: the activity of providing what you need for yourself and others with similar experiences or difficulties without going to an official organization

examples.en: It is a group providing self-help for single parents.
examples.trans: 這是一個爲單親父母提供自助的團體。

examples.en: [ before noun ] self-help groups
examples.trans: 自助小組

all_entries.meaning_vi: tự phục vụ

all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: the way a person feels about his or her personality, achievements and value to society

examples.en: Having a decent job contributes to a good self-image.
examples.trans: 擁有一份體面的工作有助於樹立良好的自我形象。

all_entries.meaning_vi: hình ảnh / hình tượng

all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: the belief that you are more important or have a higher value than other people

examples.en: He's a modest, mild-mannered man, without a trace of self-importance.
examples.trans: 他是個謙虛而溫和的人，沒有絲毫的自大。

all_entries.meaning_vi: ngạo mạn

all_entries.definition_en: decided by yourself, without being influenced or ordered by other people
all_entries.translation: 自己決定的；自己規定的

examples.en: The end of the year was their self-imposed deadline for finishing the work.
examples.trans: 年底是他們自己提出的完成工作的最後期限。

examples.en: After the military coup, the family left for self-imposed exile in America.
examples.trans: 軍事政變後，這家人出於自願逃亡到了美國。

all_entries.meaning_vi: quyết định (làm gì đó) / quyết tâm / quyết định
all_entries.translation_zh: 自己決定的；自己規定的

all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: the activity of learning new things on your own that make you a more skilled or able person

examples.en: In the interest of self-improvement, I took a Spanish course.
examples.trans: 為了自我提高，我上了西班牙語課。

all_entries.meaning_vi: nâng cao / tăng / cải thiện

all_entries.meaning_vi: dẫn đến; tạo ra; gây ra; mang lại

all_entries.definition_en: allowing yourself to have or do anything that you enjoy

examples.en: I know it's self-indulgent of me, but I'll have another chocolate.
examples.trans: 我知道這有些自我放縱，但我還是要再吃一塊巧克力。

all_entries.meaning_vi: nuông chiều / chiều chuộng / tha thứ / dễ dãi / làm ngơ / phóng túng / không kiềm chế / thiếu kỷ luật / vô văn hóa / thô lỗ

examples.en: The company's donation was surely motivated by self-interest, as it attracted a lot of media attention.
examples.trans: 公司的捐款一定是受到了私利的驅使，因爲吸引了很多媒體的關注。

examples.en: a self-loathing failed novelist
examples.trans: 自我厭惡的失敗小說家

all_entries.meaning_vi: ghê tởm / căm ghét / không thích điều gì đó

examples.trans: 他心中充滿了焦慮和自我厭惡。

examples.en: a self-loathing failed novelist
examples.trans: 自我厭惡的失敗小說家

all_entries.meaning_vi: ghê tởm / căm ghét / không thích điều gì đó

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)

all_entries.translation: 自我沉迷的；專注於自己的；自戀的

examples.en: a self-obsessed teenager
examples.trans: 自戀的少年

all_entries.meaning_vi: tập trung; chú ý; dồn toàn bộ sự chú ý
all_entries.translation_zh: 自我沉迷的；專注於自己的；自戀的

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)

examples.trans: 不同社會群體之間的鬥爭導致了死亡與憎恨永無止境的惡性循環。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không đổi / không thay đổi / (toán) bất biến
all_entries.translation_zh: 長存不變的；永續循環的

all_entries.definition_en: sadness for yourself because you think you have a lot of problems or have suffered a lot

examples.en: He faced his illness bravely and without any hint of self-pity.
examples.trans: 他勇敢地面對自己的病情，沒有一絲自憐。

all_entries.meaning_vi: 自憐；自憫

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: the process by which pollen from the male part of a flower is carried to the female part of the same flower or to another flower of the same type
all_entries.meaning_vi: thụ phấn

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: a picture, photograph, or piece of writing that you make of or about yourself
all_entries.meaning_vi: chân dung tự họa

examples.en: He looked surprised but soon recovered his self-possession.
examples.trans: 他看起來有點驚訝，但很快就恢復了鎮定。

all_entries.meaning_vi: bình tĩnh / điềm nhiên / điềm tĩnh

all_entries.definition_en: behaviour based on the characteristics or feelings that warn people or animals to protect themselves from difficulties or dangers

examples.en: It was his instinct for self-preservation that led him to abandon his former friends and transfer his allegiance to the new rulers.
examples.trans: 正是他自保的本能驅使他拋棄了以前的朋友，轉而效忠於新的統治者。

all_entries.definition_en: said or announced about yourself

examples.en: He's a self-proclaimed expert on national defence.
examples.trans: 他自稱是位精通國防的專家。

all_entries.meaning_vi: tự cho mình là (điều gì đó tích cực)

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: said, announced, or admitted about yourself

examples.en: a self-professed gambler
examples.trans: 承認自己是賭徒的人

examples.en: She's a self-professed supporter of prison reform.
examples.trans: 她自稱是監獄改革的支持者。

all_entries.meaning_vi: thừa nhận / thú nhận / công nhận / sự công nhận (ngoại giao, nghệ thuật, v.v.)

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: able to move by its own power
all_entries.translation: 自行驅動的；自走的，自行的
all_entries.meaning_vi: tự nguyện / tự chủ / tự mình / tự...
all_entries.translation_zh: 自行驅動的；自走的，自行的

all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: keeping yourself safe from injury or damage

examples.en: They claimed that they needed the weapons for self-protection.
examples.trans: 他們聲稱自己需要武器以自保。

all_entries.meaning_vi: bảo vệ / phòng thủ / bảo hộ / sự bảo vệ

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: A self-referential book, film, play, etc. refers to itself, its writer, or other work by that writer.
all_entries.translation: （書、電影、戲劇等）自指的，自我參考的

examples.en: Modern television sitcoms are often ironic and self-referential.
examples.trans: 現代電視情景喜劇往往帶有諷刺意味，具有自我指認的性質。

all_entries.meaning_vi: tham khảo / tài liệu tham khảo / tham chiếu
all_entries.translation_zh: （書、電影、戲劇等）自指的，自我參考的

all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: making certain yourself that you or your employees act according to the rules, rather than having this done by other people

examples.en: They favour the self-regulation of the industry, and strict codes of conduct have already been issued by the Advertising Association.
examples.trans: 他們傾向於產業自我監管，而廣告協會已經頒布了嚴格的行爲準則。

all_entries.meaning_vi: tự- / cái tôi (tâm lý học)

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to give details about something yourself, rather than having them reported by someone else

examples.en: Most of the problems had been self-reported by employees.
examples.trans: 絕大部分問題已由雇員自我報告了。

examples.en: We cannot rely on polluting industries to self-report.
examples.trans: 我們不能依靠污染企業主動自我報告。

all_entries.meaning_vi: thông báo / báo cáo / cho biết / bản báo cáo / bài phát biểu / bài nói chuyện / bài giảng

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: control of your own actions

examples.en: He was angry but managed, with great self-restraint, to reply calmly.
examples.trans: 他很生氣，但以極大的自製冷靜地作出了回答。

all_entries.meaning_vi: duy trì tự chủ / tự chủ

all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: believing that your ideas and behaviour are morally better than those of other people
all_entries.translation: 自以爲是的；自認爲道德高尚的

examples.en: He's so self-righteous - like he's never done anything wrong in his life.
examples.trans: 他非常自以爲是——就像是一生都沒做過錯事似的。

all_entries.meaning_vi: đúng vậy, đúng rồi / biến thể của 似的[shi4 de5]
all_entries.translation_zh: 自以爲是的；自認爲道德高尚的

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)

examples.en: See also
examples.trans: self-government

all_entries.meaning_vi: tự trị

all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: giving up what you want so that other people can have what they want

examples.en: People say this is a selfish society, but frankly I've seen too much kindness, self-sacrifice and generosity to believe that.
examples.trans: 人們說這是個自私的社會，但坦白地說，我看過太多善良、自我犧牲和慷慨之舉，因此不會輕信這個說法。

examples.trans: 與我們競爭的公司先於我們推出他們的軟體，從而搶佔了先機。

examples.en: Sandy stole my thunder when she announced that she was pregnant two days before I'd planned to tell people about my pregnancy.
examples.trans: 在我打算告訴大家我懷孕的消息之前兩天，桑迪搶先宣佈她懷孕了，搶了我的風頭。

examples.trans: 女主角摔斷了腿，伊索貝爾臨時加入頂替她。

all_entries.meaning_vi: sưởi ấm / xua đuổi cái lạnh (y học cổ truyền)

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to make something unpleasant have less of an effect on someone
all_entries.translation: 減弱，削弱（不良事物的影響）

examples.en: Have an apple - it'll take the edge off your hunger.
examples.trans: 吃個蘋果吧——可以充充飢。

examples.en: His apology took the edge off her anger.
examples.trans: 他道了歉，她的火氣就消了些。

all_entries.meaning_vi: xấu / có hại / không lành mạnh
all_entries.translation_zh: 減弱，削弱（不良事物的影響）

all_entries.word: take the gilt off the gingerbread
all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to spoil something that is in every other way enjoyable

examples.en: We had a great trip, but our flight home was badly delayed, which took the gilt off the gingerbread.
examples.trans: 我們的旅行很愉快，但返航的班機嚴重延誤，令人掃興。

all_entries.meaning_vi: lực hút (như lực hấp dẫn) / sức quyến rũ / sự hấp dẫn

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to make an event or occasion less special and enjoyable
all_entries.translation: 煞…的風景；使黯然失色；使遜色

examples.en: The bad weather really took the gloss off our trip to the zoo.
examples.trans: 糟糕的天氣著實破壞了我們去動物園玩的興致。

all_entries.meaning_vi: mất đi vẻ rực rỡ / mất sức hút / bị lu mờ / bị làm cho lu mờ
all_entries.translation_zh: 煞…的風景；使黯然失色；使遜色

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: If someone or something takes the heat off you, he, she, or it reduces the amount of criticism you have to deal with.

examples.en: The deputy's resignation over the scandal has taken some of the heat off his superior.
examples.trans: 副手因醜聞而辭職，這使他的上級少受了一些批評。

all_entries.meaning_vi: phê bình; chỉ trích

all_entries.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
all_entries.definition_en: to think about the effects that something will have in the future instead of in the present
all_entries.translation: 考慮…的長期影響；以長遠的眼光看…

examples.en: If you take the long view, of course, you can regard staff training as an investment for the company.
examples.trans: 當然，長遠來看，員工訓練可以被視為公司的一種投資。

all_entries.meaning_vi: ảnh hưởng / tác động / ảnh hưởng đến / tác động đến (thường là tiêu cực) / làm phiền
all_entries.translation_zh: 考慮…的長期影響；以長遠的眼光看…

all_entries.word: take the piss out of sb or sth
all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: to make a joke about someone or make someone look silly

examples.en: They're always taking the piss out of him because he's a Barry Manilow fan.
examples.trans: 他們總是取笑他，因為他是巴瑞‧曼尼洛的狂熱崇拜者。

all_entries.meaning_vi: trêu chọc; chế nhạo

all_entries.word: take the rough with the smooth
all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to accept the unpleasant parts of a situation as well as the pleasant parts
all_entries.translation: 是好是歹一起承受，好事壞事都能接受，既能享樂也能吃苦

examples.en: That's relationships for you - you have to take the rough with the smooth.
examples.trans: 談戀愛就是那樣，你苦樂都要一起接受。

all_entries.meaning_vi: ở cùng một nơi / cùng nhau / với / tổng cộng (tổng số)
all_entries.translation_zh: 是好是歹一起承受，好事壞事都能接受，既能享樂也能吃苦

all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: When a person of high rank takes the salute, they stand and watch while soldiers march past saluting them.
all_entries.translation: （高級軍官在閱兵時）接受敬禮，行答禮
all_entries.meaning_vi: sĩ quan quân đội cấp cao / thượng tầng quân đội
all_entries.translation_zh: （高級軍官在閱兵時）接受敬禮，行答禮

all_entries.word: take the sting out of sth
all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: If something takes the sting out of an unpleasant situation, it makes it less unpleasant.

examples.en: The new policy of shorter working hours will serve to take the sting out of the pay cut.
examples.trans: 縮短工時的新政策有助於減少降低薪酬所帶來的不快。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không vui / tinh thần sa sút / (dao) không sắc

all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: to make the effort to do something

examples.en: She didn't even take the time to wish me good morning.
examples.trans: 她連跟我說聲早安都沒有。

all_entries.meaning_vi: sức mạnh

all_entries.word: take the weight off your feet legs
all_entries.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
all_entries.definition_en: If you take the weight off your feet/legs, you sit down, especially after standing or walking for a long time.
all_entries.translation: （長時間站立或行走後）坐下歇歇腳，坐下喘口氣

examples.en: You must be exhausted after all that shopping - sit down and take the weight off your feet!
examples.trans: 你逛了那麼長時間的街，一定累壞了——坐下歇歇腳吧！

all_entries.meaning_vi: tông giọng / cách nói / kiểu biểu đạt / ngữ điệu
all_entries.translation_zh: （長時間站立或行走後）坐下歇歇腳，坐下喘口氣

all_entries.word: take the wind out of sb s sails
all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: also knock the wind out of sb's sails, knock the wind out of sb to make someone feel less confident or less determined to do something, usually by saying or doing something that they are not expecting
all_entries.translation: 使（某人）洩氣；使（某人）不堅定

examples.en: I was all ready to tell him that the relationship was over when he greeted me with a big bunch of flowers - that took the wind out of my sails.
examples.trans: 我已經準備好要告訴他我們分手吧，可他捧著一大束花向我迎來——這令我的心又軟了下來。

all_entries.meaning_vi: vững vàng / kiên định / kiên quyết / dứt khoát
all_entries.translation_zh: 使（某人）洩氣；使（某人）不堅定

all_entries.word: take the words out of sb s mouth
all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: to say something that another person was just about to say or was thinking
all_entries.translation: 說出（某人）要說（或正在思考）的話

examples.en: "What a rude and obnoxious man!" "You took the words right out of my mouth!"
examples.trans: 「那個男人真是又粗魯又討厭！」「那正是我想說的！」

all_entries.meaning_vi: suy ngẫm / cân nhắc
all_entries.translation_zh: 說出（某人）要說（或正在思考）的話

all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)

all_entries.meaning_vi: mở; công khai; công cộng / công bố; phát hành

all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: to relax and not work too hard

examples.en: My doctor told me to take things easy for a while.
examples.trans: 我的醫生讓我放鬆一段時間。

all_entries.meaning_vi: rời đi / tạm biệt

all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: to start drinking alcohol often, sometimes because of a personal problem
all_entries.translation: （通常指因個人問題而）開始酗酒

examples.en: He took to drink after his wife left him.
examples.trans: 妻子離他而去之後他開始酗酒。

all_entries.meaning_vi: cá nhân / riêng tư / bản thân
all_entries.translation_zh: （通常指因個人問題而）開始酗酒

all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: to go somewhere, usually because you are in a difficult or dangerous situation

examples.en: The refugees took to the hills for safety.
examples.trans: 難民逃往山區避難。

all_entries.meaning_vi: yêu cầu giúp đỡ / kêu gọi giúp đỡ

all_entries.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
all_entries.definition_en: to start doing something often

examples.en: She was so depressed she took to drink.
examples.trans: 她十分抑鬱，開始酗酒。

examples.en: [ + -ing verb ] He's taken to staying out very late.
examples.trans: 他開始經常很晚才回來。

all_entries.meaning_vi: hình thành; định hình

all_entries.word: take to sth like a duck to water
all_entries.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
all_entries.definition_en: to discover when you start to do something for the first time that you have a natural ability to do it
all_entries.translation: 自然而然地做起…來，天生就會做…

examples.en: He took to fatherhood like a duck to water.
examples.trans: 他天生就是個好父親。

all_entries.meaning_vi: một cách không chủ ý / tự động
all_entries.translation_zh: 自然而然地做起…來，天生就會做…

all_entries.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
all_entries.definition_en: to start travelling

examples.en: After a short visit, they took to the road again.
examples.trans: 短暫的參觀過後，他們再次上路了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: khởi hành / bắt đầu (một hành trình)

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: often disapproving to go to bed, especially because you feel ill or unable to deal with things

examples.en: She took to her bed right after Alice was born and did not want to see anyone.
examples.trans: 她生了愛麗絲以後就一直臥病在床，誰也不想見。

all_entries.meaning_vi: ốm liệt giường; nằm liệt giường

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to quickly run away

examples.en: When they saw the soldiers coming, they took to their heels.
examples.trans: 當看見士兵過來時，他們拔腿就跑。

all_entries.meaning_vi: chạy trốn / chạy thoát

all_entries.word: take up the cudgels for against sb sth
all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: to argue strongly in support of, or against, someone or something

examples.en: Relatives have taken up the cudgels for two British women accused of murder.
examples.trans: 親屬們極力爲兩名被控謀殺的英國女子辯護。

all_entries.meaning_vi: phản đối; chống lại

all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: to become friendly or start a relationship with someone, especially someone who might have a bad influence on you
all_entries.translation: 開始與（尤指可能帶來不良影響的人）來往

examples.en: She's taken up with a strange crowd of people.
examples.trans: 她開始與一幫古怪的人來往。

all_entries.meaning_vi: xấu / có hại / không lành mạnh
all_entries.translation_zh: 開始與（尤指可能帶來不良影響的人）來往

all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: If something takes years off a person, it makes them appear or feel much younger.
all_entries.translation: 使某人顯得年輕；使某人覺得年輕

examples.en: "Have you seen James without his beard?" "I know - it takes years off him!"
examples.trans: 「你見過詹姆斯不留鬍子的樣子嗎？」「我知道──那樣令他看起來年輕好幾歲！」

all_entries.meaning_vi: trẻ
all_entries.translation_zh: 使某人顯得年輕；使某人覺得年輕

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to kill yourself
all_entries.meaning_vi: tự giết mình / tự sát / tự tử

all_entries.word: take your cue from sth sb
all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to be strongly influenced by something or someone

examples.en: The architects took their cue for the design of the new hotel from the nearby banks.
examples.trans: 建築師們對新旅館的設計深受附近銀行建築的影響

all_entries.meaning_vi: ảnh hưởng / tác động / ảnh hưởng đến / tác động đến (thường là tiêu cực) / làm phiền

all_entries.word: take your eye off the ball
all_entries.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
all_entries.definition_en: to not give your attention to what you are doing at the time

examples.en: If you're a manager, you can't afford to take your eye off the ball for one minute.
examples.trans: 如果你是經理，就必須時刻小心謹慎。

all_entries.meaning_vi: cẩn thận / chú ý

all_entries.word: take your hat off to sb
all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: If you say that you take your hat off to someone, you mean that you admire them for an achievement.

examples.en: So Emma actually manages to juggle two small children and a full-time job, does she? Well, I take my hat off to her.
examples.trans: 這麽說艾瑪在照顧好兩個小孩子的同時還做著一份全職工作，是嗎？我可真佩服她。

all_entries.meaning_vi: một người nào đó / một người nhất định / một số người / tôi (xưng hô sau họ của một người)

all_entries.word: take your life in your hands
all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: to do something that is very dangerous, especially where you risk death

examples.en: Every time you go parachuting you're taking your life in your hands.
examples.trans: 你每次去跳傘都是在拿性命冒險。

all_entries.meaning_vi: mạo hiểm / liều lĩnh / cuộc thám hiểm / cuộc phiêu lưu

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: the main message or piece of information that you learn from something
all_entries.translation: 從…中了解到的主要資訊

examples.en: The take-home message from/of this research is that even small amounts of regular exercise make a huge difference to health.
examples.trans: 這項研究傳達的主要信息就是即使是少量的鍛煉都會對身體健康都有很大作用。

all_entries.meaning_vi: chính; chủ yếu; quan trọng; hàng đầu
all_entries.translation_zh: 從…中了解到的主要資訊

all_entries.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
all_entries.definition_en: a test that students complete at home, especially because there would not be enough time to do it in class
all_entries.translation: 帶回家完成的考試，開卷考試，課外考試
all_entries.meaning_vi: trở về nhà
all_entries.translation_zh: 帶回家完成的考試，開卷考試，課外考試

all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: how much people start to use or accept a service, or sometimes a product, that has become available to them
all_entries.translation: （享受某項服務或使用某種產品的）人數

examples.en: We are calling for government action to improve the take-up of state benefits.
examples.trans: 我們呼籲政府採取措施讓更多的人享受國家福利。

all_entries.meaning_vi: tận hưởng / sống xa hoa / niềm vui
all_entries.translation_zh: （享受某項服務或使用某種產品的）人數

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to receive a lot of criticism

examples.en: The movie took quite a pounding from the critics.
examples.trans: 這部電影受到評論家的猛烈抨擊。

all_entries.meaning_vi: tấn công (bằng lời nói hoặc viết)

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to be damaged because of a bad experience

examples.en: Her confidence took a hard knock when her application was rejected.
examples.trans: 申請被拒絕了，她的自信心受到嚴重打擊。

all_entries.meaning_vi: bị cản trở / bị ngăn trở / thất bại

all_entries.word: take lead sb on to one side
all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: to have a private talk with someone

examples.en: Bill's father took him to one side and told him to stop misbehaving.
examples.trans: 比爾的父親把他拉到一邊，讓他別再那麽無禮了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: thảo luận; trò chuyện / trò chuyện; thảo luận

all_entries.topic: Cảm xúc, Thái độ & Tâm lý (Emotions, Attitudes & Psychology)
all_entries.definition_en: an expression used when someone needs to calm down when something has made them feel sexually excited
all_entries.translation: 洗個冷水澡（指某人因某事而性興奮時需要冷靜）

examples.en: Did you see the dress she was wearing? I think I'd better go and take a cold shower!
examples.trans: 你看到她穿的裙子了嗎？我感到血脈賁張，最好去沖個涼水澡降降溫。

all_entries.meaning_vi: nước lạnh / nước chưa đun / nghĩa bóng: chưa sẵn sàng (kế hoạch)
all_entries.translation_zh: 洗個冷水澡（指某人因某事而性興奮時需要冷靜）

all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: to agree to fight or compete with someone
all_entries.meaning_vi: thử thách / thách thức

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)

examples.en: What's this then, you're only drinking orange juice - have you signed the pledge or something?
examples.trans: 這是怎麼回事？你只喝柳橙汁——你是發過誓不再喝酒了，還是其他甚麼原因？

all_entries.meaning_vi: từ bỏ uống rượu / kiêng uống rượu

examples.en: I asked how he was and he started telling me this big tale of woe.
examples.trans: 我問他過得怎麼樣，他向我大倒苦水。

all_entries.meaning_vi: khốn khổ / bi thảm

all_entries.meaning_vi: giải trí / tiêu khiển / giải khuây / sự giải trí / trò tiêu khiển / sở thích / vui / chơi

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: to talk quickly and without stopping

examples.en: He talked a blue streak all through breakfast.
examples.trans: 他吃早餐時一直滔滔不絕地說話。

all_entries.meaning_vi: miệng như thác đổ (thành ngữ) / lưu loát / lém lỉnh / có tài ăn nói

all_entries.meaning_vi: đến gần; đến gần hơn

all_entries.meaning_vi: tin tức / thông tin

all_entries.meaning_vi: nghiêm trọng / nguy kịch / nặng nề / trầm trọng

all_entries.translation: 他們和我們；別人和自己人

examples.trans: 如果鼓勵家長參與學校事務，家長和學校之間的矛盾就會少些。

examples.en: The management has its own restaurant. - It's definitely a case of them and us.
examples.trans: 高級職員有他們自己的餐廳——這明顯是一種劃分員工等級的做法。

all_entries.meaning_vi: người cùng phe / chúng ta / người của mình / một người trong chúng ta
all_entries.translation_zh: 他們和我們；別人和自己人

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: music that is written for and played during a particular television programme or film

examples.en: From down the hall the theme music of the news channel blared from Nana's TV.
examples.trans: 在走廊的遠處，從娜娜的電視機裡傳出新聞頻道刺耳的主題音樂。

all_entries.meaning_vi: chủ đề / đề tài

all_entries.meaning_vi: công viên giải trí (trong đó các trò vui chỉ dựa trên một tư tưởng hoặc nhóm tư tưởng)

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: a piece of music from a television programme, film, etc. that is remembered as the music that represents that programme or film
all_entries.meaning_vi: bài hát chủ đề ((thường) nhắc đi nhắc lại trong một cuốn phim để làm bật chủ đề); rađiô bài hát dạo, khúc nhạc hiệu ((thường) nhắc đi nhắc lại ở trên đài mỗi khi đến một buổi phát thanh nào đó)

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: immediately

examples.en: I suggested he call his mother and he did it there and then.
examples.trans: 我建議他給他媽媽打電話，他立即照做了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: ngay lập tức

all_entries.translation: 海裡的魚多的是；還有很多合適的人（或機會）

examples.en: Don't cry over Pierre - there are plenty more fish in the sea!
examples.trans: 別為皮埃爾哭了，天下的好男人多的是！

all_entries.meaning_vi: thích hợp; vừa vặn; phù hợp
all_entries.translation_zh: 海裡的魚多的是；還有很多合適的人（或機會）

all_entries.word: there but for the grace of god go i
all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: said when something bad that has happened to someone else could have happened to you
all_entries.translation: （表示沒有遭到別人的厄運而慶幸）要不是上帝的恩典（我也遭殃）；多虧上帝開恩（我才逃過一劫）
all_entries.meaning_vi: nếu không phải vì / nếu không có

examples.trans: 他們架起那個標誌，因為過去在這裡發生過事故。

all_entries.translation_zh: （there would 或 there had的縮略形式）

all_entries.definition_en: something you say that means someone will be very angry if something happens

examples.en: There'll be hell to pay if she doesn't get the money in time.
examples.trans: 如果她沒有及時拿到錢，那可就有大麻煩了。

examples.trans: 還是家最好。

examples.trans: 還從來沒有過像這麼令人激動的選舉。

all_entries.meaning_vi: bề ngoài / hình thức / hình dáng
all_entries.translation_zh: （there is 或 there has 的縮略形式）

all_entries.translation_zh: 這東西沒甚麽稀奇的，這東西多了去了

all_entries.meaning_vi: mọi thứ

examples.en: Personally, I think there's little to be said for such a policy.
examples.trans: 我個人認爲這樣的政策沒有甚麽好處。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không thuận lợi / bất lợi / có hại / tổn hại

all_entries.definition_en: said to emphasize that many bad things might happen before something is finished
all_entries.translation: 杯到嘴邊還會失手；世事往往功虧一簣
all_entries.meaning_vi: nghĩa đen: hủy hoại sự nghiệp vì một sọt đất / thất bại do thiếu nỗ lực cuối cùng / thành ngữ: hỏng việc vì tiết kiệm không đáng (thành ngữ)
all_entries.translation_zh: 杯到嘴邊還會失手；世事往往功虧一簣

all_entries.word: there s method in your madness

all_entries.meaning_vi: lý trí / tính lý trí / hợp lý

all_entries.definition_en: said when it is difficult to explain why different people like different things, especially things that you do not like
all_entries.translation: 人的愛憎好惡是無法解釋的

examples.en: "I love working at weekends." "Well, there's no accounting for taste!"
examples.trans: 「我喜歡在週末工作。」「嗯，真是蘿蔔青菜，各有所愛！」

all_entries.meaning_vi: nghĩa đen: thích và không thích / sở thích / gu
all_entries.translation_zh: 人的愛憎好惡是無法解釋的

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: said to mean that something certainly will not happen
all_entries.translation: （表示某事肯定不會發生）不會的！沒事的！

examples.en: "Bye - don't work too hard!" "There's no danger of that!"
examples.trans: 「再見——別太累了！」「不會的！」

all_entries.meaning_vi: không có khả năng / không có khả năng xảy ra / sẽ không (hành động, xảy ra v.v.) / không thể / không biết làm việc gì đó / (khẩu ngữ) (Đài Loan) đừng nhắc đến / không có chi
all_entries.translation_zh: （表示某事肯定不會發生）不會的！沒事的！

all_entries.definition_en: used to mean that something is certain
all_entries.translation: 不可否認的是；毫無疑問

examples.en: There's no escaping the fact (that) we won't be able to complete these orders without extra staff.
examples.trans: 不可否認的是，如果不增添人手，我們將無法完成這些訂單。

all_entries.meaning_vi: chắc chắn / không còn nghi ngờ gì
all_entries.translation_zh: 不可否認的是；毫無疑問

all_entries.word: there s no help for it
all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: there is no other choice in this situation
all_entries.translation: 別無選擇，沒有其他辦法

examples.en: If you catch them stealing again, there'll be no help for it but (= except) to call the police.
examples.trans: 如果再逮到他們偷東西，那就別無選擇，只好報警。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không có lựa chọn nào khác
all_entries.translation_zh: 別無選擇，沒有其他辦法

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: If you say there's no knowing, you mean it is impossible to be certain about something.

examples.en: There's no knowing what she'll do if she finds out about this.
examples.trans: 無從知曉她查出這事後會做些甚麼。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không có cách / ngoài thẩm quyền hoặc khả năng / việc không có cách làm

all_entries.word: there s no knowing telling saying
all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: it is not possible to know what will happen

examples.en: She's very unpredictable, so there's no knowing how she'll react to the news.
examples.trans: 她讓人捉摸不透，所以說不定她對這消息會有甚麼反應。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không thể; không có khả năng

all_entries.word: there s no rest for the wicked
all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: said when you must continue with your work or other activity although you are very tired

all_entries.meaning_vi: (trong hoàn cảnh như vậy) sẽ không có bình yên / không thể thở phào nhẹ nhõm
all_entries.translation_zh: （形容自己太忙）惡人永無寧日。

all_entries.word: there s no smoke without fire

all_entries.definition_en: If unpleasant things are said about someone or something, there is probably a good reason for it.
all_entries.translation: 無火不生煙；無風不起浪

examples.en: She says the accusations are not true, but there's no smoke without fire.
examples.trans: 她說那些指控純屬子虛烏有，但無風不起浪。

all_entries.meaning_vi: nghĩa đen: không có gió thì không có sóng (thành ngữ); phải có lý do / không có lửa làm sao có khói
all_entries.translation_zh: 無火不生煙；無風不起浪

examples.trans: 「我這份工作可以經常去四處走走，不過壞處是我要經常作報告。」「哎呀，天下沒有免費的午餐嘛。」

all_entries.meaning_vi: miễn phí

all_entries.word: there s no time like the present
all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: said to encourage someone to take action immediately instead of waiting
all_entries.meaning_vi: Hershey's (thương hiệu)

all_entries.word: there s none so deaf as those who will not hear
all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: said about someone who chooses to ignore advice or will not believe what they are told
all_entries.meaning_vi: vô tình / không có hứng

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: used for saying that something you have been told is not true

examples.en: I heard a rumour that she's leaving, but apparently there's nothing in it.
examples.trans: 我聽到謠言說她要離開，但這顯然純屬捏造。

all_entries.meaning_vi: hoá ra là đúng / được xác minh / đúng

all_entries.word: there s nowt so queer as folk

all_entries.translation: 人世間千奇百怪；人間有百態
all_entries.meaning_vi: muôn hình vạn trạng kỳ lạ (thành ngữ)
all_entries.translation_zh: 人世間千奇百怪；人間有百態

examples.trans: 烏馬泡了一杯茶等我喝，還準備了一盤餅乾。

all_entries.meaning_vi: một người nào đó / một người nhất định / một số người / tôi (xưng hô sau họ của một người)
all_entries.translation_zh: 等著（某人）去做（或處理等）

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to be expecting someone or something and be prepared to deal with him, her, or it

examples.en: When the thieves left the building, the police were waiting for them.
examples.trans: 當盜賊們離開那棟樓的時候，警察正在等著抓他們。

all_entries.meaning_vi: chờ; chờ đợi

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to stay at home because you are expecting someone or something to arrive, or someone to phone you

examples.en: I waited in for the plumber all morning, but he didn't turn up.
examples.trans: 我在家裡等那個水管工等了一上午，可他卻連面也沒露。

all_entries.meaning_vi: nhà

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: If someone or something is waiting in the wings, they are not yet active or important, but are ready or likely to be so soon.

examples.en: The team has several talented young players waiting in the wings.
examples.trans: 這支隊伍裡有幾位很有天賦的年輕隊員隨時可以頂替。

all_entries.meaning_vi: sử dụng / tận dụng / áp dụng

all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: to do everything for someone so that that person does not have to do anything for himself or herself

examples.en: While she was pregnant, her husband waited on her hand and foot (= did everything for her).
examples.trans: 她懷孕時，她丈夫無微不至地照顧她。

all_entries.meaning_vi: phục vụ; hầu hạ

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to serve food and drink, especially to customers in a restaurant
all_entries.translation: （尤指在餐館裡）服侍…進餐，給…上菜

examples.en: The staff who waited on us at dinner were excellent.
examples.trans: 吃飯時為我們服務的侍者非常不錯。

examples.en: She waited on tables (= served meals as a job) to earn some extra money.
examples.trans: 她當侍者來賺些額外的收入。

all_entries.meaning_vi: dọn món
all_entries.translation_zh: （尤指在餐館裡）服侍…進餐，給…上菜

all_entries.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
all_entries.definition_en: to wait until you know the result of an activity before doing or deciding something

examples.en: The lawyers are waiting on the jury's verdict.
examples.trans: 律師們在等待陪審團的裁決。

all_entries.meaning_vi: đợi / chờ đợi

all_entries.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
all_entries.definition_en: to delay serving a meal until someone arrives

examples.en: Don't wait dinner for me - I'll be home late.
examples.trans: 別等我吃飯了——我會很晚才回家。

all_entries.meaning_vi: dùng bữa / ăn / kiếm sống

all_entries.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
all_entries.definition_en: to wait until something unpleasant has ended
all_entries.translation: 等到（令人不快之事）結束

examples.en: I'd rather wait out the storm than drive home immediately.
examples.trans: 我想等到風暴過去，而不是馬上開車回家。

all_entries.meaning_vi: khó chịu / đáng chê trách
all_entries.translation_zh: 等到（令人不快之事）結束

all_entries.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
all_entries.definition_en: to not go to bed at night because you are expecting someone to arrive

examples.en: I'll be home after midnight, so don't wait up for me.
examples.trans: 我會在半夜以後才回家，所以你先睡吧，不用等我。

all_entries.meaning_vi: trở về nhà

all_entries.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
all_entries.definition_en: to wait until it is really your turn to do or get something

examples.en: If people were more polite, they would wait their turn.
examples.trans: 假如人們是更講禮貌的話，他們就會按順序等候。

all_entries.meaning_vi: đến lượt (của ai đó hoặc cái gì đó)

all_entries.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
all_entries.definition_en: a situation in which you delay taking any action, so that you can watch how a situation develops and see what it is best for you to do

examples.en: In a contest like this, the stronger team can afford to play a waiting game.
examples.trans: 在這種比賽中，實力較強的一方才可以採取伺機而動的策略。

all_entries.meaning_vi: chờ cơ hội / theo dõi thời cơ

all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: a list of people who have asked for something that is not immediately available but will be in the future

examples.en: The hospital has a two-year waiting list for minor operations.
examples.trans: 這家醫院的小手術已經排到了兩年後。

examples.en: The course is full, but I can put you on the waiting list, in case someone drops out.
examples.trans: 這門課程已經滿額了，但我可以把你列在後補名單裡，說不定有人會放棄。

all_entries.meaning_vi: danh sách tên

all_entries.word: wake up and smell the coffee
all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: used to tell someone that they are wrong about a particular situation and must realize what is really happening
all_entries.translation: （用於告訴某人）認清形勢，正視目前的情況
all_entries.meaning_vi: khởi kiện; nộp đơn khiếu nại
all_entries.translation_zh: （用於告訴某人）認清形勢，正視目前的情況

all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: to start to understand that a situation or problem exists

examples.en: Governments are finally waking up to the fact that the environment should be cleaned up.
examples.trans: 各國政府終於開始意識到應該整治環境這個事實。

all_entries.meaning_vi: câu hỏi / vấn đề / chủ đề

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: something you say to tell someone to listen or to become involved when they have not been listening or paying attention

examples.en: Wake up, Daniel! It's your turn.
examples.trans: 注意點，丹尼爾！輪到你了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: chú ý đến; quan tâm đến

all_entries.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
all_entries.definition_en: If something that happens is a wake-up call, it should make you realize that you need to take action to change a situation.

examples.en: For the insurance industry, these floods were a wake-up call.
examples.trans: 對保險業來說，這些洪水敲響了警鐘。

all_entries.meaning_vi: cảnh báo / cảnh giác / mang tính cảnh báo

all_entries.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
all_entries.definition_en: a phone call that you arrange to be made, for example in a hotel, to wake you up at a certain time

examples.en: For the insurance industry, these floods were a wake-up call.
examples.trans: 對保險業來說，這些洪水敲響了警鐘。

all_entries.definition_en: said to someone in order to wake them up from sleep
all_entries.meaning_vi: 醒醒，醒醒

all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: to treat someone very badly or defeat them very easily
all_entries.translation: 虐待（某人）；輕鬆戰勝（某人）

examples.en: If you don't want to work at the weekend, say so - don't let the boss walk all over you.
examples.trans: 假如你週末不想工作，那就說出來——不要聽任老闆的擺布。

all_entries.meaning_vi: chiến thắng / đánh bại / vượt qua
all_entries.translation_zh: 虐待（某人）；輕鬆戰勝（某人）

all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: disapproving to stop being involved in a situation because it is difficult to deal with or does not give you any advantages

examples.en: You can't just walk away from a marriage at the first sign of a problem.
examples.trans: 你不能婚姻稍有問題就想擺脫掉了事。

examples.en: She overturned the car, but walked away from it without a scratch.
examples.trans: 她翻了車，可是卻平安無事，一點擦傷都沒有。

all_entries.meaning_vi: tránh vấn đề bằng cách bỏ đi / từ bỏ

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to escape an accident without being badly hurt

examples.en: You can't just walk away from a marriage at the first sign of a problem.
examples.trans: 你不能婚姻稍有問題就想擺脫掉了事。

examples.en: She overturned the car, but walked away from it without a scratch.
examples.trans: 她翻了車，可是卻平安無事，一點擦傷都沒有。

all_entries.meaning_vi: bình an / khỏe mạnh / không có chuyện gì / yên tĩnh và an toàn / an bình

all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: to win a prize or competition very easily

examples.en: He walked away with all three gold medals.
examples.trans: 他很輕鬆地拿到了全部三枚金牌。

all_entries.meaning_vi: cuộc thi (thể thao, v.v.) / trận đấu
all_entries.translation_zh: 輕鬆獲（獎）；輕鬆贏得（比賽）

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to go into a room and see what someone is doing, when they did not want to be seen

examples.en: She walked in on me when I was getting undressed.
examples.trans: 她進屋正好撞見我在脫衣服。

all_entries.meaning_vi: gặp tình cờ

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to get a job very easily

examples.en: She walked straight into a well-paid job after graduating from university.
examples.trans: 她一離開大學便輕鬆獲得了一份工資很高的工作。

all_entries.meaning_vi: làm việc / (máy móc) vận hành / công việc / việc / nhiệm vụ

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: When people talk about walk(s) of life, they are referring to different types of jobs and different levels of society.
all_entries.translation: 各行各業；各個社會階層

examples.en: Members of the gym include lawyers, teachers, plumbers, and hairdressers - people from all (different) walks of life.
examples.trans: 我們這個俱樂部裡有律師，有教師，有水管工人，有理髮師——各行各業的人都有。

all_entries.meaning_vi: mọi ngành nghề; tất cả các nghề; mọi lĩnh vực trong cuộc sống
all_entries.translation_zh: 各行各業；各個社會階層

all_entries.topic: Cảm xúc, Thái độ & Tâm lý (Emotions, Attitudes & Psychology)

examples.en: She threatened to walk off the film set because of the conditions.
examples.trans: 她曾因工作條件問題而威脅要離開拍攝場地。

examples.en: He refused to discuss it and just walked off in a huff.
examples.trans: 他拒絕談論這個問題並氣衝衝地離開了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: bực bội / không hài lòng / không thỏa mãn

examples.en: She walked off with the top prize.
examples.trans: 她輕鬆地拿到了頭獎。

examples.en: Who's walked off with my cup?
examples.trans: 誰把我的杯子偷走了？

all_entries.meaning_vi: giành chiến thắng / đạt được

examples.trans: 她輕鬆地拿到了頭獎。

examples.en: Who's walked off with my cup?
examples.trans: 誰把我的杯子偷走了？

all_entries.meaning_vi: cho phép / đồng ý

all_entries.topic: Cảm xúc, Thái độ & Tâm lý (Emotions, Attitudes & Psychology)
all_entries.definition_en: to feel extremely excited or happy

examples.en: After the delivery of her baby, she was walking on air.
examples.trans: 她生下了孩子之後興奮異常。

all_entries.meaning_vi: cực kỳ / vô cùng

all_entries.definition_en: If you are walking on eggs/eggshells, you are being very careful not to offend someone or do anything wrong.
all_entries.translation: 小心翼翼地做事；小心謹慎

examples.en: When my mother is staying at our house, I feel like I'm walking on eggshells.
examples.trans: 當我媽媽住在我們家的時候，我凡事都要小心翼翼。

all_entries.meaning_vi: cẩn thận và trang trọng (thành ngữ); rất cẩn thận / thận trọng / nhẹ nhàng và cẩn thận
all_entries.translation_zh: 小心翼翼地做事；小心謹慎

all_entries.topic: Cảm xúc, Thái độ & Tâm lý (Emotions, Attitudes & Psychology)

examples.en: All the parents walked out (of the meeting) in protest.
examples.trans: 所有的父母都退（出會）場以示抗議。

examples.en: He walked out on his wife and two kids.
examples.trans: 他突然拋下他的妻子和兩個孩子出走了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: phản đối; chống lại

examples.en: All the parents walked out (of the meeting) in protest.
examples.trans: 所有的父母都退（出會）場以示抗議。

examples.en: He walked out on his wife and two kids.
examples.trans: 他突然拋下他的妻子和兩個孩子出走了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: từ bỏ / vứt bỏ / từ chối / chia tay (ai đó)

all_entries.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)

examples.trans: 所有的父母都退（出會）場以示抗議。

examples.en: He walked out on his wife and two kids.
examples.trans: 他突然拋下他的妻子和兩個孩子出走了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: cuộc đình công / đình công

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: If you walk right into something, you are caught or tricked by it because you did not know what was happening.

examples.en: We set a trap and they walked right into it.
examples.trans: 我們設了個圈套，他們徑直就踩了進去。

all_entries.meaning_vi: rơi vào / mắc vào / lâm vào (một tình cảnh)

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)

all_entries.translation: 耐心地給（某人）示範…；詳細地教授（某人）…

examples.en: She walked me through the six-page document.
examples.trans: 她耐心地給我解釋了一遍這份長達六頁的文件。

examples.en: He'll walk you through the procedure.
examples.trans: 他會詳細地給你示範操作程序的。

all_entries.meaning_vi: tính cách
all_entries.translation_zh: 耐心地給（某人）示範…；詳細地教授（某人）…

all_entries.definition_en: to walk in order to try and get rid of pain or an unpleasant feeling such as anger
all_entries.translation: 散步消除（不適）；散步緩解（頭痛）；散步消（食）

examples.en: I'm going out to walk off this headache.
examples.trans: 我要出去散散步，緩解一下頭痛。

examples.en: She twisted her ankle and tried to walk it off, but it hurt too much.
examples.trans: 她扭了腳，想要走走緩解一下，但是太痛了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không khỏe / khó ở / mệt mỏi
all_entries.translation_zh: 散步消除（不適）；散步緩解（頭痛）；散步消（食）

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to show that something is true by your actions rather than your words

examples.trans: 我們來參加這次會議，因為我們是做實事的環境保護主義者。

examples.en: Compare

all_entries.meaning_vi: áp dụng / đưa vào (thực tiễn, v.v.) / đưa ra (thử nghiệm, biểu quyết, v.v.)

examples.en: Let's just walk through the scene one more time.
examples.trans: 我們再排練一次吧。

all_entries.meaning_vi: có mặt / có mặt tại hiện trường

all_entries.definition_en: used to refer to a space used for storing things that is large enough for a person to enter and walk around in
all_entries.translation: （儲存空間）大得人能走進去的，步入式的

examples.en: a walk-in wardrobe
examples.trans: 步入式衣櫥，衣帽間

examples.trans: 步入式冰箱

all_entries.meaning_vi: dự trữ / lưu trữ / tích trữ / kho lưu trữ
all_entries.translation_zh: （儲存空間）大得人能走進去的，步入式的

all_entries.definition_en: mainly US used to refer to a place that you can go to without having already made an arrangement

examples.en: a walk-in wardrobe
examples.trans: 步入式衣櫥，衣帽間

examples.en: a walk-in refrigerator
examples.trans: 步入式冰箱

all_entries.meaning_vi: dời lên ngày sớm hơn / làm gì đó trước thời hạn / trước thời hạn

all_entries.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
all_entries.definition_en: A walk-on part in a play is a very small part in which the actor is on the stage for a short time and speaks very few or no words.
all_entries.translation: （戲劇裡的）跑龍套角色，小角色
all_entries.meaning_vi: đóng vai nhỏ
all_entries.translation_zh: （戲劇裡的）跑龍套角色，小角色

all_entries.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
all_entries.definition_en: the price you pay for something such as a ticket if you buy it just before using it, rather than buying it some time earlier

examples.en: Tickets booked online for the same day will be charged at the full walk-up price.
examples.trans: 當天網上訂購的票價為全價，跟臨時購買的價格一樣。

all_entries.meaning_vi: giá

all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: If you walk/tread a tightrope, you have to deal with a difficult situation, especially one involving making a decision between two opposing plans of action.
all_entries.translation: 走鋼絲；（尤指因進退兩難而）處境危險

all_entries.meaning_vi: nguyên nhân / nguồn gốc / nguyên nhân gốc / lý do

all_entries.word: what more do you want jam on it
all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: used to say that someone should be grateful for what they have or have been offered, and not demand something better
all_entries.translation: 知足常樂（用來表示某人應對其所擁有的或別人所提供的表示感激，而不應當得寸進尺）

examples.en: They've given him a holiday in Italy. What more does he want - jam on it?
examples.trans: 他們已經讓他到義大利度假。他還想要甚麼呢？不要得寸進尺！

all_entries.meaning_vi: nghĩa đen: được tấc muốn thước (thành ngữ); nghĩa bóng: không hài lòng với lợi nhỏ / cho hắn một tấc, sẽ muốn một thước
all_entries.translation_zh: 知足常樂（用來表示某人應對其所擁有的或別人所提供的表示感激，而不應當得寸進尺）

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: used to rudely say that you do not think something is important
all_entries.translation: 那又怎麼樣呢？那又有甚麼關係？

examples.en: "That's the third time you've done that!" "Yeah, what of it?"
examples.trans: 「你那樣做已經是第三次了！」「是啊，那又怎麼樣呢？」

all_entries.meaning_vi: như thế nào? / thế nào? / ra sao? / mọi thứ sao rồi?
all_entries.translation_zh: 那又怎麼樣呢？那又有甚麼關係？

all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: said when you think it is possible that the admiration, success, etc. that has been achieved was not worth all the suffering it has caused
all_entries.translation: 名聲／勝利／成功等又有甚麼用？

examples.en: What price victory when so many people have died in the struggle?
examples.trans: 這麼多人在這場鬥爭中失去了生命，勝利又有甚麼用呢？

all_entries.meaning_vi: chiến thắng
all_entries.translation_zh: 名聲／勝利／成功等又有甚麼用？

all_entries.word: what sb is really made of
all_entries.topic: Cảm xúc, Thái độ & Tâm lý (Emotions, Attitudes & Psychology)
all_entries.definition_en: how strong, clever, or brave someone is

examples.en: The race next week will be a chance for her to show what she's made of.
examples.trans: 下周的賽跑是她大顯身手的機會。

all_entries.meaning_vi: tài liệu gốc / câu chuyện gốc

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: said to mean that you must do whatever a particular person says
all_entries.translation: （某人）怎麽說就得怎麽做；服從（某人的）命令

examples.en: Around here, kid, what I say, goes!
examples.trans: 老兄，在這裡，我怎麽說就怎麽做！

all_entries.meaning_vi: mệnh lệnh / lệnh
all_entries.translation_zh: （某人）怎麽說就得怎麽做；服從（某人的）命令

all_entries.topic: Cảm xúc, Thái độ & Tâm lý (Emotions, Attitudes & Psychology)
all_entries.definition_en: used to give force to something you feel angry about
all_entries.translation: （用於增強憤怒的語氣）到底…？ 究竟…？

examples.en: What the blazes did he do that for?
examples.trans: 他到底為甚麽那麽做?

all_entries.meaning_vi: cuối cùng / rốt cuộc / khi tất cả đã được nói và làm / xét cho cùng / đến cuối cùng / đến tận cùng
all_entries.translation_zh: （用於增強憤怒的語氣）到底…？ 究竟…？

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: used to say that you will do something although you know you should not do it
all_entries.translation: 管它的（表示要做明知不應該做的事）

examples.en: The doctor said I shouldn't drink, but what the heck.
examples.trans: 醫生說我不能喝酒，管他的。

all_entries.meaning_vi: nên / phải / cần
all_entries.translation_zh: 管它的（表示要做明知不應該做的事）

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: said when you suddenly realize that your plan is not important to you and that you will do something else

examples.en: I was supposed to be working this evening but what the hell - I'll see you at the bar in half an hour.
examples.trans: 今晚我本來應該工作的，但這也沒關係——我們半小時後酒吧見。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không sao đâu

all_entries.word: what with one thing and another
all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: You say what with one thing and another when you want to explain that the reason you have failed to do something is because you have been very busy.
all_entries.translation: 因為事情一件接著一件，因為忙得不可開交

examples.en: What with one thing and another, I forgot to call you yesterday.
examples.trans: 由於昨天事情一件接著一件，我忘了給你打電話。

all_entries.meaning_vi: rất (bận rộn, v.v.)
all_entries.translation_zh: 因為事情一件接著一件，因為忙得不可開交

all_entries.word: what you lose on the swings you gain on the roundabouts
all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: said to mean that the positive and negative results of a situation or action balance each other
all_entries.translation: 有得也有失；有利也有弊；失之東隅，收之桑榆

examples.en: "The route through town would be shorter, but there'll be more traffic." "Well, it's just swings and roundabouts."
examples.trans: 「穿過市鎮的這條路更近一些，但是車也更多。」「哦！就是有利也有弊。」

all_entries.meaning_vi: mất ở chỗ này nhưng được ở chỗ kia (thành ngữ) / bù đắp sau cho mất mát ban đầu / cái mất ở đu quay, cái được ở vòng quay
all_entries.translation_zh: 有得也有失；有利也有弊；失之東隅，收之桑榆

all_entries.word: what you see is what you get
all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: said to show that there is nothing hidden

examples.en: See also
examples.trans: WYSIWYG

all_entries.meaning_vi: Thấy gì có nấy (WYSIWYG)

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: short form of what is or what has
all_entries.translation: （what is 或 what has 的縮略形式）

examples.en: What's (= what is) that stuff on your forehead?
examples.trans: 你前額上的是什麼東西？

examples.en: They want a list of what's (= what has) been stolen.
examples.trans: 他們想要一個失竊物品的清單。

all_entries.meaning_vi: bề ngoài / hình thức / hình dáng
all_entries.translation_zh: （what is 或 what has 的縮略形式）

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: used to ask about what is happening or what someone is planning
all_entries.translation: 發生甚麽事了？怎麽回事？要做什麼？

examples.en: Hi there! What's cooking? Are we going out?
examples.trans: 嗨！要做什麼？你要出去嗎？

all_entries.meaning_vi: gì? / điều gì đó; bất kỳ điều gì
all_entries.translation_zh: 發生甚麽事了？怎麽回事？要做什麼？

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: said when you cannot change something that has already happened
all_entries.meaning_vi: cho đến nay / đến giờ

all_entries.topic: Cảm xúc, Thái độ & Tâm lý (Emotions, Attitudes & Psychology)
all_entries.definition_en: used to ask why someone seems angry or upset

examples.en: Jack's in a strange mood - I wonder what's eating him?
examples.trans: 傑克今天脾氣怪怪的，甚麼事讓他那麼煩啊？

all_entries.meaning_vi: 是甚麽使…煩心？

all_entries.word: what s it worth to you
all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: said when you want to know what someone will give you if you give them the piece of information they have asked for

examples.en: "Do you know where Dave's living now?" "What's it worth?"
examples.trans: 「你知不知道戴夫現在住在哪裡？」「告訴你對我有甚麼好處？」

all_entries.meaning_vi: dễ hòa hợp

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: used to say that you think something is very good, and that nobody could disagree with your opinion
all_entries.translation: （表示認為非常好）有什麼不好的呢？

examples.en: It's a big house with a swimming pool. What's not to like?
examples.trans: 一座帶著游泳池的大屋，還能有什麼不好的呢？

all_entries.meaning_vi: không tốt
all_entries.translation_zh: （表示認為非常好）有什麼不好的呢？

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: used to mean "what is happening". This phrase is often used as the title of the part of a newspaper that tells you about events and entertainment happening in the next week or month.
all_entries.translation: 正在發生的事（常用在報紙的標題中，用來預告下週或下個月將發生的大事或娛樂事件）
all_entries.meaning_vi: tháng sau
all_entries.translation_zh: 正在發生的事（常用在報紙的標題中，用來預告下週或下個月將發生的大事或娛樂事件）

all_entries.word: what s sauce for the goose is sauce for the gander
all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: said to emphasize that if one person is allowed to do something or to behave in a particular way, then another person must be allowed to do that thing or behave in that way, too
all_entries.translation: 適用於此者也應適用於彼；應該一視同仁
all_entries.meaning_vi: đối xử với mọi người một cách công bằng (thành ngữ); không phân biệt đối xử giữa người với người
all_entries.translation_zh: 適用於此者也應適用於彼；應該一視同仁

all_entries.word: what s sth in aid of
all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: said when you want to know the reason for something

examples.en: What's all this shouting in aid of?
examples.trans: 這大喊大叫的到底怎麼回事？

all_entries.meaning_vi: có chuyện gì vậy? / chuyện gì đang xảy ra? / sao có thể như vậy? / làm sao mà như thế? / tất cả là sao?

all_entries.word: what s that all about then
all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: used when you do not understand why something or someone is so popular or fashionable
all_entries.translation: （用於表示不理解為甚麼某人或某物如此流行）那算是甚麼?

examples.en: Pierced tongues - what's that about, then?
examples.trans: 在舌頭上穿孔——那算是甚麼？

all_entries.meaning_vi: từ chối thừa nhận / không chú ý đến / làm ngơ / phớt lờ
all_entries.translation_zh: （用於表示不理解為甚麼某人或某物如此流行）那算是甚麼?

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: used to say that it is very likely that something is true or will happen
all_entries.translation: 很可能（是真的或會發生）

examples.en: What's the betting Dan forgets to bring the tickets?
examples.trans: 丹十之八九會忘了帶票，你敢打賭嗎？

all_entries.meaning_vi: có thể (xảy ra) / có khả năng / có xác suất / khả năng / xác suất / có lẽ / có thể
all_entries.translation_zh: 很可能（是真的或會發生）

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: used to ask someone why they have done something annoying

examples.en: What's the big idea? I was watching that programme!
examples.trans: 你怎麼回事？我正在看那個節目呢！

all_entries.meaning_vi: ý tưởng / ý kiến / nghĩa / ước nguyện / mong muốn / hứng thú / vui / lòng biết ơn, tình cảm, v.v.

all_entries.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
all_entries.definition_en: used to ask how much you have to pay for something
all_entries.meaning_vi: số lượng; mức độ / phần nào

all_entries.word: what s the drill for sth
all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: used to ask what the usual, correct way of doing or getting something is
all_entries.translation: 通常都怎麽辦？正確的步驟是甚麽？

examples.en: What's the drill for getting paid for my expenses?
examples.trans: 報銷費用的步驟是什麼？

all_entries.meaning_vi: như thế nào? / cái gì? / tại sao?
all_entries.translation_zh: 通常都怎麽辦？正確的步驟是甚麽？

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: said to a child who has not said "please" when asking for something
all_entries.translation: 該怎麼說呢？（讓孩子要東西時說「請」字的用語）
all_entries.meaning_vi: Sao lại như vậy?; Sao thế?
all_entries.translation_zh: 該怎麼說呢？（讓孩子要東西時說「請」字的用語）

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: used to ask someone about what is going to happen, especially when arrangements have been confused
all_entries.translation: （尤指安排被打亂時）情況怎麽樣？

examples.en: What's the score, then - are they coming?
examples.trans: 情況怎麽樣？——他們要來嗎？

all_entries.meaning_vi: sắp xếp / lên kế hoạch / tổ chức / sự sắp xếp / kế hoạch
all_entries.translation_zh: （尤指安排被打亂時）情況怎麽樣？

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: used to tell someone to stop worrying because worrying will not help
all_entries.translation: （用於勸告某人不要爲某事擔心）…有甚麽用?

examples.en: Try not to get depressed - after all, what's the use of worrying?
examples.trans: 不要沮喪——話說回來，擔心又有甚麽用呢？

all_entries.meaning_vi: đừng!; không được
all_entries.translation_zh: （用於勸告某人不要爲某事擔心）…有甚麽用?

all_entries.word: what s the world coming to
all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: something you say that means that life is not as pleasant or safe as it was in the past
all_entries.translation: 世界變成什麼樣了？（抱怨生活不像過去那樣舒適或安全了）

examples.en: What's the world coming to when you can't leave your house for five minutes without someone trying to break in and rob you?
examples.trans: 現在你離開家僅五分鐘就可能遭人進屋洗劫，這是甚麼世道啊！

all_entries.meaning_vi: loại gì?; dạng gì?
all_entries.translation_zh: 世界變成什麼樣了？（抱怨生活不像過去那樣舒適或安全了）

all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: used to ask someone what the problem is

examples.en: What's up - why does everyone look so serious?
examples.trans: 怎麼了——為甚麼大家看起來都這麼嚴肅？

examples.en: What's up with Terry?
examples.trans: 特裡怎麼了？

all_entries.meaning_vi: Có chuyện gì vậy? / Chuyện gì đang xảy ra? / Chuyện gì đã xảy ra?

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: the facts of a situation

examples.en: Gloria will know what's what.
examples.trans: 格洛裡亞知道真相。

all_entries.meaning_vi: sự việc; vấn đề; điều; công việc

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: something you ask when you want to know what someone is doing or secretly planning to do
all_entries.translation: 你在玩甚麽把戲？你在搞甚麽鬼？

examples.en: The porter saw me climbing over the wall and shouted "Hey you, what's your game?"
examples.trans: 守門人看到我翻牆，大聲叫道：「哎，你在搞甚麽鬼？」

all_entries.meaning_vi: xiếc; ảo thuật / mánh khóe; chiêu trò
all_entries.translation_zh: 你在玩甚麽把戲？你在搞甚麽鬼？

all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: used for referring to a woman or girl when you cannot remember or do not know her name
all_entries.translation: 名叫某某的她，某個她（用於忘記女子的名字時）

examples.en: I gave the report to what's-her-name - the new marketing assistant.
examples.trans: 我把報告給了那個叫甚麼來著——就是那個新的市場助理。

all_entries.meaning_vi: gọi là / tên là
all_entries.translation_zh: 名叫某某的她，某個她（用於忘記女子的名字時）

all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: used for referring to a man or boy when you cannot remember or do not know his name
all_entries.translation: 名叫某某的他，某個他（用於忘記男子的名字時）

examples.en: Have you invited Mike Whats-his-name to the party?
examples.trans: 你邀請那個叫麥克甚麼甚麼的來參加聚會了嗎？

all_entries.meaning_vi: gọi là / tên là
all_entries.translation_zh: 名叫某某的他，某個他（用於忘記男子的名字時）

all_entries.word: what how why etc in the world
all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: used to emphasize your surprise when asking a question
all_entries.translation: （用在疑問句中強調很吃驚）究竟，到底

examples.en: What in the world are you doing in the cupboard?
examples.trans: 你究竟在碗櫃裡做什麼呢？

examples.en: Who in the world could do such a thing?
examples.trans: 到底有誰能做這樣的事？

all_entries.meaning_vi: câu hỏi (ngữ pháp) / câu nghi vấn
all_entries.translation_zh: （用在疑問句中強調很吃驚）究竟，到底

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: used to mean that you have to do what someone says
all_entries.translation: 不管（某人）說甚麼，都要按其說的去做

examples.en: It was Helen's idea and what Helen says goes.
examples.trans: 那是海倫的主意，她怎麼說就怎麼做。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không quan tâm / bất kể / dù sao đi nữa
all_entries.translation_zh: 不管（某人）說甚麼，都要按其說的去做

all_entries.word: what where how why the devil
all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: used to give emphasis to a question

examples.en: What the devil are you doing?
examples.trans: 你到底在做甚麼？

examples.en: Where the devil have you been?
examples.trans: 你究竟去了哪裡？

all_entries.meaning_vi: cuối cùng / rốt cuộc / khi tất cả đã được nói và làm / xét cho cùng / đến cuối cùng / đến tận cùng

all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: If a person has a wheat complexion, the skin on their face is light brown in colour.
all_entries.meaning_vi: lúa mì

all_entries.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
all_entries.definition_en: to turn round quickly

examples.en: She wheeled round to face him and saw him take out a gun.
examples.trans: 她快速轉身面對他，看到他掏出了手槍。

all_entries.meaning_vi: nhanh; tốc độ cao; mau lẹ

all_entries.topic: Con người, Tính cách & Mối quan hệ (People, Character & Relationships)
all_entries.definition_en: to use something or someone that you have used many times before in a way that is boring for other people
all_entries.translation: 反復使用（致使他人厭煩）；重施故技
