all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: used to say that you think an offer or arrangement is good
all_entries.translation: 價格再公道不過了；協定的條件已很優厚了
all_entries.meaning_vi: chỉ / chỉ là / không nhiều hơn / nhưng / tuy nhiên / dù sao (để trở lại chủ đề trước) / không thể hơn (sau tính từ)
all_entries.translation_zh: 價格再公道不過了；協定的條件已很優厚了

all_entries.word: you can t teach an old dog new tricks
all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: said to mean that it is very difficult to teach someone new skills or to change someone's habits or character
all_entries.meaning_vi: Khó thay đổi bản chất của một người (thành ngữ). Bạn không thể thay đổi con người mình được. / Báo khó lòng bỏ vằn. (Giê-rê-mi 13:23)

all_entries.word: you can t win em all
all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: something you say that means it is not possible to succeed at everything you do
all_entries.translation: 不可能凡事都成功；有得必有失

examples.en: It would have been great to get the job but I suppose you can't win 'em all.
examples.trans: 能得到那份工作就好了，但是不可能事事都如意的。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không thể / không thể nào / không có khả năng
all_entries.translation_zh: 不可能凡事都成功；有得必有失

all_entries.word: you can depend on upon it
all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: you can be certain

examples.en: You haven't heard the last of this, depend upon it.
examples.trans: 你還不知道此事的最新消息，這一點是可以肯定。

all_entries.meaning_vi: có thể / được / khả thi / có khả năng / không tệ / khá tốt

all_entries.word: you could cut the atmosphere with a knife
all_entries.topic: Cảm xúc, Thái độ & Tâm lý (Emotions, Attitudes & Psychology)
all_entries.definition_en: used to describe a situation in which everyone is feeling very angry or nervous and you feel that something unpleasant could soon happen
all_entries.meaning_vi: có thể xảy ra bất cứ lúc nào / bên bờ vực

all_entries.word: you could have heard a pin drop
all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: something that you say in order to describe a situation where there was complete silence, especially because people were very interested or very surprised by what was happening

examples.en: Margaret's ex-husband turned up at the wedding. Honestly, you could have heard a pin drop.
examples.trans: 瑪格麗特的前夫出現在婚禮現場。老實說，當時全場真是鴉雀無聲。

all_entries.meaning_vi: nghĩa đen: quạ và chim sẻ đều không kêu / yên lặng tuyệt đối (thành ngữ); không nghe thấy một tiếng động nào / yên lặng tuyệt đối

all_entries.word: you could have knocked me down over with a feather
all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: said when you are extremely surprised
all_entries.translation: （用來表示自己極度吃驚）你嚇死我了！
all_entries.meaning_vi: bị giật mình / bị sốc / ngạc nhiên
all_entries.translation_zh: （用來表示自己極度吃驚）你嚇死我了！

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: used either to express surprise or lack of surprise in a humorous and slightly unkind way
all_entries.translation: （表示驚訝）不會這樣吧！不至於吧！（幽默且不太客氣地表示並不驚訝）我就知道！

examples.en: "He's lost his job." "You don't say!"
examples.trans: 「他丟掉了工作。」「不會吧！」

all_entries.meaning_vi: không đến mức; không tệ như
all_entries.translation_zh: （表示驚訝）不會這樣吧！不至於吧！（幽默且不太客氣地表示並不驚訝）我就知道！

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: used to say that you will quickly do what someone has asked you to do
all_entries.translation: （用於表示很快就完成對方要求你做的事情）

examples.en: "Would you get me a coffee?" "Sure, you got it!"
examples.trans: 「你能幫我拿杯咖啡麼？」「沒問題，馬上就來。」

all_entries.meaning_vi: sự việc; vấn đề; điều; công việc
all_entries.translation_zh: （用於表示很快就完成對方要求你做的事情）

all_entries.word: you have got to be kidding
all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: informal also you must be kidding used to show that you are very surprised by what someone has said and do not accept it
all_entries.translation: （表示對某人的話非常驚訝而且不相信是真的）別開玩笑了

examples.en: You want me to drive into the city? You’ve got to be kidding.
examples.trans: 你想讓我開車去城裡？別開玩笑了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: đùa giỡn; chế nhạo; nói đùa
all_entries.translation_zh: （表示對某人的話非常驚訝而且不相信是真的）別開玩笑了

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: said for emphasis when you are describing how good or bad an experience is
all_entries.translation: （表示強調）你不知道，你難以想像

examples.en: Flying a plane is wonderful, you have no idea.
examples.trans: 你不知道駕駛飛機有多棒。

examples.en: You have no idea how embarrassed I was.
examples.trans: 你不知道我當時有多尷尬。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không biết / không hay / vô tình / không thừa nhận (thất bại, khó khăn, mệt mỏi, v.v.)
all_entries.translation_zh: （表示強調）你不知道，你難以想像

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: said before giving an opinion or a piece of information
all_entries.translation: （用於告知意見或資訊之前）要我告訴你嗎？你聽說了嗎？

examples.en: You know something? I don't think I like that man.
examples.trans: 聽我說，我想我不喜歡那個人。

examples.en: You know what? I think it's time to go home.
examples.trans: 要我告訴你嗎？我想該回家了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: trước / trước khi / cách đây / trước đó
all_entries.translation_zh: （用於告知意見或資訊之前）要我告訴你嗎？你聽說了嗎？

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: said when you hear or discover something that is surprising
all_entries.translation: （表示對得知的東西感到驚訝）真想不到

examples.en: I had no idea they were related. Oh well, you live and learn.
examples.trans: 我一點都沒想到他們之間還有聯繫。唉，真是想不到啊。

all_entries.meaning_vi: bất ngờ / khó tưởng tượng / không ngờ tới / ai mà ngờ rằng
all_entries.translation_zh: （表示對得知的東西感到驚訝）真想不到

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: it would be very interesting to know
all_entries.translation: （表示…耐人尋味）你覺得出奇吧

examples.en: How could Jonathan afford to buy a new car? You may well ask.
examples.trans: 喬納森怎麼買得起新車的呢？你感到出奇吧？

all_entries.meaning_vi: gợi suy nghĩ / đáng để nghiền ngẫm / cung cấp thức ăn cho tư duy
all_entries.translation_zh: （表示…耐人尋味）你覺得出奇吧

all_entries.word: you might as well be hung for a sheep as for a lamb
all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: said to mean that because the punishment for a bad action and an even worse one will be the same, you have no reason not to do the worse one
all_entries.translation: 既然懲罰都一樣，我還不如索性做得更差些。
all_entries.meaning_vi: thà rằng ... / chi bằng ...
all_entries.translation_zh: 既然懲罰都一樣，我還不如索性做得更差些。

all_entries.word: you pays your money and you takes your choice chance
all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: said to someone who must decide between different things and accept the results of their decision
all_entries.meaning_vi: thử vận may / để mọi thứ tùy cơ hội

all_entries.word: you pays your money and you takes your choice chance
all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: You are responsible for your decisions and cannot blame anyone else when what you have chosen is not successful.
all_entries.translation: 自己選擇自己承擔後果。
all_entries.meaning_vi: hậu quả / hệ quả
all_entries.translation_zh: 自己選擇自己承擔後果。

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: used to say that you agree with what has just been said
all_entries.translation: 你說對了！正是如此！沒錯！

examples.en: "How stupid of me to lend him that money!" "You said it!"
examples.trans: 「我借錢給他，真傻。」「沒錯！」

all_entries.meaning_vi: như thế; như vậy; như là
all_entries.translation_zh: 你說對了！正是如此！沒錯！

all_entries.word: you scratch my back and i ll scratch yours
all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: used to tell someone that if they help you, you will help them
all_entries.translation: 你幫我，我也幫你；我們互謀其利
all_entries.meaning_vi: chúng tôi; chúng ta; bản thân chúng ta; của chúng tôi
all_entries.translation_zh: 你幫我，我也幫你；我們互謀其利

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: used to say that someone is very unlikely to get what they want
all_entries.translation: （用於告訴某人其幾乎不可能如願）但願你走運！

examples.en: "She's going to ask for a salary increase." "She should be so lucky!"
examples.trans: 「她打算要求加薪。」「但願她走運吧！」

all_entries.meaning_vi: không thể / không thể nào / không có khả năng
all_entries.translation_zh: （用於告訴某人其幾乎不可能如願）但願你走運！

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: used to tell someone that they are spending too much time doing things that are boring or not important
all_entries.translation: 你應該做點更有意義的事；別老憋在家裡做些雞毛蒜皮的事

examples.en: "I arranged all my CDs in alphabetical order." "Mmm, I think you should get out more, Mike."
examples.trans: 「我把所有的光碟都按字母順序排好了。」「哦，我覺得你倒不如出去做些更有意思的事，麥克。」

all_entries.meaning_vi: nghĩa đen: lông gà và vỏ tỏi (thành ngữ) / nghĩa bóng: chuyện vặt vãnh
all_entries.translation_zh: 你應該做點更有意義的事；別老憋在家裡做些雞毛蒜皮的事

all_entries.word: you should have seen heard sth sb
all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: seeing or hearing something or someone would have interested or entertained you very much
all_entries.translation: 你真該看看／聽聽（某事或某人）

examples.en: You should have seen her - she was furious!
examples.trans: 你真該看看她那時的模樣——她大發脾氣！

all_entries.meaning_vi: một việc nào đó / một sự việc nhất định
all_entries.translation_zh: 你真該看看／聽聽（某事或某人）

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: said when thanking someone who has given you a present, to mean that you did not expect it
all_entries.translation: （當別人給你禮物時，用來表示你沒有期待如此）

examples.en: Flowers! You shouldn't have!
examples.trans: 「給我的鮮花！你不必送的！」

all_entries.meaning_vi: người khác; những người khác
all_entries.translation_zh: （當別人給你禮物時，用來表示你沒有期待如此）

all_entries.topic: Tiền bạc, Giá trị & Lợi ích (Money, Cost & Benefits)
all_entries.definition_en: if you do not pay attention and do something quickly, someone else will do it instead of you
all_entries.translation: 一旦不留神就會被人搶先
all_entries.meaning_vi: trong trường hợp (điều gì đó xảy ra) / nếu / một khi (điều gì đó xảy ra, thì...) / khi / trong thời gian ngắn / trong một ngày
all_entries.translation_zh: 一旦不留神就會被人搶先

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: used to praise a person who has done something well
all_entries.translation: （用於稱讚）做得不錯，老兄！真有你的！
all_entries.meaning_vi: Bạn thật là gì đó! / Bạn thật tuyệt vời!
all_entries.translation_zh: （用於稱讚）做得不錯，老兄！真有你的！

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: something you say to someone who has persuaded you to do something that you did not intend to do, especially when that person has used force and you are angry
all_entries.translation: （好吧）你贏了！（用於表示被說服，尤指對方使用強制辦法時）

examples.en: Okay, you win - you can go to the party! But you'd better be home by midnight!
examples.trans: 好了，你贏了——你可以去參加這個聚會！不過最好半夜前回來！

all_entries.meaning_vi: sử dụng / tận dụng / áp dụng
all_entries.translation_zh: （好吧）你贏了！（用於表示被說服，尤指對方使用強制辦法時）

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: short form of you had

examples.en: It happened just after you'd left the room.
examples.trans: 你剛離開房間，事情就發生了。

examples.en: You'd be much warmer in your black jacket.
examples.trans: 你穿上那件黑色的外套會暖和很多。

all_entries.meaning_vi: bề ngoài / hình thức / hình dáng

all_entries.definition_en: short form of you would

examples.trans: 你剛離開房間，事情就發生了。

examples.en: You'd be much warmer in your black jacket.
examples.trans: 你穿上那件黑色的外套會暖和很多。

all_entries.meaning_vi: bề ngoài / hình thức / hình dáng

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: short form of you will

examples.en: You'll remember to tell her, won't you?
examples.trans: 你會記得告訴她，對吧？

all_entries.meaning_vi: bề ngoài / hình thức / hình dáng

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: short form of you are

examples.en: You're so nice to me!
examples.trans: 你對我真是太好了！

all_entries.meaning_vi: bề ngoài / hình thức / hình dáng

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: something you say to someone when they have been nice and helpful to you
all_entries.translation: （表示感激某人）你真是個大好人！
all_entries.meaning_vi: biết ơn / cảm kích / cảm ơn
all_entries.translation_zh: （表示感激某人）你真是個大好人！

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: said by children playing a guessing or searching game to tell the person who is guessing or searching that he or she is getting further away from the answer or hidden object
all_entries.translation: （兒童遊戲時用語）你距離（答案或目標）更遠了；你猜得越來越離譜了
all_entries.meaning_vi: ngày càng...
all_entries.translation_zh: （兒童遊戲時用語）你距離（答案或目標）更遠了；你猜得越來越離譜了

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: used to show that you think that what someone has just said is not reasonable or fair

examples.en: £500 to cut down a tree - you're having a laugh, mate!
examples.trans: 500英鎊砍一棵樹——老兄，你簡直是在開玩笑！

all_entries.meaning_vi: đùa giỡn; chế nhạo; nói đùa

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: used as a way of expressing agreement to something happening

examples.en: "I'll give you £50 for your bike." "You're on!"
examples.trans: 「我出50英磅買你的腳踏車。」「成交！」

all_entries.meaning_vi: (về ai đó) bày tỏ; phát biểu; cho thấy / (về điều gì đó) biểu thị; có nghĩa; cho thấy / sự biểu đạt; sự thể hiện

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: used to say that you strongly agree with what someone has just said
all_entries.translation: 那還用說！你說的太對了！

examples.en: "Stephen's in such a bad mood today." "You're telling me!"
examples.trans: 「斯蒂芬今天心情很不好。」「那還用說！」

all_entries.meaning_vi: Đúng rồi! / À, đúng rồi, ... (khi đột nhiên nhớ ra điều muốn nói) / À, nhân tiện, ...
all_entries.translation_zh: 那還用說！你說的太對了！

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: short form of you have

examples.en: You've dropped something.
examples.trans: 你掉了什麼東西。

all_entries.meaning_vi: bề ngoài / hình thức / hình dáng

all_entries.word: you ve got nothing to lose
all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: used to say that you cannot make things worse, or cause any disadvantages for yourself by doing a particular thing
all_entries.translation: 不會有任何損失；不會有任何壞處

examples.en: Why don't you take the job? You've got nothing to lose.
examples.trans: 你為甚麽不接受這份工作？這對你不會有任何壞處。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không có khả năng / không có khả năng xảy ra / sẽ không (hành động, xảy ra v.v.) / không thể / không biết làm việc gì đó / (khẩu ngữ) (Đài Loan) đừng nhắc đến / không có chi
all_entries.translation_zh: 不會有任何損失；不會有任何壞處

all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: said when you can see something funny in a difficult situation
all_entries.translation: 還是值得一笑，還有可笑之處
all_entries.meaning_vi: đáng / đáng để
all_entries.translation_zh: 還是值得一笑，還有可笑之處

all_entries.word: you ve made your bed now lie in it
all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)
all_entries.definition_en: said to someone who must accept the unpleasant results of something they have done
all_entries.meaning_vi: (thành ngữ) gieo gió gặt bão; tự làm tự chịu

all_entries.topic: Thành công, Nỗ lực & Thử thách (Success, Effort & Challenges)
all_entries.definition_en: used for telling someone that when they consider all the facts and figures, something cannot succeed or be possible
all_entries.translation: 你自己算算（表示讓人自己考慮各種因素，並得出結論）
all_entries.meaning_vi: mỗi loại; mọi loại; các loại khác nhau
all_entries.translation_zh: 你自己算算（表示讓人自己考慮各種因素，並得出結論）

all_entries.topic: Giao tiếp, Lời nói & Ứng xử (Communication, Speech & Behavior)

examples.en: Just zip it - I'm tired of listening to you complain.
examples.trans: 住嘴——我聽夠你抱怨了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: ngậm miệng lại / Câm đi!

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to fasten a piece of clothing by using its zip, or to help someone close the zip on a piece of clothing they are wearing
all_entries.translation: 拉上…的拉鏈；幫（某人）拉上拉鏈

examples.en: Could you zip me up, please?
examples.trans: 請幫我拉上拉鏈，好嗎？

examples.en: Zip up your jacket, it's cold out there.
examples.trans: 把上衣的拉鏈拉上，外面很冷。

all_entries.meaning_vi: dây kéo
all_entries.translation_zh: 拉上…的拉鏈；幫（某人）拉上拉鏈

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: a long thick wire attached between two points, one higher than the other, that you can move along quickly while hanging from a small wheel, as entertainment or as a way of travelling above and across something
all_entries.translation: 高空滑索，高空飛索，單索滑降

examples.en: Activities include archery, zip wire, and abseiling.
examples.trans: 活動包括射箭、單索滑降和繞繩下降。

examples.en: The elevated zip line will take guests on a 50-mph ride across the forest canopy.
examples.trans: 架高的鋼索將讓遊客以每小時50英里的速度飛越森林的樹冠層。

all_entries.meaning_vi: độ cao lớn
all_entries.translation_zh: 高空滑索，高空飛索，單索滑降

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: in basketball and some other sports, a system of defending in which each player is responsible for defending an area rather than an opposing player
all_entries.meaning_vi: khu vực / vùng / quận

all_entries.topic: Thời gian, Cơ hội & Thay đổi (Time, Opportunity & Change)
all_entries.definition_en: to stop paying attention and not hear or see what is around you for a short period of time

examples.en: When the men start talking about football, I just zone out.
examples.trans: 男人們一開始談論足球，我就走神了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: tinh thần / tâm trí / ý thức / suy nghĩ / tâm lý / tinh hoa / cốt lõi

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: formal for
all_entries.meaning_vi: zoo

all_entries.topic: Cuộc sống & Tình huống thường ngày (Life & Everyday Situations)
all_entries.definition_en: to notice and give special attention to something

examples.en: Henry immediately zoomed in on the weakest part of my argument.
examples.trans: 亨利馬上注意到我論據中最薄弱的部分。

all_entries.meaning_vi: khác thường; đặc biệt / rất; đặc biệt; đặc biệt là / đặc biệt; cho một mục đích cụ thể / (thường theo sau bởi 是[shi4]) đặc biệt là
